				return att
			end
			return nil
		end

			end
			return CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)

local propTable = {
	Name = "Actor",
	BaseClass = "Model",
}

return {
	class = "Actor",

	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local bindedToMessage = {}
		local bindedToMessageParallel = {}

		local zune_task = zune.task

		-- description: "Sends a message to the actor's thread."
		-- args: "topic: string, ...: any"
		function instance:SendMessage(topic, ...)
			if bindedToMessage[topic] then
				for _, cb in ipairs(bindedToMessage[topic]) do
					if zune_task then
						zune_task.spawn(cb, ...)
					end
				end
			end
			if bindedToMessageParallel[topic] then
				for _, cb in ipairs(bindedToMessageParallel[topic]) do
					-- Parallel execution context simulation via desync
					if zune_task then
						zune_task.spawn(function(...)
							local thread = coroutine.running()
							if thread then
								zune_task.defer(thread)
								coroutine.yield()
							end
							cb(...)
						end, ...)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function createConnection(list, topic, callback)
			return {
				-- description: "Disconnects."
				Disconnect = function()
					local listeners = list[topic]
					if listeners then
						for i = #listeners, 1, -1 do
							if listeners[i] == callback then
								table.remove(listeners, i)
								break
							end
						end
					end
				end,
				Connected = true,
			}
		end

		-- description: "Binds to message."
		-- args: "topic: string, callback: function"
		function instance:BindToMessage(topic, callback)
			if not bindedToMessage[topic] then
				bindedToMessage[topic] = {}
			end
			table.insert(bindedToMessage[topic], callback)
			return createConnection(bindedToMessage, topic, callback)
		end

		-- description: "Binds to message parallel."
		-- args: "topic: string, callback: function"
		function instance:BindToMessageParallel(topic, callback)
			if not bindedToMessageParallel[topic] then
				bindedToMessageParallel[topic] = {}
			end
			table.insert(bindedToMessageParallel[topic], callback)
			return createConnection(bindedToMessageParallel, topic, callback)
		end

		return instance
	end,
	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

  Code: -- description: "Manages animation playback, blending, and control for animated objects."
local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")

-- description: "Copies."
-- args: "tbl: table"
local function copy(tbl)
	local out = {}
	for k, v in pairs(tbl or {}) do
		out[k] = v
	end
	return out
end

-- description: "Merges pose."
-- args: "basePose: any, layerPose: any"
local function mergePose(basePose, layerPose)
	if type(layerPose) ~= "table" then
		return basePose
	end

	for bindingName, bindingPose in pairs(layerPose) do
		if type(bindingPose) == "table" and type(bindingPose.ToTable) ~= "function" then
			local target = basePose[bindingName]
			if type(target) ~= "table" or type(target.ToTable) == "function" then
				target = {}
				basePose[bindingName] = target
			end
			for segmentName, segmentPose in pairs(bindingPose) do
				target[segmentName] = segmentPose
			end
		else
			basePose[bindingName] = bindingPose
		end
	end

	return basePose
end

local propTable = {
	Name = "Animator",
	Clock = 0,
	SpeedScale = 1,
	UseDefaultAnimations = true,
	PoseProvider = nil,
	DefaultProvider = nil,
	-- NOTE: PoseLayers, State, and AnimationPlayed are intentionally
	-- NOT in this shared table; they are created fresh per instance below.
}

return {
	class = "Animator",
	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance.AnimationPlayed = signal.new()
		instance.PoseLayers = {}
		instance.State = {}

		-- description: "Sets the Pose Provider."
		-- args: "provider: number"
		function instance:SetPoseProvider(provider)
			instance.PoseProvider = provider
		end

		-- description: "Adds a pose layer."
		-- args: "name: string, layer: number"
		function instance:AddPoseLayer(name, layer)
			local layers = copy(instance.PoseLayers)
			layers[name] = layer
			instance.PoseLayers = layers
		end

		-- description: "Removes a pose layer."
		-- args: "name: string"
		function instance:RemovePoseLayer(name)
			local layers = copy(instance.PoseLayers)
			layers[name] = nil
			instance.PoseLayers = layers
		end

		-- description: "Sets the Default Provider."
		-- args: "provider: number"
		function instance:SetDefaultProvider(provider)
			instance.DefaultProvider = provider
		end

		-- description: "Resets clock."
		-- args: "value: number"
		function instance:ResetClock(value)
			instance.Clock = value or 0
		end

		-- description: "Advances."
		-- args: "dt: number"
		function instance:Advance(dt)
			dt = type(dt) == "number" and dt or 0
			local newClock = (instance.Clock or 0) + dt * (instance.SpeedScale or 1)
			instance.Clock = newClock
			return newClock
		end

		-- description: "Sets the State Value."
		-- args: "key: number, value: number"
		function instance:SetStateValue(key, value)
			local stateTable = copy(instance.State)
			stateTable[key] = value
			instance.State = stateTable
		end

		-- description: "Gets the Stat eValue."
		-- args: "key: number"
		function instance:GetStateValue(key)
			local stateTable = instance.State or {}
			return stateTable[key]
		end

		-- description: "Gets the Pose."
		-- args: "target: table, context: table"
		function instance:GetPose(target, context)
			local pose = instance._cachedPose
			if not pose then
				pose = {}
				instance._cachedPose = pose
			else
				for k, v in pairs(pose) do
					if type(v) == "table" and type(v.ToTable) ~= "function" then
						table.clear(v)
					else
						pose[k] = nil
					end
				end
			end

			local defaultProvider = instance.DefaultProvider
			if instance.UseDefaultAnimations ~= false and type(defaultProvider) == "function" then
				pose = mergePose(pose, defaultProvider(instance, target, context))
			end

			local provider = instance.PoseProvider
			if type(provider) == "function" then
				pose = mergePose(pose, provider(instance, target, context))
			end

			for _, layer in pairs(instance.PoseLayers or {}) do
				if type(layer) == "function" then
					pose = mergePose(pose, layer(instance, target, context))
				elseif type(layer) == "table" then
					pose = mergePose(pose, layer)
				end
			end

			return pose
		end

		-- description: "Steps animation."
		-- args: "target: table, context: table"
		function instance:StepAnimation(target, context)
			local runtimeContext
			if type(context) == "table" then
				runtimeContext = context
			else
				runtimeContext = {}
			end

			if runtimeContext.advanceClock ~= false then
				instance:Advance(runtimeContext.dt or 0)
			end

			if runtimeContext.clock == nil then
				runtimeContext.clock = instance.Clock
			end
			runtimeContext.animatorState = instance.State

			local pose = instance:GetPose(target, runtimeContext)
			instance.AnimationPlayed:Fire(target, runtimeContext, pose)
			return pose
		end

		return instance
	end,
	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local lib, const = raylib.lib, raylib.const

local propTable = {
	Color = Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
	Adornee = nil,
	CastShadows = false,
	Name = "Handles",
}

local function toVector(v)
	return vector.create(v.X, v.Y, v.Z)
end

local function drawArcRing(center, radius, axis, segments, color)
	segments = segments or 64
	local step = (math.pi * 2) / segments

	local prevPoint = nil

	for i = 0, segments do
		local a = i * step
		local x = math.cos(a) * radius
		local y = math.sin(a) * radius

		local point
		if axis == "X" then
			point = center + Vector3.new(0, x, y)
		elseif axis == "Y" then
			point = center + Vector3.new(x, 0, y)
		elseif axis == "Z" then
			point = center + Vector3.new(x, y, 0)
		end

		if prevPoint then
			lib.DrawLine3D(toVector(prevPoint), toVector(point), color)
		end

		prevPoint = point
	end
end

return {
	class = "ArcHandles",

	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		propTable.render = function(handles, renderer)
			if handles.Adornee then
				local part = handles.Adornee

				local pos = part.Position
				local size = part.Size
				local scale = math.max(size.X, size.Y, size.Z) * 1.2

				local radius = scale * 0.9

				drawArcRing(pos, radius, "X", 64, const.RED)
				drawArcRing(pos, radius, "Y", 64, const.GREEN)
				drawArcRing(pos, radius, "Z", 64, const.BLUE)
			end
		end

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

  Code: -- description: "Represents an attachment in 2d, usually used for 2D Physics."
local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")

local propTable = {
	-- local transform
	Position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
	Rotation = 0, -- radians

	BaseClass = "Attachment2D",

	-- api
	-- description: "Gets the World Position."
	-- args: "self: table"
	-- returns: "Vector2"
	GetWorldPosition = function(self)
		local parent = self.Parent
		if not parent then
			return self.Position
		end

		local parentPos = parent.WorldPosition or parent.Position
		local parentRot = parent.Rotation or 0

		local c = math.cos(parentRot)
		local s = math.sin(parentRot)

		local x = self.Position.X * c - self.Position.Y * s
		local y = self.Position.X * s + self.Position.Y * c

		return parentPos + Vector2.new(x, y)
	end,

	-- description: "Gets the World Rotation."
	-- args: "self: table"
	-- returns: "number"
	GetWorldRotation = function(self)
		local parentRot = (self.Parent and self.Parent.Rotation) or 0
		return parentRot + self.Rotation

return {
	class = "BallSocketConstraint",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		local KinemiumPhysicsService = datamodel:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local _activeConstraint = nil

		-- description: "Cleans up the resources."
		local function cleanup()
			if _activeConstraint then
				local jolt = KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt
				if jolt and jolt.lib and jolt.physicsSystem then
					jolt.lib.JPH_PhysicsSystem_RemoveConstraint(jolt.physicsSystem, _activeConstraint)
				end
				_activeConstraint = nil
			end
		end

		-- description: "Rebuilds the state."
		local function rebuild()
			cleanup()

			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end

			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1

			if not att0 or not att1 then
				return
			end

			local part0 = att0.Parent
			local part1 = att1.Parent

			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return
			end

			if not NetworkOwnership.ShouldSimulateConstraintForMachine(instance, datamodel) then
				return
			end

			if not KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part0) or not KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part1) then
				task.defer(rebuild)
				return
			end

			local wPos0 = part0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wPos1 = part1.CFrame * att1.Position

			_activeConstraint = KinemiumPhysicsService.CreateBallSocket(part0, part1, wPos0, wPos1)

			-- description: "Ons part changed."
			-- args: "prop: any"
			local function onPartChanged(prop)
				if prop == "Anchored" then
					task.defer(rebuild)
				end
			end

			if _activeConstraint then
				if part0 then
					part0.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
				end
				if part1 then
					part1.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
				end
			else
				task.defer(rebuild)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Draws the visual representation."
		local function drawGizmo()
			if not instance.Visible then
				return
			end
			local att0 = instance.Attachment0

				return
			end

			local wPos = att0.Parent.CFrame * att0.Position
			local color = instance.Color
			local rlColor = raylib.structs.Color:new({
				r = color.R * 255,
				g = color.G * 255,
				b = color.B * 255,
				a = 200,
			})

			rl.DrawSphere(vector.create(wPos.X, wPos.Y, wPos.Z), instance.Radius, rlColor)
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if prop == "Attachment0" or prop == "Attachment1" or prop == "Enabled" then
				rebuild()
			end
		end)

	return Vector2.new(lib.GetRenderWidth(), lib.GetRenderHeight())
end

local function getSizePixels(instance)
	if not instance.Size then
		return Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end

	local reference = getReferenceSize()

	local size = instance.Size:ToPixels(reference)

	return Vector2.new(size.X, size.Y)
end

local function getAdornee(instance)
	if instance.Adornee then
		return instance.Adornee
	end

	return instance.Parent
end

local function getWorldPosition(adornee, offsetLocal, offsetWorld)
	if not adornee then
		return nil
	end

	local basePos = nil

	if adornee.CFrame and adornee.CFrame.Position then
		basePos = adornee.CFrame.Position
	elseif adornee.Position then
		basePos = adornee.Position
	end

	if not basePos then
		return nil
	end

	local pos = basePos

	if offsetLocal and adornee.CFrame and adornee.CFrame.VectorToWorldSpace then
		pos = pos + adornee.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(offsetLocal)
	end

	if offsetWorld then
		pos = pos + offsetWorld
	end

	return pos
end

	class = "BillboardGui",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		if _G.IsHeadless or not renderer then
			return instance
		end

		local rtx = nil
		local rtxW = 0
		local rtxH = 0
		local render2dId = nil
		local render3dId = nil

		local function resetRenderTexture(width, height)
			local w = math.max(1, math.floor(width or 1))
			local h = math.max(1, math.floor(height or 1))
			if rtx then
				lib.UnloadRenderTexture(rtx)
			end

			rtx = lib.LoadRenderTexture(w, h)
			rtxW = w
			rtxH = h

			local tex = zune.mem.slice(rtx, structs.RenderTexture:offset("texture"), structs.Texture:size())
			lib.SetTextureFilter(tex, const.TextureFilter.TEXTURE_FILTER_TRILINEAR)
			lib.SetTextureWrap(tex, const.TextureWrap.TEXTURE_WRAP_CLAMP)
		end

		resetRenderTexture(1, 1)

		render2dId = renderer.Pool.new("2d", function()
			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end

			local sizePixels = getSizePixels(instance)

			if sizePixels.X <= 0 or sizePixels.Y <= 0 then
				return
			end

			if rtxW ~= math.floor(sizePixels.X) or rtxH ~= math.floor(sizePixels.Y) then
				resetRenderTexture(sizePixels.X, sizePixels.Y)
			end

			lib.BeginTextureMode(rtx)
			lib.ClearBackground(const.BLANK)

			for _, child in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				if child.render then
					child.render(lib, child, lib.GetFrameTime(), structs, renderer, datamodel)
				end
			end

			lib.EndTextureMode()
		end)

		render3dId = renderer.Pool.new("gizmo", function()
			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end

			if not rtx then
				return
			end

			local camera = instance.Camera or (datamodel and datamodel.Workspace and datamodel.Workspace.Camera)
			if not camera or not camera._raylibcam then
				return
			end

			local adornee = getAdornee(instance)

			local pos = getWorldPosition(adornee, instance.StudsOffset, instance.StudsOffsetWorldSpace)

			if not pos then
				return
			end

			local maxDist = instance.MaxDistance or 0

			if maxDist > 0 and camera.Position then
				local dx = pos.X - camera.Position.X

				local dy = pos.Y - camera.Position.Y

				local dz = pos.Z - camera.Position.Z

				if (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) > (maxDist * maxDist) then
					return
				end
			end

			local tex = zune.mem.slice(rtx, structs.RenderTexture:offset("texture"), structs.Texture:size())

			local texW = buffer.readi32(tex, 4)

			local texH = buffer.readi32(tex, 8)

			if texW <= 0 or texH <= 0 then
				return
			end

			local pixelsPerStud = instance.PixelsPerStud or 50

			if pixelsPerStud <= 0 then
				pixelsPerStud = 50
			end

			local sizeWorld = Vector2.new(texW / pixelsPerStud, texH / pixelsPerStud)

			local source = structs.Rectangle:new({
				x = 0,
				y = 0,
				width = texW,
				height = -texH,
			})

			local up = vector.create(0, 1, 0)

			if instance.AlwaysOnTop then
				lib.rlDisableDepthTest()
			end

			lib.DrawBillboardPro(
				camera._raylibcam,
				tex,
				source,
				vector.create(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z),
				up,
				vector.create(sizeWorld.X, sizeWorld.Y, 0),
				origin,
				0,
				const.WHITE
			)

			if instance.AlwaysOnTop then
				lib.rlEnableDepthTest()
			end
		end)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if render2dId then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(render2dId)
			end

			if render3dId then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(render3dId)
			end

			if rtx then
				lib.UnloadRenderTexture(rtx)

				rtx = nil
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,

local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local CFrame = require("@CFrame")

local propTable = {
	Part = nil,
	P = 500,
	D = 50,
	MaxTorque = Vector3.new(10000, 0, 10000),
	CFrame = CFrame.new(),
	Enabled = true,
	Name = "BodyGyro",
}

return {
	class = "BodyGyro",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local PhysicsService = game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")

		local function shouldApplyPhysics(part)
			local replicator = game:GetService("ReplicatorService")
			local ownership = replicator and replicator.NetworkOwnership or nil
			if ownership and ownership.ShouldSimulatePhysicsForMachine then
				return ownership.ShouldSimulatePhysicsForMachine(part, game)
			end

			if part == nil then
				return false
			end

			if part.NetworkOwner == nil then
				return IsServer == true
			end

			if IsClient ~= true then
				return false
			end

			local players = game:GetService("Players")
			return players.LocalPlayer ~= nil and players.LocalPlayer == part.NetworkOwner
		end

		renderer.EventBus:Connect(function(route)
			if route ~= "RenderStepped" then
				return
			end
			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end

			local part = instance.Part
			if not part or not shouldApplyPhysics(part) then
				return
			end

			local currentUp = part.CFrame:GetUpVector()
			local currentLook = part.CFrame:GetLookVector()
			local targetUp = instance.CFrame:GetUpVector()
			local targetLook = instance.CFrame:GetLookVector()
			local errorAxis = currentUp:Cross(targetUp) + currentLook:Cross(targetLook)

			local angVel = PhysicsService.GetAngularVelocity(part)

			local P = instance.P
			local D = instance.D
			local maxT = instance.MaxTorque

			local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
				return math.max(lo, math.min(hi, v))
			end

			local tx, ty, tz = 0, 0, 0

			if maxT.X ~= 0 then
				tx = clamp(errorAxis.X * P - angVel.X * D, -maxT.X, maxT.X)
			end
			if maxT.Y ~= 0 then
				ty = clamp(errorAxis.Y * P - angVel.Y * D, -maxT.Y, maxT.Y)
			end
			if maxT.Z ~= 0 then
				tz = clamp(errorAxis.Z * P - angVel.Z * D, -maxT.Z, maxT.Z)
			end

			PhysicsService.ApplyTorque(part, Vector3.new(tx, ty, tz))
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,

local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local CFrame = require("@CFrame")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")

_G.SecurityCapabilities = Enum.SecurityCapabilities.Internals

local lib = raylib.lib
local structs = raylib.structs
local const = raylib.const

local propTable = {
	FieldOfView = 70,
	CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)),
	Roll = 0, -- degrees
	Name = "Camera",
	CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable,
	CameraSubject = nil,
	Focus = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0),
}

local cameraSingleton = nil

return {
	class = "Camera",
	singleton = true,
	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		if cameraSingleton and not cameraSingleton.Destroyed then
			if cameraSingleton.CFrame == nil or cameraSingleton.CFrame.Position == nil then
				cameraSingleton.CFrame = propTable.CFrame
			end
			if cameraSingleton.FieldOfView == nil then
				cameraSingleton.FieldOfView = propTable.FieldOfView
			end
			if cameraSingleton.CameraType == nil then
				cameraSingleton.CameraType = propTable.CameraType
			end
			return cameraSingleton
		end

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		cameraSingleton = instance

		if IsHeadless then
			return instance
		end

		local camera = structs.Camera3D:new({
			position = vector.create(0, 0, 0),
			target = vector.create(0, 0, 0),
			up = vector.create(0, 1, 0),
			fovy = instance.FieldOfView,
			projection = const.CameraProjection.CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE,
		})

		instance._raylibcam = camera

		local function syncRaylibCamera()
			local camCF = instance.CFrame
			if camCF == nil or camCF.Position == nil then
				camCF = propTable.CFrame
				if camCF == nil or camCF.Position == nil then
					return
				end
				instance.CFrame = camCF
			end
			local rollRad = math.rad(instance.Roll or 0)

			instance.Position = camCF.Position
			local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
			instance.ViewportSize = Vector2.new(lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y)

			-- sync props to actual Camera object
			-- position
			zune.mem.writeVector3(camera, 0, vector.create(camCF.Position.X, camCF.Position.Y, camCF.Position.Z))

			-- target
			local look = camCF:GetLookVector()
			zune.mem.writeVector3(
				camera,
				12,
				vector.create(camCF.Position.X + look.X, camCF.Position.Y + look.Y, camCF.Position.Z + look.Z)
			)

			-- up
			local baseUp = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) -- hardcoded reference up

			-- apply roll around forward
			local cosR, sinR = math.cos(rollRad), math.sin(rollRad)
			local right = look:Cross(baseUp):Unit()
			local up = Vector3.new(
				baseUp.X * cosR + right.X * sinR,
				baseUp.Y * cosR + right.Y * sinR,
				baseUp.Z * cosR + right.Z * sinR
			)

			zune.mem.writeVector3(camera, 24, vector.create(up.X, up.Y, up.Z))

			-- fov
			buffer.writef32(camera, 36, instance.FieldOfView)

			if instance.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
				-- we aren't gonna do anything here, the user script will control it
			elseif instance.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Orbital then
				if not instance._orbital then
					local startPos = (instance.CFrame and instance.CFrame.Position) or Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
					local subject = instance.CameraSubject
					local pivot = (subject and subject:IsA("BasePart") and subject.Position) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					local offset = startPos - pivot
					local r = offset:Magnitude()
					if r < 0.1 then
						r = 8
					end

					instance._orbital = {
						yaw = math.atan2(-offset.X, -offset.Z),
						pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(offset.Y / r, -1, 1)),
						radius = r,
					}
				end

				local orb = instance._orbital
				local subject = instance.CameraSubject
				local pivot = (subject and subject.Position) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

				local delta = lib.GetMouseDelta()
				local rmb = lib.IsMouseButtonDown(const.MouseButton.MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT)
				local wheel = lib.GetMouseWheelMove()

				if rmb then
					orb.yaw = orb.yaw - math.rad(delta.x * 0.35)
					orb.pitch = math.clamp(orb.pitch - math.rad(delta.y * 0.35), math.rad(-80), math.rad(80))
				end

				if wheel ~= 0 then
					local CAM_ZOOM_MUL = 1.15
					if wheel > 0 then
						orb.radius = math.max(1, orb.radius / CAM_ZOOM_MUL)
					else
						orb.radius = math.min(200, orb.radius * CAM_ZOOM_MUL)
					end
				end

				local cosP = math.cos(orb.pitch)
				local camOffset = Vector3.new(
					orb.radius * cosP * -math.sin(orb.yaw),
					orb.radius * math.sin(orb.pitch),
					orb.radius * cosP * -math.cos(orb.yaw)
				)

				instance.Focus = CFrame.new(pivot)
				instance.CFrame = CFrame.new(pivot + camOffset, pivot)
			elseif instance.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Follow then
				if not instance._follow then
					local startPos = (instance.CFrame and instance.CFrame.Position) or Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
					local subject = instance.CameraSubject
					local pivot = (subject and subject.Position) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
					local offset = startPos - pivot
					local r = offset:Magnitude()
					if r < 0.1 then
						r = 8
					end

					instance._follow = {
						yaw = math.atan2(-offset.X, -offset.Z),
						pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(offset.Y / r, -1, 1)),
						radius = r,
						lastPivot = pivot,
					}
				end

				local flw = instance._follow
				local subject = instance.CameraSubject
				local pivot = (subject and subject.Position) or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

				local delta = lib.GetMouseDelta()
				local rmb = lib.IsMouseButtonDown(const.MouseButton.MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT)
				local wheel = lib.GetMouseWheelMove()

				if rmb then
					flw.yaw = flw.yaw - math.rad(delta.x * 0.35)
					flw.pitch = math.clamp(flw.pitch - math.rad(delta.y * 0.35), math.rad(-80), math.rad(80))
					flw.lastPivot = pivot
				else
					local subjectCF = subject and subject.CFrame
					if subjectCF then
						look = subjectCF:GetLookVector()
						local subjectYaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)

						local moved = (pivot - flw.lastPivot):Magnitude()
						if moved > 0.01 then
							local diff = subjectYaw - flw.yaw
							diff = ((diff + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi)) - math.pi
							flw.yaw = flw.yaw + diff * math.min(dt * 3, 1)
						end
					end
					flw.lastPivot = pivot
				end

				if wheel ~= 0 then
					local CAM_ZOOM_MUL = 1.15
					if wheel > 0 then
						flw.radius = math.max(1, flw.radius / CAM_ZOOM_MUL)
					else
						flw.radius = math.min(200, flw.radius * CAM_ZOOM_MUL)
					end
				end

				local cosP = math.cos(flw.pitch)
				local camOffset = Vector3.new(
					flw.radius * cosP * -math.sin(flw.yaw),
					flw.radius * math.sin(flw.pitch),
					flw.radius * cosP * -math.cos(flw.yaw)
				)

				instance.Focus = CFrame.new(pivot)
				instance.CFrame = CFrame.new(pivot + camOffset, pivot)
			end
		end

		syncRaylibCamera()
		renderer.Hook.new("Renderstep", syncRaylibCamera)

		return instance
	end,
	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,

  Code: -- description: "Renders descendant GUI objects as a single canvas."
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local lib = raylib.lib
local utils = require("@bufferutils")
local Color3 = require("@Color3")

local GuiObject = require("@GuiObject")

local propTable = {
	Name = "CanvasGroup",
	AbsoluteSize = nil,
	AbsolutePosition = nil,
	GroupColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	GroupTransparency = 0,
}

local function improveQuality(tex)
	local texture = utils.extract.texture(tex)
	raylib.lib.SetTextureFilter(texture, raylib.const.TextureFilter.TEXTURE_FILTER_TRILINEAR)
	raylib.lib.SetTextureWrap(texture, raylib.const.TextureWrap.TEXTURE_WRAP_CLAMP)
	raylib.lib.GenTextureMipmaps(texture)
end

GuiObject.inherit(propTable)

propTable.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
	if raylib.lib.IsWindowResized() == 1 then
		local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
		local width, height = lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y
		local texture = raylib.lib.LoadRenderTexture(width, height)
		if object._rendertex then
			raylib.lib.UnloadRenderTexture(object._rendertex)
		end
		object._rendertex = texture
		improveQuality(texture)
	end

	if not object.Visible then
		return
	end

	if object._rendertex then
		raylib.lib.BeginTextureMode(object._rendertex)
		raylib.lib.ClearBackground(raylib.const.BLANK)

		-- render gui objects
		local pos, size = GuiObject.render(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
		object.AbsolutePosition = pos
		object.AbsoluteSize = size
		GuiObject.renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
		raylib.lib.EndTextureMode()

		local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
		local W, H = lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y
		local source = raylib.structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = W, height = -H })
		local dest = raylib.structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = W, height = -H })

		lib.DrawTexturePro(
			utils.extract.texture(object._rendertex),
			source,
			dest,
			vector.create(0, 0),
			0,
			object.GroupColor3:ToRaylib(object.GroupTransparency)
		)
	end
end

return {
	class = "CanvasGroup",
	render = propTable.render,
	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
		local width, height = lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y
		local texture = raylib.lib.LoadRenderTexture(width, height)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance._rendertex = texture
		improveQuality(texture)
		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if instance._rendertex then
				raylib.lib.UnloadRenderTexture(instance._rendertex)
				instance._rendertex = nil
			end
		end)
		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		GuiObject.inherit(tble)
	end,
}

local function generateCursorImages(object)
	object._cache = {}
	local iconpack_path = zembed.AssetPath(object.IconPack)

	local entries = fs.entries(iconpack_path)

	for _, file in pairs(entries) do
		local kind = file.kind
		local name = file.name

		if kind == "file" then
			if string.find(name, ".cur") then
				--[[
				local filePath = iconpack_path .. "/" .. name
				local content = fs.readFile(filePath, true)
				if content then
					local newFilePath = string.gsub(filePath, name, "")
					newFilePath = newFilePath .. string.gsub(name, ".cur", ".png")
					fs.writeFile(newFilePath, content)
					object._cache[string.gsub(name, ".cur", "")] = raylib.lib.LoadTexture(newFilePath)
				end
                --]]
			elseif string.find(name, ".png") and not _G.IsHeadless then
				local filePath = fs.path.join(iconpack_path, name)
				object._cache[string.gsub(name, ".png", "")] = raylib.lib.LoadTexture(filePath)
			end
		end
	end

		arrow,

		structs.Rectangle:new({
			x = pos.x,
			y = pos.y,
			width = objectSize.X,
			height = objectSize.Y,
		}),
		vector.create(0, 0),
		0,
		raylib.const.WHITE
	)
end

							lib.DrawSphere(vector.create(worldPos.X, worldPos.Y, worldPos.Z), 0.1, const.ORANGE)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if renderId then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(renderId)
			end
		end)

	end,

local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local CFrame = require("@CFrame")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local r3d = require("@r3d")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local zembed = require("@zembed")

local rlib = r3d.lib
local r3dstructs = r3d.structs
local ffi = zune.ffi
local lib = raylib.lib
local const = raylib.const
local structs = raylib.structs

local propTable = {
	Transparency = 0,
	Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	Texture = "./src/assets/images/placeholder.png",
	ColorMapContent = "./src/assets/images/placeholder.png",
	Face = Enum.NormalId.Top,
	Adornee = nil,
	Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	Wrap = false,
	Depth = 0.1,
	NormalThreshold = 0,
	FadeWidth = 0,

local function getFaceSize(size, face)
	if face == Enum.NormalId.Front or face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		return size.X, size.Y
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Left or face == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		return size.Z, size.Y
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Top or face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
		return size.X, size.Z
	end
end

local function getFaceCFrame(cf, size, face)
	local half = size * 0.5
	local padding = 0.005 -- offset to prevent Z-fighting

	if face == Enum.NormalId.Front then
		return cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -half.Z - padding) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(180), 0)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		return cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, half.Z + padding) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(180), 0)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Left then
		return cf * CFrame.new(-half.X - padding, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-90), math.rad(90))
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		return cf * CFrame.new(half.X + padding, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-90), math.rad(90))
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Top then
		return cf * CFrame.new(0, half.Y + padding, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180), 0, 0)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
		return cf * CFrame.new(0, -half.Y - padding, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-180), 0, 0)
	end
end

local function buildBaseDecal()
	local decal = r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:new({})

	local albedo = r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:new({
		color = const.WHITE,
	})
	buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("albedo"), albedo, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size())

	local emission = r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:new({
		color = const.WHITE,
		energy = 0.0,
	})
	buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("emission"), emission, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:size())

	local normal = r3dstructs.R3D_NormalMap:new({
		scale = 1.0,
	})
	buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("normal"), normal, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_NormalMap:size())

	local orm = r3dstructs.R3D_OrmMap:new({
		occlusion = 1.0,
		roughness = 1.0,
		metalness = 0.0,
	})
	buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("orm"), orm, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_OrmMap:size())

	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("uvScale"), 1.0)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("uvScale") + 4, 1.0)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("alphaCutoff"), 0.01)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("normalThreshold"), 0.0)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("fadeWidth"), 0.0)
	buffer.writeu8(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("applyColor"), 1)

	return decal
end

local function resolveTextureSource(instance)
	if type(instance.ColorMapContent) == "table" and instance.ColorMapContent.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
		return instance.ColorMapContent
	end
	if type(instance.ColorMapContent) == "string" and instance.ColorMapContent ~= "" then
		return instance.ColorMapContent
	end
	if type(instance.Texture) == "table" and instance.Texture.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
		return instance.Texture
	end
	if type(instance.Texture) == "string" and instance.Texture ~= "" then
		return instance.Texture
	end
	return nil
end

local function loadAlbedoMap(path, color)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		return nil
	end
	path = zembed.AssetPath(path)

	local ok, data = pcall(zune.fs.readFileSync, path, true)
	if not ok or not data then
		return nil
	end

	local ext = lib.GetFileExtension(path)
	local okLoad, map = pcall(rlib.R3D_LoadAlbedoMapFromMemory, ext, data, buffer.len(data), color)
	if okLoad then
		return map
	end

	return nil
end

local function loadAlbedoMapFromEditable(editableImage, color)
	if not editableImage or not editableImage._image then
		return nil
	end

	local sizePtr = ffi.create(ffi.types.i32)
	local memPtr = lib.ExportImageToMemory(editableImage._image, ".png", sizePtr)
	if memPtr == ffi.null then
		return nil
	end

	local size = sizePtr:readi32(0)
	if not size or size <= 0 then
		lib.MemFree(memPtr)
		return nil
	end

	local data = buffer.create(size)
	for i = 0, size - 1 do
		buffer.writeu8(data, i, memPtr:readu8(i))
	end
	lib.MemFree(memPtr)

	local okLoad, map = pcall(rlib.R3D_LoadAlbedoMapFromMemory, ".png", data, size, color)
	if okLoad then
		return map
	end
	return nil
end

local function applyAlbedoColor(decal, color, transparency)
	local albedoColor = color:ToRaylib(transparency or 0)
	local offset = r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("albedo") + r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:offset("color")
	buffer.copy(decal, offset, albedoColor, 0, structs.Color:size())
end

local function applyDecalSettings(instance, decal)
	local normalThreshold = math.max(0, instance.NormalThreshold or 0)
	local fadeWidth = math.max(0, instance.FadeWidth or 0)

	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("normalThreshold"), normalThreshold)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("fadeWidth"), fadeWidth)
end

local function applyFaceOffset(cf, offset)
	if type(offset) ~= "table" or not offset.__type then
		return cf
	end

	if offset.__type == "Vector3" then
		return cf * CFrame.new(offset.X, offset.Y, offset.Z)
	elseif offset.__type == "Vector2" then
		return cf * CFrame.new(offset.X, offset.Y, 0)
	end

	return cf
end

return {
	class = "Decal",

	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local decal = buildBaseDecal()
		instance._r3dDecal = decal
		instance._decalHasMaps = false
		instance._decalLastPath = nil

		local function syncAlbedo(force)
			if _G.IsHeadless then
				return
			end
			local source = resolveTextureSource(instance)
			local color = instance.Color3:ToRaylib(instance.Transparency or 0)

			if not force and source == instance._decalLastPath then
				if type(source) == "table" and source.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
					if source._dirty or source._texture ~= instance._decalLastTexture then
						-- continue to rebuild
					else
						return
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end

			instance._decalLastPath = source

			local map = nil
			if type(source) == "table" and source.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
				if source._dirty then
					if source._texture then
						lib.UnloadTexture(source._texture)
					end
					source._texture = lib.LoadTextureFromImage(source._image)
					source._dirty = false
				end
				map = loadAlbedoMapFromEditable(source, color)
				instance._decalLastTexture = source._texture
			else
				map = loadAlbedoMap(source, color)
				instance._decalLastTexture = nil
			end

			if map then
				if instance._decalHasMaps then
					pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadDecalMaps, decal)
				end
				buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("albedo"), map, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size())
				instance._decalHasMaps = true
			else
				if instance._decalHasMaps then
					pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadDecalMaps, decal)
					instance._decalHasMaps = false
				end
				local fallback = r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:new({ color = color })
				buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("albedo"), fallback, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size())
			end

			applyAlbedoColor(decal, instance.Color3, instance.Transparency or 0)
		end

		syncAlbedo(true)
		applyDecalSettings(instance, decal)

		local renderId
		if renderer and renderer.DecalPool and renderer.Pool then
			renderId = renderer.Pool.new("3d", function()
				syncAlbedo(false)
				if instance.Transparency >= 1 then
					return
				end

				local adornee = instance.Adornee
				if not adornee or not adornee.CFrame or not adornee.Size then
					adornee = instance.Parent
				end
				if not adornee or not adornee.CFrame or not adornee.Size then
					return
				end

				local face = instance.Face
				local depth = math.max(0.001, instance.Depth or 0.1)
				local cf
				local scale

				if instance.Wrap == true then
					cf = adornee.CFrame
					scale = Vector3.new(adornee.Size.X + depth, adornee.Size.Y + depth, adornee.Size.Z + depth)
				else
					local width, height = getFaceSize(adornee.Size, face)
					if not width or not height then
						return
					end
					cf = getFaceCFrame(adornee.CFrame, adornee.Size, face)
					if not cf then
						return
					end
					scale = Vector3.new(width, depth, height)
				end

				cf = applyFaceOffset(cf, instance.Position)
				local matrix = cf:ToRaylibMatrixScale(scale, structs)

				renderer.DecalPool.DrawDecal(decal, matrix)
			end)
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property)
			if property == "Texture" or property == "ColorMapContent" then
				syncAlbedo(true)
			elseif property == "Color3" or property == "Transparency" then
				applyAlbedoColor(decal, instance.Color3, instance.Transparency or 0)
			elseif property == "NormalThreshold" or property == "FadeWidth" then
				applyDecalSettings(instance, decal)
			end
		end)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if renderId and renderer and renderer.Pool then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(renderId)
			end
			pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadDecalMaps, decal)
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,

	Visible = true,

local function renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer, pos, size)
	for _, child in pairs(object:GetChildren()) do
		if child.render then
			lib.BeginScissorMode(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y)
			child.render(lib, child, dt, structs, renderer)
			lib.EndScissorMode()
		end
	end
end

local function sanitizeOptions(options)
	local sanitized = {}
	for _, option in ipairs(type(options) == "table" and options or {}) do
		sanitized[#sanitized + 1] = tostring(option)
	end

	if #sanitized == 0 then
		sanitized[1] = "Option 1"
	end

	return sanitized
end

GuiObject.inherit(propTable)

return {
	class = "UIDropdown",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		local onSelectionChanged = signal.new()
		local dropdown = gui.dropdown({
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			width = 220,
			height = 36,
			options = sanitizeOptions(instance.Options),
			selectedIndex = instance.SelectedIndex,
			onSelect = function(index, option)
				instance.SelectedIndex = index
				instance.SelectedOption = option
				onSelectionChanged:Fire(index, option)
			end,
		})

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance.OnSelectionChanged = onSelectionChanged
		instance._dropdown = dropdown

		instance.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if object.Visible == false then
				return
			end

			local pos, size = GuiObject.calculatePositions(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			local options = sanitizeOptions(object.Options)
			local selectedIndex = math.clamp(tonumber(object.SelectedIndex) or 1, 1, #options)
			local selectedOption = options[selectedIndex]

			if object.SelectedIndex ~= selectedIndex then
				object.SelectedIndex = selectedIndex
			end
			if object.SelectedOption ~= selectedOption then
				object.SelectedOption = selectedOption
			end

			dropdown.set("obj_rect", arect.new(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y))
			dropdown.set("options", options)
			dropdown.set("selectedIndex", selectedIndex)
			dropdown.set("backgroundColor", object.BackgroundColor3)
			dropdown.set("hoverColor", object.HoverColor3)
			dropdown.set("selectedColor", object.SelectedColor3)
			dropdown.set("borderColor", object.BorderColor3)
			dropdown.set("textColor", object.TextColor3)
			dropdown.set("secondaryTextColor", object.SecondaryTextColor3)
			dropdown.set("fontSize", object.TextSize)

			dropdown.render(dt)
			renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer, pos, size)

			return pos, size
		end

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		GuiObject.inherit(tble)
	end,
}

		local function buildRawGeometry(self)
			local rawVertices = {}
			local indices = {}
			local vMap = {} -- hash -> zero-based index
			local counter = 0

			for faceId, face in pairs(self._faces) do
				for vi = 1, 3 do
					local vid = face[vi]
					local pos = self._vertices[vid] or Vector3.new()

					local nid = self:GetVertexFaceNormal(vid, faceId)
					local nor = self._normals[nid] or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

					local uvid = self:GetVertexFaceUV(vid, faceId)
					local uv = self._uvs[uvid] or Vector2.new()

					local cid = self:GetVertexFaceColor(vid, faceId)
					local c = self._colors[cid]
					local col = c and c.color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
					local alp = c and c.alpha or 1

					local hash = vid .. "_" .. nid .. "_" .. uvid .. "_" .. cid
					if not vMap[hash] then
						table.insert(rawVertices, {
							position = pos,
							normal = nor,
							uv = uv,
							color = {
								col.R * 255,
								col.G * 255,
								col.B * 255,
								alp * 255,
							},
						})
						vMap[hash] = counter
						counter += 1
					end
					table.insert(indices, vMap[hash])
				end
			end

			return rawVertices, indices
		end

			local workspace = game and game.Workspace or nil

			return tostring(id)
		end

		-- description: "Returns the id of the vertex nearest to the given point."
		-- args: "toThisPoint: Vector3"
		-- returns: "number"
		function instance:FindClosestVertex(toThisPoint: Vector3): number
			local closestId = 0
			local closestDist = math.huge
			for id, pos in pairs(self._vertices) do
				local dist = (pos - toThisPoint):Magnitude()
				if dist < closestDist then
					closestDist = dist
					closestId = id
				end
			end
			return closestId
		end

		-- description: "Returns vertex ids whose positions are inside or on a sphere."
		-- args: "center: Vector3, radius: number"
		-- returns: "{ number }"
		function instance:FindVerticesWithinSphere(center: Vector3, radius: number): { number }
			local res = {}
			for id, pos in pairs(self._vertices) do
				if (pos - center):Magnitude() <= radius then
					table.insert(res, id)
				end
			end
			return res
		end

		-- description: "Returns the average position of all vertices."
		-- returns: "Vector3"
		function instance:GetCenter(): Vector3
			local count = 0
			local sum = Vector3.new()
			for _, pos in pairs(self._vertices) do
				sum += pos
				count += 1
			end
			return count > 0 and (sum / count) or Vector3.new()
		end

		-- description: "Returns the axis-aligned bounding box size of the mesh vertices."
		-- returns: "Vector3"
		function instance:GetSize(): Vector3
			local min = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
			local max = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
			local count = 0
			for _, pos in pairs(self._vertices) do
				count += 1
				min = Vector3.new(math.min(min.x, pos.x), math.min(min.y, pos.y), math.min(min.z, pos.z))
				max = Vector3.new(math.max(max.x, pos.x), math.max(max.y, pos.y), math.max(max.z, pos.z))
			end
			return count > 0 and (max - min) or Vector3.new()
		end

		-- description: "Returns faces that share an edge with the given face."
		-- args: "faceId: number"
		-- returns: "{ number }"
		function instance:GetAdjacentFaces(faceId: number): { number }
			local f = self._faces[faceId]
			if not f then
				return {}
			end

			local vSet = { [f[1]] = true, [f[2]] = true, [f[3]] = true }
			local res = {}

			for fid, face in pairs(self._faces) do
				if fid ~= faceId then
					local shared = 0
					if vSet[face[1]] then
						shared += 1
					end
					if vSet[face[2]] then
						shared += 1
					end
					if vSet[face[3]] then
						shared += 1
					end
					if shared >= 2 then
						table.insert(res, fid)
					end
				end
			end
			return res
		end

		-- description: "Returns vertices connected to the given vertex by any face."
		-- args: "vertexId: number"
		-- returns: "{ number }"
		function instance:GetAdjacentVertices(vertexId: number): { number }
			local adjSet = {}
			for _, face in pairs(self._faces) do
				if face[1] == vertexId or face[2] == vertexId or face[3] == vertexId then
					if face[1] ~= vertexId then
						adjSet[face[1]] = true
					end
					if face[2] ~= vertexId then
						adjSet[face[2]] = true
					end
					if face[3] ~= vertexId then
						adjSet[face[3]] = true
					end
				end
			end
			local res = {}
			for v in pairs(adjSet) do
				table.insert(res, v)
			end
			return res
		end

		-- description: "Returns face ids that reference the given vertex."

		-- description: "Adds a bone definition and returns its bone id."

		-- description: "Builds renderable mesh data from the current faces, vertices, and attributes."
		-- args: "opts: { smooth: boolean?, flat: boolean?, generateTangents: boolean?, weld: boolean?, weldTolerance: number? }?"
		function instance:Triangulate(opts: any?)
			local rawVertices, indices = buildRawGeometry(self)

			if #rawVertices == 0 then
				self._mesh = nil
				self._meshgenHandle = nil
				self._cpuMeshData = nil
				self._geometryDirty = false
				notifyLinkedMeshParts()
				return
			end

			local buildOpts = {
				usage = meshgen.Usage.Dynamic,
				indicesAreZeroBased = true,
			}

			if opts then
				if opts.smooth then
					buildOpts.smooth = true
				elseif opts.flat then
					buildOpts.flat = true
				end

				if opts.generateTangents then
					buildOpts.generateTangents = true
				end

				if opts.weld then
					buildOpts.weld = true
					buildOpts.weldTolerance = opts.weldTolerance
				end
			end

			-- Use buildMeshWithData to retain the CPU-side R3D_MeshData for raycasting.
			local result = meshgen.buildMeshWithData(rawVertices, indices, buildOpts)
			if result then
				self._cpuMeshData = result[1]
				self._mesh = result[2]
				self._meshgenHandle = result[2]
			else
				self._cpuMeshData = nil
				self._mesh = nil
				self._meshgenHandle = nil
			end
			self._geometryDirty = false
			notifyLinkedMeshParts()
		end

		-- description: "Rebuilds mesh data only when geometry has changed."
		-- args: "opts: { smooth: boolean?, flat: boolean?, generateTangents: boolean?, weld: boolean?, weldTolerance: number? }?"
		function instance:FlushIfDirty(opts: any?)
			if self._geometryDirty then
				self:Triangulate(opts)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Creates planar UVs for vertices along an axis and assigns them to each face corner."
		-- args: "axis: string?, scale: { number }?, offset: { number }?"
		function instance:ApplyUVProjection(axis: string?, scale: { number }?, offset: { number }?)
			local vertList = {}
			local idToIdx = {}
			for vid, pos in pairs(self._vertices) do
				local idx = #vertList + 1
				vertList[idx] = { position = pos }
				idToIdx[vid] = idx
			end

			meshgen.uvPlanar(vertList, axis, scale, offset)

			for vid, idx in pairs(idToIdx) do
				local projUV = vertList[idx].uv
				if projUV then
					local newUvId = self:AddUV(Vector2.new(projUV[1], projUV[2]))
					for fid in pairs(self._faces) do
						local f = self._faces[fid]
						if f and (f[1] == vid or f[2] == vid or f[3] == vid) then
							self:SetVertexFaceUV(vid, fid, newUvId)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			self._geometryDirty = true
		end

		-- description: "Recomputes face corner normals from the current geometry."
		-- args: "smooth: boolean"
		function instance:RecalculateNormals(smooth: boolean?)
			local rawVertices, indices = buildRawGeometry(self)
			if #rawVertices == 0 then
				return
			end

			meshgen.recalculateNormals(rawVertices, indices, smooth)

			for i, v in ipairs(rawVertices) do
				if v.normal then
					local n = v.normal
					local nx = type(n) == "table" and (n[1] or n.x or n.X) or 0
					local ny = type(n) == "table" and (n[2] or n.y or n.Y) or 1
					local nz = type(n) == "table" and (n[3] or n.z or n.Z) or 0
					local nid = self:AddNormal(Vector3.new(nx, ny, nz))
					local triIdx = math.floor((i - 1) / 3)
					local cornerIdx = ((i - 1) % 3) + 1
					local faceId = nil
					local faceCount = 0
					for fid in pairs(self._faces) do
						if faceCount == triIdx then
							faceId = fid
							break
						end
						faceCount += 1
					end
					if faceId then
						local face = self._faces[faceId]
						self:SetVertexFaceNormal(face[cornerIdx], faceId, nid)
					end
				end
			end

			self._geometryDirty = true
		end

		-- description: "Computes a welded vertex remap using the given merge tolerance."
		-- args: "mergeTolerance: number"
		-- returns: "{ [number]: number }"
		function instance:MergeVertices(mergeTolerance: number): any
			local rawVertices, indices = buildRawGeometry(self)
			if #rawVertices == 0 then
				return {}
			end

			local weldedVerts, weldedIndices = meshgen.weldVertices(rawVertices, indices, mergeTolerance)

			local remap = {}
			for i, wIdx in ipairs(weldedIndices) do
				remap[i - 1] = wIdx
			end

			self._geometryDirty = true
			return remap
		end

		-- description: "Raycasts against mesh triangles in local space."
		-- args: "origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3"
		-- returns: "Vector3?, Vector3?, number?, number?"
		function instance:RaycastLocal(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3)
			local minT = math.huge
			local closestHit = nil
			local closestNorm = nil
			local closestFace = 0

			for fid, face in pairs(self._faces) do
				local v0 = self._vertices[face[1]]
				local v1 = self._vertices[face[2]]
				local v2 = self._vertices[face[3]]
				if v0 and v1 and v2 then
					local edge1 = v1 - v0
					local edge2 = v2 - v0
					local h = direction:Cross(edge2)
					local a = edge1:Dot(h)
					if math.abs(a) > 1e-8 then
						local f = 1.0 / a
						local s = origin - v0
						local u = f * s:Dot(h)
						if u >= 0 and u <= 1.0 then
							local q = s:Cross(edge1)
							local v = f * direction:Dot(q)
							if v >= 0 and u + v <= 1.0 then
								local t = f * edge2:Dot(q)
								if t > 0 and t < minT then
									minT = t
									closestHit = origin + direction * t
									closestNorm = edge1:Cross(edge2):Unit()
									closestFace = fid
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if closestHit then
				return closestHit, closestNorm, closestFace, minT
			end
			return nil
		end

		-- description: "Returns the closest surface point, distance, and face id for a local-space point."
		-- args: "point: Vector3"
		-- returns: "Vector3, number, number"
		function instance:FindClosestPointOnSurface(point: Vector3)
			local closestP = nil
			local closestDist = math.huge
			local closestFace = 0

			for fid, face in pairs(self._faces) do
				local v0 = self._vertices[face[1]]
				local v1 = self._vertices[face[2]]
				local v2 = self._vertices[face[3]]
				if v0 and v1 and v2 then
					local edge1 = v1 - v0
					local edge2 = v2 - v0
					local n = edge1:Cross(edge2)
					local lenSq = n:Dot(n)

					local proj
					if lenSq > 1e-12 then
						local d = n:Dot(v0)
						local t = (n:Dot(point) - d) / lenSq
						local pp = point - n * t

						-- Barycentric check
						local function bary(p, a, b, c)
							local v0b = b - a
							local v1b = c - a
							local v2b = p - a
							local d00 = v0b:Dot(v0b)
							local d01 = v0b:Dot(v1b)
							local d11 = v1b:Dot(v1b)
							local d20 = v2b:Dot(v0b)
							local d21 = v2b:Dot(v1b)
							local denom = d00 * d11 - d01 * d01
							if math.abs(denom) < 1e-12 then
								return 0, 0
							end
							local sv = (d11 * d20 - d01 * d21) / denom
							local tv = (d00 * d21 - d01 * d20) / denom
							return sv, tv
						end

						local sv, tv = bary(pp, v0, v1, v2)
						if sv >= 0 and tv >= 0 and sv + tv <= 1 then
							proj = pp
						end
					end

					if not proj then
						local d0 = (v0 - point):Magnitude()
						local d1 = (v1 - point):Magnitude()
						local d2 = (v2 - point):Magnitude()
						if d0 <= d1 and d0 <= d2 then
							proj = v0
						elseif d1 <= d2 then
							proj = v1
						else
							proj = v2
						end
					end

					local d = (proj - point):Magnitude()
					if d < closestDist then
						closestDist = d
						closestP = proj
						closestFace = fid
					end
				end
			end

			return closestP or Vector3.new(), closestDist, closestFace
		end

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function()
		return propTable
	end,
}

  Code: -- description: "Stores a file from disk."
local propTable = {
	Name = "File",
	Size = 0,
	FilePath = "",

	_file = nil,
}

return {
	class = "File",
	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if prop == "FilePath" then
				local success, buf = pcall(function()
					return zune.fs.readFile(instance.FilePath, true)
				end)

				if success and buf then
					instance._file = buf
					instance.Size = buffer.len(buf)
				end
			end
		end)

		function instance:GetBinaryContents(returnBuffer)
			if type(returnBuffer) ~= "boolean" then
				return
			end
			if returnBuffer then
				return instance._file
			else
				return buffer.tostring(instance._file)
			end
		end

		function instance:Write(data)
			if typeof(data) == "string" then
				data = buffer.fromstring(data)
			end

			local oldBuffer = instance._file or buffer.create(0)
			local oldSize = buffer.len(oldBuffer)
			local newSize = oldSize + buffer.len(data)

			local newBuffer = buffer.create(newSize)

			buffer.copy(newBuffer, 0, oldBuffer)
			buffer.copy(newBuffer, oldSize, data)

			instance._file = newBuffer
			instance.Size = newSize

			if instance.FilePath ~= "" then
				zune.fs.writeFile(instance.FilePath, newBuffer)
			end
		end

		function instance:GetTemporaryId()
			-- compat
			return instance.FilePath
		end

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

-- description: "Builds color sequence."
-- args: "primary: number, secondary: number"
local function buildColorSequence(primary, secondary)
	return ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, secondary),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, primary),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.new(0.15, 0.02, 0)),
	})
end

-- description: "Builds size sequence."
-- args: "size: number"
local function buildSizeSequence(size)
	local scale = math.max(0, size)
	return NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, scale * 0.35),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, scale),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
	})
end

-- description: "Builds transparency sequence."
-- args: "modifier: number"
local function buildTransparencySequence(modifier)
	local alpha = math.clamp(modifier or 0, 0, 1)
	return NumberSequence.new({
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, alpha),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, alpha + (1 - alpha) * 0.35),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
end

local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")

local Color3 = require("@Color3")

local ffi = zune.ffi

local U32_MOD = 4294967296

local function readPtr64(buf: buffer, offset: number): number
	local lo = buffer.readu32(buf, offset)
	local hi = buffer.readu32(buf, offset + 4)
	return lo + hi * U32_MOD
end

local function ptrFromStructField(structBuf: buffer, fieldOff: number): any
	local addr = readPtr64(structBuf, fieldOff)
	if addr == 0 then
		return ffi.null
	end
	local b = buffer.create(8)
	local hi = math.floor(addr / U32_MOD)
	local lo = addr - hi * U32_MOD
	buffer.writeu32(b, 0, lo)
	buffer.writeu32(b, 4, hi)
	return ffi.ptrFromAddress(b)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- Math helpers
-- ============================================================================

local function normalize3(x: number, y: number, z: number): (number, number, number)
	local len = math.sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)
	if len < 1e-8 then
		return 0, 1, 0
	end
	local inv = 1 / len
	return x * inv, y * inv, z * inv
end

local function makeF32Buf(v: number): buffer
	local b = buffer.create(4)
	buffer.writef32(b, 0, v)
	return b
end

local function makeVec2Buf(x: number, y: number): buffer
	local b = buffer.create(8)
	buffer.writef32(b, 0, x)
	buffer.writef32(b, 4, y)
	return b
end

-- ============================================================================
-- Visual-only wave ripple math (overlaid on top of the simulated heights)
-- Each wave: { height, speed, scale, dirX, dirZ, phase }
-- ============================================================================

local TWO_PI = math.pi * 2

local function waveDisplacement(x: number, z: number, t: number, waves: { any }): number
	local y = 0
	for i = 1, #waves do
		local w = waves[i]
		local k = w.scale * TWO_PI
		local ph = k * (w.dirX * x + w.dirZ * z) - w.speed * k * t + w.phase
		y += w.height * math.sin(ph)
	end
	return y
end

local function waveNormal(x: number, z: number, t: number, waves: { any }): (number, number, number)
	local dydx, dydz = 0, 0
	for i = 1, #waves do
		local w = waves[i]
		local k = w.scale * TWO_PI
		local ph = k * (w.dirX * x + w.dirZ * z) - w.speed * k * t + w.phase
		local d = w.height * k * math.cos(ph)
		dydx += d * w.dirX
		dydz += d * w.dirZ
	end
	return normalize3(-dydx, 1.0, -dydz)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- Water surface shader
-- Uses TIME built-in (no manual time uniform needed).
-- R3D_NO_AUTO_FETCH ΓåÆ we own every output; opaque+transparent both pre-compiled.
-- ============================================================================

local WATER_SHADER_SRC = [[
#pragma usage opaque transparent
#define R3D_NO_AUTO_FETCH

uniform vec4  u_tint;
uniform float u_roughness;
uniform vec2  u_flow_uv;

void fragment() {
    vec2  uv = TEXCOORD;

    float r1 = sin(uv.x * 9.0  + TIME * 1.9 + u_flow_uv.x)
             * sin(uv.y * 9.0  + TIME * 1.6 + u_flow_uv.y) * 0.07;
    float r2 = sin(uv.x * 17.0 - TIME * 2.3 + u_flow_uv.y * 0.6)
             * sin(uv.y * 17.0 - TIME * 2.1 + u_flow_uv.x * 0.6) * 0.04;

    float ripple = r1 + r2;
    vec3  col    = clamp(u_tint.rgb + vec3(ripple * 0.15, ripple * 0.08, -ripple * 0.04),
                         vec3(0.0), vec3(1.0));

    ALBEDO    = col;
    ROUGHNESS = clamp(u_roughness - abs(ripple) * 0.15, 0.02, 1.0);
    METALNESS = 0.0;
    OCCLUSION = 1.0;
    ALPHA     = clamp(u_tint.a + ripple * 0.08, 0.05, 1.0);
}
]]

local OFF_MAT_CULL = nil
local OFF_MAT_SHADER = nil
local SIZE_MAT = nil

local function ensureOffsets()
	if OFF_MAT_TRANSPARENCY then
		return
	end
	OFF_MAT_TRANSPARENCY = r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("transparencyMode")
	OFF_MAT_CULL = r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("cullMode")
	OFF_MAT_SHADER = r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("shader")
	SIZE_MAT = r3dstructs.R3D_Material:size()
end
