		local offCached = false

		--  Simulation state
		local simW = math.max(4, math.min(64, math.floor(instance.SimResolution or 16)))
		local simH = simW
		local simGrid: { number } = {} -- [z*simW + x + 1] = water height (0..Size.Y)
		local simInitialised = false

		--  Visual mesh state
		-- gridPositions[i] = {worldX, worldZ, u, v}
		local gridPositions: { { number } } = {}
		local vertCount = 0

		-- Visual ripple waves
		local activeWaves: { any } = {}

		-- Shader uniform buffers (stay alive; pointer must remain valid)
		local ubTint = buffer.create(16)
		local ubRough = makeF32Buf(0.07)
		local ubFlowUV = makeVec2Buf(0, 0)

		-- Flow UV accumulator
		local flowAccumU = 0
		local flowAccumV = 0

		--  Drain connections
		-- Each entry: { target=FluidSim, wx, wz, thresholdH, flowMult }
		local drainConnections: { any } = {}

		--  Buoyancy tracking
		local submergedSet: { [any]: boolean } = {}

		-- Container signature (cheap change-detection)
		local lastContainerSig = ""

		--  Event flags
		local wasEmpty = false

		-- ====================================================================
		-- SIMULATION GRID
		-- ====================================================================

		local function simIndex(x: number, z: number): number
			return z * simW + x + 1
		end

		local function initGrid()
			local level = math.clamp(instance.WaterLevel or 0.5, 0, 1) * instance.Size.Y
			for z = 0, simH - 1 do
				for x = 0, simW - 1 do
					simGrid[simIndex(x, z)] = level
				end
			end
			simInitialised = true
		end

		-- Bilinear sample of the simulation grid at normalised coords (lx,lz in 0..1)
		local function sampleGrid(lx: number, lz: number): number
			local gx = math.clamp(lx * (simW - 1), 0, simW - 1)
			local gz = math.clamp(lz * (simH - 1), 0, simH - 1)
			local x0 = math.floor(gx)
			local z0 = math.floor(gz)
			local x1 = math.min(x0 + 1, simW - 1)
			local z1 = math.min(z0 + 1, simH - 1)
			local fx = gx - x0
			local fz = gz - z0

			local h00 = simGrid[simIndex(x0, z0)] or 0
			local h10 = simGrid[simIndex(x1, z0)] or 0
			local h01 = simGrid[simIndex(x0, z1)] or 0
			local h11 = simGrid[simIndex(x1, z1)] or 0

			return h00 * (1 - fx) * (1 - fz) + h10 * fx * (1 - fz) + h01 * (1 - fx) * fz + h11 * fx * fz
		end

		-- Convert world XZ ΓåÆ normalised [0..1] grid coordinates
		local function worldToNorm(wx: number, wz: number): (number, number)
			local pos = instance.Position
			local size = instance.Size
			return (wx - pos.X + size.X * 0.5) / size.X, (wz - pos.Z + size.Z * 0.5) / size.Z
		end

		-- Water surface Y at a world position (bilinear sim + wave overlay)
		local function surfaceYAt(wx: number, wz: number, t: number?): number
			local pos = instance.Position
			local size = instance.Size
			local floorY = pos.Y - size.Y * 0.5
			local lx, lz = worldToNorm(wx, wz)
			lx = math.clamp(lx, 0, 1)
			lz = math.clamp(lz, 0, 1)
			local simH_val = sampleGrid(lx, lz)
			local wave = 0
			if t and #activeWaves > 0 then
				wave = waveDisplacement(wx, wz, t, activeWaves) * math.clamp(simH_val / 0.1, 0, 1)
			end
			return floorY + simH_val + wave
		end

		-- Total water volume in the sim (sum of all cell heights ├ù cell area)
		local function totalWater(): number
			local sum = 0
			for i = 1, simW * simH do
				sum = sum + (simGrid[i] or 0)
			end
			return sum / (simW * simH) -- average height (convenient 0..Size.Y range)
		end

		--  Simulation step
		local function stepSimulation(dt: number)
			local maxH = instance.Size.Y
			local flowFac = math.clamp((instance.FlowRate or 0.7) * dt * 18.0, 0, 0.48)
			local contained = instance.Contained

			-- Horizontal flow in X
			for z = 0, simH - 1 do
				for x = 0, simW - 2 do
					local i = simIndex(x, z)
					local j = simIndex(x + 1, z)
					local diff = (simGrid[i] or 0) - (simGrid[j] or 0)
					if diff > 0.001 then
						local flow = math.min(diff * flowFac, simGrid[i] * 0.5)
						simGrid[i] -= flow
						simGrid[j] += flow
					elseif diff < -0.001 then
						local flow = math.min(-diff * flowFac, simGrid[j] * 0.5)
						simGrid[j] -= flow
						simGrid[i] += flow
					end
				end
			end

			-- Horizontal flow in Z
			for z = 0, simH - 2 do
				for x = 0, simW - 1 do
					local i = simIndex(x, z)
					local j = simIndex(x, z + 1)
					local diff = (simGrid[i] or 0) - (simGrid[j] or 0)
					if diff > 0.001 then
						local flow = math.min(diff * flowFac, simGrid[i] * 0.5)
						simGrid[i] -= flow
						simGrid[j] += flow
					elseif diff < -0.001 then
						local flow = math.min(-diff * flowFac, simGrid[j] * 0.5)
						simGrid[j] -= flow
						simGrid[i] += flow
					end
				end
			end

			-- Edge leaking (when not Contained)
			local leaked = 0
			if not contained then
				local edgeDrain = flowFac * 0.6
				for x = 0, simW - 1 do
					-- Z = 0 and Z = simH-1 edges
					local top = simIndex(x, 0)
					local bot = simIndex(x, simH - 1)
					leaked += (simGrid[top] or 0) * edgeDrain
					simGrid[top] = (simGrid[top] or 0) * (1 - edgeDrain)
					leaked += (simGrid[bot] or 0) * edgeDrain
					simGrid[bot] = (simGrid[bot] or 0) * (1 - edgeDrain)
				end
				for z = 1, simH - 2 do
					-- X = 0 and X = simW-1 edges
					local left = simIndex(0, z)
					local right = simIndex(simW - 1, z)
					leaked += (simGrid[left] or 0) * edgeDrain
					simGrid[left] = (simGrid[left] or 0) * (1 - edgeDrain)
					leaked += (simGrid[right] or 0) * edgeDrain
					simGrid[right] = (simGrid[right] or 0) * (1 - edgeDrain)
				end
				if leaked > 0.001 then
					pcall(function()
						instance.Overflowed:Fire(leaked)
					end)
				end
			end

			-- Overflow cap (clamp to maxH, fire event for excess)
			local overflow = 0
			for i = 1, simW * simH do
				if (simGrid[i] or 0) > maxH then
					overflow += simGrid[i] - maxH
					simGrid[i] = maxH
				end
				if (simGrid[i] or 0) < 0 then
					simGrid[i] = 0
				end
			end
			if overflow > 0.01 then
				pcall(function()
					instance.Overflowed:Fire(overflow / (simW * simH))
				end)
			end

			-- Emptied event
			local avg = totalWater()
			if avg < 0.001 and not wasEmpty then
				wasEmpty = true
				pcall(function()
					instance.Emptied:Fire()
				end)
			elseif avg >= 0.001 then
				wasEmpty = false
			end
		end

		-- ====================================================================
		-- DRAIN CONNECTIONS
		-- ====================================================================

		local function updateDrains(dt: number)
			if #drainConnections == 0 then
				return
			end
			local pos = instance.Position
			local size = instance.Size
			local floorY = pos.Y - size.Y * 0.5

			for _, conn in ipairs(drainConnections) do
				local target = conn.target
				if not target or not target._fluidAPI then
					continue
				end

				local api = target._fluidAPI

				-- My water surface at the drain point
				local lx, lz = worldToNorm(conn.wx, conn.wz)
				lx, lz = math.clamp(lx, 0, 1), math.clamp(lz, 0, 1)
				local mySimH = sampleGrid(lx, lz)
				local mySurfY = floorY + mySimH

				-- Target floor and average surface
				local tPos = target.Position
				local tSize = target.Size
				local tFloorY = tPos.Y - tSize.Y * 0.5
				local tAvgH = api.avgWater()
				local tSurfY = tFloorY + tAvgH

				-- Threshold height in world space
				local threshY = floorY + (conn.thresholdH or 0)

				-- Only flow if our surface is above both the threshold and the target surface
				if mySurfY <= threshY or mySurfY <= tSurfY then
					continue
				end

				local available = mySimH - (conn.thresholdH or 0)
				if available <= 0.001 then
					continue
				end

				-- Amount to transfer this frame
				local amount = math.min(available, (mySurfY - tSurfY) * 0.5)
					* (conn.flowMult or 1.0)
					* (instance.FlowRate or 0.7)
					* dt
					* 8.0

				if amount <= 0.001 then
					continue
				end

				-- Remove from source cells near the drain point
				local srcX = math.floor(math.clamp(lx * (simW - 1), 0, simW - 1))
				local srcZ = math.floor(math.clamp(lz * (simH - 1), 0, simH - 1))
				local removed = 0
				for dz = -1, 1 do
					for dx = -1, 1 do
						local cx = math.clamp(srcX + dx, 0, simW - 1)
						local cz = math.clamp(srcZ + dz, 0, simH - 1)
						local idx = simIndex(cx, cz)
						local take = math.min(simGrid[idx] or 0, amount * 0.11)
						simGrid[idx] = (simGrid[idx] or 0) - take
						removed += take
					end
				end

				-- Add water uniformly to the target simulation
				if removed > 0.001 then
					api.addWaterUniform(removed)
				end
			end
		end

		-- ====================================================================
		-- VISUAL MESH BUILD & UPDATE
		-- ====================================================================

		local function buildWaveConfig()
			local dir = instance.WaveDirection or Vector2.new(1, 0)
			local dx, dz = dir.X, dir.Y
			local dl = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
			if dl < 1e-6 then
				dx, dz = 1, 0
			else
				dx, dz = dx / dl, dz / dl
			end
			local h, spd, scl = instance.WaveHeight, instance.WaveSpeed, instance.WaveScale
			local px, pz = -dz, dx
			return {
				{
					height = h,
					speed = spd,
					scale = scl,
					dirX = dx,
					dirZ = dz,
					phase = 0,
				},
				{
					height = h * 0.4,
					speed = spd * 1.3,
					scale = scl * 1.4,
					dirX = px,
					dirZ = pz,
					phase = 1.1,
				},
				{
					height = h * 0.2,
					speed = spd * 0.65,
					scale = scl * 2.7,
					dirX = (dx * 0.7 + dz * 0.7),
					dirZ = (dz * 0.7 - dx * 0.7),
					phase = 2.4,
				},
			}
		end

		local function buildGrid_vis(posX, posZ, halfW, halfL, resX, resZ)
			local positions = table.create((resX + 1) * (resZ + 1))
			local duX = 1.0 / resX
			local dvZ = 1.0 / resZ
			for iz = 0, resZ do
				for ix = 0, resX do
					local u = ix * duX
					local v = iz * dvZ
					table.insert(positions, {
						posX + (u - 0.5) * halfW * 2,
						posZ + (v - 0.5) * halfL * 2,
						u,
						v,
					})
				end
			end
			return positions
		end

		local function buildIndices_vis(resX, resZ): { number }
			local indices = table.create(resX * resZ * 6)
			local stride = resX + 1
			for iz = 0, resZ - 1 do
				for ix = 0, resX - 1 do
					local i00 = iz * stride + ix
					local i10 = i00 + 1
					local i01 = i00 + stride
					local i11 = i01 + 1
					table.insert(indices, i00)
					table.insert(indices, i01)
					table.insert(indices, i10)
					table.insert(indices, i10)
					table.insert(indices, i01)
					table.insert(indices, i11)
				end
			end
			return indices
		end

		--  Material creation
		local function createMaterial()
			local base = rlib.R3D_GetDefaultMaterial()
			local mat = buffer.create(SIZE_MAT)
			buffer.copy(mat, 0, base, 0, SIZE_MAT)

			buffer.writei32(mat, OFF_MAT_TRANSPARENCY, r3dconst.R3D_TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA)
			buffer.writei32(mat, OFF_MAT_CULL, r3dconst.R3D_CULL_NONE)

			-- Load surface shader.
			-- Use buffer.copy to embed it  this mirrors what Workspace does
			-- with its global shader (proven to work in the engine).
			local ok, sh = pcall(rlib.R3D_LoadSurfaceShaderFromMemory, WATER_SHADER_SRC)
			if ok and sh then
				surfaceShader = sh
				buffer.copy(mat, OFF_MAT_SHADER, sh)
			end

			return mat
		end

		--  GPU mesh build/rebuild
		local function buildMesh()
			if gpuMesh then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadMesh, gpuMesh)
				gpuMesh = nil
			end
			if cpuMeshData then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadMeshData, cpuMeshData)
				cpuMeshData = nil
			end

			local pos = instance.Position
			local size = instance.Size
			local res = math.max(4, math.min(128, math.floor(instance.VisResolution or 32)))
			local halfW = size.X * 0.5
			local halfL = size.Z * 0.5

			gridPositions = buildGrid_vis(pos.X, pos.Z, halfW, halfL, res, res)
			vertCount = #gridPositions

			local floorY = pos.Y - size.Y * 0.5
			local verts = table.create(vertCount)
			for i, p in ipairs(gridPositions) do
				verts[i] = {
					position = { p[1], floorY, p[2] },
					normal = { 0, 1, 0 },
					uv = { p[3], p[4] },
					color = { 255, 255, 255, 255 },
				}
			end

			local indices = buildIndices_vis(res, res)
			local result = meshgen.buildMeshWithData(verts, indices, {
				indicesAreZeroBased = true,
				usage = meshgen.Usage.Dynamic,
				flat = false,
			})
			if result then
				cpuMeshData = result[1]
				gpuMesh = result[2]
			end

			if not offCached then
				off_vs = r3dstructs.R3D_Vertex:size()
				off_pos = r3dstructs.R3D_Vertex:offset("position")
				off_norm = r3dstructs.R3D_Vertex:offset("normal")
				off_mdV = r3dstructs.R3D_MeshData:offset("vertices")
				offCached = true
			end

			activeWaves = buildWaveConfig()
			renderMatrix = lib.MatrixIdentity()
		end

		--  Vertex deformation
		local function updateMeshVerts(t: number)
			if not cpuMeshData or not gpuMesh or not offCached then
				return
			end
			local vptr = ptrFromStructField(cpuMeshData, off_mdV)
			if vptr == ffi.null then
				return
			end

			local pos = instance.Position
			local size = instance.Size
			local floorY = pos.Y - size.Y * 0.5
			local vs = off_vs
			local poff = off_pos
			local noff = off_norm

			for i = 1, vertCount do
				local p = gridPositions[i]
				local wx = p[1]
				local wz = p[2]

				-- Sample simulation grid
				local lx, lz = worldToNorm(wx, wz)
				lx = math.clamp(lx, 0, 1)
				lz = math.clamp(lz, 0, 1)
				local simH_val = sampleGrid(lx, lz)

				-- Scale wave amplitude by water level (no ripples on empty cells)
				local wScale = math.clamp(simH_val / 0.15, 0, 1)
				local wy = floorY + simH_val + waveDisplacement(wx, wz, t, activeWaves) * wScale
				local nx, ny, nz = waveNormal(wx, wz, t, activeWaves)
				-- Blend toward (0,1,0) when nearly empty
				ny = ny * wScale + (1 - wScale)
				nx, ny, nz = normalize3(nx * wScale, ny, nz * wScale)

				local base = (i - 1) * vs
				vptr:writef32(base + poff + 0, wx)
				vptr:writef32(base + poff + 4, wy)
				vptr:writef32(base + poff + 8, wz)
				vptr:writef32(base + noff + 0, nx)
				vptr:writef32(base + noff + 4, ny)
				vptr:writef32(base + noff + 8, nz)
			end

			pcall(rlib.R3D_UpdateMesh, gpuMesh, cpuMeshData, ffi.null)
		end

		--  Shader uniforms
		local function syncShaderUniforms()
			if not surfaceShader then
				return
			end
			local col = instance.Color or Color3.new(0.05, 0.35, 0.72)
			local alpha = math.clamp(1 - (instance.Transparency or 0.42), 0.05, 1)
			buffer.writef32(ubTint, 0, col.R)
			buffer.writef32(ubTint, 4, col.G)
			buffer.writef32(ubTint, 8, col.B)
			buffer.writef32(ubTint, 12, alpha)
			buffer.writef32(ubRough, 0, math.clamp(instance.Roughness or 0.07, 0, 1))
			buffer.writef32(ubFlowUV, 0, flowAccumU)
			buffer.writef32(ubFlowUV, 4, flowAccumV)
			pcall(rlib.R3D_SetSurfaceShaderUniform, surfaceShader, "u_tint", ubTint)
			pcall(rlib.R3D_SetSurfaceShaderUniform, surfaceShader, "u_roughness", ubRough)
			pcall(rlib.R3D_SetSurfaceShaderUniform, surfaceShader, "u_flow_uv", ubFlowUV)
		end

		-- ====================================================================
		-- CONTAINER FITTING
		-- ====================================================================

		local function syncToContainer()
			if not instance.FitContainer then
				return
			end
			local container = instance.Container
			if not container and instance.Parent and instance.Parent.BaseClass == "BasePart" then
				container = instance.Parent
			end
			if not container or not container.Size or not container.Position then
				return
			end
			local cs = container.Size
			local cp = container.Position
			local sig = string.format(
				"%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f",
				cp.X,
				cp.Y,
				cp.Z,
				cs.X,
				cs.Y,
				cs.Z,
				instance.FillLevel or 0.85
			)
			if sig == lastContainerSig then
				return
			end
			lastContainerSig = sig
			local inset = 0.04
			local fillY = (cp.Y - cs.Y * 0.5) + cs.Y * math.clamp(instance.FillLevel or 0.85, 0, 1)
			local props = rawget(instance, "_props")
			if props then
				props.Position = Vector3.new(cp.X, fillY, cp.Z)
				props.Size =
					Vector3.new(math.max(1, cs.X * (1 - inset)), instance.Size.Y, math.max(1, cs.Z * (1 - inset)))
			end
			buildMesh()
		end

		-- ====================================================================
		-- BUOYANCY
		-- ====================================================================

		local function runBuoyancy(dt: number)
			if not instance.PhysicsEnabled then
				return
			end
			if not workspace then
				return
			end
			dt = math.clamp(dt, 0, 0.05)
			if dt < 1 / 120 then
				return
			end

			local pos = instance.Position
			local size = instance.Size
			local halfW = size.X * 0.5
			local halfL = size.Z * 0.5
			local depth = size.Y
			local buoy = instance.BuoyancyFactor or 25
			local drag = math.clamp(instance.Dampening or 0.55, 0, 1)
			local t = lib.GetTime()

			local fdir = instance.FlowDirection or Vector2.new(0, 0)
			local fspd = instance.FlowSpeed or 0
			local fdl = math.sqrt(fdir.X ^ 2 + fdir.Y ^ 2)
			local fvx, fvz = 0, 0
			if fdl > 1e-6 then
				fvx = fdir.X / fdl * fspd
				fvz = fdir.Y / fdl * fspd
			end

			local ok, descendants = pcall(function()
				return workspace:GetDescendants()
			end)
			if not ok then
				return
			end

			for _, part in ipairs(descendants) do
				if part.BaseClass ~= "BasePart" then
					continue
				end
				if part.Anchored then
					continue
				end
				if not part.ApplyImpulse then
					continue
				end

				local ppos = part.Position
				if not ppos then
					continue
				end

				local hpx = (part.Size and part.Size.X or 1) * 0.5
				local hpz = (part.Size and part.Size.Z or 1) * 0.5
				if math.abs(ppos.X - pos.X) > halfW + hpx then
					continue
				end
				if math.abs(ppos.Z - pos.Z) > halfL + hpz then
					continue
				end

				local fluidH = surfaceYAt(ppos.X, ppos.Z, t)
				local partH = (part.Size and part.Size.Y) or 1
				local partBot = ppos.Y - partH * 0.5
				local partTop = ppos.Y + partH * 0.5
				local fBot = fluidH - depth

				if partBot >= fluidH then
					submergedSet[part] = nil
					continue
				end
				if partTop <= fBot then
					continue
				end

				local subH = math.min(partTop, fluidH) - math.max(partBot, fBot)
				local frac = math.clamp(subH / partH, 0, 1)
				if frac <= 0 then
					continue
				end

				if not submergedSet[part] then
					submergedSet[part] = true
					pcall(function()
						instance.Splashed:Fire(part, frac)
					end)
				end

				local psz = part.Size or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
				local vol = psz.X * psz.Y * psz.Z
				local upY = buoy * frac * vol * dt
				local vel = part.Velocity or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				local dFac = drag * frac * dt * 8
				local dX = (fvx - vel.X) * dFac
				local dY = -vel.Y * dFac * 0.3
				local dZ = (fvz - vel.Z) * dFac
				pcall(function()
					part:ApplyImpulse(Vector3.new(dX, upY + dY, dZ))
				end)
			end
		end

		-- ====================================================================
		-- PUBLIC API
		-- ====================================================================

		-- Internal fluid API table (used by drain connections)
		instance._fluidAPI = {
			avgWater = function()
				return totalWater()
			end,
			addWaterUniform = function(amount: number)
				local perCell = amount / (simW * simH)
				local maxH = instance.Size.Y
				for i = 1, simW * simH do
					simGrid[i] = math.clamp((simGrid[i] or 0) + perCell, 0, maxH)
				end
				wasEmpty = false
			end,
		}

		-- description: "Sets every simulation cell to a fill level from 0 to 1."
		-- args: "level: number"
		function instance:SetWaterLevel(level: number)
			local h = math.clamp(level, 0, 1) * self.Size.Y
			for i = 1, simW * simH do
				simGrid[i] = h
			end
			wasEmpty = (h < 0.001)
		end

		-- description: "Returns the current average fill level from 0 to 1."
		-- returns: "number"
		function instance:GetWaterLevel(): number
			return math.clamp(totalWater() / self.Size.Y, 0, 1)
		end

		-- description: "Adds water uniformly across the simulation surface."
		-- args: "amount: number"
		function instance:AddWater(amount: number)
			instance._fluidAPI.addWaterUniform(amount)
		end

		-- description: "Removes water uniformly across the simulation surface."
		-- args: "amount: number"
		function instance:RemoveWater(amount: number)
			local perCell = amount / (simW * simH)
			for i = 1, simW * simH do
				simGrid[i] = math.max(0, (simGrid[i] or 0) - perCell)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Adds water to the simulation cell nearest a world-space XZ position."
		-- args: "worldX: number, worldZ: number, amount: number"
		function instance:AddWaterAt(worldX: number, worldZ: number, amount: number)
			local lx, lz = worldToNorm(worldX, worldZ)
			local cx = math.floor(math.clamp(lx * (simW - 1), 0, simW - 1))
			local cz = math.floor(math.clamp(lz * (simH - 1), 0, simH - 1))
			local maxH = self.Size.Y
			local idx = simIndex(cx, cz)
			simGrid[idx] = math.clamp((simGrid[idx] or 0) + amount, 0, maxH)
			wasEmpty = false
		end

		-- description: "Removes water from the simulation cell nearest a world-space XZ position and returns the amount removed."
		-- args: "worldX: number, worldZ: number, amount: number"
		-- returns: "number"
		function instance:RemoveWaterAt(worldX: number, worldZ: number, amount: number): number
			local lx, lz = worldToNorm(worldX, worldZ)
			local cx = math.floor(math.clamp(lx * (simW - 1), 0, simW - 1))
			local cz = math.floor(math.clamp(lz * (simH - 1), 0, simH - 1))
			local idx = simIndex(cx, cz)
			local have = simGrid[idx] or 0
			local take = math.min(have, amount)
			simGrid[idx] = have - take
			return take
		end

		-- description: "Returns the water surface Y position at a world-space XZ position."
		-- args: "worldX: number, worldZ: number"
		-- returns: "number"
		function instance:GetWaterHeight(worldX: number, worldZ: number): number
			return surfaceYAt(worldX, worldZ, lib.GetTime())
		end

		-- description: "Returns whether a world-space point is inside the current water volume."
		-- args: "worldPos: Vector3"
		-- returns: "boolean"
		function instance:IsPointSubmerged(worldPos: any): boolean
			local pos = self.Position
			local size = self.Size
			if math.abs(worldPos.X - pos.X) > size.X * 0.5 then
				return false
			end
			if math.abs(worldPos.Z - pos.Z) > size.Z * 0.5 then
				return false
			end
			local h = self:GetWaterHeight(worldPos.X, worldPos.Z)
			return worldPos.Y <= h and worldPos.Y >= h - size.Y
		end

		-- description: "Returns how much of a part's height is submerged, from 0 to 1."
		-- args: "part: any"
		-- returns: "number"
		function instance:GetSubmergedFraction(part: any): number
			if not part or not part.Position then
				return 0
			end
			local h = self:GetWaterHeight(part.Position.X, part.Position.Z)
			local pH = (part.Size and part.Size.Y) or 1
			local bot = part.Position.Y - pH * 0.5
			if bot >= h then
				return 0
			end
			return math.clamp((math.min(part.Position.Y + pH * 0.5, h) - bot) / pH, 0, 1)
		end

		-- description: "Connects this simulation to another so water can flow through a drain point."
		-- args: "targetSim: any, worldX: number, worldZ: number, thresholdH: number?, flowMult: number?"
		function instance:ConnectTo(
			targetSim: any,
			worldX: number,
			worldZ: number,
			thresholdH: number?,
			flowMult: number?
		)
			table.insert(drainConnections, {
				target = targetSim,
				wx = worldX,
				wz = worldZ,
				thresholdH = thresholdH or 0,
				flowMult = flowMult or 1.0,
			})
		end

		-- description: "Removes all drain connections from this simulation to a target simulation."
		-- args: "targetSim: any"
		function instance:Disconnect(targetSim: any)
			for i = #drainConnections, 1, -1 do
				if drainConnections[i].target == targetSim then
					table.remove(drainConnections, i)
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Rebuilds the render mesh and resets the simulation grid when already initialized."
		function instance:Rebuild()
			buildMesh()
			if simInitialised then
				initGrid()
			end
		end

		-- ====================================================================
		-- INITIALISE
		-- ====================================================================

		material = createMaterial()
		initGrid()
		syncToContainer()
		buildMesh()

		-- Register in the 3D render pool
		renderId = renderer.Pool.new("3d", function()
			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end
			if not gpuMesh or not material then
				return
			end
			renderer.MeshPool.DrawMesh(gpuMesh, material, renderMatrix)
		end)

		-- ====================================================================
		-- PER-FRAME LOOP
		-- ====================================================================

		renderer.Hook.new("Renderstep", function(dt: number)
			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end
			local t = lib.GetTime()

			syncToContainer()

			-- Flow UV scroll
			local fdir = instance.FlowDirection or Vector2.new(0, 0)
			local fspd = instance.FlowSpeed or 0
			local fdl = math.sqrt(fdir.X ^ 2 + fdir.Y ^ 2)
			if fdl > 1e-6 then
				local inv = fspd * dt / fdl
				flowAccumU += fdir.X * inv
				flowAccumV += fdir.Y * inv
			end

			stepSimulation(dt)
			updateDrains(dt)
			updateMeshVerts(t)
			syncShaderUniforms()
			runBuoyancy(dt)
		end)

		-- ====================================================================
		-- PROPERTY CHANGE REACTIONS
		-- ====================================================================

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property, _value)
			if property == "Size" or property == "Position" or property == "VisResolution" then
				if not instance.FitContainer then
					buildMesh()
				end
			elseif property == "SimResolution" then
				simW = math.max(4, math.min(64, math.floor(instance.SimResolution)))
				simH = simW
				initGrid()
				buildMesh()
			elseif property == "WaterLevel" then
				instance:SetWaterLevel(instance.WaterLevel)
			elseif
				property == "WaveHeight"
				or property == "WaveSpeed"
				or property == "WaveScale"
				or property == "WaveDirection"
			then
				activeWaves = buildWaveConfig()
			elseif property == "Container" or property == "FitContainer" or property == "FillLevel" then
				lastContainerSig = ""
				syncToContainer()
			end
		end)

		-- ====================================================================
		-- CLEANUP
		-- ====================================================================

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if renderId then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(renderId)
				renderId = nil
			end
			if gpuMesh then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadMesh, gpuMesh)
				gpuMesh = nil
			end
			if cpuMeshData then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadMeshData, cpuMeshData)
				cpuMeshData = nil
			end
			if surfaceShader then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadSurfaceShader, surfaceShader)
				surfaceShader = nil
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			if tble[prop] == nil then
				tble[prop] = val
			end
		end
	end,
}

  Code: -- description: "Base class for 2D GUI elements with layout, rendering, input, and tween helpers."
local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local TweenInfo = require("@TweenInfo")
local UDim2 = require("@UDim2")
local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")
local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")
local raylib = require("@raylib")

local SEGMENTS = 16
local CORNER_SEGMENTS = 8
local SQUIRCLE_SEGMENTS = 10
local ZERO_V = vector.create(0, 0, 0)
local MAX_AUTOMATIC_SIZE_DEPTH = 8

local function resolveUDim2(val, parentDim)
	if val then
		if val.ToPixels then
			return val:ToPixels(parentDim)
		elseif val.X and val.Y then
			local x = (type(val.X) == "table" and ((val.X.Scale or 0) * parentDim.X + (val.X.Offset or 0))) or 0
			local y = (type(val.Y) == "table" and ((val.Y.Scale or 0) * parentDim.Y + (val.Y.Offset or 0))) or 0
			return vector.create(x, y, 0)
		end
	end
	return ZERO_V
end

local function resolveBlendMode(raylib, value)
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return value
	end

	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		return raylib.const.BlendMode.BLEND_ALPHA
	end

	local normalized = string.lower(value)
	if normalized == "additive" or normalized == "add" then
		return raylib.const.BlendMode.BLEND_ADDITIVE
	elseif normalized == "multiply" or normalized == "multiplied" then
		return raylib.const.BlendMode.BLEND_MULTIPLIED
	elseif normalized == "premultiply" or normalized == "premultipliedalpha" or normalized == "premultiplied" then
		return raylib.const.BlendMode.BLEND_ALPHA_PREMULTIPLY
	elseif normalized == "addcolors" then
		return raylib.const.BlendMode.BLEND_ADD_COLORS
	elseif normalized == "subtract" or normalized == "subtractcolors" then
		return raylib.const.BlendMode.BLEND_SUBTRACT_COLORS
	end

	return raylib.const.BlendMode.BLEND_ALPHA
end

local function drawCornerArc(lib, cx, cy, radius, angleStart, angleEnd, color)
	for i = 0, CORNER_SEGMENTS - 1 do
		local a1 = angleStart + (angleEnd - angleStart) * (i / CORNER_SEGMENTS)
		local a2 = angleStart + (angleEnd - angleStart) * ((i + 1) / CORNER_SEGMENTS)
		lib.DrawTriangle(
			vector.create(cx, cy, 0),
			vector.create(cx + math.cos(a1) * radius, cy + math.sin(a1) * radius, 0),
			vector.create(cx + math.cos(a2) * radius, cy + math.sin(a2) * radius, 0),
			color
		)
	end
end

local function drawRoundedRectangleEx(lib, x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, color)
	local minDim = math.min(w, h)
	local maxR = minDim / 2

	tl = math.min(tl, maxR)
	tr = math.min(tr, maxR)
	bl = math.min(bl, maxR)
	br = math.min(br, maxR)

	local cw = w - tl - tr
	local ch = h - tl - bl

	if cw > 0 and ch > 0 then
		lib.DrawRectangle(x + tl, y + tl, cw, ch, color)
	end
	if w - tl - tr > 0 then
		lib.DrawRectangle(x + tl, y, w - tl - tr, math.max(tl, tr), color)
	end
	if w - bl - br > 0 then
		lib.DrawRectangle(x + bl, y + h - math.max(bl, br), w - bl - br, math.max(bl, br), color)
	end
	if h - tl - bl > 0 then
		lib.DrawRectangle(x, y + tl, math.max(tl, bl), h - tl - bl, color)
	end
	if h - tr - br > 0 then
		lib.DrawRectangle(x + w - math.max(tr, br), y + tr, math.max(tr, br), h - tr - br, color)
	end

	if tl > 0 then
		drawCornerArc(lib, x + tl, y + tl, tl, math.pi, math.pi * 1.5, color)
	end
	if tr > 0 then
		drawCornerArc(lib, x + w - tr, y + tr, tr, math.pi * 1.5, math.pi * 2, color)
	end
	if bl > 0 then
		drawCornerArc(lib, x + bl, y + h - bl, bl, math.pi * 0.5, math.pi, color)
	end
	if br > 0 then
		drawCornerArc(lib, x + w - br, y + h - br, br, 0, math.pi * 0.5, color)
	end
end

local function resolveAutomaticSizeAxes(mode)
	if mode == Enum.AutomaticSize.XY then
		return true, true
	elseif mode == Enum.AutomaticSize.X then
		return true, false
	elseif mode == Enum.AutomaticSize.Y then
		return false, true
	end

	local name = type(mode) == "table" and mode.Name or mode
	if name == "XY" then
		return true, true
	elseif name == "X" then
		return true, false
	elseif name == "Y" then
		return false, true
	end

	return false, false
end

local function resolvePaddingBounds(object, parentSize)
	local left, right, top, bottom = 0, 0, 0, 0

	for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
		if child.ClassName == "UIPadding" and child.GetResolvedPadding then
			local padding = child:GetResolvedPadding(parentSize)
			left += padding.Left or 0
			right += padding.Right or 0
			top += padding.Top or 0
			bottom += padding.Bottom or 0
		end
	end

	return left, right, top, bottom
end

local function getContentMetrics(object, size)
	if not object or object.BaseClass == "UIContainer" then
		return ZERO_V, size
	end

	local left, right, top, bottom = resolvePaddingBounds(object, size)
	return vector.create(left, top, 0),
		vector.create(math.max(0, size.X - left - right), math.max(0, size.Y - top - bottom), 0)
end

local function precomputeLayoutChildren(object, lib, dt, structs, renderer)
	if not lib then
		return
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
		local className = child.ClassName
		local isLayout = type(className) == "string" and string.sub(className, -6) == "Layout"
		if isLayout and child.render and child.Enabled ~= false then
			child.render(lib, child, dt or 0, structs, renderer)
		end
	end
end

local function calculateResolvedSize(object, parentSize, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
	local size = resolveUDim2(object.Size, parentSize)
	local autoX, autoY = resolveAutomaticSizeAxes(object.AutomaticSize)

	if (not autoX and not autoY) or (depth or 0) >= MAX_AUTOMATIC_SIZE_DEPTH then
		return size
	end

	precomputeLayoutChildren(object, lib, dt, structs, renderer)

	local left, right, top, bottom = resolvePaddingBounds(object, size)
	local contentSize = vector.create(math.max(0, size.X - left - right), math.max(0, size.Y - top - bottom), 0)
	local maxX, maxY = left, top
	local hasGuiChild = false

	for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
		if child.BaseClass == "GuiObject" and child.Visible ~= false and child.Size then
			hasGuiChild = true

			local childSize = calculateResolvedSize(child, contentSize, lib, dt, structs, renderer, (depth or 0) + 1)
			local anchor = child.AnchorPoint or ZERO_V
			local relX, relY

			if child._LayoutControlled and child._LayoutRelativePosition then
				relX = child._LayoutRelativePosition.X - childSize.X * anchor.X
				relY = child._LayoutRelativePosition.Y - childSize.Y * anchor.Y
			elseif child.Position then
				local childPos = resolveUDim2(child.Position, contentSize)
				relX = left + childPos.X - childSize.X * anchor.X
				relY = top + childPos.Y - childSize.Y * anchor.Y
			end

			if relX and relY then
				maxX = math.max(maxX, relX + childSize.X)
				maxY = math.max(maxY, relY + childSize.Y)
			end
		end
	end

	if hasGuiChild then
		maxX += right
		maxY += bottom
	else
		maxX = left + right
		maxY = top + bottom
	end

	return vector.create(autoX and math.max(0, maxX) or size.X, autoY and math.max(0, maxY) or size.Y, 0)
end

local function GetAbsoluteSize(object, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
	if object.BaseClass == "UIContainer" then
		return vector.create(object.Size.X.Offset, object.Size.Y.Offset, 0)
	end

	local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(object.Parent, lib, dt, structs, renderer, (depth or 0) + 1)
	local _, parentContentSize = getContentMetrics(object.Parent, parentSize)
	return calculateResolvedSize(object, parentContentSize, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
end

local function getAbsoluteDrawPos(object, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
	if object.BaseClass == "UIContainer" then
		return object.RenderOffset
	end
	local parent = object.Parent
	local parentAbsPos = getAbsoluteDrawPos(parent, lib, dt, structs, renderer, (depth or 0) + 1)
	local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(parent, lib, dt, structs, renderer, (depth or 0) + 1)
	local parentPaddingOffset, parentContentSize = getContentMetrics(parent, parentSize)
	local size = calculateResolvedSize(object, parentContentSize, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
	local anchor = object.AnchorPoint or ZERO_V
	local drawPos

	if object._LayoutControlled and object._LayoutRelativePosition then
		drawPos = vector.create(
			parentAbsPos.X + object._LayoutRelativePosition.X - size.X * anchor.X,
			parentAbsPos.Y + object._LayoutRelativePosition.Y - size.Y * anchor.Y,
			0
		)
	else
		local pos = resolveUDim2(object.Position, parentContentSize)
		drawPos = vector.create(
			parentAbsPos.X + parentPaddingOffset.X + pos.X - size.X * anchor.X,
			parentAbsPos.Y + parentPaddingOffset.Y + pos.Y - size.Y * anchor.Y,
			0
		)
	end

	if parent and parent.ClassName == "ScrollingFrame" then
		drawPos = vector.create(drawPos.X, drawPos.Y - (parent.CanvasPosition or 0), 0)
	end
	return drawPos
end

local function isMouseInRect(mousePos, drawPos, size)
	return mousePos.X >= drawPos.X
		and mousePos.X <= drawPos.X + size.X
		and mousePos.Y >= drawPos.Y
		and mousePos.Y <= drawPos.Y + size.Y
end

local function calculateDrawParams(object, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
	local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(object.Parent, lib, dt, structs, renderer, (depth or 0) + 1)
	local _, parentContentSize = getContentMetrics(object.Parent, parentSize)
	local size, drawPos, anchor

	if object._EditorOverride then
		size = object.AbsoluteSize or ZERO_V
		drawPos = object.AbsolutePosition or ZERO_V
	elseif object._LayoutControlled and object._LayoutRelativePosition then
		size = calculateResolvedSize(object, parentContentSize, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
		anchor = object.AnchorPoint or ZERO_V
		local parentDrawPos = getAbsoluteDrawPos(object.Parent, lib, dt, structs, renderer, (depth or 0) + 1)
		drawPos = vector.create(
			parentDrawPos.X + object._LayoutRelativePosition.X - size.X * anchor.X,
			parentDrawPos.Y + object._LayoutRelativePosition.Y - size.Y * anchor.Y,
			0
		)
		if object.Parent and object.Parent.ClassName == "ScrollingFrame" then
			drawPos = vector.create(drawPos.X, drawPos.Y - (object.Parent.CanvasPosition or 0), 0)
		end
	else
		size = calculateResolvedSize(object, parentContentSize, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
		drawPos = getAbsoluteDrawPos(object, lib, dt, structs, renderer, depth)
	end

	return drawPos, size
end

local function resolveGuiPoint(point)
	if type(point) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	local x = point.X
	if x == nil then
		x = point.x
	end

	local y = point.Y
	if y == nil then
		y = point.y
	end

	if type(x) ~= "number" or type(y) ~= "number" then
		return nil
	end

	return Vector2.new(x, y)
end

local function getGuiMetrics(object)
	if object.AbsolutePosition and object.AbsoluteSize then
		local pos = object.AbsolutePosition
		local size = object.AbsoluteSize
		return Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y), Vector2.new(size.X, size.Y)
	end

	if not object.Parent then
		return Vector2.Zero, Vector2.Zero
	end

	local drawPos, size = calculateDrawParams(object)
	return Vector2.new(drawPos.X, drawPos.Y), Vector2.new(size.X, size.Y)
end

local function getGuiTweenRegistry(object)
	local registry = rawget(object, "_GuiTweenRegistry")
	if not registry then
		registry = {}
		rawset(object, "_GuiTweenRegistry", registry)
	end
	return registry
end

local function isTweenBusy(tween)
	if not tween then
		return false
	end

	return tween.PlaybackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Completed and tween.PlaybackState ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled
end

local function playGuiTween(
	object,
	propertyNames,
	properties,
	easingDirection,
	easingStyle,
	duration,
	override,
	callback
)
	local tweenService = game and game.GetService and game:GetService("TweenService") or nil
	if not tweenService then
		return false, nil
	end

	local registry = getGuiTweenRegistry(object)
	for _, propertyName in ipairs(propertyNames) do
		local activeTween = registry[propertyName]
		if isTweenBusy(activeTween) then
			if not override then
				return false, activeTween
			end
			activeTween:Cancel()
		end
	end

	local tweenInfo =
		TweenInfo.new(duration or 1, easingStyle or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, easingDirection or Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	local tween = tweenService:Create(object, tweenInfo, properties)

	for _, propertyName in ipairs(propertyNames) do
		registry[propertyName] = tween
	end

	tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
		for _, propertyName in ipairs(propertyNames) do
			if registry[propertyName] == tween then
				registry[propertyName] = nil
			end
		end

		if callback then
			callback(playbackState)
		end
	end)

	tween:Play()
	return true, tween
end

local function resolveCornerRadii(corner, minDim)
	local base = corner.CornerRadius.Scale * minDim + corner.CornerRadius.Offset
	local function isDefaultCornerValue(prop)
		return prop and prop.Scale == 0 and prop.Offset == 15
	end

	local function resolve(prop)
		if prop and not isDefaultCornerValue(prop) then
			local v = prop.Scale * minDim + prop.Offset
			return v > 0 and v or base
		end
		return base
	end

	local tl = resolve(corner.TopLeftRadius)
	local tr = resolve(corner.TopRightRadius)
	local bl = resolve(corner.BottomLeftRadius)
	local br = resolve(corner.BottomRightRadius)

	local uniform = tl == tr and tl == bl and tl == br

	local function isDifferent(prop)
		return prop and not isDefaultCornerValue(prop)
	end

	local useIndividual = isDifferent(corner.TopLeftRadius)
		or isDifferent(corner.TopRightRadius)
		or isDifferent(corner.BottomLeftRadius)
		or isDifferent(corner.BottomRightRadius)

	return tl, tr, bl, br, base, useIndividual
end

local function appendPoint(points, x, y)
	local last = points[#points]
	if last and math.abs(last.X - x) < 0.01 and math.abs(last.Y - y) < 0.01 then
		return
	end

	table.insert(points, vector.create(x, y, 0))
end

local function appendSquircleArc(points, cx, cy, radius, sx, sy, angleStart, angleEnd, exponent, skipFirst)
	if radius <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local power = 2 / math.max(2, exponent or 4)
	local startIndex = if skipFirst then 1 else 0

	for i = startIndex, SQUIRCLE_SEGMENTS do
		local alpha = i / SQUIRCLE_SEGMENTS
		local angle = angleStart + (angleEnd - angleStart) * alpha
		local cosValue = math.abs(math.cos(angle)) ^ power
		local sinValue = math.abs(math.sin(angle)) ^ power

		appendPoint(points, cx + sx * radius * cosValue, cy + sy * radius * sinValue)
	end
end

local function buildSquirclePoints(x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, exponent)
	local points = {}
	local maxR = math.min(w, h) / 2

	tl = math.min(tl, maxR)
	tr = math.min(tr, maxR)
	bl = math.min(bl, maxR)
	br = math.min(br, maxR)

	appendPoint(points, x + tl, y)
	appendPoint(points, x + w - tr, y)
	appendSquircleArc(points, x + w - tr, y + tr, tr, 1, -1, math.pi * 0.5, 0, exponent, true)

	appendPoint(points, x + w, y + h - br)
	appendSquircleArc(points, x + w - br, y + h - br, br, 1, 1, 0, math.pi * 0.5, exponent, true)

	appendPoint(points, x + bl, y + h)
	appendSquircleArc(points, x + bl, y + h - bl, bl, -1, 1, math.pi * 0.5, 0, exponent, true)

	appendPoint(points, x, y + tl)
	appendSquircleArc(points, x + tl, y + tl, tl, -1, -1, 0, math.pi * 0.5, exponent, true)

	return points
end

local function drawSquircleFilled(lib, x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, exponent, color)
	local points = buildSquirclePoints(x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, exponent)
	local center = vector.create(x + w * 0.5, y + h * 0.5, 0)

	for i = 1, #points do
		local nextIndex = if i == #points then 1 else i + 1
		lib.DrawTriangle(center, points[i], points[nextIndex], color)
	end
end

local function drawSquircleOutline(lib, x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, exponent, thickness, color)
	local points = buildSquirclePoints(x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, exponent)

	for i = 1, #points do
		local nextIndex = if i == #points then 1 else i + 1
		lib.DrawLineEx(points[i], points[nextIndex], thickness, color)
	end
end

local function getRoundedHorizontalInset(localY, height, radius, exponent)
	if radius <= 0 then
		return 0
	end

	local curveExponent = math.max(2, exponent or 2)
	local normalizedPower = 2 / curveExponent

	local function edgeInset(distanceToEdge)
		if distanceToEdge >= radius then
			return 0
		end

		local normalized = math.clamp((radius - distanceToEdge) / radius, 0, 1)
		return radius * (1 - (1 - normalized ^ curveExponent) ^ normalizedPower)
	end

	if localY < radius then
		return edgeInset(localY)
	end

	if localY > height - radius then
		return edgeInset(height - localY)
	end

	return 0
end

local function drawShadow(lib, structs, object, shadow, drawPos, size, corner, squircle)
	if not shadow or shadow.Enabled == false then
		return
	end

	local transparency = shadow.Transparency or 0
	if transparency >= 1 then
		return
	end

	local passes = math.max(1, math.floor(math.max(shadow.Blur or 0, 0)))
	local spread = math.max(0, shadow.Spread or 0)
	local offset = shadow.Offset or ZERO_V
	local minDim = math.min(size.X, size.Y)
	local tl, tr, bl, br, base, useIndividual = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, false
	local squircleExponent = squircle and squircle.Exponent or 4

	if squircle then
		tl, tr, bl, br = resolveCornerRadii(squircle, minDim)
	elseif corner then
		tl, tr, bl, br, base, useIndividual = resolveCornerRadii(corner, minDim)
	end

	local isCircleShadow = corner
		and not useIndividual
		and math.abs(size.X - size.Y) < 0.01
		and base >= (minDim * 0.5 - 0.01)

	for i = 1, passes do
		local expansion = spread + (passes - i)
		local alphaScale = i / passes
		local layerTransparency = 1 - ((1 - transparency) * alphaScale)
		local layerColor = shadow.Color:ToRaylib(layerTransparency)
		local shadowX = drawPos.X + offset.X - expansion
		local shadowY = drawPos.Y + offset.Y - expansion
		local shadowW = size.X + expansion * 2
		local shadowH = size.Y + expansion * 2

		if shadowW <= 0 or shadowH <= 0 then
			continue
		end

		local rec = structs.Rectangle:new({
			x = shadowX,
			y = shadowY,
			width = shadowW,
			height = shadowH,
		})
		local layerMinDim = math.max(1, math.min(shadowW, shadowH))

		if object.Rotation ~= 0 then
			lib.DrawRectanglePro(rec, ZERO_V, object.Rotation, layerColor)
		elseif isCircleShadow then
			lib.DrawCircleV(
				vector.create(shadowX + shadowW * 0.5, shadowY + shadowH * 0.5, 0),
				math.max(0, math.min(shadowW, shadowH) * 0.5),
				layerColor
			)
		elseif squircle then
			drawSquircleFilled(
				lib,
				shadowX,
				shadowY,
				shadowW,
				shadowH,
				tl + expansion,
				tr + expansion,
				bl + expansion,
				br + expansion,
				squircleExponent,
				layerColor
			)
		elseif corner then
			drawRoundedRectangleEx(
				lib,
				shadowX,
				shadowY,
				shadowW,
				shadowH,
				(tl > 0 and tl or base) + expansion,
				(tr > 0 and tr or base) + expansion,
				(bl > 0 and bl or base) + expansion,
				(br > 0 and br or base) + expansion,
				layerColor
			)
		else
			lib.DrawRectangleRec(rec, layerColor)
		end
	end
end

local function drawShapeFill(lib, structs, object, modifier, x, y, w, h, color)
	if w <= 0 or h <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local rec = structs.Rectangle:new({ x = x, y = y, width = w, height = h })
	local minDim = math.min(w, h)

	if object.Rotation ~= 0 then
		lib.DrawRectanglePro(rec, ZERO_V, object.Rotation, color)
		return
	end

	if modifier and modifier.ClassName == "UISquircle" then
		local tl, tr, bl, br = resolveCornerRadii(modifier, minDim)
		drawSquircleFilled(lib, x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, modifier.Exponent or 4, color)
	elseif modifier and modifier.ClassName == "UICorner" then
		local tl, tr, bl, br, base, useIndividual = resolveCornerRadii(modifier, minDim)
		if useIndividual then
			drawRoundedRectangleEx(lib, x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, color)
		else
			lib.DrawRectangleRounded(rec, base / minDim, SEGMENTS, color)
		end
	else
		lib.DrawRectangleRec(rec, color)
	end
end

local function drawShapeOutline(lib, structs, object, modifier, x, y, w, h, thickness, color)
	if w <= 0 or h <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local rec = structs.Rectangle:new({ x = x, y = y, width = w, height = h })
	local minDim = math.min(w, h)

	if object.Rotation ~= 0 then
		lib.DrawRectangleLinesEx(rec, thickness, color)
		return
	end

	if modifier and modifier.ClassName == "UISquircle" then
		local tl, tr, bl, br = resolveCornerRadii(modifier, minDim)
		drawSquircleOutline(lib, x, y, w, h, tl, tr, bl, br, modifier.Exponent or 4, thickness, color)
	elseif modifier and modifier.ClassName == "UICorner" then
		local _, _, _, _, base = resolveCornerRadii(modifier, minDim)
		lib.DrawRectangleRoundedLinesEx(rec, base / minDim, SEGMENTS, thickness, color)
	else
		lib.DrawRectangleLinesEx(rec, thickness, color)
	end
end

local function drawGlow(lib, structs, object, glow, drawPos, size, shapeModifier)
	if not glow or glow.Enabled == false then
		return
	end

	local transparency = glow.Transparency or 0
	if transparency >= 1 then
		return
	end

	local passes = math.max(1, math.floor(math.max(glow.Blur or 0, 0)))
	local spread = math.max(0, glow.Spread or 0)
	local blendMode = resolveBlendMode(raylib, glow.BlendMode or "Additive")
	lib.BeginBlendMode(blendMode)

	for i = 1, passes do
		local expansion = spread + (passes - i)
		local alphaScale = i / passes
		local layerTransparency = 1 - ((1 - transparency) * alphaScale)
		local layerColor = glow.Color:ToRaylib(layerTransparency)
		drawShapeFill(
			lib,
			structs,
			object,
			shapeModifier,
			drawPos.X - expansion,
			drawPos.Y - expansion,
			size.X + expansion * 2,
			size.Y + expansion * 2,
			layerColor
		)
	end

	lib.EndBlendMode()
end

local function drawVignette(lib, structs, object, vignette, drawPos, size, shapeModifier)
	if not vignette or vignette.Enabled == false then
		return
	end

	local transparency = vignette.Transparency or 0
	if transparency >= 1 then
		return
	end

	local steps = math.max(1, math.floor(vignette.Steps or 8))
	local thickness = math.max(1, vignette.Thickness or 18)

	for i = 1, steps do
		local alphaScale = i / steps
		local layerTransparency = 1 - ((1 - transparency) * alphaScale)
		local inset = ((i - 1) / steps) * thickness
		local width = size.X - inset * 2
		local height = size.Y - inset * 2
		if width <= 0 or height <= 0 then
			break
		end

		drawShapeOutline(
			lib,
			structs,
			object,
			shapeModifier,
			drawPos.X + inset,
			drawPos.Y + inset,
			width,
			height,
			1,
			vignette.Color:ToRaylib(layerTransparency)
		)
	end
end

local function drawBevel(lib, structs, object, bevel, drawPos, size, shapeModifier)
	if not bevel or bevel.Enabled == false then
		return
	end

	local thickness = math.max(1, math.floor(bevel.Thickness or 2))
	local lightColor = bevel.LightColor:ToRaylib(bevel.LightTransparency or 0)
	local shadowColor = bevel.ShadowColor:ToRaylib(bevel.ShadowTransparency or 0)
	local isInset = type(bevel.Style) == "string" and string.lower(bevel.Style) == "inset"

	if isInset then
		lightColor, shadowColor = shadowColor, lightColor
	end

	for i = 0, thickness - 1 do
		local inset = i
		local width = size.X - inset * 2
		local height = size.Y - inset * 2
		if width <= 0 or height <= 0 then
			break
		end

		local x = drawPos.X + inset
		local y = drawPos.Y + inset

		lib.BeginScissorMode(x, y, math.max(1, math.floor(width * 0.5)), math.max(1, math.floor(height * 0.5)))
		drawShapeOutline(lib, structs, object, shapeModifier, x, y, width, height, 1, lightColor)
		lib.EndScissorMode()

		lib.BeginScissorMode(
			x + math.floor(width * 0.5),
			y + math.floor(height * 0.5),
			math.max(1, math.ceil(width * 0.5)),
			math.max(1, math.ceil(height * 0.5))
		)
		drawShapeOutline(lib, structs, object, shapeModifier, x, y, width, height, 1, shadowColor)
		lib.EndScissorMode()
	end
end

local function drawRipple(lib, raylib, ripple, object, drawPos, size, dt)
	if not ripple or ripple.Enabled == false then
		return
	end

	if ripple._state == nil then
		ripple._state = {}
	end

	if object.MouseIsInObject and lib.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 then
		table.insert(ripple._state, {
			x = lib.GetMouseX(),
			y = lib.GetMouseY(),
			time = 0,
		})
	end

	local duration = math.max(0.01, ripple.Duration or 0.6)
	local maxRadius = math.max(size.X, size.Y) * (ripple.MaxRadiusScale or 1.2)
	local color3 = ripple.Color
	local blendMode = resolveBlendMode(raylib, ripple.BlendMode or "Alpha")

	lib.BeginScissorMode(drawPos.X, drawPos.Y, math.max(1, size.X), math.max(1, size.Y))
	lib.BeginBlendMode(blendMode)

	for i = #ripple._state, 1, -1 do
		local pulse = ripple._state[i]
		pulse.time += dt

		local progress = pulse.time / duration
		if progress >= 1 then
			table.remove(ripple._state, i)
		else
			local radius = maxRadius * progress
			local alpha = (1 - progress) * (1 - (ripple.Transparency or 0))
			local color = structs.Color:new({
				r = color3.R * 255,
				g = color3.G * 255,
				b = color3.B * 255,
				a = math.floor(255 * math.clamp(alpha, 0, 1)),
			})

			if ripple.Fill == false then
				local inner = math.max(0, radius - (ripple.Thickness or 2))
				lib.DrawRing(vector.create(pulse.x, pulse.y, 0), inner, radius, 0, 360, 32, color)
			else
				lib.DrawCircleV(vector.create(pulse.x, pulse.y, 0), radius, color)
			end
		end
	end

	lib.EndBlendMode()
	lib.EndScissorMode()
end

local propTable = {
	BaseClass = "GuiObject",
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	BackgroundTransparency = 0,
	Visible = true,
	BorderSize = 0,
	BorderColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
	BorderTransparency = 0,
	Rotation = 0,
	AbsolutePosition = nil,
	Anchored = true,
	AbsoluteSize = nil,
	AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None,
	ClipsDescendants = false,
	ZIndex = 1,
	AnchorPoint = ZERO_V,
	MouseIsInObject = false,
	-- description: "Returns the absolute top-left position and size of the GUI object."
	-- args: "self: table"
	-- returns: "Vector2, Vector2"
	GetBounds = function(self)
		return getGuiMetrics(self)
	end,
	-- description: "Returns the absolute center point of the GUI object."
	-- args: "self: table"
	-- returns: "Vector2"
	GetCenter = function(self)
		local pos, size = getGuiMetrics(self)
		return Vector2.new(pos.X + size.X * 0.5, pos.Y + size.Y * 0.5)
	end,
	-- description: "Returns whether a screen-space point is inside the GUI object bounds."
	-- args: "self: table, point: Vector2"
	-- returns: "boolean"
	IsPointInside = function(self, point)
		local resolvedPoint = resolveGuiPoint(point)
		if not resolvedPoint then
			return false
		end

		local pos, size = getGuiMetrics(self)
		return resolvedPoint.X >= pos.X
			and resolvedPoint.X <= pos.X + size.X
			and resolvedPoint.Y >= pos.Y
			and resolvedPoint.Y <= pos.Y + size.Y
	end,
	-- description: "Converts a screen-space point into coordinates relative to the GUI object."
	-- args: "self: table, point: Vector2"
	-- returns: "Vector2?"
	GetRelativePoint = function(self, point)
		local resolvedPoint = resolveGuiPoint(point)
		if not resolvedPoint then
			return nil
		end

		local pos = getGuiMetrics(self)
		return Vector2.new(resolvedPoint.X - pos.X, resolvedPoint.Y - pos.Y)
	end,
	-- description: "Cancels active GUI tweens started by this object."
	-- args: "self: table"
	CancelGuiTweens = function(self)
		local registry = rawget(self, "_GuiTweenRegistry")
		if not registry then
			return
		end

		local cancelled = {}
		for _, tween in pairs(registry) do
			if tween and not cancelled[tween] and isTweenBusy(tween) then
				cancelled[tween] = true
				tween:Cancel()
			end
		end
	end,
	-- description: "Tweens the Position property to a target value."
	-- args: "self: table, endPosition: UDim2, easingDirection: string, easingStyle: string, time: number, override: boolean?, callback: function?"
	-- returns: "boolean, any"
	TweenPosition = function(self, endPosition, easingDirection, easingStyle, time, override, callback)
		return playGuiTween(
			self,
			{ "Position" },
			{ Position = endPosition },
			easingDirection,
			easingStyle,
			time,
			override,
			callback
		)
	end,
	-- description: "Tweens the Size property to a target value."
	-- args: "self: table, endSize: UDim2, easingDirection: string, easingStyle: string, time: number, override: boolean?, callback: function?"
	-- returns: "boolean, any"
	TweenSize = function(self, endSize, easingDirection, easingStyle, time, override, callback)
		return playGuiTween(
			self,
			{ "Size" },
			{ Size = endSize },
			easingDirection,
			easingStyle,
			time,
			override,
			callback
		)
	end,
	-- description: "Tweens Size and Position together."
	-- args: "self: table, endSize: UDim2, endPosition: UDim2, easingDirection: string, easingStyle: string, time: number, override: boolean?, callback: function?"
	-- returns: "boolean, any"
	TweenSizeAndPosition = function(self, endSize, endPosition, easingDirection, easingStyle, time, override, callback)
		return playGuiTween(
			self,
			{ "Size", "Position" },
			{ Size = endSize, Position = endPosition },
			easingDirection,
			easingStyle,
			time,
			override,
			callback
		)
	end,
	-- description: "Renders this GUI object and updates absolute bounds and hover state."
	-- args: "lib: number, object: table, dt: number, structs: table, renderer: number"
	-- returns: "Vector3?, Vector3?"
	render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
		if not object.Visible then
			return
		end

		local drawPos, size = calculateDrawParams(object, lib, dt, structs, renderer)
		local mousePos = vector.create(lib.GetMouseX(), lib.GetMouseY(), 0)
		local mouseIsInObject = isMouseInRect(mousePos, drawPos, size)

		local tilt, corner, stroke, gradient, shadow, glow, ripple, vignette, bevel, squircle, blend, blur
		for _, child in ipairs(object.Children) do
			local cls = child.ClassName
			if cls == "UITilt" then
				tilt = child
			elseif cls == "UICorner" then
				corner = child
			elseif cls == "UIStroke" then
				stroke = child
			elseif cls == "UIGradient" then
				gradient = child
			elseif cls == "UIShadow" then
				shadow = child
			elseif cls == "UIGlow" then
				glow = child
			elseif cls == "UIRipple" then
				ripple = child
			elseif cls == "UIVignette" then
				vignette = child
			elseif cls == "UIBevel" then
				bevel = child
			elseif cls == "UISquircle" then
				squircle = child
			elseif cls == "UIBlend" then
				blend = child
			elseif cls == "BlurEffect" then
				blur = child
			end
		end

		if tilt and tilt.Enabled ~= false and mouseIsInObject then
			local maxOffset = tilt.MaxOffset or Vector2.new(6, 6)
			local nx = (((mousePos.X - drawPos.X) / math.max(size.X, 1)) - 0.5) * 2
			local ny = (((mousePos.Y - drawPos.Y) / math.max(size.Y, 1)) - 0.5) * 2
			drawPos = vector.create(drawPos.X + nx * maxOffset.X, drawPos.Y + ny * maxOffset.Y, 0)
		end

		rawset(object, "MouseIsInObject", mouseIsInObject)
		object.MouseEnter:FireOncePerPress("MouseEnter", mouseIsInObject)
		object.MouseLeave:FireOncePerPress("MouseLeave", not mouseIsInObject)

		local color = object.BackgroundColor3:ToRaylib(object.BackgroundTransparency)
		local shapeModifier = squircle or corner
		local shapeExponent = squircle and squircle.Exponent or 2

		local minDim = math.min(size.X, size.Y)

		local selfBlendActive = false
		if blend and blend.Enabled ~= false and blend.AffectSelf ~= false then
			lib.BeginBlendMode(resolveBlendMode(raylib, blend.Mode))
			selfBlendActive = true
		end

		drawShadow(lib, structs, object, shadow, drawPos, size, corner, squircle)
		drawGlow(lib, structs, object, glow, drawPos, size, shapeModifier)

		if blur then
			renderer.Blur.blurRadius = blur.Size
			renderer.Blur:DrawBlurredRegion(drawPos.X, drawPos.Y, size.X, size.Y, Color3.new(1, 1, 1):ToRaylib(0))
		end

		if gradient and gradient.ColorSequence then
			local steps = 50
			local stepHeight = size.Y / steps
			local cornerRadius = shapeModifier
					and (shapeModifier.CornerRadius.Scale * minDim + shapeModifier.CornerRadius.Offset)
				or 0
			cornerRadius = math.min(cornerRadius, minDim / 2)

			local gradRec = structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = 0, height = 0 })

			for i = 0, steps - 1 do
				local t1, t2 = i / steps, (i + 1) / steps
				local color1 = gradient.ColorSequence:Evaluate(t1)
				local color2 = gradient.ColorSequence:Evaluate(t2)
				local offsetLeft, offsetRight = 0, 0

				if cornerRadius > 0 then
					local yPos1, yPos2 = i * stepHeight, (i + 1) * stepHeight
					offsetLeft = math.max(
						getRoundedHorizontalInset(yPos1, size.Y, cornerRadius, shapeExponent),
						getRoundedHorizontalInset(yPos2, size.Y, cornerRadius, shapeExponent)
					)
					offsetRight = offsetLeft
				end

				gradRec.x = drawPos.X + offsetLeft
				gradRec.y = drawPos.Y + i * stepHeight
				gradRec.width = size.X - offsetLeft - offsetRight
				gradRec.height = stepHeight

				lib.DrawRectangleGradientEx(
					gradRec,
					color1:ToRaylib(0),
					color1:ToRaylib(0),
					color2:ToRaylib(0),
					color2:ToRaylib(0)
				)
			end

			if stroke and stroke.Transparency ~= 1 then
				drawShapeOutline(
					lib,
					structs,
					object,
					shapeModifier,
					drawPos.X,
					drawPos.Y,
					size.X,
					size.Y,
					stroke.Thickness,
					stroke.Color:ToRaylib(stroke.Transparency)
				)
			end
		else
			if object.BackgroundTransparency ~= 1 then
				drawShapeFill(lib, structs, object, shapeModifier, drawPos.X, drawPos.Y, size.X, size.Y, color)
			end

			if stroke and stroke.Transparency ~= 1 then
				drawShapeOutline(
					lib,
					structs,
					object,
					shapeModifier,
					drawPos.X,
					drawPos.Y,
					size.X,
					size.Y,
					stroke.Thickness,
					stroke.Color:ToRaylib(stroke.Transparency)
				)
			end
		end

		drawBevel(lib, structs, object, bevel, drawPos, size, shapeModifier)
		drawVignette(lib, structs, object, vignette, drawPos, size, shapeModifier)
		drawRipple(lib, raylib, ripple, object, drawPos, size, dt)

		if selfBlendActive then
			lib.EndBlendMode()
		end

		rawset(object, "AbsolutePosition", drawPos)
		rawset(object, "AbsoluteSize", size)

		return drawPos, size
	end,
}

return {
	class = "GuiObject",
	non_creatable = true,
	resolveBlendMode = resolveBlendMode,
	render = propTable.render,

	-- description: "Returns whether an object is parented directly under a GUI container."
	-- args: "object: table"
	-- returns: "boolean"
	IsParentGuiContainer = function(object)
		return object.Parent.BaseClass == "UIContainer"
	end,

	-- description: "Renders visible GUI children with clipping and blend modifiers applied."
	-- args: "lib: number, object: table, dt: number, structs: table, renderer: number"
	renderChildren = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
		local mask = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIMask")
		local blend = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIBlend")
		local didClip = false
		local didBlend = false

		if blend and blend.Enabled ~= false and blend.AffectChildren ~= false then
			lib.BeginBlendMode(resolveBlendMode(raylib, blend.Mode))
			didBlend = true
		end

		if object.ClipsDescendants or (mask and mask.Enabled ~= false and mask.AffectChildren ~= false) then
			local pos = object.AbsolutePosition or ZERO_V
			local size = object.AbsoluteSize or ZERO_V
			local insetX, insetY = 0, 0

			if mask and mask.Inset and object.AbsoluteSize then
				local inset = resolveUDim2(mask.Inset, object.AbsoluteSize)
				insetX = inset.X
				insetY = inset.Y
			end

			local clipX = pos.X + insetX
			local clipY = pos.Y + insetY
			local clipW = math.max(1, size.X - insetX * 2)
			local clipH = math.max(1, size.Y - insetY * 2)

			lib.BeginScissorMode(clipX, clipY, clipW, clipH)
			didClip = true
		end

		for _, child in pairs(object:GetChildren()) do
			if child.render then
				child.render(lib, child, dt, structs, renderer)
			end
		end

		if didClip then
			lib.EndScissorMode()
		end

		if didBlend then
			lib.EndBlendMode()
		end
	end,

	-- description: "Updates absolute position, absolute size, and hover state without drawing."
	-- args: "lib: number, object: table, dt: number, structs: table, renderer: number"
	-- returns: "Vector3, Vector3"
	calculatePositions = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
		local drawPos, size = calculateDrawParams(object, lib, dt, structs, renderer)
		local mousePos = vector.create(lib.GetMouseX(), lib.GetMouseY(), 0)
		local mouseIsInObject = isMouseInRect(mousePos, drawPos, size)

		rawset(object, "MouseIsInObject", mouseIsInObject)

		if object.MouseEnter then
			object.MouseEnter:FireOncePerPress("MouseEnter", mouseIsInObject)
		end
		if object.MouseLeave then
			object.MouseLeave:FireOncePerPress("MouseLeave", not mouseIsInObject)
		end

		rawset(object, "AbsolutePosition", drawPos)
		rawset(object, "AbsoluteSize", size)

		return drawPos, size
	end,

	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		local signals = createSignals()
		for k, v in pairs(signals) do
			propTable[k] = v
		end
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		rawset(instance, "_GuiTweenRegistry", {})
		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		local signals = createSignals()
		for k, v in pairs(signals) do
			tble[k] = v
		end
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			if not tble[prop] then
				tble[prop] = val
			end
		end
	end,
}

local function drawRotatedCube(rl, cf, size, color, fill, outlineThickness)
	local p = cf.Position
	local qx, qy, qz, qw = cf:ToQuaternion()
	qw = math.clamp(qw, -1, 1)
	local angle = math.deg(2 * math.acos(qw))
	local s = math.sqrt(1 - qw * qw)
	local ax, ay, az
	if s < 0.001 then
		ax, ay, az = 1, 0, 0
	else
		ax, ay, az = qx / s, qy / s, qz / s
	end
	rl.rlPushMatrix()
	rl.rlTranslatef(p.X, p.Y, p.Z)
	rl.rlRotatef(angle, ax, ay, az)
	rl.DrawCubeV(vector.create(0, 0, 0), vector.create(size.X, size.Y, size.Z), fill)
	rl.rlSetLineWidth(outlineThickness or 1.0)
	rl.DrawCubeWiresV(vector.create(0, 0, 0), vector.create(size.X, size.Y, size.Z), color)
	rl.rlSetLineWidth(1.0) -- reset after
	rl.rlPopMatrix()
end

return {
	class = "Highlight",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		renderer.Pool.new("gizmo", function()
			local adornee = instance.Adornee
			if adornee and adornee.BaseClass == "BasePart" then
				local CFrame = adornee.CFrame
				if not CFrame then
					return
				end

				local Size = adornee.Size

				drawRotatedCube(
					raylib.lib,
					CFrame,
					Size,
					instance.OutlineColor:ToRaylib(instance.OutlineTransparency),
					instance.FillColor:ToRaylib(instance.FillTransparency),
					instance.OutlineThickness
				)
			end
		end)

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		return instance

return {
	class = "HingeConstraint",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		local KinemiumPhysicsService = datamodel:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local _activeConstraint = nil

		local function cleanup()
			if _activeConstraint then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.lib.JPH_PhysicsSystem_RemoveConstraint(
					KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.physicsSystem,
					_activeConstraint
				)
				_activeConstraint = nil
			end
		end

		local function rebuild()
			cleanup()

			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end
			if not instance.Attachment0 or not instance.Attachment1 then
				return
			end

			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			local part0 = att0.Parent
			local part1 = att1.Parent

			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return
			end

			if not NetworkOwnership.ShouldSimulateConstraintForMachine(instance, datamodel) then
				return
			end

			-- Wait for bodies to exist
			local bodyID0 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part0)
			local bodyID1 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part1)

			if not bodyID0 or not bodyID1 then
				task.defer(rebuild)
				return
			end

			-- Convert attachments to World Space
			local wPos0 = part0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wAxis0 = part0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.Axis):Unit()
			local wNormal0 = part0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.SecondaryAxis):Unit()

			-- Attachment1 is offset by the constraint's Offset property
			local offsetCF = instance.Offset
			local wPos1 = part1.CFrame * (att1.Position + offsetCF.Position)
			local wAxis1 = part1.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(offsetCF:VectorToWorldSpace(att1.Axis)):Unit()
			local wNormal1 = part1.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(offsetCF:VectorToWorldSpace(att1.SecondaryAxis)):Unit()

			_activeConstraint = KinemiumPhysicsService.CreateHinge(
				part0,
				part1,
				wPos0,
				wAxis0,
				wNormal0,
				wPos1,
				wAxis1,
				wNormal1,
				instance.MotorMaxTorque
			)

			if _activeConstraint then
				-- Initial state sync
				instance:UpdateActuator()
				instance:UpdateLimits()

				-- Re-apply motor state when a connected body becomes dynamic.
				-- Jolt silently ignores motor state on static bodies; once unanchored
				-- we must push the motor settings + state again.
				-- description: "Ons part changed."
				-- args: "property: number"
				local function onPartChanged(property)
					if property == "Anchored" then
						task.defer(function()
							instance:UpdateActuator()
						end)
					end
				end
				if part0 then
					part0.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
				end
				if part1 then
					part1.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
				end
			else
				warn("[HingeConstraint] CreateHinge returned nil - bodies may not be registered yet")
				task.defer(rebuild)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Updates actuator."
		function instance:UpdateActuator()
			if not _activeConstraint then
				return
			end

			local actuator = instance.ActuatorType
			if actuator == Enum.ActuatorType.None then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeMotorState(_activeConstraint, 0) -- Off
			elseif actuator == Enum.ActuatorType.Motor then
				-- Settings MUST be applied before state for Jolt motor to work
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeMotorSettings(_activeConstraint, instance.MotorMaxTorque)
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeMotorState(_activeConstraint, 1) -- Velocity
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeTargetVelocity(_activeConstraint, instance.AngularVelocity)
			elseif actuator == Enum.ActuatorType.Servo then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeMotorSettings(_activeConstraint, instance.ServoMaxTorque)
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeMotorState(_activeConstraint, 2) -- Position
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeTargetAngle(_activeConstraint, math.rad(instance.TargetAngle))
			end

			-- Force activation to ensure motor starts immediately
			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			if att0 and att0.Parent then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ActivatePart(att0.Parent)
			end
			if att1 and att1.Parent then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ActivatePart(att1.Parent)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Updates limits."
		function instance:UpdateLimits()
			if not _activeConstraint then
				return
			end
			if instance.LimitsEnabled then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeLimits(
					_activeConstraint,
					math.rad(instance.LowerAngle),
					math.rad(instance.UpperAngle)
				)
			else
				-- Jolt "no limits" is usually -PI to PI or similar, but specifically disabling it in settings is best.
				-- For now, if disabled, we set a huge range.
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetHingeLimits(_activeConstraint, -math.pi * 10, math.pi * 10)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Draws the visual representation."
		local function drawGizmo()
			if not instance.Visible then
				return
			end
			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			if not att0 or not att1 then
				return
			end

			local p0 = att0.Parent
			local p1 = att1.Parent
			if not p0 or not p1 then
				return
			end

			-- World coordinates
			local wPos0 = p0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wAxis0 = p0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.Axis):Unit()
			local wNormal0 = p0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.SecondaryAxis):Unit()
			local wPerp0 = wAxis0:Cross(wNormal0):Unit() -- The other axis in the plane

			local color = instance.Color
			-- description: "Tos raylib color."
			-- args: "c: any, a: number"
			local function toRaylibColor(c, a)
				return raylib.structs.Color:new({ r = c.R * 255, g = c.G * 255, b = c.B * 255, a = a or 255 })
			end

			local mainColor = toRaylibColor(color)
			local secondaryColor = toRaylibColor(Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), 100) -- Faded grey
			local limitColor = toRaylibColor(Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50), 150) -- Transparent red

			-- 1. Draw Central Axis (Cylinder)
			local axisLen = 1.0
			local axisStart = wPos0 - (wAxis0 * (axisLen / 2))
			local axisEnd = wPos0 + (wAxis0 * (axisLen / 2))
			rl.DrawCylinderEx(
				vector.create(axisStart.X, axisStart.Y, axisStart.Z),
				vector.create(axisEnd.X, axisEnd.Y, axisEnd.Z),
				0.02,
				0.02,
				8,
				mainColor
			)

			-- 2. Draw Pivot Sphere
			rl.DrawSphere(vector.create(wPos0.X, wPos0.Y, wPos0.Z), 0.05, mainColor)

			-- 3. Draw Rotation Ring (Circle)
			local ringRadius = 0.5
			local segments = 32
			local prevRingPoint = nil
			for i = 0, segments do
				local rad = (i / segments) * math.pi * 2
				local ringPoint = wPos0
					+ (wNormal0 * math.cos(rad) * ringRadius)
					+ (wPerp0 * math.sin(rad) * ringRadius)
				if prevRingPoint then
					rl.DrawLine3D(
						vector.create(prevRingPoint.X, prevRingPoint.Y, prevRingPoint.Z),
						vector.create(ringPoint.X, ringPoint.Y, ringPoint.Z),
						secondaryColor
					)
				end
				prevRingPoint = ringPoint
			end

			-- 4. Draw Current Angle (if active)
			local currentAngle = 0
			if _activeConstraint then
				currentAngle = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetHingeAngle(_activeConstraint)
			end

			local angleDir = (wNormal0 * math.cos(currentAngle) + wPerp0 * math.sin(currentAngle)):Unit()
			local angleEnd = wPos0 + (angleDir * ringRadius)
			rl.DrawLine3D(
				vector.create(wPos0.X, wPos0.Y, wPos0.Z),
				vector.create(angleEnd.X, angleEnd.Y, angleEnd.Z),
				mainColor
			)

			-- 5. Draw Limits (Arcs)
			if instance.LimitsEnabled then
				local low = math.rad(instance.LowerAngle)
				local high = math.rad(instance.UpperAngle)
				local limitSegments = 16

				-- Draw boundary lines
				local lowDir = (wNormal0 * math.cos(low) + wPerp0 * math.sin(low)):Unit()
				local highDir = (wNormal0 * math.cos(high) + wPerp0 * math.sin(high)):Unit()

				rl.DrawLine3D(
					vector.create(wPos0.X, wPos0.Y, wPos0.Z),
					vector.create(
						wPos0.X + lowDir.X * ringRadius,
						wPos0.Y + lowDir.Y * ringRadius,
						wPos0.Z + lowDir.Z * ringRadius
					),
					limitColor
				)
				rl.DrawLine3D(
					vector.create(wPos0.X, wPos0.Y, wPos0.Z),
					vector.create(
						wPos0.X + highDir.X * ringRadius,
						wPos0.Y + highDir.Y * ringRadius,
						wPos0.Z + highDir.Z * ringRadius
					),
					limitColor
				)

				-- Draw arc
				local prevLimitPoint = nil
				for i = 0, limitSegments do
					local rad = low + (i / limitSegments) * (high - low)
					local limitPoint = wPos0
						+ (wNormal0 * math.cos(rad) * ringRadius)
						+ (wPerp0 * math.sin(rad) * ringRadius)
					if prevLimitPoint then
						rl.DrawLine3D(
							vector.create(prevLimitPoint.X, prevLimitPoint.Y, prevLimitPoint.Z),
							vector.create(limitPoint.X, limitPoint.Y, limitPoint.Z),
							limitColor
						)
					end
					prevLimitPoint = limitPoint
				end
			end
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if prop == "Attachment0" or prop == "Attachment1" or prop == "Enabled" or prop == "Offset" then
				rebuild()
			elseif
				prop == "ActuatorType"
				or prop == "AngularVelocity"
				or prop == "TargetAngle"
				or prop == "MotorMaxTorque"
				or prop == "ServoMaxTorque"
			then
				instance:UpdateActuator()
			elseif prop == "LimitsEnabled" or prop == "LowerAngle" or prop == "UpperAngle" then
				instance:UpdateLimits()
			end
		end)

		-- Handle parent cleanup
		instance.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if not parent then
				cleanup()
			end
		end)

		renderer.Pool.new("gizmo", function()
			drawGizmo()
		end)

		rebuild()

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local function isVec3(v)
	return type(v) == "table" and type(v.Magnitude) == "function"

	return type(v) == "table" and type(v.ToTable) == "function"

local function flat(v)
	if not isVec3(v) then
		return ZERO, false
	end
	local f = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
	local m = f:Magnitude()
	if m <= 1e-4 then
		return ZERO, false
	end
	return f / m, true
end

local function characterOf(h)
	local c = h.Character
	if c and c.Parent ~= nil then
		return c
	end
	local p = h.Parent
	if p and p.ClassName == "Model" then
		h.Character = p
		return p
	end
	return nil
end

local function ownerRoot(h)
	local c = characterOf(h)
	if c and c.FindFirstChildOfClass and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("NetworkController") then
		return c
	end
	return h.RootPart
end

local function localOwner(h, game)
	if IsClient ~= true or not game or not game.GetService then
		return false
	end

	local players = game:GetService("Players")
	local lp = players and players.LocalPlayer or nil
	if not lp then
		return false
	end

	local replicator = game:GetService("ReplicatorService")
	local ownership = replicator and replicator.NetworkOwnership or nil
	local target = ownerRoot(h)
	if ownership and ownership.IsOwnedByPlayer and target ~= nil then
		return ownership.IsOwnedByPlayer(target, lp) == true
	end

	local char = characterOf(h)
	return char ~= nil and char.Name == lp.Name
end

local function shouldSimulate(h, game)
	local target = ownerRoot(h)
	local isLocalOwner = localOwner(h, game)
	local replicator = game and game.GetService and game:GetService("ReplicatorService") or nil
	local ownership = replicator and replicator.NetworkOwnership or nil
	if ownership and ownership.ShouldSimulatePhysicsForMachine and target ~= nil then
		return ownership.ShouldSimulatePhysicsForMachine(target, game) == true
	end

	if IsServer == true then
		return isLocalOwner ~= true
	end

	return isLocalOwner == true
end

local function canSim(h)
	if h.ControllerEnabled == false or h.PlatformStand == true or h.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

end

local humanoidDebugAt = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function shouldLogHumanoidRoot(root, interval)
	if root == nil then
		return false
	end

	local isRoot = (root.GetAttribute and root:GetAttribute("__humanoidRigRoot") == true)
		or root.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
	if not isRoot then
		return false
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local minInterval = interval or 0.5
	if now - (humanoidDebugAt[root] or -math.huge) < minInterval then
		return false
	end

	humanoidDebugAt[root] = now
	return true
end

local function speedMul(h)
	local m = 1
	for _, v in pairs(h.SpeedModifiers or {}) do
		if type(v) == "number" and v == v then
			m *= v
		end
	end
	if h.Crouching then
		m *= h.CrouchSpeedMultiplier
	elseif h.Sprinting then
		m *= h.SprintMultiplier
	end
	return math.max(m, 0)
end
