		return
	end

	part:SetAttribute("__humanoidRigPart", true)
	part:SetAttribute("__humanoidRigRoot", isRoot == true)
	part:SetAttribute("__humanoidRigSkipOwnedState", isRoot ~= true)
end

local function partFor(name, parent, spec, isRoot, createInstance)
	local existing = spec.Part ~= nil
	local part = spec.Part or createInstance("Part")
	part.Name = spec.Name or name
	if spec.Size ~= nil or not existing then
		part.Size = spec.Size or Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
	end
	if spec.Color ~= nil or not existing then
		part.Color = spec.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	if spec.Material ~= nil then
		part.Material = spec.Material
	end
	if spec.Transparency ~= nil or not existing then
		part.Transparency = spec.Transparency or 0
	end
	if spec.Anchored ~= nil or not existing then
		part.Anchored = if spec.Anchored ~= nil then spec.Anchored else true
	end
	if spec.CanCollide ~= nil or not existing then
		part.CanCollide = if spec.CanCollide ~= nil then spec.CanCollide else isRoot ~= true
	end
	if spec.CastsShadow ~= nil or not existing then
		part.CastsShadow = if spec.CastsShadow ~= nil then spec.CastsShadow else true
	end
	if spec.CFrame ~= nil then
		part.CFrame = spec.CFrame
	end
	markRigPart(part, isRoot)
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function buildRig(parent, bindings, createInstance)
	local built, parts, chains, index = {}, {}, {}, {}
	for bindName, spec in pairs(bindings or {}) do
		local bind = { Name = bindName, Transform = spec.Transform or ID, Segments = {} }
		local segs = spec.Segments
		if type(segs) ~= "table" or #segs == 0 then
			segs = {
				{
					Name = "Main",
					Part = spec.Part,
					Size = spec.Size,
					Color = spec.Color,
					Material = spec.Material,
					Transparency = spec.Transparency,
					Anchored = spec.Anchored,
					CanCollide = spec.CanCollide,
					CastsShadow = spec.CastsShadow,
					CFrame = spec.CFrame,
					Transform = ID,
					CenterOffset = spec.CenterOffset or ID,
				},
			}
		end

		local chain = {}
		for i, segSpec in ipairs(segs) do
			local segName = segSpec.Name or segSpec.Key or tostring(i)
			local partName = if segName == "Main" then bindName else `{bindName}_{segName}`
			local partSpec = copy(segSpec)
			partSpec.Name = segSpec.PartName or partName
			local part = partFor(partName, parent, partSpec, false, createInstance)
			local seg = {
				Name = segName,
				Part = part,
				Transform = segSpec.Transform or ID,
				CenterOffset = segSpec.CenterOffset or ID,
			}
			table.insert(bind.Segments, seg)
			table.insert(chain, part)
			index[bindName] = index[bindName] or part
			index[`{bindName}.{segName}`] = part
		end

		built[bindName] = bind
		chains[bindName] = chain
		parts[bindName] = if #chain == 1 then chain[1] else chain
	end
	return built, parts, chains, index
end

local function encodeRigDescriptor(descriptor)
	if type(descriptor) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	local serializable = {
		RootPartName = descriptor.RootPartName or "HumanoidRootPart",
		Bindings = {},
	}

	for bindingName, binding in pairs(descriptor.Bindings or {}) do
		local bindingData = {
			Transform = (binding.Transform or ID):ToTable(),
			Segments = {},
		}

		for _, seg in ipairs(binding.Segments or {}) do
			table.insert(bindingData.Segments, {
				Name = seg.Name,
				PartName = seg.PartName,
				Transform = (seg.Transform or ID):ToTable(),
				CenterOffset = (seg.CenterOffset or ID):ToTable(),
			})
		end

		serializable.Bindings[bindingName] = bindingData
	end

	local ok, encoded = pcall(JSON.encode, serializable)
	return ok and encoded or nil
end

local function decodeRigDescriptor(rawDescriptor)
	local descriptor = rawDescriptor
	if type(rawDescriptor) == "string" then
		if rawDescriptor == "" then
			return nil
		end

		local ok, decoded = pcall(JSON.decode, rawDescriptor)
		if not ok or type(decoded) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		descriptor = decoded
	end

	if type(descriptor) ~= "table" or type(descriptor.Bindings) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	local normalized = {
		RootPartName = descriptor.RootPartName or "HumanoidRootPart",
		Bindings = {},
	}

	for bindingName, binding in pairs(descriptor.Bindings) do
		local normalizedBinding = {
			Transform = isCF(binding.Transform) and binding.Transform
				or CFrame.FromTable(binding.Transform or ID:ToTable()),
			Segments = {},
		}

		for _, seg in ipairs(binding.Segments or {}) do
			table.insert(normalizedBinding.Segments, {
				Name = seg.Name or "Main",
				PartName = seg.PartName,
				Transform = isCF(seg.Transform) and seg.Transform or CFrame.FromTable(seg.Transform or ID:ToTable()),
				CenterOffset = isCF(seg.CenterOffset) and seg.CenterOffset
					or CFrame.FromTable(seg.CenterOffset or ID:ToTable()),
			})
		end

		normalized.Bindings[bindingName] = normalizedBinding
	end

	return normalized
end

local function exportRigDescriptor(root, bindings)
	local descriptor = {
		RootPartName = root and root.Name or "HumanoidRootPart",
		Bindings = {},
	}

	for bindingName, binding in pairs(bindings or {}) do
		local bindingDescriptor = {
			Transform = binding.Transform or ID,
			Segments = {},
		}

		for _, seg in ipairs(binding.Segments or {}) do
			table.insert(bindingDescriptor.Segments, {
				Name = seg.Name,
				PartName = seg.Part and seg.Part.Name or nil,
				Transform = seg.Transform or ID,
				CenterOffset = seg.CenterOffset or ID,
			})
		end

		descriptor.Bindings[bindingName] = bindingDescriptor
	end

	return encodeRigDescriptor(descriptor)
end

local function inferRigDescriptorFromCharacter(char, root)
	if not char or char.FindFirstChild == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local template = defaultRig({})
	local bindings = {}

	for bindingName, bindingSpec in pairs(template.Bindings or {}) do
		local part = char:FindFirstChild(bindingName)
		if part then
			bindings[bindingName] = {
				Transform = bindingSpec.Transform or ID,
				Segments = {
					{
						Name = "Main",
						PartName = part.Name,
						Transform = ID,
						CenterOffset = bindingSpec.CenterOffset or ID,
					},
				},
			}
		end
	end

	if next(bindings) == nil then
		return nil
	end

	return {
		RootPartName = (root and root.Name) or "HumanoidRootPart",
		Bindings = bindings,
	}
end

local function syncRoot(h)
	local root = h.RootPart
	if not root or root.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	local c = rawget(h, "_humanoidController")
	if not c then
		return
	end
	-- Only initialize currentPos once. The authoritative physics loop accumulates
	-- it every tick via c.currentPos += vel * dt; resetting it here (e.g. when a
	-- replicated Character/RigDescriptor patch fires Changed) would teleport the
	-- character back to origin. The non-authoritative branch syncs it explicitly.
	if c.currentPos == nil then
		c.currentPos = root.CFrame.Position
	end
	local look, ok = flat(root.CFrame:GetLookVector())
	c.lookXZ = ok and look or LOOK
end

local function segPose(pose, name, i)
	if isCF(pose) then
		return pose
	end
	if type(pose) ~= "table" then
		return ID
	end
	if isCF(pose[name]) then
		return pose[name]
	end
	local shortName = name:match("_(.+)$")
	if shortName and isCF(pose[shortName]) then
		return pose[shortName]
	end
	if isCF(pose[i]) then
		return pose[i]
	end
	return ID
end

local function poseOffset(h, bindingName, segName, i)
	local offsets = h.PoseOffsets and h.PoseOffsets[bindingName] or nil
	return segPose(offsets, segName, i)
end

local function applyPose(h, rootCF, pose)
	local c = rawget(h, "_humanoidController")
	if not c then
		return
	end
	-- Track final CFrames per binding name for accessory attachment
	local partCFrames = {}
	for bindingName, binding in pairs(c.bindings) do
		local bindPose = pose[bindingName]
		for i, seg in ipairs(binding.Segments) do
			if seg.Part and seg.Part.Parent ~= nil then
				local finalCF = rootCF
					* binding.Transform
					* seg.Transform
					* segPose(bindPose, seg.Name, i)
					* poseOffset(h, bindingName, seg.Name, i)
					* seg.CenterOffset

				seg.Part.CFrame = finalCF
				-- Store the first segment's CFrame as the binding's CFrame
				if not partCFrames[bindingName] then
					partCFrames[bindingName] = finalCF
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Position accessories relative to their parent body part
	for _, accEntry in ipairs(c.accessories) do
		local accessory = accEntry.accessory
		local attachPoint = accEntry.attachmentPoint
		if accessory and accessory.Parent ~= nil then
			local parentCF = partCFrames[attachPoint] or rootCF
			local att = accessory.GetAttachment and accessory:GetAttachment() or nil
			local offset = att and att.CFrame or ID
			accessory.CFrame = parentCF * offset
		end
	end
end

local function setState(h, c, nextState)
	if c.state == nextState then
		return
	end
	local prev = c.state
	c.state = nextState
	h.State = nextState
	h.StateMachine:ChangeState(nextState)
	h.StateChanged:Fire(prev, nextState)
	if nextState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
		h.Jumping:Fire(true)
	elseif nextState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
		h.FreeFalling:Fire(true)
	elseif nextState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
		h.FreeFalling:Fire(false)
		h.Landed:Fire()
	end
end

local function updateStance(h)
	local nextStance = "default"
	if h.SeatPart ~= nil then
		nextStance = "seated"
	elseif h.Dashing then
		nextStance = "dash"
	elseif h.Crouching then
		nextStance = "crouch"
	elseif h.Sprinting then
		nextStance = "sprint"
	end
	if h.Stance ~= nextStance then
		local prev = h.Stance
		h.Stance = nextStance
		h.StanceChanged:Fire(prev, nextStance)
	end
end

local function isSeated(h)
	return h.SeatPart ~= nil
end

local function reportSpeed(h, c, speed)
	if math.abs(speed - c.lastSpeed) <= 0.05 then
		return
	end
	c.lastSpeed = speed
	h.Running:Fire(speed)
end

local function restoreRigFromDescriptor(h, c)
	if not c or c.restoringRig == true then
		return false
	end
	c.restoringRig = true

	local success = false
	local char = characterOf(h)
	local descriptor = decodeRigDescriptor(h.RigDescriptor)
	if descriptor == nil then
		descriptor = inferRigDescriptorFromCharacter(char, h.RootPart)
	end
	repeat
		if not char or type(descriptor) ~= "table" or type(descriptor.Bindings) ~= "table" then
			break
		end

		local root = h.RootPart
		if not root or root.Parent ~= char then
			root = descriptor.RootPartName and char:FindFirstChild(descriptor.RootPartName)
				or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then
				break
			end
			-- Only set RootPart if it changed, to avoid triggering Changed
			if h.RootPart ~= root then
				h.RootPart = root
			end
		end
		markRigPart(root, true)

		local bindings, rigParts, rigChains, partIndex = {}, {}, {}, {}
		for bindingName, bindingDescriptor in pairs(descriptor.Bindings) do
			local restoredBinding = {
				Name = bindingName,
				Transform = bindingDescriptor.Transform or ID,
				Segments = {},
			}
			local chain = {}

			for i, segDescriptor in ipairs(bindingDescriptor.Segments or {}) do
				local partName = segDescriptor.PartName
					or (segDescriptor.Name == "Main" and bindingName or `{bindingName}_{segDescriptor.Name}`)
				local part = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
				if part then
					markRigPart(part, false)
					local segment = {
						Name = segDescriptor.Name or tostring(i),
						Part = part,
						Transform = segDescriptor.Transform or ID,
						CenterOffset = segDescriptor.CenterOffset or ID,
					}
					table.insert(restoredBinding.Segments, segment)
					table.insert(chain, part)
					partIndex[bindingName] = partIndex[bindingName] or part
					partIndex[`{bindingName}.{segment.Name}`] = part
				end
			end

			if #restoredBinding.Segments > 0 then
				bindings[bindingName] = restoredBinding
				rigChains[bindingName] = chain
				rigParts[bindingName] = #chain == 1 and chain[1] or chain
			end
		end

		if next(bindings) == nil then
			break
		end

		h.RigBindings = bindings
		h.RigParts = rigParts
		h.RigChains = rigChains
		h.RigPartIndex = partIndex
		c.bindings = bindings
		c.partIndex = partIndex
		syncRoot(h)
		if root then
			applyPose(h, root.CFrame, {})
		end
		success = true
	until true
	c.restoringRig = false
	return success
end

local function humanoidDefaultPose(animator, humanoid, context)
	context = context or {}

	local stance = context.stance or humanoid.Stance or "default"

	if stance == "seated" then
		local clock = context.clock or 0
		local breathing = math.sin(clock * 1.2)
		local idleArmSway = 0.06 + breathing * 0.03

		return {
			Torso = CFrame.Angles(0.1, 0, 0),
			Head = CFrame.Angles(-0.05 + breathing * 0.01, 0, 0),
			LeftArm = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -idleArmSway - 0.3),
			RightArm = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, idleArmSway + 0.3),
			LeftLeg = CFrame.Angles(-math.pi * 0.5, 0, 0.06),
			RightLeg = CFrame.Angles(-math.pi * 0.5, 0, -0.06),
		}
	end

	local clock = context.clock or animator.Clock or 0
	local speed = math.max(context.speed or 0, 0)
	local walkSpeed = math.max(context.walkSpeed or humanoid.WalkSpeed or 16, 1)
	local moveAlpha = math.clamp(speed / walkSpeed, 0, 1)
	local airborne = context.airborne == true
	local lean = context.lean or 0
	local landBob = math.max(context.landBob or 0, 0)
	local stance = context.stance or humanoid.Stance or "default"
	local verticalVelocity = context.verticalVelocity or 0

	local sprintAlpha = stance == "sprint" and 1 or 0
	local crouchAlpha = stance == "crouch" and 1 or 0
	local dashAlpha = stance == "dash" and 1 or 0

	local walkSwingLimit = 0.52
	local sprintSwingMultiplier = 1.35
	local stride = context.stride or (clock * 4)

	local armSwing = math.sin(stride) * walkSwingLimit * (1 + sprintAlpha * (sprintSwingMultiplier - 1)) * moveAlpha
	local legSwing = math.sin(stride) * walkSwingLimit * (1 + sprintAlpha * (sprintSwingMultiplier - 1)) * moveAlpha
	local sideBob = math.cos(stride) * 0.05 * moveAlpha

	-- Run lean: pitch torso forward based on speed
	local runLean = moveAlpha * (0.12 + sprintAlpha * 0.1)

	local idleAlpha = (1 - moveAlpha)
	local breathing = math.sin(clock * 1.2)
	local idleArmSway = (0.08 + breathing * 0.04) * idleAlpha
	local idleTorsoBob = breathing * 0.015 * idleAlpha
	local idleHeadTilt = math.sin(clock * 0.8) * 0.012 * idleAlpha

	local torsoPitch = idleTorsoBob
		- crouchAlpha * 0.45
		+ sprintAlpha * 0.08
		+ dashAlpha * 0.35
		- landBob * 0.22
		+ runLean
	local torsoTwist = math.sin(stride * 0.5) * 0.08 * moveAlpha + (breathing * 0.01 * idleAlpha)
	local headPitch = crouchAlpha * 0.18 - dashAlpha * 0.08 - breathing * 0.02 * idleAlpha - runLean * 0.5
	local armRoll = lean * 0.35
	local legRoll = lean * 0.18

	-- Squash & stretch scalars (applied via pose offsets on torso/legs)
	-- >0 = squash (landing), <0 = stretch (rising fast)
	local stretchAlpha = 0
	local squashAlpha = 0

	if airborne then
		local absVel = math.abs(verticalVelocity)

		-- Peak hang: near apex, limbs spread for floaty feel
		local peakAlpha = math.clamp(1 - absVel / 8, 0, 1)
		peakAlpha = peakAlpha * peakAlpha -- ease in

		-- Rising: stretch upward
		local riseAlpha = math.clamp(verticalVelocity / 20, 0, 1)
		stretchAlpha = riseAlpha * (1 - peakAlpha)

		-- Falling: tuck legs, pull arms in
		local fallAlpha = math.clamp(-verticalVelocity / 20, 0, 1)

		local flail = math.sin(clock * 18) * 0.08

		if verticalVelocity > 0.5 then
			-- Rising: arms back and up, legs kick back
			torsoPitch -= 0.1 + stretchAlpha * 0.08
			headPitch += 0.06 + stretchAlpha * 0.04
			armSwing = -0.55 - stretchAlpha * 0.2 + flail
			legSwing = 0.3 + stretchAlpha * 0.15
		elseif verticalVelocity < -0.5 then
			-- Falling: lean forward, tuck legs, arms wide
			torsoPitch += 0.18 + fallAlpha * 0.12
			headPitch -= 0.12 - fallAlpha * 0.05
			armSwing = 0.75 + fallAlpha * 0.2 + flail
			legSwing = -0.45 - fallAlpha * 0.2 -- legs tuck up behind
		else
			-- Peak hang: spread everything out
			armSwing = (0.55 + peakAlpha * 0.2) + flail
			legSwing = 0.35 + peakAlpha * 0.15
			torsoPitch -= peakAlpha * 0.05
		end

		-- At apex: arms splay outward (roll) for that classic hang look
		armRoll = armRoll + peakAlpha * 0.3
	else
		-- Grounded landing squash: stronger than just landBob on torso
		squashAlpha = landBob
		torsoPitch += squashAlpha * 0.1
		-- Legs bend more on landing
		legSwing = legSwing + squashAlpha * 0.2
	end

	if dashAlpha > 0 then
		armSwing = -0.8
		legSwing = 0.55
	end

	local microHeadYaw = math.sin(clock * 0.9) * 0.02 * idleAlpha
	local microHeadPitch = math.sin(clock * 1.1 + 2) * 0.015 * idleAlpha
	local microTorsoRoll = math.sin(clock * 0.7 + 1) * 0.01 * idleAlpha
	local microShoulderBob = math.sin(clock * 1.5 + 3) * 0.01 * idleAlpha
	local microHipBob = math.sin(clock * 1.3 + 4) * 0.01 * idleAlpha

	local lookActivity = math.clamp(math.sin(clock * 0.45) * 2.5 - 1.5, 0, 1)
	local idleLookYaw = math.sin(clock * 0.8) * math.sin(clock * 0.3) * 0.6 * lookActivity * idleAlpha
	local idleLookPitch = math.cos(clock * 0.7) * math.sin(clock * 0.2) * 0.25 * lookActivity * idleAlpha

	local handCheckActivity = math.clamp(math.sin(clock * 0.15) * 6 - 5, 0, 1) * idleAlpha
	local handSide = math.sin(clock * 0.075) > 0 and 1 or -1
	local checkPitch = -1.2 * handCheckActivity
	local checkYaw = -0.45 * handSide * handCheckActivity

	idleLookYaw = (idleLookYaw * (1 - handCheckActivity)) + (checkYaw * handCheckActivity)
	idleLookPitch = (idleLookPitch * (1 - handCheckActivity)) + (0.22 * handCheckActivity)

	local headHeightOffset = -crouchAlpha * 0.55 + sprintAlpha * 0.05
	local headDepthOffset = crouchAlpha * 0.15 - sprintAlpha * 0.1

	local pose = {
		Torso = CFrame.Angles(torsoPitch + sideBob + microHipBob, torsoTwist, lean * 0.4 + microTorsoRoll),
		Head = CFrame.new(0, headHeightOffset, headDepthOffset) * CFrame.Angles(
			headPitch + idleHeadTilt + microHeadPitch + idleLookPitch,
			-torsoTwist * 0.35 + microHeadYaw + idleLookYaw,
			-lean * 0.35
		),
		LeftArm = CFrame.Angles(
			-armSwing - crouchAlpha * 0.2 + dashAlpha * 0.35 + microShoulderBob + (handSide == -1 and checkPitch or 0),
			(handSide == -1 and 0.45 * handCheckActivity or 0),
			-armRoll - idleArmSway + (handSide == -1 and 0.2 * handCheckActivity or 0)
		),
		RightArm = CFrame.Angles(
			armSwing - crouchAlpha * 0.2 + dashAlpha * 0.35 - microShoulderBob + (handSide == 1 and checkPitch or 0),
			(handSide == 1 and -0.45 * handCheckActivity or 0),
			armRoll + idleArmSway + (handSide == 1 and -0.2 * handCheckActivity or 0)
		),
		-- Legs spread slightly at apex, tuck on fall
		LeftLeg = CFrame.Angles(
			legSwing + (crouchAlpha * 0.25) + sideBob * 0.5,
			0,
			legRoll + (airborne and armRoll * 0.3 or 0)
		),
		RightLeg = CFrame.Angles(
			-legSwing + (crouchAlpha * 0.25) - sideBob * 0.5,
			0,
			-legRoll - (airborne and armRoll * 0.3 or 0)
		),
	}

	return pose
end

local function configureAnimator(animator, autoEnableDefaults)
	if not animator or animator.ClassName ~= "Animator" then
		return nil
	end

	if animator.SetDefaultProvider and animator.DefaultProvider == nil then
		animator:SetDefaultProvider(humanoidDefaultPose)
	end

	if autoEnableDefaults == true then
		animator.UseDefaultAnimations = true
	elseif
		animator.DefaultProvider == humanoidDefaultPose
		and animator.PoseProvider == nil
		and next(animator.PoseLayers or {}) == nil
	then
		animator.UseDefaultAnimations = true
	end

	return animator
end

local function getAnimator(h, createIfMissing, createInstance)
	local animator = h.Animator
	if animator and animator.Parent ~= nil and animator.ClassName == "Animator" then
		return configureAnimator(animator, false)
	end

	local childAnimator = h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if childAnimator then
		h.Animator = childAnimator
		return configureAnimator(childAnimator, false)
	end

	if createIfMissing and IsClient == true and h.NetworkId ~= nil then
		return nil
	end

	if createIfMissing then
		animator = createInstance("Animator")
		animator.Parent = h
		h.Animator = animator
		return configureAnimator(animator, true)
	end

	return nil
end

local registry = require("@Kinemium.registry")
local InputActionService = require("@InputActionService")
local RollbackEngine = require("@RollbackEngine")

return {
	class = "Humanoid",
	callback = function(h, renderer, game)
		local function getAssociatedPlayer(humanoid)
			local char = humanoid.Parent
			if char and char.ClassName == "Model" then
				local players = game:GetService("Players")
				return players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
			end
			return nil
		end
		if rawget(h, "_humanoidCallbackInitialized") == true and rawget(h, "_humanoidController") ~= nil then
			return h
		end

		local c = controller()
		rawset(h, "_humanoidCallbackInitialized", true)
		rawset(h, "_humanoidController", c)

		h:SetProperties(props())

		local function createObject(className)
			if registry and registry.new then
				local ok, created = pcall(registry.new, className, renderer, game)
				if ok and created then
					return created
				end
			end
			return Instance.new(className)
		end

		local function bind(def)
			local char = def.Character or characterOf(h)
			if not char or char.ClassName ~= "Model" then
				return nil
			end

			local rootSpec = copy(def.RootPart or {})
			rootSpec.CFrame = rootSpec.CFrame or (h.RootPart and h.RootPart.CFrame) or CFrame.new(0, 20, 0)
			if rootSpec.Anchored == nil then
				rootSpec.Anchored = true
			end

			local root = partFor(rootSpec.Name or "HumanoidRootPart", char, rootSpec, true, createObject)
			local bindings, rigParts, rigChains, partIndex = buildRig(char, def.Bindings, createObject)

			char.PrimaryPart = root
			char.WorldPivot = root.CFrame
			h.Character = char
			h.RootPart = root
			h.RigType = def.RigType or h.RigType
			h.HipHeight = def.HipHeight or h.HipHeight
			h.CameraOffset = def.CameraOffset or h.CameraOffset
			h.FocusOffset = def.FocusOffset or h.FocusOffset
			h.RigBindings = bindings
			h.RigParts = rigParts
			h.RigChains = rigChains
			h.RigPartIndex = partIndex
			h.RigDescriptor = exportRigDescriptor(root, bindings)

			local c = rawget(h, "_humanoidController")
			c.bindings = bindings
			c.partIndex = partIndex

			getAnimator(h, true, createObject)
			syncRoot(h)
			applyPose(h, root.CFrame, {})
			h.RigBuilt:Fire(char, rigParts)
			return char
		end

		-- description: "Binds a rig definition to the humanoid without creating default parts."
		-- args: "def: any"
		-- returns: "Model?"
		function h:BindRig(def)
			return bind(def or {})
		end

		-- description: "Builds rig parts from a rig definition and binds them to the humanoid."
		-- args: "def: any"
		-- returns: "Model?"
		function h:BuildRig(def)
			return bind(def or {})
		end

		-- description: "Creates and binds a default humanoid rig."
		-- args: "options: table"
		-- returns: "Model?"
		function h:CreateDefaultRig(options)
			local def = defaultRig(options)
			def.Character = options and options.Character or characterOf(self)
			return bind(def)
		end

		-- description: "Restores rig bindings from the current rig descriptor or character parts."
		-- returns: "boolean"
		function h:RestoreRig()
			return restoreRigFromDescriptor(self, c)
		end

		-- description: "Returns a rig part by binding or indexed segment name."
		-- args: "name: string"
		-- returns: "any"
		function h:GetRigPart(name)
			return (self.RigPartIndex and self.RigPartIndex[name]) or (self.RigParts and self.RigParts[name]) or nil
		end

		-- description: "Returns the ordered part chain for a rig binding."
		-- args: "name: string"
		-- returns: "{ any }?"
		function h:GetRigChain(name)
			return self.RigChains and self.RigChains[name] or nil
		end

		-- description: "Returns the active rig binding table."
		-- returns: "table"
		function h:GetRigBindings()
			return self.RigBindings or {}
		end

		-- description: "Sets the animator instance or pose provider used by this humanoid."
		-- args: "animatorOrProvider: any"
		-- returns: "any"
		function h:SetAnimator(animatorOrProvider)
			if type(animatorOrProvider) == "function" then
				local animator = getAnimator(self, true, createObject)
				animator:SetPoseProvider(animatorOrProvider)
				self.Animator = animator
				return animator
			end
			if type(animatorOrProvider) == "table" and animatorOrProvider.ClassName == "Animator" then
				if animatorOrProvider.Parent ~= self then
					animatorOrProvider.Parent = self
				end
				self.Animator = configureAnimator(animatorOrProvider, false)
				return self.Animator
			end
			return nil
		end

		-- description: "Sets an additional pose offset for a rig binding."
		-- args: "name: string, offset: CFrame"
		function h:SetPoseOffset(name, offset)
			local t = copy(self.PoseOffsets)
			t[name] = offset
			self.PoseOffsets = t
		end

		-- description: "Clears a pose offset for a rig binding."
		-- args: "name: string"
		function h:ClearPoseOffset(name)
			local t = copy(self.PoseOffsets)
			t[name] = nil
			self.PoseOffsets = t
		end

		-- description: "Adds or replaces a named movement speed multiplier."
		-- args: "key: any, mult: number"
		function h:SetSpeedModifier(key, mult)
			local t = copy(self.SpeedModifiers)
			t[key] = mult
			self.SpeedModifiers = t
		end

		-- description: "Removes a named movement speed multiplier."
		-- args: "key: any"
		function h:RemoveSpeedModifier(key)
			local t = copy(self.SpeedModifiers)
			t[key] = nil
			self.SpeedModifiers = t
		end

		-- description: "Sets a callback that can override or add inverse-kinematics pose data."
		-- args: "source: any, callback: function"
		function h:SetIKCallback(source, callback)
			if type(source) == "function" and callback == nil then
				rawset(self, "_ikCallback", source)
				rawset(self, "_ikSource", nil)
			else
				rawset(self, "_ikSource", source)
				rawset(self, "_ikCallback", callback)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Returns WalkSpeed after sprint, crouch, and custom modifiers are applied."
		-- returns: "number"
		function h:GetEffectiveWalkSpeed()
			return self.WalkSpeed * speedMul(self)
		end

		-- description: "Enables or disables sprinting and updates stance state."
		-- args: "on: boolean"
		function h:SetSprinting(on)
			on = on == true
			if self.Sprinting == on then
				return
			end
			self.Sprinting = on
			if on then
				self.SprintStarted:Fire()
			else
				self.SprintEnded:Fire()
			end
			updateStance(self)
		end

		-- description: "Enables or disables crouching and updates stance state."
		-- args: "on: boolean"
		function h:SetCrouching(on)
			on = on == true
			if self.Crouching == on then
				return
			end
			self.Crouching = on
			if on then
				self.CrouchStarted:Fire()
			else
				self.CrouchEnded:Fire()
			end
			updateStance(self)
		end

		-- description: "Toggles the crouching state."
		function h:ToggleCrouch()
			self:SetCrouching(not self.Crouching)
		end

		-- description: "Equips a Tool by parenting it to the character and activating equip hooks."
		-- args: "tool: any"
		function h:EquipTool(tool)
			if not tool or tool.ClassName ~= "Tool" then
				return
			end

			local char = characterOf(self)
			if not char then
				return
			end

			tool.Parent = char

			local handle = nil
			if tool.RequiresHandle then
				handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			else
				handle = tool.PrimaryPart
					or tool:FindFirstChildOfClass("Part")
					or tool:FindFirstChildOfClass("MeshPart")
			end

			if not handle then
				return
			end

			local rightArm = self:GetRigPart("RightArm")
				or char:FindFirstChild("RightArm")
				or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
			if not rightArm then
				return
			end

			if tool.Grip then
				handle.CFrame = rightArm.CFrame * tool.Grip
			end

			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Name = "ToolWeld"
			weld.Part0 = rightArm
			weld.Part1 = handle
			weld.Parent = rightArm
		end

		-- description: "Unequips all Tool children from the character."
		function h:UnequipTools()
			local char = characterOf(self)
			if not char then
				return
			end

			local players = game and game.GetService and game:GetService("Players") or nil
			local player = players and players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char) or nil
			local backpack = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or nil

			for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
				if child.ClassName == "Tool" then
					for _, desc in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
						if desc.ClassName == "WeldConstraint" and desc.Name == "ToolWeld" then
							local handle = child:FindFirstChild("Handle")
							local isRelated = (handle ~= nil and desc.Part1 == handle)
								or (desc.Part1 and desc.Part1:IsDescendantOf(child))
							if isRelated then
								desc:Destroy()
							end
						end
					end
					if backpack then
						child.Parent = backpack
					else
						child.Parent = nil
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Adds an Accessory to the character and tracks it for rig attachment."
		-- args: "accessory: any"
		function h:AddAccessory(accessory)
			if not accessory or accessory.ClassName ~= "Accessory" then
				return
			end

			local char = characterOf(self)
			if not char then
				return
			end

			-- Parent the accessory to the character model
			accessory.Parent = char

			local attachPoint = accessory.AttachmentPoint or "Head"

			-- Initial snap: position the accessory at its attachment point
			local rigPart = self:GetRigPart(attachPoint)
			if rigPart and rigPart.CFrame then
				local att = accessory.GetAttachment and accessory:GetAttachment() or nil
				local offset = att and att.CFrame or CFrame.new()
				accessory.CFrame = rigPart.CFrame * offset
			end

			-- Track in the controller for per-frame updates
			local ctrl = rawget(self, "_humanoidController")
			if ctrl then
				-- Avoid duplicates
				for _, entry in ipairs(ctrl.accessories) do
					if entry.accessory == accessory then
						return
					end
				end
				table.insert(ctrl.accessories, {
					accessory = accessory,
					attachmentPoint = attachPoint,
				})
			end
		end

		-- description: "Removes a tracked Accessory from the humanoid."
		-- args: "accessory: any"
		function h:RemoveAccessory(accessory)
			if not accessory then
				return
			end

			local ctrl = rawget(self, "_humanoidController")
			if ctrl then
				for i, entry in ipairs(ctrl.accessories) do
					if entry.accessory == accessory then
						table.remove(ctrl.accessories, i)
						break
					end
				end
			end

			if accessory.Parent ~= nil then
				accessory.Parent = nil
			end
		end

		-- description: "Returns all accessories currently tracked by the humanoid."
		-- returns: "{ any }"
		function h:GetAccessories()
			local result = {}
			local ctrl = rawget(self, "_humanoidController")
			if ctrl then
				for _, entry in ipairs(ctrl.accessories) do
					if entry.accessory and entry.accessory.Parent ~= nil then
						table.insert(result, entry.accessory)
					end
				end
			end
			return result
		end

		-- description: "Sets the humanoid's world-space movement direction."
		-- args: "dir: Vector3"
		function h:Move(dir)
			self.MoveDirection = dir or ZERO
		end

		-- description: "Sets movement from a local direction relative to a CFrame or look-vector provider."
		-- args: "localDir: Vector3, ref: any"
		function h:MoveRelative(localDir, ref)
			if type(ref) == "table" and ref.CFrame then
				ref = ref.CFrame
			end
			if not ref or type(ref.GetLookVector) ~= "function" or not isVec3(localDir) then
				self.MoveDirection = localDir or ZERO
				return
			end
			local f, okF = flat(ref:GetLookVector())
			local r, okR = flat(ref:GetRightVector())
			if not okF or not okR then
				self.MoveDirection = ZERO
				return
			end
			self.MoveDirection = r * localDir.X + f * -localDir.Z
		end

		-- description: "Sets the desired world-space facing direction."
		-- args: "dir: Vector3"
		function h:Face(dir)
			local f, ok = flat(dir)
			self.FacingDirection = ok and f or nil
		end

		-- description: "Clears the explicit facing direction so movement can drive rotation again."
		function h:ClearFacingDirection()
			self.FacingDirection = nil
		end

		-- description: "Clears current movement input."
		function h:Stop()
			self.MoveDirection = ZERO
		end

		-- description: "Queues a jump request for the next simulation step."
		function h:RequestJump()
			self.Jump = true
			c.jumpQueuedTime = os.clock()
		end

		-- description: "Returns whether the dash cooldown has finished."
		-- returns: "boolean"
		function h:CanDash()
			return os.clock() >= c.dashCooldownUntil
		end

		-- description: "Starts a dash in the given direction when the cooldown allows it."
		-- args: "dir: Vector3?"
		-- returns: "boolean"
		function h:Dash(dir)
			local now = os.clock()
			if now < c.dashCooldownUntil then
				return false
			end
			local f, ok = flat(dir or self.MoveDirection)
			if not ok then
				f, ok = flat(self.FacingDirection or c.lookXZ)
			end
			c.dashDirection = ok and f or c.lookXZ
			c.dashEndTime = now + self.DashDuration
			c.dashCooldownUntil = now + self.DashCooldown
			self.Dashing = true
			updateStance(self)
			self.Dashed:Fire(c.dashDirection)
			return true
		end

		-- description: "Returns the humanoid controller's current state."
		-- returns: "Enum.HumanoidStateType"
		function h:GetState()
			return c.state
		end

		-- description: "Returns the current root part CFrame, or identity when no root exists."
		-- returns: "CFrame"
		function h:GetRootCFrame()
			return self.RootPart and self.RootPart.CFrame or CFrame.new()
		end

		-- description: "Returns the current horizontal look vector."
		-- returns: "Vector3"
		function h:GetLookVector()
			return c.lookXZ
		end

		-- description: "Returns the camera focus position for the current stance."
		-- returns: "Vector3"
		function h:GetFocusPosition()
			if not self.RootPart then
				return self.FocusOffset + self.CameraOffset + stanceOffset(self)
			end
			return self.RootPart.CFrame.Position + self.FocusOffset + self.CameraOffset + stanceOffset(self)
		end

		h.Changed:Connect(function(prop, value)
			if prop == "Health" then
				h.HealthChanged:Fire(value)
				if value <= 0 then
					setState(h, c, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
					h.Died:Fire()
				end
			elseif prop == "Jump" and value == true then
				c.jumpQueuedTime = os.clock()
			elseif prop == "RootPart" and value ~= nil then
				syncRoot(h)
			elseif prop == "Character" and value ~= nil then
				syncRoot(h)
				restoreRigFromDescriptor(h, c)
			elseif prop == "RigDescriptor" and value ~= nil then
				restoreRigFromDescriptor(h, c)
			elseif prop == "Sprinting" or prop == "Crouching" or prop == "Dashing" then
				updateStance(h)
			elseif prop == "SeatPart" then
				if value ~= nil then
					setState(h, c, Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated)
					h.Sit = true
					h.Seated:Fire(true, value)
					updateStance(h)
				else
					h.Sit = false
					h.Seated:Fire(false, nil)
					updateStance(h)
				end
			end
		end)

			else

  Code: -- description: "Forces an object to travel in a straight line at a set speed and direction."
local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")
local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local propTable = {
	Attachment0 = nil,
	Attachment1 = nil,

	ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.Magnitude,
	ForceLimitsEnabled = false,
	LineDirection = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
	LineVelocity = 0,
	MaxAxesForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge),
	MaxForce = math.huge,
	MaxPlanarAxesForce = Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge),
	PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(0, 0),
	PrimaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0),
	ReactionForceEnabled = false,
	RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World,
	SecondaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
	VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector,

	Enabled = true,
	Name = "LinearVelocity",
}

return {
	class = "LinearVelocity",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local PhysicsService = game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")

		-- returns: "boolean"
		local function shouldApplyPhysics(part)
			local replicator = game:GetService("ReplicatorService")
			local ownership = replicator and replicator.NetworkOwnership or nil
			if ownership and ownership.ShouldSimulatePhysicsForMachine then
				return ownership.ShouldSimulatePhysicsForMachine(part, game)
			end

			if part == nil then
				return false
			end

			if part.NetworkOwner == nil then
				return IsServer == true
			end

			if IsClient ~= true then
				return false
			end

			local players = game:GetService("Players")
			return players.LocalPlayer ~= nil and players.LocalPlayer == part.NetworkOwner
		end

		local function getAttachmentPart(attachment)
			if attachment and attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
				local parent = attachment.Parent
				if parent and parent.BaseClass == "BasePart" then
					return parent
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function resolvePart()
			local part = getAttachmentPart(instance.Attachment0)
			if part then
				return part
			end

			local parent = instance.Parent
			if parent and parent.BaseClass == "BasePart" then
				return parent
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function getReferenceCFrame(part)
			local relativeTo = instance.RelativeTo
			if relativeTo == Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.Attachment0 then
				local attachmentPart = getAttachmentPart(instance.Attachment0)
				return attachmentPart and attachmentPart.CFrame or (part and part.CFrame or nil)
			elseif relativeTo == Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.Attachment1 then
				local attachmentPart = getAttachmentPart(instance.Attachment1)
				return attachmentPart and attachmentPart.CFrame or (part and part.CFrame or nil)
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function vectorToWorld(vectorValue, part)
			local reference = getReferenceCFrame(part)
			if reference and reference.VectorToWorldSpace then
				return reference:VectorToWorldSpace(vectorValue)
			end
			return vectorValue
		end

		local function vectorToRelative(vectorValue, part)
			local reference = getReferenceCFrame(part)
			if reference and reference.VectorToObjectSpace then
				return reference:VectorToObjectSpace(vectorValue)
			end
			return vectorValue
		end

		local function orthonormalize(primary, secondary)
			local p = primary:IsZero() and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or primary:Unit()
			local s = secondary - p * secondary:Dot(p)
			if s:IsZero() then
				s = p:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
				if s:IsZero() then
					s = p:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
				end
			end
			return p, s:Unit()
		end

		local function resolvePlaneAxes(part)
			local primary = vectorToWorld(instance.PrimaryTangentAxis, part)
			local secondary = vectorToWorld(instance.SecondaryTangentAxis, part)
			return orthonormalize(primary, secondary)
		end

		local function resolveTargetVelocity(part)
			if instance.VelocityConstraintMode == Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Line then
				local direction = vectorToWorld(instance.LineDirection, part)
				if direction:IsZero() then
					direction = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
				end
				return direction:Unit() * instance.LineVelocity
			elseif instance.VelocityConstraintMode == Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane then
				local primary, secondary = resolvePlaneAxes(part)
				return primary * instance.PlaneVelocity.X + secondary * instance.PlaneVelocity.Y
			end

			return vectorToWorld(instance.VectorVelocity, part)
		end

		local function clampVectorMagnitude(vectorValue, maxMagnitude)
			if maxMagnitude == nil or maxMagnitude == math.huge or maxMagnitude <= 0 then
				return vectorValue
			end
			local magnitude = vectorValue:Magnitude()
			if magnitude > maxMagnitude and magnitude > 0 then
				return vectorValue:Unit() * maxMagnitude
			end
			return vectorValue
		end

		local function clampPerAxis(forceValue, part)
			if instance.VelocityConstraintMode == Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane then
				local primary, secondary = resolvePlaneAxes(part)
				local primaryForce =
					math.clamp(forceValue:Dot(primary), -instance.MaxPlanarAxesForce.X, instance.MaxPlanarAxesForce.X)
				local secondaryForce =
					math.clamp(forceValue:Dot(secondary), -instance.MaxPlanarAxesForce.Y, instance.MaxPlanarAxesForce.Y)
				return primary * primaryForce + secondary * secondaryForce
			end

			local relativeForce = vectorToRelative(forceValue, part)
			relativeForce = Vector3.new(
				math.clamp(relativeForce.X, -instance.MaxAxesForce.X, instance.MaxAxesForce.X),
				math.clamp(relativeForce.Y, -instance.MaxAxesForce.Y, instance.MaxAxesForce.Y),
				math.clamp(relativeForce.Z, -instance.MaxAxesForce.Z, instance.MaxAxesForce.Z)
			)
			return vectorToWorld(relativeForce, part)
		end

		renderer.EventBus:Connect(function(route, dt)
			if route ~= "RenderStepped" then
				return
			end
			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end

			local part = resolvePart()
			if not part or not shouldApplyPhysics(part) then
				return
			end
			if not PhysicsService.GetBody or not PhysicsService.GetBody(part) then
				return
			end

			local targetVelocity = resolveTargetVelocity(part)
			PhysicsService.ActivatePart(part)

			if not instance.ForceLimitsEnabled then
				PhysicsService.SetVelocity(part, targetVelocity)
				return
			end

			local currentVelocity = PhysicsService.GetVelocity(part)
			local deltaVelocity = targetVelocity - currentVelocity
			if deltaVelocity:IsZero() then
				return
			end

			local mass = math.max(part.AssemblyMass or part.Mass or 1, 0.001)
			local safeDt = math.max(dt or 0, 1 / 240)
			local desiredForce = deltaVelocity * (mass / safeDt)

			if instance.ForceLimitMode == Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis then
				desiredForce = clampPerAxis(desiredForce, part)
			else
				desiredForce = clampVectorMagnitude(desiredForce, instance.MaxForce)
			end

			if desiredForce:IsZero() then
				return
			end

			PhysicsService.ApplyImpulse(part, desiredForce * safeDt)
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local Part = require("@Part")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local propTable = {
	MeshObject = nil,
	_showhitbox = false,
	CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Default,
	RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Automatic,
	CollisionScale = 1,
	Anchored = true,
	Name = "MeshPart",
	BaseClass = "BasePart",
	MeshScale = 1,
	Transparency = 0,
	Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),
}

Part.inherit(propTable)

return {
	class = "MeshPart",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance:SetMetadata("IsMovable", true)

		local KinemiumPhysicsService = game and game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService") or nil
		-- description: "Applies an impulse to the part."
		-- args: "self: table, v: Vector3"
		instance.ApplyImpulse = function(self, v)
			if KinemiumPhysicsService then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ApplyImpulse(instance, v)
			end
		end

		renderer.EventBus:Fire("UpdatePart", instance)

		local syncingTransform = false

		local function syncMeshObject(meshObject)
			instance._mesh = meshObject and (meshObject._mesh or meshObject._meshgenHandle) or nil
			instance._cpuMeshData = meshObject and meshObject._cpuMeshData or nil
			instance._materialHandle = meshObject and meshObject._materialHandle or nil
		end

		local function syncFromCFrame(cf)
			if not cf or not cf.Position then
				return
			end
			local rx, ry, rz = cf:ToOrientation()
			local props = rawget(instance, "_props")
			if not props then
				return
			end
			props.Position = cf.Position
			props.Orientation = Vector3.new(rx, ry, rz)
			props.Rotation = props.Orientation
		end

		local function syncFromPosition(position)
			if not position then
				return
			end
			local props = rawget(instance, "_props")
			if not props or not props.CFrame then
				return
			end
			props.CFrame = props.CFrame:WithPosition(position)
		end

		syncMeshObject(instance.MeshObject)

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property, value)
			if syncingTransform then
				return
			end
			if property == "CFrame" then
				syncingTransform = true
				syncFromCFrame(value)
				syncingTransform = false
			elseif property == "Position" then
				syncingTransform = true
				syncFromPosition(value)
				syncingTransform = false
			elseif property == "MeshObject" then
				syncMeshObject(value)
				renderer.EventBus:Fire("UpdatePart", instance)
			elseif property == "_mesh" or property == "_cpuMeshData" or property == "Material" then
				renderer.EventBus:Fire("UpdatePart", instance)
			elseif property == "Parent" then
				renderer.EventBus:Fire("UpdatePart", instance)
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,
	inherit = function()

return {
	class = "Model",

	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties({
			WorldPivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0),
			PrimaryPart = nil,
			Visible = true,
		})
		instance:SetMetadata("IsMovable", true)

		-- description: "Sets the part used as this model's primary reference part."
		-- args: "part: any"
		function instance:SetPrimaryPart(part)
			self.PrimaryPart = part
		end

		-- description: "Returns the PrimaryPart CFrame, or the WorldPivot when no PrimaryPart is set."
		-- returns: "CFrame"
		function instance:GetPrimaryPartCFrame()
			return self.PrimaryPart and self.PrimaryPart.CFrame or self.WorldPivot
		end

		-- description: "Returns the model's world pivot CFrame."
		-- returns: "CFrame"
		function instance:GetPivot()
			return self.WorldPivot
		end

		-- description: "Sets the model pivot and moves child parts by the same transform offset."
		-- args: "cf: CFrame"
		function instance:SetPivot(cf)
			local offset = cf * self.WorldPivot:Inverse()
			self.WorldPivot = cf
			for _, child in ipairs(self:GetChildren()) do
				if child.CFrame then
					child.CFrame = offset * child.CFrame
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Moves the model to a new pivot CFrame."
		-- args: "cf: CFrame"
		function instance:PivotTo(cf)
			self:SetPivot(cf)
		end

		-- description: "Moves the model pivot to a world position while preserving its orientation."
		-- args: "pos: Vector3"
		function instance:MoveTo(pos)
			local current = self:GetPrimaryPartCFrame()
			self:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos) * current:ToObjectSpace(current))
		end

		-- description: "Offsets the model pivot and child parts by a world-space vector."
		-- args: "offset: Vector3"
		function instance:TranslateBy(offset)
			self:PivotTo(self.WorldPivot + offset)
		end

		-- description: "Rotates the model around its current world pivot."
		-- args: "rotCF: CFrame"
		function instance:RotateBy(rotCF)
			local pivot = self.WorldPivot
			local newPivot = pivot * rotCF
			self:SetPivot(newPivot)
		end

		-- description: "Scales BasePart descendants around the model pivot."
		-- args: "factor: number"
		function instance:ScaleTo(factor)
			for _, child in ipairs(self:GetChildren()) do
				if child.BaseClass == "BasePart" then
					child.Size = child.Size * factor
					child.CFrame = self.WorldPivot + ((child.CFrame.Position - self.WorldPivot.Position) * factor)
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Scales sized descendants around the model pivot."
		-- args: "factor: number"
		function instance:ScaleByFactor(factor)
			for _, child in ipairs(self:GetChildren()) do
				if child.Size then
					child.Size = child.Size * factor
					child.CFrame = self.WorldPivot + ((child.CFrame.Position - self.WorldPivot.Position) * factor)
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Returns the axis-aligned bounding size of all child parts."
		-- returns: "Vector3"
		function instance:GetExtentsSize()
			local minVec = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
			local maxVec = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)

			for _, child in ipairs(self:GetChildren()) do
				if child.Size and child.CFrame then
					local half = child.Size / 2
					local cf = child.CFrame

					local corners = {
						cf * Vector3.new(half.X, half.Y, half.Z),
						cf * Vector3.new(half.X, half.Y, -half.Z),
						cf * Vector3.new(half.X, -half.Y, half.Z),
						cf * Vector3.new(half.X, -half.Y, -half.Z),
						cf * Vector3.new(-half.X, half.Y, half.Z),
						cf * Vector3.new(-half.X, half.Y, -half.Z),
						cf * Vector3.new(-half.X, -half.Y, half.Z),
						cf * Vector3.new(-half.X, -half.Y, -half.Z),
					}

					for _, p in ipairs(corners) do
						minVec = Vector3.new(math.min(minVec.X, p.X), math.min(minVec.Y, p.Y), math.min(minVec.Z, p.Z))
						maxVec = Vector3.new(math.max(maxVec.X, p.X), math.max(maxVec.Y, p.Y), math.max(maxVec.Z, p.Z))
					end
				end
			end

			return maxVec - minVec
		end

		-- description: "Returns the model pivot and bounding size for all child parts."
		-- returns: "CFrame, Vector3"
		function instance:GetBoundingBox()
			local size = self:GetExtentsSize()
			local center = self.WorldPivot
			return center, size
		end

		-- description: "Returns the center point between child part positions."
		-- returns: "Vector3"
		function instance:GetCenter()
			local minVec = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
			local maxVec = Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)

			for _, child in ipairs(self:GetChildren()) do
				if child.Size and child.CFrame then
					local p = child.CFrame.Position
					minVec = Vector3.new(math.min(minVec.X, p.X), math.min(minVec.Y, p.Y), math.min(minVec.Z, p.Z))
					maxVec = Vector3.new(math.max(maxVec.X, p.X), math.max(maxVec.Y, p.Y), math.max(maxVec.Z, p.Z))
				end
			end

			return (minVec + maxVec) / 2
		end

		-- description: "Returns all descendant parts with Size and CFrame properties."
		-- returns: "{ any }"
		function instance:GetAllParts()
			local parts = {}
			local function recurse(parent)
				for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
					if child.Size and child.CFrame then
						table.insert(parts, child)
					end
					if child.GetChildren then
						recurse(child)
					end
				end
			end
			recurse(self)
			return parts
		end

		-- description: "Returns whether the model has no direct children."
		-- returns: "boolean"
		function instance:IsEmpty()
			return #self:GetChildren() == 0
		end

		-- description: "Sets descendant part transparency to visible or hidden."
		-- args: "visible: boolean"
		function instance:SetVisible(visible)
			for _, child in ipairs(self:GetAllParts()) do
				if child.Transparency ~= nil then
					child.Transparency = visible and 0 or 1
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Sets transparency on every descendant part."
		-- args: "t: number"
		function instance:SetTransparency(t)
			for _, child in ipairs(self:GetAllParts()) do
				if child.Transparency ~= nil then
					child.Transparency = t
				end
			end
		end

		return instance
	end,

local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local CFrame = require("@CFrame")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local Ray = require("@Ray")
local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")

local function RayIntersectOBB(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, part)
	local cx, cy, cz, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22 = part.CFrame:GetComponents()
	local hx, hy, hz = part.Size.X * 0.5, part.Size.Y * 0.5, part.Size.Z * 0.5

	local vx, vy, vz = ox - cx, oy - cy, oz - cz

	local localOrgX = vx * r00 + vy * r10 + vz * r20
	local localOrgY = vx * r01 + vy * r11 + vz * r21
	local localOrgZ = vx * r02 + vy * r12 + vz * r22

	local localDirX = dx * r00 + dy * r10 + dz * r20
	local localDirY = dx * r01 + dy * r11 + dz * r21
	local localDirZ = dx * r02 + dy * r12 + dz * r22

	local tmin = -math.huge
	local tmax = math.huge
	local hitAxis = 0
	local hitSign = 0

	if math.abs(localDirX) > 1e-6 then
		local invD = 1.0 / localDirX
		local t0 = (-hx - localOrgX) * invD
		local t1 = (hx - localOrgX) * invD
		local sign0 = -1
		if t0 > t1 then
			t0, t1 = t1, t0
			sign0 = 1
		end
		if t0 > tmin then
			tmin = t0
			hitAxis = 1
			hitSign = sign0
		end
		tmax = tmax < t1 and tmax or t1
		if tmax < tmin then
			return false
		end
	elseif localOrgX < -hx or localOrgX > hx then
		return false
	end

	if math.abs(localDirY) > 1e-6 then
		local invD = 1.0 / localDirY
		local t0 = (-hy - localOrgY) * invD
		local t1 = (hy - localOrgY) * invD
		local sign0 = -1
		if t0 > t1 then
			t0, t1 = t1, t0
			sign0 = 1
		end
		if t0 > tmin then
			tmin = t0
			hitAxis = 2
			hitSign = sign0
		end
		tmax = tmax < t1 and tmax or t1
		if tmax < tmin then
			return false
		end
	elseif localOrgY < -hy or localOrgY > hy then
		return false
	end

	if math.abs(localDirZ) > 1e-6 then
		local invD = 1.0 / localDirZ
		local t0 = (-hz - localOrgZ) * invD
		local t1 = (hz - localOrgZ) * invD
		local sign0 = -1
		if t0 > t1 then
			t0, t1 = t1, t0
			sign0 = 1
		end
		if t0 > tmin then
			tmin = t0
			hitAxis = 3
			hitSign = sign0
		end
		tmax = tmax < t1 and tmax or t1
		if tmax < tmin then
			return false
		end
	elseif localOrgZ < -hz or localOrgZ > hz then
		return false
	end

	if tmax < 0 then
		return false
	end

	local t = tmin < 0 and 0 or tmin

	local normX, normY, normZ = 0, 0, 0
	if hitAxis == 1 then
		normX, normY, normZ = hitSign * r00, hitSign * r10, hitSign * r20
	elseif hitAxis == 2 then
		normX, normY, normZ = hitSign * r01, hitSign * r11, hitSign * r21
	elseif hitAxis == 3 then
		normX, normY, normZ = hitSign * r02, hitSign * r12, hitSign * r22
	end

	return true, t, ox + dx * t, oy + dy * t, oz + dz * t, normX, normY, normZ
end

local function readRayCollision(buf)
	--[[
	local RayCollision = ffi.struct({
	{ hit = bool },
	{ distance = float },
	{ point = Vector3 },
	{ normal = Vector3 },
})
export type RayCollision = typeof(RayCollision:new({}))
	--]]
	local hit = buffer.readu8(buf, raylib.structs.RayCollision:offset("hit"))
	local distance = buffer.readf32(buf, raylib.structs.RayCollision:offset("distance"))
	local px = buffer.readf32(buf, raylib.structs.RayCollision:offset("point"))
	local py = buffer.readf32(buf, raylib.structs.RayCollision:offset("point") + 4)
	local pz = buffer.readf32(buf, raylib.structs.RayCollision:offset("point") + 8)
	local nx = buffer.readf32(buf, raylib.structs.RayCollision:offset("normal"))
	local ny = buffer.readf32(buf, raylib.structs.RayCollision:offset("normal") + 4)
	local nz = buffer.readf32(buf, raylib.structs.RayCollision:offset("normal") + 8)
	return {
		hit = hit,
		distance = distance,
		point = Vector3.new(px, py, pz),
		normal = Vector3.new(nx, ny, nz),
	}
end

local function isInstance(value)
	return type(value) == "table" and rawget(value, "_props") ~= nil
end

local function isDescendantOrSelf(instance, ancestor)
	local current = instance
	while current do
		if current == ancestor then
			return true
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local function isTargetFiltered(targetFilter, part)
	if not targetFilter then
		return false
	end

	if isInstance(targetFilter) then
		return isDescendantOrSelf(part, targetFilter)
	end

	if type(targetFilter) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	for _, filter in ipairs(targetFilter) do
		if isInstance(filter) and isDescendantOrSelf(part, filter) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

return {
	class = "Mouse",
	non_creatable = true,
	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance._workspace = game and game.Workspace

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property, value)
			if property == "Icon" then
				MouseCursor.request(value.Value)
			end
		end)

		renderer.EventBus:Connect(function(route, data)
			if route == "MouseData" then
				local position = data.position
				local mouse_wheel_move = data.mouse_wheel_move

				instance.X = position.X
				instance.Y = position.Y
				instance.IsMouseHidden = data.is_cursor_hidden
				instance.IsMouseOutOfBounds = data.is_cursor_inbounds

				local bestPart = nil
				local bestPoint = nil
				local bestNormal = nil
				local bestDist = math.huge

				local Workspace = game and game.Workspace
				local camera = Workspace and Workspace.Camera
				local raylibCam = camera and camera._raylibcam

				if raylibCam and Workspace then
					local rayInfo = raycastMod:GetMouseRay(raylibCam)
					local ray = rayInfo.ray

					local preloadedMeshes = renderer.Mesh
						and renderer.Mesh.GetPreloadedMeshes
						and renderer.Mesh.GetPreloadedMeshes()

					local ox, oy, oz =
						rayInfo.position.X or rayInfo.position.x,
						rayInfo.position.Y or rayInfo.position.y,
						rayInfo.position.Z or rayInfo.position.z
					local dx, dy, dz =
						rayInfo.direction.X or rayInfo.direction.x,
						rayInfo.direction.Y or rayInfo.direction.y,
						rayInfo.direction.Z or rayInfo.direction.z

					instance.UnitRay = Ray.new(Vector3.new(ox, oy, oz), Vector3.new(dx, dy, dz))

					local parts = Workspace:Get3DObjects()
					for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
						if isTargetFiltered(instance.TargetFilter, part) then
							continue
						end

						-- Fast Sphere Cull
						if not part.Size then
							continue
						end
						local sX, sY, sZ = part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z
						local pX, pY, pZ = part.CFrame.Position.X, part.CFrame.Position.Y, part.CFrame.Position.Z
						local radius = (sX > sY and (sX > sZ and sX or sZ) or (sY > sZ and sY or sZ)) * 0.866

						local vX, vY, vZ = pX - ox, pY - oy, pZ - oz
						local t = vX * dx + vY * dy + vZ * dz
						local d2 = (vX * vX + vY * vY + vZ * vZ) - t * t

						if (t < 0 and (vX * vX + vY * vY + vZ * vZ) > radius * radius) or d2 > radius * radius then
							continue
						end

						local isMesh = part:IsA("MeshPart") or part._mesh ~= nil
						local shapeName = not isMesh
								and (part.Shape and part.Shape.Name and string.lower(part.Shape.Name) or "block")
							or nil

						if not isMesh and shapeName == "block" then
							local hit, t, hx, hy, hz, nx, ny, nz = RayIntersectOBB(ox, oy, oz, dx, dy, dz, part)
							if hit and t < bestDist then
								bestDist = t
								bestPart = part
								bestPoint = Vector3.new(hx, hy, hz)
								bestNormal = Vector3.new(nx, ny, nz)
							end
							continue
						end

						local cpuMeshData = nil

						if isMesh then
							cpuMeshData = part._cpuMeshData
							if not cpuMeshData and part.MeshObject then
								cpuMeshData = part.MeshObject._cpuMeshData
							end
						else
							if shapeName == "ball" then
								shapeName = "sphere"
							end

							if shapeName and preloadedMeshes then
								local entry = preloadedMeshes[shapeName]
								if entry then
									cpuMeshData = entry[1]
								end
							end
						end

						if not cpuMeshData then
							continue
						end

						local matrix
						if part.__cachedMatrix and not part.__matrixDirty then
							matrix = part.__cachedMatrix
						else
							matrix = part.CFrame:ToRaylibMatrixScale(part.Size, raylib.structs)
						end

						local ok, collision = pcall(rlib.R3D_RaycastMesh, ray, cpuMeshData, matrix)
						if not ok or not collision then
							continue
						end

						local result = readRayCollision(collision)

						if result.hit == 1 and result.distance < bestDist then
							bestDist = result.distance
							bestPart = part
							bestPoint = result.point
							bestNormal = result.normal
						end
					end

					local terrain = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Terrain")
					if terrain and terrain._chunks then
						local identity = raylib.lib.MatrixIdentity()
						for _, chunk in pairs(terrain._chunks) do
							if chunk._cpuMeshData then
								local ok, collision = pcall(rlib.R3D_RaycastMesh, ray, chunk._cpuMeshData, identity)
								if ok and collision then
									local result = readRayCollision(collision)

									if result.hit == 1 and result.distance < bestDist then
										bestDist = result.distance
										bestPart = terrain
										bestPoint = result.point
										bestNormal = result.normal
									end
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end

				instance.Target = bestPart
				instance.target = bestPart
				instance.Hit = bestPoint and CFrame.new(bestPoint) or nil
				instance.hit = instance.Hit
				instance.TargetSurface = bestNormal
				instance._button1Down = data.Button1IsDown == true
				instance._button2Down = data.Button2IsDown == true

				if mouse_wheel_move then
					Move:Fire()
				end

				if data.Button1Down then
					Button1Down:Fire()
				end

				if data.Button1Released then
					Button1Up:Fire()
				end

				if data.Button2Down then
					Button2Down:Fire()
				end

				if data.Button2Released then
					Button2Up:Fire()
				end
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local function UpdateManifoldPointer(instance)
	if instance.Shape == Enum.PartType.Block then
		manifold.gen.free(instance._manifoldptr)
		instance._manifoldptr = manifold.gen.box(instance.Size.X, instance.Size.Y, instance.Size.Z)
	elseif instance.Shape == Enum.PartType.Ball then
		local radius = instance.Size.X * 0.5
		manifold.gen.free(instance._manifoldptr)
		instance._manifoldptr = manifold.gen.sphere(radius, 32)
	elseif instance.Shape == Enum.PartType.Cylinder then
		local radius = instance.Size.X * 0.5
		local height = instance.Size.Y
		local segments = 24

		manifold.gen.free(instance._manifoldptr)
		instance._manifoldptr = manifold.gen.cylinder(radius, height, segments, true, radius)
	end
end

local function syncFromCFrame(instance, cf)
	if not cf or not cf.Position then
		return
	end

	local rx, ry, rz = cf:ToOrientation()
	local props = rawget(instance, "_props")
	if not props then
		return
	end

	props.Position = cf.Position
	props.Orientation = Vector3.new(rx, ry, rz)
	props.Rotation = props.Orientation
end

local function syncFromPosition(instance, position)
	if not position then
		return
	end

	local props = rawget(instance, "_props")
	if not props or not props.CFrame then
		return
	end

	props.CFrame = props.CFrame:WithPosition(position)
end

return {
	class = "Part",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		instance:SetMetadata("IsMovable", true)

		local KinemiumPhysicsService = game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
		local syncingTransform = false

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		syncFromCFrame(instance, instance.CFrame)
		if renderer and renderer.EventBus then
			renderer.EventBus:Fire("UpdatePart", instance)
		end

		-- api

		-- description: "Applies physics impulse."
		-- args: "self: table, v: Vector3"
		function instance:ApplyImpulse(v)
			if KinemiumPhysicsService then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ApplyImpulse(instance, v)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Applies physics impulse at a specified position."
		-- args: "self: table, v: Vector3"
		function instance:ApplyImpulseAtPosition(v)
			-- add impulse at position feature
			if KinemiumPhysicsService then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ApplyImpulse(instance, v)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Returns whether the parts can collide with each other."
		-- args: "self: table, part: Part"
		function instance:CanCollideWith(part)
			-- add support
		end

		UpdateManifoldPointer(instance)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			instance.Touched = nil
			instance.TouchEnded = nil
			instance._mesh = nil

			manifold.gen.free(instance._manifoldptr)
		end)

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property, value)
			if syncingTransform then
				return
			end

			if property == "CFrame" then
				syncingTransform = true
				syncFromCFrame(instance, value)
				syncingTransform = false
			elseif property == "Position" then
				syncingTransform = true
				syncFromPosition(instance, value)
				syncingTransform = false
			elseif property == "Parent" then
				if renderer and renderer.EventBus then
					renderer.EventBus:Fire("UpdatePart", instance)
				end
			elseif property == "Size" then
				UpdateManifoldPointer(instance)
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			if not tble[prop] then
				tble[prop] = val
			end
		end
	end,

local BLEND_MIX = 0

local function getRange(value, defaultMin, defaultMax)
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return value, value
	end
	if type(value) == "table" then
		if value.Min ~= nil and value.Max ~= nil then
			return value.Min, value.Max
		end
	end
	return defaultMin, defaultMax
end

local function randomRange(value, defaultMin, defaultMax)
	local minVal, maxVal = getRange(value, defaultMin, defaultMax)
	if minVal == nil or maxVal == nil then
		return 0
	end
	if minVal == maxVal then
		return minVal
	end
	return minVal + math.random() * (maxVal - minVal)
end

local function clamp01(v)
	if v < 0 then
		return 0
	end
	if v > 1 then
		return 1
	end
	return v
end

	if type(value) == "number" then
		return value

	if type(value) == "table" and value.Value ~= nil then
		return value.Value
	end
	return const.R3D_TRANSPARENCY_PREPASS
end

		if parent.WorldCFrame then
			return parent.WorldCFrame

			return parent.CFrame
		end

	return CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)

local function getEmissionDirection(cf, normalId)
	if normalId == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
		return -cf:GetUpVector()
	elseif normalId == Enum.NormalId.Top then
		return cf:GetUpVector()
	elseif normalId == Enum.NormalId.Left then
		return -cf:GetRightVector()
	elseif normalId == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		return cf:GetRightVector()
	elseif normalId == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		return -cf:GetLookVector()
	end
	return cf:GetLookVector()
end

local function getEmitterVelocity(instance)
	local parent = instance.Parent
	if parent then
		if type(parent.AssemblyLinearVelocity) == "table" and parent.AssemblyLinearVelocity.__type == "Vector3" then
			return parent.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		end
		if
			parent.Parent
			and type(parent.Parent.AssemblyLinearVelocity) == "table"
			and parent.Parent.AssemblyLinearVelocity.__type == "Vector3"
		then
			return parent.Parent.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		end
	end
	return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

local function applySpread(baseDir, basisRight, basisUp, spread)
	if not spread or type(spread) ~= "table" then
		return baseDir
	end

	local spreadX = math.tan(math.rad(spread.X or 0) * 0.5)
	local spreadY = math.tan(math.rad(spread.Y or 0) * 0.5)
	if spreadX == 0 and spreadY == 0 then
		return baseDir
	end

	local rx = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spreadX
	local ry = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * spreadY
	local dir = baseDir + (basisRight * rx) + (basisUp * ry)
	return dir:Unit()
end

	})
end

end

		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
		NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
	})
end

local function createMaterial(texturePath)
	local baseMaterial = rlib.R3D_GetDefaultMaterial()
	local material = buffer.create(r3dstructs.R3D_Material:size())
	buffer.copy(material, 0, baseMaterial, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:size())

	if type(texturePath) == "string" and texturePath ~= "" then
		texturePath = zembed.AssetPath(texturePath)
		local ok, data = pcall(zune.fs.readFileSync, texturePath, true)
		if ok and data then
			local ext = lib.GetFileExtension(texturePath)
			local okLoad, map = pcall(rlib.R3D_LoadAlbedoMapFromMemory, ext, data, buffer.len(data), raylib.const.WHITE)
			if okLoad then
				buffer.copy(material, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("albedo"), map, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size())
				return material, map
			end
		end
	end

	return material, nil
end
