return {
	class = "ParticleEmitter",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		if _G.IsHeadless or not renderer then
			return instance
		end

		local particleMesh = rlib.R3D_GenMeshQuad(1, 1, 1, 1, vector.create(0, 0, 1))
		local particleMaterial, albedoMap = createMaterial(instance.Texture)
		local emissionMap = nil
		local instanceFlags = bit32.bor(
			const.R3D_INSTANCE_POSITION,
			const.R3D_INSTANCE_ROTATION,
			const.R3D_INSTANCE_SCALE,
			const.R3D_INSTANCE_COLOR
		)
		local instanceBuffer = rlib.R3D_LoadInstanceBuffer(instance.MaxParticles, instanceFlags)
		local SHADOW_AUTO = 0
		local SHADOW_DISABLED = 8
		local flipbookTime = 0
		local flipbookFrame = 0
		local flipbookDir = 1

		local particles = {}
		local activeCount = 0
		local emitAccumulator = 0

		local function rebuildInstanceBuffer()
			if instanceBuffer then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadInstanceBuffer, instanceBuffer)
			end
			instanceBuffer = rlib.R3D_LoadInstanceBuffer(instance.MaxParticles, instanceFlags)
		end

		local updateFlipbook

		local function applyMaterialSettings()
			if not particleMaterial then
				return
			end

			buffer.writei32(
				particleMaterial,
				r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("transparencyMode"),
				resolveTransparencyMode(instance.TransparencyMode)
			)
			buffer.writei32(
				particleMaterial,
				r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("blendMode"),
				resolveBlendMode(instance.BlendMode)
			)
			buffer.writei32(
				particleMaterial,
				r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("billboardMode"),
				resolveBillboardMode(instance.BillboardMode)
			)
			buffer.writei32(
				particleMaterial,
				r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("cullMode"),
				resolveCullMode(instance.CullMode)
			)

			local uvScale = getVector2(instance.UVScale, Vector2.new(1, 1))
			local uvOffset = getVector2(instance.UVOffset, Vector2.new(0, 0))
			buffer.writef32(particleMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvScale"), uvScale.X)
			buffer.writef32(particleMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvScale") + 4, uvScale.Y)
			buffer.writef32(particleMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvOffset"), uvOffset.X)
			buffer.writef32(particleMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvOffset") + 4, uvOffset.Y)

			local emissionColor = getColor3(instance.EmissionColor, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			local emissionEnergy = instance.EmissionEnergy or 0
			if emissionMap then
				buffer.copy(
					emissionMap,
					r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:offset("color"),
					emissionColor:ToRaylib(0),
					0,
					structs.Color:size()
				)
				buffer.writef32(emissionMap, r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:offset("energy"), emissionEnergy)
				buffer.copy(
					particleMaterial,
					r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("emission"),
					emissionMap,
					0,
					r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:size()
				)
			else
				local emissionMapLocal = r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:new({
					color = emissionColor:ToRaylib(0),
					energy = emissionEnergy,
				})
				buffer.copy(
					particleMaterial,
					r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("emission"),
					emissionMapLocal,
					0,
					r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:size()
				)
			end
		end

		local function updateMaterial()
			if albedoMap then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadAlbedoMap, albedoMap)
				albedoMap = nil
			end
			if emissionMap then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadEmissionMap, emissionMap)
				emissionMap = nil
			end
			local material, map = createMaterial(instance.Texture)
			particleMaterial = material
			albedoMap = map

			if type(instance.EmissionTexture) == "string" and instance.EmissionTexture ~= "" then
				local emissionTexture = zembed.AssetPath(instance.EmissionTexture)
				local ok, data = pcall(zune.fs.readFileSync, emissionTexture, true)
				if ok and data then
					local ext = lib.GetFileExtension(emissionTexture)
					local okLoad, map2 =
						pcall(rlib.R3D_LoadEmissionMapFromMemory, ext, data, buffer.len(data), raylib.const.WHITE, 1)
					if okLoad then
						emissionMap = map2
						buffer.copy(
							particleMaterial,
							r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("emission"),
							emissionMap,
							0,
							r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:size()
						)
					end
				end
			end

			applyMaterialSettings()
			if updateFlipbook then
				updateFlipbook(0)
			end
		end

		local function applyShadowMode()
			if particleMesh then
				local mode = instance.CastShadow and SHADOW_AUTO or SHADOW_DISABLED
				buffer.writei32(particleMesh, r3dstructs.R3D_Mesh:offset("shadowCastMode"), mode)
			end
		end

		applyShadowMode()
		applyMaterialSettings()

		local function emitParticle()
			if activeCount >= instance.MaxParticles then
				return
			end

			local emitterCF = getEmitterCFrame(instance)
			local baseDir = getEmissionDirection(emitterCF, instance.EmissionDirection)
			local dir = applySpread(baseDir, emitterCF:GetRightVector(), emitterCF:GetUpVector(), instance.SpreadAngle)

			local spread = instance.SpreadAngle
			local isFullSphere = spread and spread.X >= 180 and spread.Y >= 180
			if isFullSphere then
				-- true uniform sphere sampling
				local u = math.random() * 2 - 1
				local theta = math.random() * math.pi * 2
				local r = math.sqrt(1 - u * u)
				dir = Vector3.new(r * math.cos(theta), u, r * math.sin(theta))
			else
				dir = applySpread(baseDir, emitterCF:GetRightVector(), emitterCF:GetUpVector(), spread)
			end

			local lifetime = randomRange(instance.Lifetime, 1, 1)
			if lifetime <= 0 then
				return
			end

			local baseVel = dir * randomRange(instance.Speed, 0, 0)
			local inheritance = instance.VelocityInheritance or 0
			if inheritance ~= 0 then
				baseVel = baseVel + getEmitterVelocity(instance) * inheritance
			end

			local rawBodyID = nil
			if game then
				local ups = game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
				if ups and ups.CreateRawBody then
					rawBodyID = ups.CreateRawBody({
						Position = emitterCF.Position,
						Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * (instance.CollisionRadius or 0.5) * 2,
						Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
						CanCollide = instance.CollideParticles,
						Anchored = false,
						Mass = 1,
						AssemblyLinearVelocity = baseVel,
						Friction = instance.Friction,
						Restitution = instance.Restitution,
						CollisionGroup = instance.CollisionGroup or "Particles",
					})
				end
			end

			activeCount += 1
			particles[activeCount] = {
				bodyID = rawBodyID,
				life = lifetime,
				lifetime = lifetime,
				rotation = math.rad(randomRange(instance.Rotation, 0, 0)),
				rotSpeed = math.rad(randomRange(instance.RotSpeed, 0, 0)),
				axis = dir,
				-- Fallback physics if UPS is unavailable
				position = not rawBodyID and emitterCF.Position or nil,
				velocity = not rawBodyID and baseVel or nil,
			}
		end

		local function emit(count)
			for _ = 1, count do
				emitParticle()
			end
		end

		-- description: "Emits a specified amount of particles."
		-- args: "self: table, count: number"
		instance.Emit = function(_, count)
			emit(math.max(0, count or 1))
		end

		local function updateParticles(dt)
			local timeScale = instance.TimeScale or 1
			local scaledDt = dt * timeScale

			if instance.Enabled then
				emitAccumulator += (instance.Rate or 0) * dt -- Rate is typically real-time
				local emitCount = math.floor(emitAccumulator)
				if emitCount > 0 then
					emitAccumulator -= emitCount
					emit(emitCount)
				end
			end

			local accel = instance.Acceleration or Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			local drag = instance.Drag or 0
			local windAffectsDrag = instance.WindAffectsDrag or false

			local globalWind = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			if windAffectsDrag and game then
				local workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
				if workspace and type(workspace.GlobalWind) == "table" and workspace.GlobalWind.__type == "Vector3" then
					globalWind = workspace.GlobalWind
				end
			end

			local ups = game and game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")

			local i = 1
			while i <= activeCount do
				local p = particles[i]
				p.life -= scaledDt
				if p.life <= 0 then
					if p.bodyID and ups and ups.DeleteRawBody then
						ups.DeleteRawBody(p.bodyID)
					end
					particles[i] = particles[activeCount]
					particles[activeCount] = nil
					activeCount -= 1
				else
					if p.bodyID then
						if ups and ups.ApplyForceToRawBody then
							if accel.X ~= 0 or accel.Y ~= 0 or accel.Z ~= 0 then
								ups.ApplyForceToRawBody(p.bodyID, accel) -- mass is 1
							end

							if drag > 0 then
								local vel = ups.GetRawBodyVelocity(p.bodyID)
								if
									windAffectsDrag and (globalWind.X ~= 0 or globalWind.Y ~= 0 or globalWind.Z ~= 0)
								then
									local force = (globalWind - vel) * (drag * 60)
									ups.ApplyForceToRawBody(p.bodyID, force)
								else
									local force = -vel * (drag * 60)
									ups.ApplyForceToRawBody(p.bodyID, force)
								end
							end
						end
					else
						-- Optional manual physics fallback
						local velocity = p.velocity
						local position = p.position

						-- Apply acceleration
						velocity = velocity + accel * scaledDt

						-- Apply drag
						if drag > 0 then
							if windAffectsDrag then
								velocity = velocity + (globalWind - velocity) * (drag * scaledDt)
							else
								velocity = velocity * (1 - drag * scaledDt)
							end
						end

						p.velocity = velocity
						p.position = position + velocity * scaledDt
					end

					p.rotation += p.rotSpeed * scaledDt
					i += 1
				end
			end
		end

		local function updateInstanceBuffer()
			if activeCount <= 0 or not instanceBuffer then
				return
			end

			local mappedPosition = nil
			local mappedRotation = nil
			local mappedScale = nil
			local mappedColor = nil

			local ups = game and game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")

			local okMap = pcall(function()
				mappedPosition = rlib.R3D_MapInstances(instanceBuffer, const.R3D_INSTANCE_POSITION)
				mappedRotation = rlib.R3D_MapInstances(instanceBuffer, const.R3D_INSTANCE_ROTATION)
				mappedScale = rlib.R3D_MapInstances(instanceBuffer, const.R3D_INSTANCE_SCALE)
				mappedColor = rlib.R3D_MapInstances(instanceBuffer, const.R3D_INSTANCE_COLOR)
			end)

			local mappedFlags = bit32.bor(
				mappedPosition and const.R3D_INSTANCE_POSITION or 0,
				mappedRotation and const.R3D_INSTANCE_ROTATION or 0,
				mappedScale and const.R3D_INSTANCE_SCALE or 0,
				mappedColor and const.R3D_INSTANCE_COLOR or 0
			)

			-- description: "Writes instances."
			-- args: "writePosition: any, writeRotation: number, writeScale: number, writeColor: number"
			local function writeInstances(writePosition, writeRotation, writeScale, writeColor)
				for idx = 1, activeCount do
					local p = particles[idx]
					local age = 1 - (p.life / p.lifetime)
					local t = clamp01(age)

					local size = evalNumberSequence(instance.Size, t, 1)
					local color = evalColorSequence(instance.Color, t, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
					local transparency = evalNumberSequence(instance.Transparency, t, 0)

					local r, g, b = color:ToRGB()
					local alpha = math.floor(255 * (1 - clamp01(transparency)))

					if writePosition then
						local pOffset = (idx - 1) * 12
						local pos = Vector3.zero
						if p.bodyID then
							if ups and ups.GetRawBodyPosition then
								pos = ups.GetRawBodyPosition(p.bodyID)
							end
						else
							pos = p.position or Vector3.zero
						end
						writePosition(pOffset, pos)
					end

					if writeRotation then
						local rotCF = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(p.axis, p.rotation)
						local qx, qy, qz, qw = rotCF:ToQuaternion()
						local rOffset = (idx - 1) * 16
						writeRotation(rOffset, qx, qy, qz, qw)
					end

					if writeScale then
						local sOffset = (idx - 1) * 12
						writeScale(sOffset, size)
					end

					if writeColor then
						local cOffset = (idx - 1) * 4
						writeColor(cOffset, r, g, b, alpha)
					end
				end
			end

			if okMap and mappedFlags == instanceFlags then
				local okWrite = pcall(function()
					writeInstances(
						writePositionMapped(mappedPosition),
						writeRotationMapped(mappedRotation),
						writeScaleMapped(mappedScale),
						writeColorMapped(mappedColor)
					)
				end)
				if okWrite then
					pcall(rlib.R3D_UnmapInstances, instanceBuffer, instanceFlags)
					return
				end
			end

			if mappedFlags ~= 0 then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnmapInstances, instanceBuffer, mappedFlags)
			end

			local positionBuffer = buffer.create(activeCount * 12)
			local rotationBuffer = buffer.create(activeCount * 16)
			local scaleBuffer = buffer.create(activeCount * 12)
			local colorBuffer = buffer.create(activeCount * 4)

			writeInstances(
				writePositionBuffer(positionBuffer),
				writeRotationBuffer(rotationBuffer),
				writeScaleBuffer(scaleBuffer),
				writeColorBuffer(colorBuffer)
			)

			pcall(function()
				rlib.R3D_UploadInstances(instanceBuffer, const.R3D_INSTANCE_POSITION, 0, activeCount, positionBuffer)
				rlib.R3D_UploadInstances(instanceBuffer, const.R3D_INSTANCE_ROTATION, 0, activeCount, rotationBuffer)
				rlib.R3D_UploadInstances(instanceBuffer, const.R3D_INSTANCE_SCALE, 0, activeCount, scaleBuffer)
				rlib.R3D_UploadInstances(instanceBuffer, const.R3D_INSTANCE_COLOR, 0, activeCount, colorBuffer)
			end)
		end

		-- description: "Updates flipbook."
		-- args: "dt: number"
		updateFlipbook = function(dt)
			local cols = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookColumns) or 1)
			local rows = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookRows) or 1)
			local frames = cols * rows
			local framerate = tonumber(instance.FlipbookFramerate) or 0

			if frames <= 1 then
				return
			end

			if framerate > 0 then
				flipbookTime += dt * framerate
				while flipbookTime >= 1 do
					flipbookTime -= 1
					local mode = getFlipbookMode(instance.FlipbookMode)
					if mode == 1 then
						flipbookFrame = math.min(frames - 1, flipbookFrame + 1)
					elseif mode == 2 then
						if flipbookFrame + flipbookDir >= frames or flipbookFrame + flipbookDir < 0 then
							flipbookDir = -flipbookDir
						end
						flipbookFrame = flipbookFrame + flipbookDir
					elseif mode == 3 then
						flipbookFrame = math.random(0, frames - 1)
					else
						flipbookFrame = (flipbookFrame + 1) % frames
					end
				end
			end

			local baseScale = getVector2(instance.UVScale, Vector2.new(1, 1))
			local baseOffset = getVector2(instance.UVOffset, Vector2.new(0, 0))
			local frameScaleX = 1 / cols
			local frameScaleY = 1 / rows
			local col = flipbookFrame % cols
			local row = math.floor(flipbookFrame / cols)

			local finalScaleX = baseScale.X * frameScaleX
			local finalScaleY = baseScale.Y * frameScaleY
			local finalOffsetX = baseOffset.X + (col * frameScaleX * baseScale.X)
			local finalOffsetY = baseOffset.Y + (row * frameScaleY * baseScale.Y)

			buffer.writef32(particleMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvScale"), finalScaleX)
			buffer.writef32(particleMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvScale") + 4, finalScaleY)
			buffer.writef32(particleMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvOffset"), finalOffsetX)
			buffer.writef32(particleMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvOffset") + 4, finalOffsetY)
		end

		local renderId = renderer.Pool.new("3d", function()
			if activeCount <= 0 then
				return
			end
			renderer.MeshPool.DrawMeshInstanced(particleMesh, particleMaterial, instanceBuffer, activeCount)
		end)

		if instance.FlipbookStartRandom then
			local cols = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookColumns) or 1)
			local rows = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookRows) or 1)
			local frames = cols * rows
			if frames > 1 then
				flipbookFrame = math.random(0, frames - 1)
			end
		end

		renderer.Hook.new("Renderstep", function(dt)
			updateParticles(dt)
			updateInstanceBuffer()
			updateFlipbook(dt)
		end)

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property)
			if property == "Texture" then
				updateMaterial()
			elseif property == "EmissionTexture" then
				updateMaterial()
			elseif property == "EmissionColor" or property == "EmissionEnergy" then
				applyMaterialSettings()
			elseif property == "TransparencyMode" or property == "BlendMode" or property == "CullMode" then
				applyMaterialSettings()
			elseif property == "BillboardMode" or property == "UVScale" or property == "UVOffset" then
				applyMaterialSettings()
				updateFlipbook(0)
			elseif
				property == "FlipbookColumns"
				or property == "FlipbookRows"
				or property == "FlipbookFramerate"
				or property == "FlipbookMode"
			then
				updateFlipbook(0)
			elseif property == "MaxParticles" then
				rebuildInstanceBuffer()
			elseif property == "CastShadow" then
				applyShadowMode()
			end
		end)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if renderId then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(renderId)
			end
			if instanceBuffer then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadInstanceBuffer, instanceBuffer)
			end
			if particleMesh then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadMesh, particleMesh)
			end
			if albedoMap then
				pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadAlbedoMap, albedoMap)
			end
			local ups = game and game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
			for i = 1, activeCount do
				if particles[i] and particles[i].bodyID and ups and ups.DeleteRawBody then
					pcall(ups.DeleteRawBody, particles[i].bodyID)
				end
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local function getRange(value, defaultMin, defaultMax)
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return value, value
	end
	if type(value) == "table" then
		if value.Min ~= nil and value.Max ~= nil then
			return value.Min, value.Max
		end
	end
	return defaultMin, defaultMax
end

local function randomRange(value, defaultMin, defaultMax)
	local minVal, maxVal = getRange(value, defaultMin, defaultMax)
	if minVal == nil or maxVal == nil then
		return 0
	end
	if minVal == maxVal then
		return minVal
	end
	return minVal + math.random() * (maxVal - minVal)
end

local function clamp01(v)
	if v < 0 then
		return 0
	end
	if v > 1 then
		return 1
	end
	return v
end

local function evalNumberSequence(seq, t, fallback)
	if type(seq) == "number" then
		return seq
	end
	if type(seq) == "table" and seq.Evaluate then
		return seq:Evaluate(t)
	end
	return fallback
end

local function evalColorSequence(seq, t, fallback)
	if type(seq) == "table" and seq.Evaluate then
		return seq:Evaluate(t)
	end
	if type(seq) == "table" and seq.__type == "Color3" then
		return seq
	end
	return fallback
end

local function getSpreadAngle(spread)
	if type(spread) == "number" then
		return spread
	end
	if type(spread) == "table" and spread.__type == "Vector2" then
		return spread.X
	end
	return 0
end

local function resolveUIBlendMode(value)
	local v = value
	if type(v) == "table" and v.Value ~= nil then
		v = v.Value
	end
	if v == Enum.ParticleBlendMode.Additive.Value then
		return const.BlendMode.BLEND_ADDITIVE
	elseif v == Enum.ParticleBlendMode.Multiply.Value then
		return const.BlendMode.BLEND_MULTIPLIED
	elseif v == Enum.ParticleBlendMode.PremultipliedAlpha.Value then
		return const.BlendMode.BLEND_ALPHA_PREMULTIPLY
	end
	return const.BlendMode.BLEND_ALPHA
end

local function getFlipbookMode(value)
	if type(value) == "number" then
		return value
	end
	if type(value) == "table" and value.Value ~= nil then
		return value.Value
	end
	return 0
end

local function getEmissionDirection(direction)
	if direction == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
		return Vector2.new(0, 1)
	elseif direction == Enum.NormalId.Left then
		return Vector2.new(-1, 0)
	elseif direction == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		return Vector2.new(1, 0)
	elseif direction == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		return Vector2.new(0, 1)
	elseif direction == Enum.NormalId.Front then
		return Vector2.new(0, -1)
	end
	return Vector2.new(0, -1)
end

		return value

	end

local function rotateVector2(vec, degrees)
	local angle = math.rad(degrees or 0)
	local cosA = math.cos(angle)
	local sinA = math.sin(angle)
	return Vector2.new(vec.X * cosA - vec.Y * sinA, vec.X * sinA + vec.Y * cosA)
end

local function randomSign()
	return math.random() * 2 - 1
end

local function randomPointInShape(shapeValue, shapeSize, shapeThickness, emitFromEdge, shapeRotation)
	local size = shapeSize or Vector2.new(0, 0)
	local thickness = math.max(0, shapeThickness or 0)

	local offset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	if shapeValue == Enum.UIParticleEmitterShape.Box.Value then
		local halfX = size.X * 0.5
		local halfY = size.Y * 0.5
		if emitFromEdge and (halfX > 0 or halfY > 0) then
			local perimeter = (halfX * 2 + halfY * 2) * 2
			local pick = math.random() * perimeter
			if pick <= halfX * 2 then
				offset = Vector2.new(-halfX + pick, -halfY)
			elseif pick <= halfX * 2 + halfY * 2 then
				offset = Vector2.new(halfX, -halfY + (pick - halfX * 2))
			elseif pick <= halfX * 4 + halfY * 2 then
				offset = Vector2.new(halfX - (pick - (halfX * 2 + halfY * 2)), halfY)
			else
				offset = Vector2.new(-halfX, halfY - (pick - (halfX * 4 + halfY * 2)))
			end
		else
			offset = Vector2.new(randomSign() * halfX, randomSign() * halfY)
		end
	elseif shapeValue == Enum.UIParticleEmitterShape.Circle.Value then
		local radius = math.min(size.X, size.Y) * 0.5
		if radius <= 0 then
			offset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		else
			local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
			local dist = radius
			if not emitFromEdge then
				dist = math.sqrt(math.random()) * radius
			end
			offset = Vector2.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, math.sin(angle) * dist)
		end
	elseif shapeValue == Enum.UIParticleEmitterShape.Ring.Value then
		local radius = math.min(size.X, size.Y) * 0.5
		if radius <= 0 then
			offset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		else
			local inner = math.max(0, radius - thickness)
			local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
			local dist = radius
			if not emitFromEdge and thickness > 0 then
				local r2 = radius * radius
				local inner2 = inner * inner
				dist = math.sqrt(inner2 + math.random() * (r2 - inner2))
			end
			offset = Vector2.new(math.cos(angle) * dist, math.sin(angle) * dist)
		end
	else
		offset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
	end

	if shapeRotation and shapeRotation ~= 0 then
		offset = rotateVector2(offset, shapeRotation)
	end

	return offset
end

	callback = function(instance, renderer)

		if _G.IsHeadless or not renderer then
			return instance
		end

		local texture = nil
		local particles = {}
		local activeCount = 0
		local emitAccumulator = 0
		local flipbookTime = 0
		local flipbookFrame = 0
		local flipbookDir = 1

		local function updateTexture()

			end
			if type(instance.Texture) == "string" and instance.Texture ~= "" then

					lib.SetTextureWrap(texture, const.TextureWrap.TEXTURE_WRAP_REPEAT)

		end

		updateTexture()

		local function updateFlipbook(dt)
			local cols = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookColumns) or 1)
			local rows = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookRows) or 1)
			local frames = cols * rows
			local framerate = tonumber(instance.FlipbookFramerate) or 0

			if frames <= 1 then

			end

				flipbookTime += dt * framerate

					local mode = getFlipbookMode(instance.FlipbookMode)
					if mode == 1 then
						flipbookFrame = math.min(frames - 1, flipbookFrame + 1)
					elseif mode == 2 then
						flipbookFrame += flipbookDir
						if flipbookFrame <= 0 then
							flipbookFrame = 0
							flipbookDir = 1
						elseif flipbookFrame >= frames - 1 then
							flipbookFrame = frames - 1
							flipbookDir = -1
						end
					elseif mode == 3 then
						flipbookFrame = math.random(0, frames - 1)
					else
						flipbookFrame = (flipbookFrame + 1) % frames
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if instance.FlipbookStartRandom then
			local cols = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookColumns) or 1)
			local rows = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookRows) or 1)
			local frames = cols * rows
			if frames > 1 then
				flipbookFrame = math.random(0, frames - 1)
			end
		end

		local function emitParticle(origin)
			if activeCount >= instance.MaxParticles then
				return
			end

			local shapeValue = getEnumValue(instance.Shape, Enum.UIParticleEmitterShape.Point.Value)
			local shapeOffset = randomPointInShape(
				shapeValue,
				instance.ShapeSize,
				instance.ShapeThickness,
				instance.EmitFromEdge,
				instance.ShapeRotation
			)

			local baseDir = getEmissionDirection(instance.EmissionDirection)
			local angle = math.atan2(baseDir.Y, baseDir.X)
			local spread = getSpreadAngle(instance.SpreadAngle)
			if spread ~= 0 then
				angle += math.rad((math.random() * 2 - 1) * spread * 0.5)
			end

			local dir = Vector2.new(math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle))
			local lifetime = randomRange(instance.Lifetime, 1, 1)
			if lifetime <= 0 then
				return
			end

			local baseSize = instance.Size or Vector2.new(16, 16)
			local sizeSpread = instance.SizeSpread or Vector2.new(0, 0)
			local spawnSize = Vector2.new(
				math.max(0, baseSize.X + randomSign() * sizeSpread.X),
				math.max(0, baseSize.Y + randomSign() * sizeSpread.Y)
			)

			activeCount += 1
			particles[activeCount] = {
				position = origin + shapeOffset,
				velocity = dir * randomRange(instance.Speed, 0, 0),
				life = lifetime,
				lifetime = lifetime,
				rotation = math.rad(randomRange(instance.Rotation, 0, 0)),
				rotSpeed = math.rad(randomRange(instance.RotSpeed, 0, 0)),
				localOffset = shapeOffset,
				size = spawnSize,
			}
		end

		-- description: "Emits a specified amount of particles"
		-- args: "self: table, count: number"
		instance.Emit = function(_, count)
			local parent = instance.Parent
			local origin = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			if parent and parent.AbsolutePosition and parent.AbsoluteSize then
				origin = Vector2.new(
					parent.AbsolutePosition.X
						+ parent.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.5
						+ (instance.Position and instance.Position.X or 0),
					parent.AbsolutePosition.Y
						+ parent.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.5
						+ (instance.Position and instance.Position.Y or 0)
				)
			end
			for _ = 1, math.max(0, count or 1) do
				emitParticle(origin)
			end
		end

		local function updateParticles(dt)
			local parent = instance.Parent
			local origin = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			if parent and parent.AbsolutePosition and parent.AbsoluteSize then
				origin = Vector2.new(
					parent.AbsolutePosition.X
						+ parent.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.5
						+ (instance.Position and instance.Position.X or 0),
					parent.AbsolutePosition.Y
						+ parent.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.5
						+ (instance.Position and instance.Position.Y or 0)
				)
			end

			if instance.Enabled then
				emitAccumulator += (instance.Rate or 0) * dt
				local emitCount = math.floor(emitAccumulator)
				if emitCount > 0 then
					emitAccumulator -= emitCount
					for _ = 1, emitCount do
						emitParticle(origin)
					end
				end
			end

			local accel = instance.Acceleration or Vector2.new(0, 0)
			local drag = instance.Drag or 0

			local i = 1
			while i <= activeCount do
				local p = particles[i]
				p.life -= dt
				if p.life <= 0 then
					particles[i] = particles[activeCount]
					particles[activeCount] = nil
					activeCount -= 1
				else
					p.velocity = p.velocity + accel * dt
					if drag > 0 then
						local dragFactor = math.max(0, 1 - drag * dt)
						p.velocity = p.velocity * dragFactor
					end
					if instance.LockedToParent then
						p.localOffset = p.localOffset + p.velocity * dt
						p.position = origin + p.localOffset
					else
						p.position = p.position + p.velocity * dt
					end
					p.rotation += p.rotSpeed * dt
					i += 1
				end
			end
		end

		local renderId = renderer.Pool.new("2d", function(_, object, _, _, _)
			if activeCount <= 0 or not texture then
				return
			end

			local blend = resolveUIBlendMode(instance.BlendMode)
			lib.BeginBlendMode(blend)

			local texW = buffer.readi32(texture, 4)
			local texH = buffer.readi32(texture, 8)
			local cols = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookColumns) or 1)
			local rows = math.max(1, tonumber(instance.FlipbookRows) or 1)
			local frameW = texW / cols
			local frameH = texH / rows
			local col = flipbookFrame % cols
			local row = math.floor(flipbookFrame / cols)

			local baseScale = instance.UVScale or Vector2.new(1, 1)
			local baseOffset = instance.UVOffset or Vector2.new(0, 0)
			local srcW = frameW * baseScale.X
			local srcH = frameH * baseScale.Y
			local srcX = col * frameW + baseOffset.X * frameW
			local srcY = row * frameH + baseOffset.Y * frameH

			for idx = 1, activeCount do
				local p = particles[idx]
				local age = 1 - (p.life / p.lifetime)
				local t = clamp01(age)

				local sizeScale = evalNumberSequence(instance.SizeScale, t, 1)
				local size = Vector2.new(p.size.X * sizeScale, p.size.Y * sizeScale)
				local color = evalColorSequence(instance.Color, t, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
				local transparency = evalNumberSequence(instance.Transparency, t, 0)

				local r, g, b = color:ToRGB()
				local alpha = math.floor(255 * (1 - clamp01(transparency)))

				local src = structs.Rectangle:new({
					x = srcX,
					y = srcY,
					width = srcW,
					height = srcH,
				})
				local dest = structs.Rectangle:new({
					x = p.position.X,
					y = p.position.Y,
					width = size.X,
					height = size.Y,
				})

				local origin = vector.create(size.X * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5, 0)
				local rotation = p.rotation
				if instance.AlignToVelocity then
					rotation += math.atan2(p.velocity.Y, p.velocity.X)
				end
				lib.DrawTexturePro(
					texture,
					src,
					dest,
					origin,
					math.deg(rotation),
					structs.Color:new({ r = r, g = g, b = b, a = alpha })
				)
			end

			lib.EndBlendMode()
		end)

		renderer.Hook.new("Renderstep", function(dt)
			updateParticles(dt)
			updateFlipbook(dt)
		end)

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property)
			if property == "Texture" then
				updateTexture()
			elseif
				property == "FlipbookColumns"
				or property == "FlipbookRows"
				or property == "FlipbookFramerate"
				or property == "FlipbookMode"
			then
				updateFlipbook(0)
			end
		end)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if renderId then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(renderId)
			end
			if texture then
				lib.UnloadTexture(texture)
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

}

return {
	class = "PrismaticConstraint",

	-- description: "Initializes the PrismaticConstraint instance."
	-- args: "instance: table, renderer: number, datamodel: table"
	-- returns: "table"
	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		local KinemiumPhysicsService = datamodel:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local _activeConstraint = nil

		-- description: "Cleans up the resources."
		local function cleanup()
			if _activeConstraint then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.lib.JPH_PhysicsSystem_RemoveConstraint(
					KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.physicsSystem,
					_activeConstraint
				)
				_activeConstraint = nil
			end
		end

		-- description: "Rebuilds the state."
		local function rebuild()
			cleanup()

			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end
			if not instance.Attachment0 or not instance.Attachment1 then
				return
			end

			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			local part0 = att0.Parent
			local part1 = att1.Parent

			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return
			end

			if not NetworkOwnership.ShouldSimulateConstraintForMachine(instance, datamodel) then
				return
			end

			-- Wait for bodies to exist
			local bodyID0 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part0)
			local bodyID1 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part1)

			if not bodyID0 or not bodyID1 then
				task.defer(rebuild)
				return
			end

			-- Convert attachments to World Space
			local wPos0 = part0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wAxis0 = part0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.Axis):Unit()
			local wNormal0 = part0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.SecondaryAxis):Unit()

			local wPos1 = part1.CFrame * att1.Position
			local wAxis1 = part1.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att1.Axis):Unit()
			local wNormal1 = part1.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att1.SecondaryAxis):Unit()

			_activeConstraint =
				KinemiumPhysicsService.CreateSlider(part0, part1, wPos0, wAxis0, wNormal0, wPos1, wAxis1, wNormal1)

			if _activeConstraint then
				-- Initial state sync
				instance:UpdateActuator()
				instance:UpdateLimits()

				-- Re-apply motor state when a connected body becomes dynamic.
				-- description: "Ons part changed."
				-- args: "property: number"
				local function onPartChanged(property)
					if property == "Anchored" then
						task.defer(function()
							instance:UpdateActuator()
						end)
					end
				end
				if part0 then
					part0.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
				end
				if part1 then
					part1.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
				end
			else
				warn("[PrismaticConstraint] CreateSlider returned nil")
				task.defer(rebuild)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Updates actuator."
		function instance:UpdateActuator()
			if not _activeConstraint then
				return
			end

			local actuator = instance.ActuatorType
			if actuator == Enum.ActuatorType.None then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderMotorState(_activeConstraint, 0) -- Off
			elseif actuator == Enum.ActuatorType.Motor then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderMotorSettings(_activeConstraint, instance.MotorMaxForce)
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderMotorState(_activeConstraint, 1) -- Velocity
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderTargetVelocity(_activeConstraint, instance.Velocity)
			elseif actuator == Enum.ActuatorType.Servo then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderMotorSettings(_activeConstraint, instance.ServoMaxForce)
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderMotorState(_activeConstraint, 2) -- Position
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderTargetPosition(_activeConstraint, instance.TargetPosition)
			end

			-- Force activation to ensure motor starts immediately
			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			if att0 and att0.Parent then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ActivatePart(att0.Parent)
			end
			if att1 and att1.Parent then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ActivatePart(att1.Parent)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Updates limits."
		function instance:UpdateLimits()
			if not _activeConstraint then
				return
			end
			if instance.LimitsEnabled then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderLimits(_activeConstraint, instance.LowerLimit, instance.UpperLimit)
			else
				-- Huge range if disabled
				KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSliderLimits(_activeConstraint, -1e6, 1e6)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Draws the visual representation."
		local function drawGizmo()
			if not instance.Visible then
				return
			end
			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			if not att0 or not att1 then
				return
			end

			local p0 = att0.Parent
			local p1 = att1.Parent
			if not p0 or not p1 then
				return
			end

			-- Center of slider axis
			local wPos0 = p0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wAxis0 = p0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.Axis):Unit()

			local color = instance.Color
			-- description: "Tos raylib color."
			-- args: "c: any, a: number"
			local function toRaylibColor(c, a)
				return raylib.structs.Color:new({ r = c.R * 255, g = c.G * 255, b = c.B * 255, a = a or 255 })
			end

			local mainColor = toRaylibColor(color)
			local secondaryColor = toRaylibColor(Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150), 100)
			local limitColor = toRaylibColor(Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50), 150)

			-- 1. Draw Axis Line
			local axisLen = 10.0
			local axisStart = wPos0 - (wAxis0 * (axisLen / 2))
			local axisEnd = wPos0 + (wAxis0 * (axisLen / 2))
			rl.DrawLine3D(
				vector.create(axisStart.X, axisStart.Y, axisStart.Z),
				vector.create(axisEnd.X, axisEnd.Y, axisEnd.Z),
				secondaryColor
			)

			-- 2. Draw Attachment Points
			rl.DrawSphere(vector.create(wPos0.X, wPos0.Y, wPos0.Z), 0.05, mainColor)

			-- 3. Draw Current Position (if active)
			local currentPos = 0
			if _activeConstraint then
				currentPos = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetSliderPosition(_activeConstraint)
			end
			local relativePos = wPos0 + (wAxis0 * currentPos)
			rl.DrawSphere(vector.create(relativePos.X, relativePos.Y, relativePos.Z), 0.08, mainColor)

			-- 4. Draw Limits
			if instance.LimitsEnabled then
				local lowPos = wPos0 + (wAxis0 * instance.LowerLimit)
				local highPos = wPos0 + (wAxis0 * instance.UpperLimit)

				-- Draw ticks at limits
				local perp = (math.abs(wAxis0.X) < 0.9 and _Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or _Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
					:Cross(wAxis0)
					:Unit()
				local tickLen = 0.2

				-- description: "Draws the visual representation."
				-- args: "center: number"
				local function drawTick(center)
					local s = center - (perp * tickLen)
					local e = center + (perp * tickLen)
					rl.DrawLine3D(vector.create(s.X, s.Y, s.Z), vector.create(e.X, e.Y, e.Z), limitColor)
				end

				drawTick(lowPos)
				drawTick(highPos)

				-- Draw segment between limits
				rl.DrawLine3D(
					vector.create(lowPos.X, lowPos.Y, lowPos.Z),
					vector.create(highPos.X, highPos.Y, highPos.Z),
					limitColor
				)
			end
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if prop == "Attachment0" or prop == "Attachment1" or prop == "Enabled" then
				rebuild()
			elseif
				prop == "ActuatorType"
				or prop == "Velocity"
				or prop == "TargetPosition"
				or prop == "MotorMaxForce"
				or prop == "ServoMaxForce"
			then
				instance:UpdateActuator()
			elseif prop == "LimitsEnabled" or prop == "LowerLimit" or prop == "UpperLimit" then
				instance:UpdateLimits()
			end
		end)

		instance.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if not parent then
				cleanup()
			end
		end)

		renderer.Pool.new("gizmo", function()
			drawGizmo()
		end)

		rebuild()

		return instance
	end,

	-- description: "Inherits the properties of the PrismaticConstraint class."
	-- args: "tble: table"
	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local proptble = {

	GravityY = -50,
	GravityX = 0,
	ZIndexBehavior = "Sibling",

	ResetOnSpawn = true,
	Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 400),
	RenderOffset = Vector2.new(0, 0),
	OverrideScreenSize = false,

	BaseClass = "UIContainer",
}

local function profileBegin(name)
	if ENGINE_PROFILER then
		ENGINE_PROFILER:Begin(name)
	end
end

local function profileSetCounter(name, value)
	if ENGINE_PROFILER then
		ENGINE_PROFILER:SetCounter(name, value)
	end
end

return {
	class = "ScreenGui",

	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		proptble.render = function(lib, instance, dt, structs, datamodel)
			if not datamodel then
				return
			end

			local renderWidth, renderHeight

			if IsHeadless then
				renderWidth = 1024
				renderHeight = 1024
			else
				local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
				renderWidth = lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x
				renderHeight = lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y
			end

			if not instance.OverrideScreenSize then
				local currentSize = instance.Size
				local currentAbsSize = instance.AbsoluteSize
				local needsResize = currentSize == nil
					or currentSize.X == nil
					or currentSize.Y == nil
					or currentSize.X.Scale ~= 0
					or currentSize.Y.Scale ~= 0
					or currentSize.X.Offset ~= renderWidth
					or currentSize.Y.Offset ~= renderHeight
					or currentAbsSize == nil
					or currentAbsSize.X ~= renderWidth
					or currentAbsSize.Y ~= renderHeight

				if needsResize then
					instance.Size = UDim2.new(0, renderWidth, 0, renderHeight)
					instance.AbsoluteSize = Vector2.new(renderWidth, renderHeight)
					instance.AbsolutePosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
				end
			end

			profileBegin("Gui render")
			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end
			for _, child in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				if child["render"] then
					child.render(lib, child, dt, structs, renderer, datamodel)
				end
			end
			profileEnd()
		end

		instance:SetProperties(proptble)

		return instance
	end,
}

local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local GuiObject = require("@GuiObject")
local raylib = require("@Raylib")
local structs = raylib.structs
local UDim = require("@UDim")
local MouseCursor = require("@Kinemium.MouseCursor")

local aereon = require("@Aereon")
local arect = aereon.rect()

local propTable = {
	Name = "ScrollingFrame",

	-- layout
	AbsoluteSize = nil,
	AbsolutePosition = nil,

	-- appearance
	ScrollBarTransparency = 0,
	ScrollBarColor3 = Color3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
	ScrollBarCornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 0),
	ScrollBarBackgroundTransparency = 1,
	ScrollBarBackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	ScrollBarHoverColor3 = Color3.new(0.6, 0.6, 0.6),

	-- scrolling state
	Scroll = 0, -- normalized 0ΓÇô1 (thumb position)
	ScrollOffset = 0.08, -- wheel step

	-- lerping
	ScrollTarget = 0, -- where input writes to
	ScrollLerpSpeed = 18, -- higher = snappier

	-- content
	ContentSize = 0, -- total content height (pixels)
	CanvasPosition = 0, -- pixel offset derived from Scroll
	AutoScrollSize = true,
	CanvasSize = 0,

	-- behavior
	ScrollBarThickness = 8,
	ScrollBarVisible = true,
	ScrollBarAutoHide = true, -- auto-hide when not scrolling
	ScrollBarFadeSpeed = 4, -- fade speed
	ScrollBarPadding = 2, -- padding from edge

	ElasticEnabled = true,
	ElasticStrength = 0.8, -- how far you can overscroll (0-1, relative to viewport)
	ElasticSnapSpeed = 12, -- how fast it snaps back

	-- momentum scrolling
	MomentumEnabled = true,
	MomentumFriction = 0.92, -- 0-1, higher = scrolls longer
	MomentumMinVelocity = 0.001, -- minimum velocity before stopping

	-- track clicking
	TrackClickEnabled = true, -- click scrollbar track to jump
	TrackClickSmooth = true, -- smooth scroll to position instead of instant

	_draggingThumb = false,
	_dragOffsetY = 0,
	_scrollBarAlpha = 0, -- for fade in/out
	_timeSinceLastScroll = 999, -- accumulated dt since last scroll
	_velocity = 0, -- for momentum
	_isOverscrolled = false,
	_lastScroll = 0, -- for velocity calculation
	_isHoveringThumb = false,
	_isHoveringTrack = false,
}

local function c3tr(c, transparency)
	local r, g, b = c:ToRGB()
	return structs.Color:new({
		r = r,
		g = g,
		b = b,
		a = math.floor(255 * (1 - transparency)),
	})
end

GuiObject.inherit(propTable)

return {
	class = "ScrollingFrame",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		propTable.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if not object.Visible then
				return
			end
			if rawget(object, "_draggingThumb") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_draggingThumb", false)
			end
			if rawget(object, "_dragOffsetY") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_dragOffsetY", 0)
			end
			if rawget(object, "_scrollBarAlpha") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_scrollBarAlpha", object.ScrollBarAutoHide and 0 or 1)
			end
			if rawget(object, "_timeSinceLastScroll") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_timeSinceLastScroll", 999)
			end
			if rawget(object, "_velocity") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_velocity", 0)
			end
			if rawget(object, "_isOverscrolled") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_isOverscrolled", false)
			end
			if rawget(object, "_lastScroll") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_lastScroll", object.Scroll)
			end
			if rawget(object, "_isHoveringThumb") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_isHoveringThumb", false)
			end
			if rawget(object, "_isHoveringTrack") == nil then
				rawset(object, "_isHoveringTrack", false)
			end

			-- Accumulate time since last scroll
			object._timeSinceLastScroll = object._timeSinceLastScroll + dt

			local pos, size = GuiObject.render(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			rawset(object, "AbsolutePosition", pos)
			rawset(object, "AbsoluteSize", size)

			local backgroundRect = arect.new(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y)

			local contentHeight = 0
			for _, child in pairs(object:GetChildren()) do
				if not child then
					continue
				end
				if not child.Position then
					continue
				end
				local childOffset = child.Position.Y.Offset
				local childHeight = child.Size.Y.Offset
				local childRelativeBottom = childOffset + childHeight
				contentHeight = math.max(contentHeight, childRelativeBottom)
			end
			object.ContentSize = object.AutoScrollSize and contentHeight or object.CanvasSize

			local maxScroll = math.max(0, object.ContentSize - object.AbsoluteSize.Y)
			local canScroll = maxScroll > 0

			if object.ScrollBarAutoHide then
				local fadeDelay = 0.5 -- seconds before fading

				if object._draggingThumb or object._isHoveringTrack or object._timeSinceLastScroll < fadeDelay then
					object._scrollBarAlpha = math.min(1, object._scrollBarAlpha + dt * object.ScrollBarFadeSpeed)
				else
					object._scrollBarAlpha = math.max(0, object._scrollBarAlpha - dt * object.ScrollBarFadeSpeed)
				end
			else
				object._scrollBarAlpha = 1
			end

			-- Only render scrollbar if visible and there's content to scroll
			local scrollbarWidth = object.ScrollBarThickness
			local scrollbarRect =
				arect.new(pos.X + size.X - scrollbarWidth - object.ScrollBarPadding, pos.Y, scrollbarWidth, size.Y)

			if object.ScrollBarVisible and canScroll and object._scrollBarAlpha > 0 then
				-- Background track
				lib.DrawRectangleRec(
					arect:translate(scrollbarRect),
					c3tr(
						object.ScrollBarBackgroundColor3,
						1 - (1 - object.ScrollBarBackgroundTransparency) * object._scrollBarAlpha
					)
				)

				-- Thumb
				local thumbMinHeight = 16
				local viewportRatio = math.min(1, size.Y / object.ContentSize)
				local thumbHeight = math.max(size.Y * viewportRatio, thumbMinHeight)
				thumbHeight = math.min(thumbHeight, size.Y)

				local scroll = object.Scroll or 0
				local scrollableRange = size.Y - thumbHeight
				local thumbY = pos.Y + scrollableRange * math.clamp(scroll, 0, 1)
				local thumbRect = arect.new(
					pos.X + size.X - scrollbarWidth - object.ScrollBarPadding,
					thumbY,
					scrollbarWidth,
					thumbHeight
				)

				-- Determine thumb color (hover effect)
				local thumbColor = object._isHoveringThumb and object.ScrollBarHoverColor3 or object.ScrollBarColor3
				lib.DrawRectangleRec(
					arect:translate(thumbRect),
					c3tr(thumbColor, 1 - (1 - object.ScrollBarTransparency) * object._scrollBarAlpha)
				)

				-- Mouse interaction
				local mousePos = lib.GetMousePosition()
				object._isHoveringThumb = arect.MouseIsInRect(thumbRect)
				object._isHoveringTrack = arect.MouseIsInRect(scrollbarRect)

				-- Start dragging thumb
				if lib.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 and object._isHoveringThumb then
					object._draggingThumb = true
					object._dragOffsetY = mousePos.y - thumbY
					object._velocity = 0 -- stop momentum when dragging
					object._timeSinceLastScroll = 0
					MouseCursor.request(raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_ALL)
				end

				-- Click on track to jump (if not clicking thumb)
				if
					object.TrackClickEnabled
					and lib.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1
					and object._isHoveringTrack
					and not object._isHoveringThumb
				then
					local clickY = mousePos.y
					local targetScroll = math.clamp((clickY - pos.Y - thumbHeight / 2) / scrollableRange, 0, 1)

					if object.TrackClickSmooth then
						object.ScrollTarget = targetScroll
					else
						object.Scroll = targetScroll
						object.ScrollTarget = targetScroll
					end
					object._timeSinceLastScroll = 0
				end

				-- Stop dragging
				if lib.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
					object._draggingThumb = false
					MouseCursor.request(raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_DEFAULT)
				end

				-- Drag update
				if object._draggingThumb then
					local minY = pos.Y
					local maxY = pos.Y + scrollableRange

					local newThumbY = mousePos.y - object._dragOffsetY
					newThumbY = math.clamp(newThumbY, minY, maxY)

					local newScroll = (newThumbY - minY) / scrollableRange
					object.ScrollTarget = newScroll
					object._timeSinceLastScroll = 0
				end
			end

			if arect.MouseIsInRect(backgroundRect) and canScroll then
				local wheel = lib.GetMouseWheelMove()

				if wheel ~= 0 then
					local currentTarget = object.ScrollTarget or object.Scroll
					object.ScrollTarget = currentTarget - wheel * object.ScrollOffset
					object._velocity = -wheel * object.ScrollOffset * 0.5 -- add some momentum
					object._timeSinceLastScroll = 0
				end
			end

			if object.ElasticEnabled then
				if object.ScrollTarget < 0 or object.ScrollTarget > 1 then
					object._isOverscrolled = true
				end

				if object.ScrollTarget < 0 then
					local overshoot = -object.ScrollTarget
					object.ScrollTarget = -overshoot * object.ElasticStrength
				elseif object.ScrollTarget > 1 then
					local overshoot = object.ScrollTarget - 1
					object.ScrollTarget = 1 + overshoot * object.ElasticStrength
				end

				if object._isOverscrolled and not object._draggingThumb then
					if object._timeSinceLastScroll > 0.1 then -- small delay before snapping
						if object.ScrollTarget < 0 then
							object.ScrollTarget = object.ScrollTarget
								+ (0 - object.ScrollTarget) * dt * object.ElasticSnapSpeed
							if math.abs(object.ScrollTarget) < 0.001 then
								object.ScrollTarget = 0
								object._isOverscrolled = false
							end
						elseif object.ScrollTarget > 1 then
							object.ScrollTarget = object.ScrollTarget
								+ (1 - object.ScrollTarget) * dt * object.ElasticSnapSpeed
							if math.abs(object.ScrollTarget - 1) < 0.001 then
								object.ScrollTarget = 1
								object._isOverscrolled = false
							end
						end
					end
				end
			else
				-- Hard clamp if elastic is disabled
				object.ScrollTarget = math.clamp(object.ScrollTarget or object.Scroll, 0, 1)
			end

			-- Calculate velocity for momentum
			if object.MomentumEnabled and not object._draggingThumb then
				local scrollDelta = object.Scroll - object._lastScroll
				object._velocity = scrollDelta / dt

				-- Apply momentum when not actively scrolling
				if object._timeSinceLastScroll > 0.05 and math.abs(object._velocity) > object.MomentumMinVelocity then
					object.ScrollTarget = object.ScrollTarget + object._velocity * dt
					object._velocity = object._velocity * object.MomentumFriction

					-- Stop momentum if velocity is too low
					if math.abs(object._velocity) < object.MomentumMinVelocity then
						object._velocity = 0
					end
				end
			end

			object.Scroll = object.Scroll
				+ (object.ScrollTarget - object.Scroll) * math.clamp(dt * object.ScrollLerpSpeed, 0, 1)

			object._lastScroll = object.Scroll

			object.CanvasPosition = object.Scroll * maxScroll

			GuiObject.renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
		end

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		return instance
	end,
	inherit = function(tble)
		GuiObject.inherit(tble)
	end,
}

	IsSeat = true,
}

Part.inherit(propTable)

return {
	class = "SeatPart",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance:SetMetadata("IsMovable", true)

		local KinemiumPhysicsService = game and game:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService") or nil
		-- description: "Applies a physics impulse to the object."
		-- args: "self: table, v: Vector3"
		instance.ApplyImpulse = function(self, v)
			if KinemiumPhysicsService then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ApplyImpulse(instance, v)
			end
		end

		renderer.EventBus:Fire("UpdatePart", instance)

		local syncingTransform = false

		local function syncFromCFrame(cf)
			if not cf or not cf.Position then
				return
			end
			local rx, ry, rz = cf:ToOrientation()
			local props = rawget(instance, "_props")
			if not props then
				return
			end
			props.Position = cf.Position
			props.Orientation = Vector3.new(rx, ry, rz)
			props.Rotation = props.Orientation
		end

		local function syncFromPosition(position)
			if not position then
				return
			end
			local props = rawget(instance, "_props")
			if not props or not props.CFrame then
				return
			end
			props.CFrame = props.CFrame:WithPosition(position)
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property, value)
			if syncingTransform then
				return
			end
			if property == "CFrame" then
				syncingTransform = true
				syncFromCFrame(value)
				syncingTransform = false
			elseif property == "Position" then
				syncingTransform = true
				syncFromPosition(value)
				syncingTransform = false
			elseif property == "Parent" then
				renderer.EventBus:Fire("UpdatePart", instance)
			end
		end)

		instance.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			if instance.Disabled or instance.Occupant then
				return
			end
			local humanoid = hit and hit.Parent and hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if
				humanoid
				and humanoid.Health > 0
				and humanoid.SeatPart == nil
				and humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
				and humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
			then
				instance.Occupant = humanoid
				humanoid.SeatPart = instance
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,
	inherit = function(t)
		Part.inherit(t)
		for k, v in pairs(propTable) do
			t[k] = v
		end
	end,
}

local GuiObject = require("@GuiObject")
local raylib = require("@raylib")

local propTable = {
	Name = "ShaderFrame",
	AbsoluteSize = nil,
	AbsolutePosition = nil,
	Shader = nil,
}

GuiObject.inherit(propTable)

local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)
	if value < minValue then
		return minValue
	end
	if value > maxValue then
		return maxValue
	end
	return value
end

propTable.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
	if not object.Visible then
		return
	end

	local pos, size = GuiObject.render(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
	object.AbsolutePosition = pos
	object.AbsoluteSize = size

	local scissorX = math.floor(pos.X)
	local scissorY = math.floor(pos.Y)
	local scissorW = math.max(1, math.floor(size.X))
	local scissorH = math.max(1, math.floor(size.Y))

	if object.Shader then
		object._frameCount = (object._frameCount or 0) + 1

		raylib.lib.BeginShaderMode(object.Shader._shader)

		local time = raylib.lib.GetTime()
		local safeW = math.max(size.X, 1)
		local safeH = math.max(size.Y, 1)

		local localX = clamp(lib.GetMouseX() - pos.X, 0, safeW)
		local localY = clamp(lib.GetMouseY() - pos.Y, 0, safeH)
		local mouseUVX = localX / safeW
		local mouseUVY = localY / safeH

		object.Shader:SetUniform("u_time", time, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("u_deltaTime", dt, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("u_frame", object._frameCount, false)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("u_resolution", { safeW, safeH }, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("u_mouse", { localX, localY }, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("u_mouseUV", { mouseUVX, mouseUVY }, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("u_framePos", { pos.X, pos.Y }, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("iTime", time, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("iTimeDelta", dt, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("iFrame", object._frameCount, false)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("iResolution", { safeW, safeH, 1 }, true)
		object.Shader:SetUniform("iMouse", { localX, localY, localX, localY }, true)
	end
	raylib.lib.DrawRectangle(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y, raylib.const.WHITE)

	if object.Shader then
		raylib.lib.EndShaderMode()
	end

	GuiObject.renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)

	return pos, size

[LOG]	CLASS: Successfully created class 'ShaderFrame' in 3.630ms from file (required in 3.629ms): ./src/environment/class/list/ShaderFrame.luau

  Code: -- description: "Creates a sky shader for custom rendering, Parented under lighting."
local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local Shader = require("@ShaderDatatype")
local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")

local function calculateSunDirection(time, latitude)
	latitude = math.rad(latitude)
	local declination = math.rad(23.45 * math.sin(math.rad(360 * (284 + time * 15) / 365)))
	local hourAngle = math.rad(15 * (time - 12))

	local elevation = math.asin(
		math.sin(latitude) * math.sin(declination) + math.cos(latitude) * math.cos(declination) * math.cos(hourAngle)
	)
	local azimuth = math.atan2(
		math.sin(hourAngle),
		math.cos(hourAngle) * math.sin(latitude) - math.tan(declination) * math.cos(latitude)
	)

	return Vector3.new(
		math.cos(azimuth) * math.cos(elevation),
		math.sin(elevation),
		math.sin(azimuth) * math.cos(elevation)
	)
end

local defaultGLSL = [[
// Sky
uniform vec3  u_ZenithColor;
uniform vec4  u_HorizonParams; // xyz = horizon color, w = horizon exponent

// Haze + Ground packed: xyz = haze color, w = haze strength
uniform vec4  u_HazeColorStrength;
uniform vec3  u_GroundColor;

// Sun (5 uniforms)
uniform vec4  u_SunParams; // xyz = direction, w = sharpness
uniform vec3  u_SunDiskColor;
uniform vec4  u_CoronaParams;   // xyz = corona color, w = corona power
uniform float u_CoronaStrength;
uniform vec4  u_ScatterParams;  // xyz = scatter color, w = scatter power
uniform float u_ScatterStrength;

// Stars: x = count, y = brightness, z = sharpness, w = twinkle amount
uniform vec4  u_StarParams;
// Twinkle speed separate (needed in expression)
uniform float u_StarTwinkleSpeed;

// Clouds: x = coverage, y = sharpness, z = speed, w = altitude
uniform vec4  u_CloudParams;
// Cloud colors + opacity: cloudColor rgb + opacity in alpha
uniform vec4  u_CloudColor;
uniform vec4  u_CloudShadowColor; // xyz = shadow color, w = shadow depth

// Total: 16 uniforms exactly

float hash(vec2 p) {
    p = fract(p * vec2(127.1, 311.7));
    p += dot(p, p + 19.19);
    return fract(p.x * p.y);
}

float noise(vec2 p) {
    vec2 i = floor(p);
    vec2 f = fract(p);
    vec2 u = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
    return mix(
        mix(hash(i),                  hash(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)), u.x),
        mix(hash(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)), hash(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)), u.x),
        u.y
    );
}

float fbm(vec2 p) {
    float v = 0.0;
    float a = 0.5;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        v += a * noise(p);
        p  = p * 2.1 + vec2(1.7, 9.2);
        a *= 0.5;
    }
    return v;
}

float starField(vec3 rd) {
    float phi   = atan(rd.z, rd.x);
    float theta = acos(clamp(rd.y, -1.0, 1.0));
    vec2  uv    = vec2(phi / 6.28318, theta / 3.14159);

    float scale = u_StarParams.x * 0.05;
    vec2  cell  = floor(uv * scale);
    vec2  lc    = fract(uv * scale) - 0.5;

    float rnd  = hash(cell);
    vec2  pos  = (vec2(hash(cell + 13.7), hash(cell + 7.3)) - 0.5) * 0.9;
    float dist = length(lc - pos);

    float twinkle = 1.0 - u_StarParams.w *
                    (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(TIME * u_StarTwinkleSpeed + rnd * 6.28318));

    float star = smoothstep(1.0 - u_StarParams.z, 1.0, 1.0 - dist * 2.0) * twinkle;

    float threshold = 1.0 - (u_StarParams.x / 200000.0);
    return (rnd > threshold) ? star * u_StarParams.y : 0.0;
}

float cloudDensity(vec3 rd) {
    if (rd.y < 0.001) return 0.0;

    float t  = u_CloudParams.w / max(rd.y, 0.001);
    vec2  uv = rd.xz * t;

    uv += vec2(TIME * u_CloudParams.z, TIME * u_CloudParams.z * 0.4);

    float n = fbm(uv * 2.5);
    return clamp((n - (1.0 - u_CloudParams.x)) * u_CloudParams.y, 0.0, 1.0);
}

void fragment() {
    vec3  rd     = normalize(EYEDIR);
    vec3  sunDir = normalize(u_SunParams.xyz);
    float sunDot = dot(rd, sunDir);
    float t      = max(rd.y, 0.0);

    // Sky gradient
    vec3 sky = mix(u_HorizonParams.xyz, u_ZenithColor, pow(t, u_HorizonParams.w));

    // Haze
    float haze = pow(1.0 - abs(rd.y), 5.0);
    sky += u_HazeColorStrength.rgb * haze * u_HazeColorStrength.a;

    // Sun disk
    float sunDisk = smoothstep(u_SunParams.w, u_SunParams.w + 0.0003, sunDot);
    sky = mix(sky, u_SunDiskColor, sunDisk);

    // Corona
    float corona = pow(max(sunDot, 0.0), u_CoronaParams.w);
    sky += u_CoronaParams.rgb * corona * u_CoronaStrength;

    // Scatter
    float scatter = pow(max(sunDot, 0.0), u_ScatterParams.w) * (1.0 - t);
    sky += u_ScatterParams.rgb * scatter * u_ScatterStrength;

    // Ground
    if (rd.y < 0.0) {
        float below = pow(max(-rd.y, 0.0), 0.3);
        sky = mix(sky, u_GroundColor, below);
    }

    // Stars (fade out during day and near sun)
    float nightMask = 1.0 - clamp(u_SunParams.y * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    float starVis   = max(rd.y, 0.0) * nightMask * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.95, 1.0, sunDot));
    sky += vec3(starField(rd) * starVis);

    // Clouds
    float cloudD = cloudDensity(rd) * u_CloudColor.a;
    if (cloudD > 0.0) {
        float sunLit   = clamp(dot(vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0), sunDir) * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
        vec3  cloudCol = mix(u_CloudShadowColor.rgb, u_CloudColor.rgb,
                             sunLit * u_CloudShadowColor.a + (1.0 - u_CloudShadowColor.a));
        sky = mix(sky, cloudCol, cloudD);
    }

    COLOR = sky;
}
]]

return {
	class = "Sky",
	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		if IsServer then
			return
		end
		local default_shader = Shader.fromMemorySky(defaultGLSL)
		local pastShader = nil
		local kinemiumShaderService = datamodel:GetService("KinemiumShaderService")
		local lighting = datamodel.Lighting

		local propTable = {
			CelestialBodiesShown = true,
			StarCount = 3000,
			SunAngularSize = 21,
			MoonAngularSize = 21,
			Shader = default_shader,

			-- Time of day
			ClockTime = 14.0,
			GeographicLatitude = 0.0,

			-- Sky (day presets, blended automatically by ClockTime)
			ZenithColor = Color3.new(0.08, 0.18, 0.55),
			HorizonColor = Color3.new(0.60, 0.75, 0.90),
			HorizonExponent = 0.45,
			HazeColor = Color3.new(0.25, 0.22, 0.15),
			HazeStrength = 1.0,
			GroundColor = Color3.new(0.15, 0.12, 0.10),
			SunDiskColor = Color3.new(1.5, 1.3, 0.9),
			SunDiskSharpness = 0.9994,
			CoronaColor = Color3.new(0.9, 0.7, 0.35),
			CoronaPower = 128.0,
			CoronaStrength = 0.6,
			ScatterColor = Color3.new(0.8, 0.4, 0.1),
			ScatterPower = 6.0,
			ScatterStrength = 0.5,

			-- Stars
			StarDensity = 3000.0,
			StarBrightness = 1.0,
			StarSharpness = 0.995,
			StarTwinkleSpeed = 3.0,
			StarTwinkleAmount = 0.4,

			-- Clouds
			CloudCoverage = 0.45,
			CloudSharpness = 2.5,
			CloudSpeed = 0.02,
			CloudColor = Color3.new(1.0, 0.98, 0.96),
			CloudShadowColor = Color3.new(0.55, 0.60, 0.72),
			CloudShadowDepth = 0.6,
			CloudAltitude = 0.08,
			CloudOpacity = 1.0,
		}
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		if IsServer then
			print("is server")
			return instance
		end

		local function pushUniforms(shader)
			local i = instance

			-- Compute sun direction from ClockTime
			local sunDir = calculateSunDirection(i.ClockTime, i.GeographicLatitude)
			local sunElevation = sunDir.Y -- -1 to 1, positive = above horizon

			-- Day/night blend factor: 1 = full day, 0 = full night
			-- Smooth transition around sunrise/sunset (sun elevation ~0)
			local dayFactor = math.clamp(sunElevation * 5.0 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0)

			-- Night sky presets
			local nightZenith = { 0.01, 0.01, 0.04 }
			local nightHorizon = { 0.02, 0.03, 0.08 }
			local nightHaze = { 0.02, 0.02, 0.05 }

			-- Sunrise/sunset tint (warm colors near horizon when sun is low)
			local sunsetFactor = math.clamp(1.0 - math.abs(sunElevation) * 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 0.6
			local sunsetR = sunsetFactor * 0.4
			local sunsetG = sunsetFactor * 0.15

			-- Blend zenith color
			local zR = nightZenith[1] + (i.ZenithColor.R - nightZenith[1]) * dayFactor
			local zG = nightZenith[2] + (i.ZenithColor.G - nightZenith[2]) * dayFactor
			local zB = nightZenith[3] + (i.ZenithColor.B - nightZenith[3]) * dayFactor
			shader:SetUniform("u_ZenithColor", { zR, zG, zB })

			-- Blend horizon color + add sunset tint
			local hR = nightHorizon[1] + (i.HorizonColor.R - nightHorizon[1]) * dayFactor + sunsetR
			local hG = nightHorizon[2] + (i.HorizonColor.G - nightHorizon[2]) * dayFactor + sunsetG
			local hB = nightHorizon[3] + (i.HorizonColor.B - nightHorizon[3]) * dayFactor
			shader:SetUniform("u_HorizonParams", { hR, hG, hB, i.HorizonExponent })

			-- Blend haze
			local haR = nightHaze[1] + (i.HazeColor.R - nightHaze[1]) * dayFactor + sunsetR * 0.5
			local haG = nightHaze[2] + (i.HazeColor.G - nightHaze[2]) * dayFactor + sunsetG * 0.5
			local haB = nightHaze[3] + (i.HazeColor.B - nightHaze[3]) * dayFactor
			shader:SetUniform("u_HazeColorStrength", { haR, haG, haB, i.HazeStrength })

			shader:SetUniform("u_GroundColor", i.GroundColor)

			-- Pack sun direction + sharpness
			shader:SetUniform("u_SunParams", { sunDir.X, sunDir.Y, sunDir.Z, i.SunDiskSharpness })
			shader:SetUniform("u_SunDiskColor", i.SunDiskColor)
			-- Pack corona color + power into vec4
			shader:SetUniform("u_CoronaParams", { i.CoronaColor.R, i.CoronaColor.G, i.CoronaColor.B, i.CoronaPower })
			shader:SetUniform("u_CoronaStrength", i.CoronaStrength)
			-- Pack scatter color + power into vec4
			shader:SetUniform(
				"u_ScatterParams",
				{ i.ScatterColor.R, i.ScatterColor.G, i.ScatterColor.B, i.ScatterPower }
			)
			shader:SetUniform("u_ScatterStrength", i.ScatterStrength)
			-- Pack star params: count, brightness, sharpness, twinkle amount
			shader:SetUniform("u_StarParams", { i.StarDensity, i.StarBrightness, i.StarSharpness, i.StarTwinkleAmount })
			shader:SetUniform("u_StarTwinkleSpeed", i.StarTwinkleSpeed)
			-- Pack cloud params: coverage, sharpness, speed, altitude
			shader:SetUniform("u_CloudParams", { i.CloudCoverage, i.CloudSharpness, i.CloudSpeed, i.CloudAltitude })
			-- Pack cloud color + opacity
			shader:SetUniform("u_CloudColor", { i.CloudColor.R, i.CloudColor.G, i.CloudColor.B, i.CloudOpacity })
			-- Pack cloud shadow color + shadow depth
			shader:SetUniform(
				"u_CloudShadowColor",
				{ i.CloudShadowColor.R, i.CloudShadowColor.G, i.CloudShadowColor.B, i.CloudShadowDepth }
			)
		end

		local skyInitialized = false
		local skyDirty = true

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property)
			if property == "Shader" then
				if pastShader and pastShader ~= instance.Shader then
					kinemiumShaderService.UnloadShader(pastShader)
				end
				skyInitialized = false
				pastShader = instance.Shader
			end
			skyDirty = true
		end)

		task.spawn(function()
			while task.wait(0.1) do
				if instance.Parent == lighting and instance.Shader then
					if skyDirty or not skyInitialized then
						pushUniforms(instance.Shader)
						skyDirty = false
					end
					kinemiumShaderService.LoadShader(instance.Shader)
					if not skyInitialized then
						skyInitialized = true
						pastShader = instance.Shader
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,
}

local GuiObject = require("@GuiObject")
local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local UDim2 = require("@UDim2")
local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")

local Aereon = require("@Aereon")

local propTable = {
	Name = "UISlider",
	BaseClass = "GuiObject",
	AbsoluteSize = nil,
	AbsolutePosition = nil,
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 28),
	Value = 0.5,
	Min = 0,
	Max = 1,
	TrackColor3 = Color3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15),
	FillColor3 = Color3.new(0.02, 0.5, 1),
	HandleColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),

	Visible = true,

local function renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer, pos, size)
	for _, child in pairs(object:GetChildren()) do
		if child.render then
			lib.BeginScissorMode(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y)
			child.render(lib, child, dt, structs, renderer)
			lib.EndScissorMode()
		end
	end
end

GuiObject.inherit(propTable)

return {
	class = "UISlider",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		local onValueChanged = signal.new()
		local slider = gui.slider({
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			width = 200,
			height = 28,
			value = instance.Value,
			min = instance.Min,
			max = instance.Max,
			onChanged = function(value)
				instance.Value = value
				onValueChanged:Fire(value)
			end,
		})

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance.OnValueChanged = onValueChanged
		instance._slider = slider

		instance.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if object.Visible == false then
				return
			end

			local pos, size = GuiObject.calculatePositions(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			local minValue = tonumber(object.Min) or 0
			local maxValue = tonumber(object.Max) or 1
			if maxValue < minValue then
				minValue, maxValue = maxValue, minValue
			end
			local value = math.clamp(tonumber(object.Value) or minValue, minValue, maxValue)
			if object.Value ~= value then
				object.Value = value
			end

			slider.set("obj_rect", arect.new(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y))
			slider.set("min", minValue)
			slider.set("max", maxValue)
			slider.set("value", value)
			slider.set("trackColor", object.TrackColor3)
			slider.set("fillColor", object.FillColor3)
			slider.set("handleColor", object.HandleColor3)

			slider.render(dt)
			renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer, pos, size)

			return pos, size
		end

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		GuiObject.inherit(tble)
	end,
}

local Signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local zembed = require("@zembed")
local task = zune.task

local propTable = {
	SoundId = "./src/assets/sounds/bqqchickenalert.mp3",
	Volume = 1.0,
	Pitch = 1.0,
	Looped = false,
	Playing = false,
	TimePosition = 0,
	PlayOnRemove = false,
	IsLoaded = false,
	Name = "Sound",
	AudioBackend = Enum.AudioBackend.RAUDIO,

	IsStream = false,
	SoundGroup = nil,
	_effectiveVolume = 1.0,
	_fadeVolume = 1.0,

	Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	Direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
	Up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
	MinDistance = 10.0,
	MaxDistance = 1000.0,
	RollOffMode = 0, -- 0 = Linear, 1 = Inverse, 2 = InverseTapered
	Is3D = false,
}

return {
	class = "Sound",
	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		raylib.lib.InitAudioDevice()

		local function updateVolume()
			if not instance.IsLoaded then
				return
			end
			local groupVol = instance.SoundGroup and instance.SoundGroup.Volume or 1.0
			instance._effectiveVolume = instance.Volume * groupVol * instance._fadeVolume
			if instance.IsStream then
				raylib.lib.SetMusicVolume(instance._raylibSound, instance._effectiveVolume)
			else
				raylib.lib.SetSoundVolume(instance._raylibSound, instance._effectiveVolume)
			end
		end

		local function updatePitch()
			if not instance.IsLoaded then
				return
			end
			if instance.IsStream then
				raylib.lib.SetMusicPitch(instance._raylibSound, instance.Pitch)
			else
				raylib.lib.SetSoundPitch(instance._raylibSound, instance.Pitch)
			end
		end

		local function loadAudio()
			if instance._raylibSound then
				if instance.IsStream then
					raylib.lib.UnloadMusicStream(instance._raylibSound)
				else
					raylib.lib.UnloadSound(instance._raylibSound)
				end
				instance._raylibSound = nil
			end

			if instance.SoundId == "" then
				instance.IsLoaded = false
				return
			end

			local soundPath = instance.SoundId
			if instance.IsStream then
				instance._raylibSound = raylib.lib.LoadMusicStream(soundPath)
				-- MusicStreams are pointer/objects, but in FFI they return valid if loaded
				instance.IsLoaded = instance._raylibSound ~= nil
			else
				instance._raylibSound = raylib.lib.LoadSound(soundPath)
				instance.IsLoaded = instance._raylibSound ~= nil
			end

			if instance.IsLoaded then
				updateVolume()
				updatePitch()
			else
				warn("Failed to load sound/stream: " .. instance.SoundId)
			end
		end

		loadAudio()

		local function fadeTo(targetFade, duration)
			if duration and duration > 0 then
				local startFade = instance._fadeVolume
				local startTime = os.clock()
				task.spawn(function()
					while true do
						local elapsed = os.clock() - startTime
						if elapsed >= duration then
							instance._fadeVolume = targetFade
							updateVolume()
							break
						end
						instance._fadeVolume = startFade + (targetFade - startFade) * (elapsed / duration)
						updateVolume()
						task.wait()
					end
				end)
			else
				instance._fadeVolume = targetFade
				updateVolume()
			end
		end

		-- description: "Plays the audio with an optional fade duration."
		-- args: "self: table, fadeDuration: number"
		instance.Play = function(self, fadeDuration)
			if self.IsLoaded and not self.Playing then
				fadeTo(1.0, fadeDuration)
				if self.IsStream then
					raylib.lib.PlayMusicStream(self._raylibSound)
				else
					raylib.lib.PlaySound(self._raylibSound)
				end
				self.Playing = true
				if self.Played then
					self.Played:Fire()
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Stops the audio with an optional fade duration."
		-- args: "self: table, fadeDuration: number"
		instance.Stop = function(self, fadeDuration)
			if self.IsLoaded then
				if fadeDuration and fadeDuration > 0 then
					fadeTo(0.0, fadeDuration)
					task.delay(fadeDuration, function()
						if self.Playing then
							if self.IsStream then
								raylib.lib.StopMusicStream(self._raylibSound)
							else
								raylib.lib.StopSound(self._raylibSound)
							end
							self.Playing = false
							self.TimePosition = 0
						end
					end)
				else
					if self.IsStream then
						raylib.lib.StopMusicStream(self._raylibSound)
					else
						raylib.lib.StopSound(self._raylibSound)
					end
					self.Playing = false
					self.TimePosition = 0
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Pauses the audio with an optional fade duration."
		-- args: "self: table, fadeDuration: number"
		instance.Pause = function(self, fadeDuration)
			if self.IsLoaded then
				if fadeDuration and fadeDuration > 0 then
					fadeTo(0.0, fadeDuration)
					task.delay(fadeDuration, function()
						if self.IsStream then
							raylib.lib.PauseMusicStream(self._raylibSound)
						else
							raylib.lib.PauseSound(self._raylibSound)
						end
						self.Playing = false
					end)
				else
					if self.IsStream then
						raylib.lib.PauseMusicStream(self._raylibSound)
					else
						raylib.lib.PauseSound(self._raylibSound)
					end
					self.Playing = false
				end
			end
		end

		-- description: "Resumes the audio."
		-- args: "self: table, fadeDuration: number"
		instance.Resume = function(self, fadeDuration)
			if self.IsLoaded then
				if self.IsStream then
					raylib.lib.ResumeMusicStream(self._raylibSound)
				else
					raylib.lib.ResumeSound(self._raylibSound)
				end
				self.Playing = true
				fadeTo(1.0, fadeDuration)
			end
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if prop == "Volume" or prop == "SoundGroup" then
				updateVolume()
			elseif prop == "Pitch" then
				updatePitch()
			elseif prop == "SoundId" or prop == "IsStream" then
				loadAudio()
			end
		end)

		instance.Played = Signal.new()
		instance.Ended = Signal.new()

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local b = require("@Color3")
local c = require("@EnumMap")

local d = require("@r3d")
local e = d.lib

local f = {
	Angle = 90,
	Face = c.NormalId.Front,
	Color = b.new(1, 1, 1),
	Brightness = 15,
	Range = 12,
	CastShadow = false,
	Enabled = true,
	Transparency = 0,
	Position = a.new(0, 0, 0),
	DebugShape = false,
	Name = "SpotLight",
	BaseClass = "Kinemium.light",

return {
	class = "SpotLight",
	callback = function(g, h, i)
		g:SetProperties(f)

		if _G.IsHeadless or not h then
			return g
		end

		local j = e.R3D_CreateLight(1)
		e.R3D_SetLightPosition(j, vector.create(g.Position.X, g.Position.Y, g.Position.Z))
		e.R3D_SetLightColor(j, g.Color:ToRaylib(g.Transparency))
		e.R3D_SetLightEnergy(j, g.Brightness)
		e.R3D_SetLightOuterCutOff(j, g.Angle)
		e.R3D_SetLightRange(j, g.Range)
		e.R3D_SetLightActive(j, false)
		g:SetMetadata("LightObject", j)

		if g.CastShadow == true then
			e.R3D_EnableShadow(j)
		end

		g.Destroying:Connect(function()
			e.R3D_DestroyLight(j)
		end)

		g.Changed:Connect(function()
			if g.Enabled == true then
				e.R3D_SetLightActive(j, true)
			end

			if g.CastShadow == true then
				e.R3D_EnableShadow(j)
			else
				e.R3D_DisableShadow(j)
			end

			e.R3D_SetLightPosition(j, vector.create(g.Position.X, g.Position.Y, g.Position.Z))
			e.R3D_SetLightColor(j, g.Color:ToRaylib(g.Transparency))
			e.R3D_SetLightEnergy(j, g.Brightness)
			e.R3D_SetLightOuterCutOff(j, g.Angle)
			e.R3D_SetLightRange(j, g.Range)
		end)

		h.Pool.new("gizmo", function()
			if g.DebugShape == true then
				e.R3D_DrawLightShape(j)
			end
		end)

		h.Hook.new("Renderstep", function()
			if g.Parent and g.Parent.CFrame then
				local newPos = g.Parent.CFrame.Position
				local dx, dy, dz = newPos.X - g.Position.X, newPos.Y - g.Position.Y, newPos.Z - g.Position.Z
				if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz > 0.0001 then
					g.Position = newPos
				end
				local k = g.Parent.CFrame:GetLookVector()
				if g.Face == c.NormalId.Top then
					k = g.Parent.CFrame:GetUpVector()
				elseif g.Face == c.NormalId.Bottom then
					k = -g.Parent.CFrame:GetUpVector()
				elseif g.Face == c.NormalId.Right then
					k = g.Parent.CFrame:GetRightVector()
				elseif g.Face == c.NormalId.Left then
					k = -g.Parent.CFrame:GetRightVector()
				elseif g.Face == c.NormalId.Back then
					k = -g.Parent.CFrame:GetLookVector()
				end
				e.R3D_SetLightDirection(j, vector.create(k.X, k.Y, k.Z))
			end
		end)

		return g
	end,

	inherit = function(g)
		for h, i in pairs(f) do
			g[h] = i
		end
	end,

	Enabled = true,
	Visible = true,
	Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0),
