return {
	class = "SpringConstraint",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		local KinemiumPhysicsService = datamodel:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local _activeConstraint = nil

		local function cleanup()
			if _activeConstraint then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.lib.JPH_PhysicsSystem_RemoveConstraint(
					KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.physicsSystem,
					_activeConstraint
				)
				_activeConstraint = nil
			end
		end

		local function rebuild()
			cleanup()

			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end
			if not instance.Attachment0 or not instance.Attachment1 then
				return
			end

			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			local part0 = att0.Parent
			local part1 = att1.Parent

			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return
			end

			if not NetworkOwnership.ShouldSimulateConstraintForMachine(instance, datamodel) then
				return
			end

			local bodyID0 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part0)
			local bodyID1 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part1)

			if not bodyID0 or not bodyID1 then
				task.defer(rebuild)
				return
			end

			local wPos0 = part0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wPos1 = part1.CFrame * att1.Position

			local minL = instance.LimitsEnabled and instance.MinLength or 0
			local maxL = instance.LimitsEnabled and instance.MaxLength or 100000

			local freqOrStiff = instance.SpringMode == 0 and instance.Frequency or instance.Stiffness

			_activeConstraint = KinemiumPhysicsService.CreateSpring(
				part0,
				part1,
				wPos0,
				wPos1,
				minL,
				maxL,
				instance.SpringMode,
				freqOrStiff,
				instance.Damping
			)

			if _activeConstraint then
				print("[SpringConstraint] Constraint created successfully")
			else
				warn("[SpringConstraint] CreateSpring returned nil - bodies may not be registered yet")
				task.defer(rebuild)
			end
		end

		function instance:UpdateSpringSettings()
			if not _activeConstraint then
				return
			end
			local freqOrStiff = instance.SpringMode == 0 and instance.Frequency or instance.Stiffness
			KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSpringSettings(
				_activeConstraint,
				instance.SpringMode,
				freqOrStiff,
				instance.Damping
			)

			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			if att0 and att0.Parent then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ActivatePart(att0.Parent)
			end
			if att1 and att1.Parent then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.ActivatePart(att1.Parent)
			end
		end

		-- description: "Updates spring limits."
		function instance:UpdateLimits()
			if not _activeConstraint then
				return
			end
			local minL = instance.LimitsEnabled and instance.MinLength or 0
			local maxL = instance.LimitsEnabled and instance.MaxLength or 100000
			KinemiumPhysicsService.SetSpringLimits(_activeConstraint, minL, maxL)
		end

		local function drawGizmo()
			if not instance.Visible then
				return
			end
			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			if not att0 or not att1 then
				return
			end

			local p0 = att0.Parent
			local p1 = att1.Parent
			if not p0 or not p1 then
				return
			end

			local wPos0 = p0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wPos1 = p1.CFrame * att1.Position

			local color = instance.Color
			local rlColor =
				raylib.structs.Color:new({ r = color.R * 255, g = color.G * 255, b = color.B * 255, a = 255 })

			local diff = wPos1 - wPos0
			local length = diff:Magnitude()
			if length < 0.001 then
				return
			end

			local dir = diff:Unit()

			local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local dirDotUp = dir.X * up.X + dir.Y * up.Y + dir.Z * up.Z
			if math.abs(dirDotUp) > 0.99 then
				up = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			end

			local perp1 =
				Vector3.new(dir.Y * up.Z - dir.Z * up.Y, dir.Z * up.X - dir.X * up.Z, dir.X * up.Y - dir.Y * up.X)
					:Unit()

			local perp2 = Vector3.new(
				dir.Y * perp1.Z - dir.Z * perp1.Y,
				dir.Z * perp1.X - dir.X * perp1.Z,
				dir.X * perp1.Y - dir.Y * perp1.X
			):Unit()

			local radius = instance.Radius
			local coils = instance.Coils -- Adjust number of coils based on length
			local segmentsPerCoil = instance.SegmentsPerCoil
			local totalSegments = coils * segmentsPerCoil

			local prevPos = wPos0
			for i = 1, totalSegments do
				local t = i / totalSegments

				local currentRadius = radius
				local easeMargin = 0.05
				if t < easeMargin then
					currentRadius = radius * (math.sin((t / easeMargin) * (math.pi / 2)))
				elseif t > 1 - easeMargin then
					currentRadius = radius * (math.sin(((1 - t) / easeMargin) * (math.pi / 2)))
				end

				local angle = t * coils * math.pi * 2
				local baseCenter = wPos0 + dir * (length * t)
				local offset = perp1 * (math.cos(angle) * currentRadius) + perp2 * (math.sin(angle) * currentRadius)

				local currentPos = baseCenter + offset

				rl.DrawLineEx(
					vector.create(prevPos.X, prevPos.Y, prevPos.Z),
					vector.create(currentPos.X, currentPos.Y, currentPos.Z),
					instance.Thickness,
					rlColor
				)

				prevPos = currentPos
			end
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if prop == "Attachment0" or prop == "Attachment1" or prop == "Enabled" then
				rebuild()

		-- args: "name: string, value: number, isFloat: boolean"

			if instance._r3dshader then
				local valBuffer
				if type(value) == "number" then
					valBuffer = buffer.create(4)

							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 8, value.Z)

							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 4, value.Position.Y)

							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 4, value.G)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 8, value.B)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 12, value.A)
						elseif value.__type == "Vector2" then
							valBuffer = buffer.create(8)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 0, value.X)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 4, value.Y)
						elseif value.__type == "UDim2" then
							valBuffer = buffer.create(16)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 0, value.X.Scale)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 4, value.X.Offset)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 8, value.Y.Scale)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 12, value.Y.Offset)
						elseif value.__type == "UDim" then
							valBuffer = buffer.create(8)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 0, value.Scale)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 4, value.Offset)
						end

						if valueCount == 4 then
							valBuffer = buffer.create(16)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 0, value[1])
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 4, value[2])

							valBuffer = buffer.create(8)
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 0, value[1])
							buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 4, value[2])

					end

					valBuffer = buffer.create(12)
					buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 0, value.x)
					buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 4, value.y)
					buffer.writef32(valBuffer, 8, value.z)
				elseif type(value) == "boolean" then
					valBuffer = buffer.create(4)
					buffer.writei32(valBuffer, 0, value and 1 or 0)
				end

			end
		end

		-- description: "Adds to pipeline."
		function instance:AddToPipeline()
			if not instance._r3dshader then
				return
			end

			local buf = buffer.create(8)
			local ptrArray = ffi.dupe(buf)
			ptrArray:writeptr(0, instance._r3dshader)

			rlib.R3D_SetScreenShaderChain(ptrArray, 1)
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property, value)
			if property == "_r3dshader" then
				return
			end
			if property == "Shader" then
				if type(value) == "table" and value.__type then
					if value._vertex and value._fragment then
						instance._r3dshader = rlib.R3D_LoadScreenShaderFromMemory(value._fragment)

local function getAdornee(instance)

		return instance.Adornee
	end
	return instance.Parent

local function getFaceSize(size, face)
	if face == Enum.NormalId.Front or face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		return size.X, size.Y
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Left or face == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		return size.Z, size.Y
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Top or face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
		return size.X, size.Z
	end
	return 1, 1
end

local function getFaceCorners(cf, size, face)
	local hX = size.X * 0.5
	local hY = size.Y * 0.5
	local hZ = size.Z * 0.5
	local pad = 0.005

	if face == Enum.NormalId.Front then
		return cf * Vector3.new(-hX, hY, -hZ - pad),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX, hY, -hZ - pad),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX, -hY, -hZ - pad),
			cf * Vector3.new(-hX, -hY, -hZ - pad)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		return cf * Vector3.new(hX, hY, hZ + pad),
			cf * Vector3.new(-hX, hY, hZ + pad),
			cf * Vector3.new(-hX, -hY, hZ + pad),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX, -hY, hZ + pad)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Left then
		return cf * Vector3.new(-hX - pad, hY, hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(-hX - pad, hY, -hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(-hX - pad, -hY, -hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(-hX - pad, -hY, hZ)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		return cf * Vector3.new(hX + pad, hY, -hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX + pad, hY, hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX + pad, -hY, hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX + pad, -hY, -hZ)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Top then
		return cf * Vector3.new(-hX, hY + pad, -hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX, hY + pad, -hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX, hY + pad, hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(-hX, hY + pad, hZ)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
		return cf * Vector3.new(-hX, -hY - pad, hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX, -hY - pad, hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(hX, -hY - pad, -hZ),
			cf * Vector3.new(-hX, -hY - pad, -hZ)
	end
	return Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
end

local function resolveTextureSource(instance)
	if type(instance.Texture) == "table" and instance.Texture.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
		return instance.Texture
	end
	if type(instance.Texture) == "string" and instance.Texture ~= "" then
		return instance.Texture
	end
	return nil
end

local function loadTextureFromPath(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		return nil
	end
	path = zembed.AssetPath(path)

	local ok, data = pcall(zune.fs.readFileSync, path, true)
	if not ok or not data then
		return nil
	end

	local ext = lib.GetFileExtension(path)
	local okLoad, tex = pcall(lib.LoadTextureFromMemory, ext, data, buffer.len(data))
	if okLoad then
		return tex
	end

	return nil
end

local function loadTextureFromEditable(editableImage)
	if not editableImage or not editableImage._image then
		return nil
	end

	if editableImage._dirty then
		if editableImage._texture then
			lib.UnloadTexture(editableImage._texture)
		end
		editableImage._texture = lib.LoadTextureFromImage(editableImage._image)
		editableImage._dirty = false
	end

	return editableImage._texture
end

		local function resetRenderTexture(width, height)
			local w = math.max(1, math.floor(width or 1))
			local h = math.max(1, math.floor(height or 1))
			if rtx then
				lib.UnloadRenderTexture(rtx)
			end
			rtx = lib.LoadRenderTexture(w, h)
			rtxW = w
			rtxH = h
			local tex = zune.mem.slice(rtx, structs.RenderTexture:offset("texture"), structs.Texture:size())
			lib.SetTextureFilter(tex, const.TextureFilter.TEXTURE_FILTER_TRILINEAR)
			lib.SetTextureWrap(tex, const.TextureWrap.TEXTURE_WRAP_CLAMP)
		end

		local function getCanvasSize()
			local w, h = 800, 600

				w = math.max(1, math.floor(instance.CanvasSize.X or 800))
				h = math.max(1, math.floor(instance.CanvasSize.Y or 600))
			elseif instance.SizingMode == Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud then
				local adornee = getAdornee(instance)
				if adornee and adornee.Size then
					local fw, fh = getFaceSize(adornee.Size, instance.Face)
					w = math.max(1, math.floor(fw * (instance.PixelsPerStud or 50)))
					h = math.max(1, math.floor(fh * (instance.PixelsPerStud or 50)))
				end
			end
			return w, h
		end

		local function syncTexture(force)
			if _G.IsHeadless then
				return
			end

			local source = resolveTextureSource(instance)
			local hasChildren = false
			for _, child in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				if child.render then
					hasChildren = true
					break
				end
			end

			if not force and source == lastTextureSource and not hasChildren then
				if type(source) == "table" and source.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
					if source._dirty or source._texture ~= lastTextureSource then
						-- continue to rebuild
					else
						return
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end

			lastTextureSource = source

			if hasChildren then
				if staticTexture then
					lib.UnloadTexture(staticTexture)
					staticTexture = nil
				end
				local w, h = getCanvasSize()
				if rtxW ~= w or rtxH ~= h then
					resetRenderTexture(w, h)
				end
			elseif source then
				if staticTexture then
					lib.UnloadTexture(staticTexture)
					staticTexture = nil
				end
				if type(source) == "table" and source.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
					staticTexture = loadTextureFromEditable(source)
				elseif type(source) == "string" then
					staticTexture = loadTextureFromPath(source)
				end
			else
				if staticTexture then
					lib.UnloadTexture(staticTexture)
					staticTexture = nil
				end
				local w, h = getCanvasSize()
				if rtxW ~= w or rtxH ~= h then
					resetRenderTexture(w, h)
				end
			end
		end

		resetRenderTexture(getCanvasSize())

		render2dId = renderer.Pool.new("2d", function()
			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end

			local w, h = getCanvasSize()
			if w <= 0 or h <= 0 then
				return
			end

			if rtxW ~= w or rtxH ~= h then
				resetRenderTexture(w, h)
			end

			lib.BeginTextureMode(rtx)
			lib.ClearBackground(const.BLANK)

			for _, child in pairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				if child.render then
					child.render(lib, child, lib.GetFrameTime(), structs, renderer, datamodel)
				end
			end

			lib.EndTextureMode()
		end)

		render3dId = renderer.Pool.new("3d", function()
			syncTexture(false)

			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end

			local adornee = getAdornee(instance)
			if not adornee or not adornee.CFrame or not adornee.Size then
				return
			end

			local texId = nil
			if staticTexture then
				texId = staticTexture.id
			elseif rtx then
				local tex = zune.mem.slice(rtx, structs.RenderTexture:offset("texture"), structs.Texture:size())
				local texW = buffer.readi32(tex, 4)
				local texH = buffer.readi32(tex, 8)
				if texW <= 0 or texH <= 0 then
					return
				end
				texId = buffer.readu32(tex, 0)
			else
				return
			end

			if not texId then
				return
			end

			local tl, tr, br, bl = getFaceCorners(adornee.CFrame, adornee.Size, instance.Face)

			if instance.AlwaysOnTop then
				lib.rlDisableDepthTest()
			end

			lib.rlSetTexture(texId)
			lib.rlBegin(7) -- GL_QUADS
			lib.rlColor4ub(255, 255, 255, 255)

			lib.rlTexCoord2f(0, 1)
			lib.rlVertex3f(tl.X, tl.Y, tl.Z)
			lib.rlTexCoord2f(1, 1)
			lib.rlVertex3f(tr.X, tr.Y, tr.Z)
			lib.rlTexCoord2f(1, 0)
			lib.rlVertex3f(br.X, br.Y, br.Z)
			lib.rlTexCoord2f(0, 0)
			lib.rlVertex3f(bl.X, bl.Y, bl.Z)

			lib.rlEnd()
			lib.rlSetTexture(0)

			if instance.AlwaysOnTop then
				lib.rlEnableDepthTest()
			end
		end)

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if prop == "Texture" then
				syncTexture(true)
			elseif
				prop == "Adornee"
				or prop == "Face"
				or prop == "CanvasSize"
				or prop == "PixelsPerStud"
				or prop == "SizingMode"
			then
				local w, h = getCanvasSize()
				if rtxW ~= w or rtxH ~= h then
					resetRenderTexture(w, h)
				end
				instance.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
			end
		end)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if render2dId then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(render2dId)
			end
			if render3dId then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(render3dId)
			end
			if rtx then
				lib.UnloadRenderTexture(rtx)
				rtx = nil
			end
			if staticTexture then
				lib.UnloadTexture(staticTexture)
				staticTexture = nil
			end
		end)

		-- description: "Gets the relative mouse position in the SurfaceGui."
		instance.GetRelativeMousePosition = function()
			local adornee = getAdornee(instance)
			if not adornee or not adornee.CFrame or not adornee.Size then
				return nil
			end

			local camera = datamodel and datamodel.Workspace and datamodel.Workspace.Camera
			if not camera or not camera._raylibcam then
				return nil
			end

			local rayInfo = raycast:GetMouseRay(camera._raylibcam)
			local ray = rayInfo.ray

			local tl, tr, _, bl = getFaceCorners(adornee.CFrame, adornee.Size, instance.Face)

			local normal = (tr - tl):Cross(bl - tl):Unit()
			local collision = lib.GetRayCollisionPlane(ray, tl, normal)

			if collision.hit == 1 then
				local p = Vector3.new(collision.point.x, collision.point.y, collision.point.z)
				local v = p - tl
				local xDir = (tr - tl)
				local yDir = (bl - tl)
				local xSize = xDir:Magnitude()
				local ySize = yDir:Magnitude()

				if xSize > 0 and ySize > 0 then
					local x = v:Dot(xDir:Unit()) / xSize
					local y = v:Dot(yDir:Unit()) / ySize

					if x >= 0 and x <= 1 and y >= 0 and y <= 1 then
						return Vector2.new(x * instance.CanvasSize.X, y * instance.CanvasSize.Y)
					end
				end
			end
			return nil
		end

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local a = require("@Vector3")
local b = require("@Color3")
local c = require("@EnumMap")

local d = require("@r3d")
local e = d.lib

local f = {
	Angle = 90,
	Face = c.NormalId.Front,
	Color = b.new(1, 1, 1),
	Brightness = 15,
	Range = 12,
	CastShadow = false,
	Enabled = true,
	Transparency = 0,
	Position = a.new(0, 0, 0),
	DebugShape = false,
	Name = "SurfaceLight",
	BaseClass = "Kinemium.light",

return {
	class = "SurfaceLight",

	callback = function(g, h, i)
		g:SetProperties(f)

		if _G.IsHeadless or not h then
			return g
		end

		local j = e.R3D_CreateLight(1)
		e.R3D_SetLightPosition(j, vector.create(g.Position.X, g.Position.Y, g.Position.Z))
		e.R3D_SetLightColor(j, g.Color:ToRaylib(g.Transparency))
		e.R3D_SetLightEnergy(j, g.Brightness)
		e.R3D_SetLightOuterCutOff(j, g.Angle)
		e.R3D_SetLightRange(j, g.Range)
		e.R3D_SetLightActive(j, false)
		g:SetMetadata("LightObject", j)

		if g.CastShadow == true then
			e.R3D_EnableShadow(j)
		end

		g.Destroying:Connect(function()
			e.R3D_DestroyLight(j)
		end)

		g.Changed:Connect(function()
			if g.Enabled == true then
				e.R3D_SetLightActive(j, true)
			end

			if g.CastShadow == true then
				e.R3D_EnableShadow(j)
			else
				e.R3D_DisableShadow(j)
			end

			e.R3D_SetLightPosition(j, vector.create(g.Position.X, g.Position.Y, g.Position.Z))
			e.R3D_SetLightColor(j, g.Color:ToRaylib(g.Transparency))
			e.R3D_SetLightEnergy(j, g.Brightness)
			e.R3D_SetLightOuterCutOff(j, g.Angle)
			e.R3D_SetLightRange(j, g.Range)
		end)

		h.Pool.new("gizmo", function()
			if g.DebugShape == true then
				e.R3D_DrawLightShape(j)
			end
		end)

		h.Hook.new("Renderstep", function()
			if g.Parent and g.Parent.CFrame then
				local newPos = g.Parent.CFrame.Position
				local dx, dy, dz = newPos.X - g.Position.X, newPos.Y - g.Position.Y, newPos.Z - g.Position.Z
				if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz > 0.0001 then
					g.Position = newPos
				end
				local k = g.Parent.CFrame:GetLookVector()
				if g.Face == c.NormalId.Top then
					k = g.Parent.CFrame:GetUpVector()
				elseif g.Face == c.NormalId.Bottom then
					k = -g.Parent.CFrame:GetUpVector()
				elseif g.Face == c.NormalId.Right then
					k = g.Parent.CFrame:GetRightVector()
				elseif g.Face == c.NormalId.Left then
					k = -g.Parent.CFrame:GetRightVector()
				elseif g.Face == c.NormalId.Back then
					k = -g.Parent.CFrame:GetLookVector()
				end
				e.R3D_SetLightDirection(j, vector.create(k.X, k.Y, k.Z))
			end
		end)

		return g
	end,

	inherit = function(g)
		for h, i in pairs(f) do
			g[h] = i
		end
	end,
}

local function sanitizeTabs(tabs)
	local sanitized = {}
	for _, tab in ipairs(type(tabs) == "table" and tabs or {}) do
		sanitized[#sanitized + 1] = tostring(tab)
	end

	if #sanitized == 0 then
		sanitized[1] = "Tab 1"
	end

	return sanitized
end

GuiObject.inherit(propTable)

local raylib = require("@raylib")
local lib = raylib.lib
local defaultFont = lib.GetFontDefault()

return {
	class = "UITabs",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		local function resolveFont(fontEnum)
			local name = fontEnum.Value
			local resolvedFont = renderer.Font.Get(name) or defaultFont
			return resolvedFont
		end

		local onTabChanged = signal.new()
		local tabs = gui.tabs({
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			width = 240,
			height = 40,
			tabs = sanitizeTabs(instance.Tabs),
			activeIndex = instance.ActiveIndex,
			onTabChange = function(index, tab)
				instance.ActiveIndex = index
				instance.ActiveTab = tab
				onTabChanged:Fire(index, tab)
			end,
		})

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance.OnTabChanged = onTabChanged
		instance._tabs = tabs

		instance.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if object.Visible == false then
				return
			end

			local pos, size = GuiObject.calculatePositions(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			local tabNames = sanitizeTabs(object.Tabs)
			local activeIndex = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(object.ActiveIndex) or 1), 1, #tabNames)
			local activeTab = tabNames[activeIndex]
			if object.ActiveIndex ~= activeIndex then
				object.ActiveIndex = activeIndex
			end
			if object.ActiveTab ~= activeTab then
				object.ActiveTab = activeTab
			end

			tabs.set("obj_rect", arect.new(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y))
			tabs.set("tabs", tabNames)
			tabs.set("activeIndex", activeIndex)
			tabs.set("backgroundColor", object.BackgroundColor3)
			tabs.set("activeColor", object.ActiveColor3)
			tabs.set("textColor", object.TextColor3)
			tabs.set("fontSize", object.TextSize)
			tabs.set("font", resolveFont(object.Font))
			tabs.set("backgroundTransparency", object.BackgroundTransparency)

		end

  Code: -- description: "A 3D textured surface that can be applied to meshes or other 3D objects."
local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local CFrame = require("@CFrame")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local r3d = require("@r3d")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local zembed = require("@zembed")

local rlib = r3d.lib
local r3dstructs = r3d.structs
local ffi = zune.ffi
local lib = raylib.lib
local const = raylib.const
local structs = raylib.structs

local propTable = {
	Transparency = 0,
	Color3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	Texture = "./src/assets/images/placeholder.png",
	Face = Enum.NormalId.Top,
	StudsPerTileU = 1,
	StudsPerTileV = 1,
	OffsetStudsU = 0,
	OffsetStudsV = 0,
	Adornee = nil,
	Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	Wrap = false,
	Depth = 0.1,
	NormalThreshold = 0,
	FadeWidth = 0,
}

local function getFaceSize(size, face)
	if face == Enum.NormalId.Front or face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		return size.X, size.Y
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Left or face == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		return size.Z, size.Y
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Top or face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
		return size.X, size.Z
	end
end

local function getFaceCFrame(cf, size, face)
	local half = size * 0.5
	local padding = 0.005 -- offset to prevent Z-fighting

	if face == Enum.NormalId.Front then
		return cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -half.Z - padding) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(180), 0)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Back then
		return cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, half.Z + padding) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(180), 0)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Left then
		return cf * CFrame.new(-half.X - padding, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-90), math.rad(90))
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Right then
		return cf * CFrame.new(half.X + padding, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(-90), math.rad(90))
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Top then
		return cf * CFrame.new(0, half.Y + padding, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(180), 0, 0)
	elseif face == Enum.NormalId.Bottom then
		return cf * CFrame.new(0, -half.Y - padding, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-180), 0, 0)
	end
end

local function buildBaseDecal()
	local decal = r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:new({})

	local albedo = r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:new({
		color = const.WHITE,
	})
	buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("albedo"), albedo, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size())

	local emission = r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:new({
		color = const.WHITE,
		energy = 0.0,
	})
	buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("emission"), emission, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_EmissionMap:size())

	local normal = r3dstructs.R3D_NormalMap:new({
		scale = 1.0,
	})
	buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("normal"), normal, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_NormalMap:size())

	local orm = r3dstructs.R3D_OrmMap:new({
		occlusion = 1.0,
		roughness = 1.0,
		metalness = 0.0,
	})
	buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("orm"), orm, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_OrmMap:size())

	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("uvScale"), 1.0)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("uvScale") + 4, 1.0)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("alphaCutoff"), 0.01)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("normalThreshold"), 0.0)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("fadeWidth"), 0.0)
	buffer.writeu8(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("applyColor"), 1)

	return decal
end

local function loadAlbedoMap(path, color)
	if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then
		return nil
	end
	path = zembed.AssetPath(path)

	local ok, data = pcall(zune.fs.readFileSync, path, true)
	if not ok or not data then
		return nil
	end

	local ext = lib.GetFileExtension(path)
	local okLoad, map = pcall(rlib.R3D_LoadAlbedoMapFromMemory, ext, data, buffer.len(data), color)
	if okLoad then
		return map
	end

	return nil
end

local function loadAlbedoMapFromEditable(editableImage, color)
	if not editableImage or not editableImage._image then
		return nil
	end

	local sizePtr = ffi.create(ffi.types.i32)
	local memPtr = lib.ExportImageToMemory(editableImage._image, ".png", sizePtr)
	if memPtr == ffi.null then
		return nil
	end

	local size = sizePtr:readi32(0)
	if not size or size <= 0 then
		lib.MemFree(memPtr)
		return nil
	end

	local data = buffer.create(size)
	for i = 0, size - 1 do
		buffer.writeu8(data, i, memPtr:readu8(i))
	end
	lib.MemFree(memPtr)

	local okLoad, map = pcall(rlib.R3D_LoadAlbedoMapFromMemory, ".png", data, size, color)
	if okLoad then
		return map
	end
	return nil
end

local function applyAlbedoColor(decal, color, transparency)
	local albedoColor = color:ToRaylib(transparency or 0)
	local offset = r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("albedo") + r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:offset("color")
	buffer.copy(decal, offset, albedoColor, 0, structs.Color:size())
end

local function applyDecalSettings(instance, decal)
	local normalThreshold = math.max(0, instance.NormalThreshold or 0)
	local fadeWidth = math.max(0, instance.FadeWidth or 0)

	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("normalThreshold"), normalThreshold)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("fadeWidth"), fadeWidth)
end

local function applyFaceOffset(cf, offset)
	if type(offset) ~= "table" or not offset.__type then
		return cf
	end

	if offset.__type == "Vector3" then
		return cf * CFrame.new(offset.X, offset.Y, offset.Z)
	elseif offset.__type == "Vector2" then
		return cf * CFrame.new(offset.X, offset.Y, 0)
	end

	return cf
end

local function applyUvSettings(instance, decal, width, height)
	local studsU = tonumber(instance.StudsPerTileU) or 1
	local studsV = tonumber(instance.StudsPerTileV) or 1

	if studsU == 0 then
		studsU = 1
	end
	if studsV == 0 then
		studsV = 1
	end

	local tilesU = width / studsU
	local tilesV = height / studsV

	local offsetU = (instance.OffsetStudsU or 0) / studsU
	local offsetV = (instance.OffsetStudsV or 0) / studsV

	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("uvScale"), tilesU)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("uvScale") + 4, tilesV)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("uvOffset"), offsetU)
	buffer.writef32(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("uvOffset") + 4, offsetV)
end

return {
	class = "Texture",

	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local decal = buildBaseDecal()
		instance._r3dDecal = decal
		instance._decalHasMaps = false
		instance._decalLastPath = nil

		local function syncAlbedo(force)
			if _G.IsHeadless then
				return
			end
			local color = instance.Color3:ToRaylib(instance.Transparency or 0)
			local source = instance.Texture

			if not force and source == instance._decalLastPath then
				if type(source) == "table" and source.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
					if source._dirty or source._texture ~= instance._decalLastTexture then
						-- continue to rebuild
					else
						return
					end
				else
					return
				end
			end

			instance._decalLastPath = source

			local map = nil
			if type(source) == "table" and source.ClassName == "EditableImage" then
				if source._dirty then
					if source._texture then
						lib.UnloadTexture(source._texture)
					end
					source._texture = lib.LoadTextureFromImage(source._image)
					source._dirty = false
				end
				map = loadAlbedoMapFromEditable(source, color)
				instance._decalLastTexture = source._texture
			else
				map = loadAlbedoMap(source, color)
				instance._decalLastTexture = nil
			end

			if map then
				if instance._decalHasMaps then
					pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadDecalMaps, decal)
				end
				buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("albedo"), map, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size())
				instance._decalHasMaps = true
			else
				if instance._decalHasMaps then
					pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadDecalMaps, decal)
					instance._decalHasMaps = false
				end
				local fallback = r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:new({ color = color })
				buffer.copy(decal, r3dstructs.R3D_Decal:offset("albedo"), fallback, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size())
			end

			applyAlbedoColor(decal, instance.Color3, instance.Transparency or 0)
		end

		syncAlbedo(true)
		applyDecalSettings(instance, decal)

		local renderId
		if renderer and renderer.DecalPool and renderer.Pool then
			renderId = renderer.Pool.new("3d", function()
				syncAlbedo(false)
				if instance.Transparency >= 1 then
					return
				end

				local adornee = instance.Adornee
				if not adornee or not adornee.CFrame or not adornee.Size then
					adornee = instance.Parent
				end
				if not adornee or not adornee.CFrame or not adornee.Size then
					return
				end

				local face = instance.Face
				local depth = math.max(0.001, instance.Depth or 0.1)
				local cf
				local scale
				local width
				local height

				if instance.Wrap == true then
					cf = adornee.CFrame
					width = adornee.Size.X
					height = adornee.Size.Z
					scale = Vector3.new(adornee.Size.X + depth, adornee.Size.Y + depth, adornee.Size.Z + depth)
				else
					width, height = getFaceSize(adornee.Size, face)
					if not width or not height then
						return
					end

					cf = getFaceCFrame(adornee.CFrame, adornee.Size, face)
					if not cf then
						return
					end

					scale = Vector3.new(width, depth, height)
				end

				cf = applyFaceOffset(cf, instance.Position)

				applyUvSettings(instance, decal, width, height)
				local matrix = cf:ToRaylibMatrixScale(scale, structs)

				renderer.DecalPool.DrawDecal(decal, matrix)
			end)
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(property)
			if property == "Texture" then
				syncAlbedo(true)
			elseif property == "Color3" or property == "Transparency" then
				applyAlbedoColor(decal, instance.Color3, instance.Transparency or 0)
			elseif property == "NormalThreshold" or property == "FadeWidth" then
				applyDecalSettings(instance, decal)
			end
		end)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if renderId and renderer and renderer.Pool then
				renderer.Pool.Destroy(renderId)
			end
			pcall(rlib.R3D_UnloadDecalMaps, decal)
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local GuiObject = require("@GuiObject")
local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local UDim2 = require("@UDim2")
local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")

local Aereon = require("@Aereon")
local gui = Aereon.gui
local arect = Aereon.rect()

local propTable = {
	Name = "UIToggle",
	BaseClass = "GuiObject",
	AbsoluteSize = nil,
	AbsolutePosition = nil,
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0, 28),
	Value = false,
	OffColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3),
	OnColor3 = Color3.new(0.02, 0.5, 1),
	HandleColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
	OnValueChanged = nil,
	Visible = true,
}

local function renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer, pos, size)
	for _, child in pairs(object:GetChildren()) do
		if child.render then
			lib.BeginScissorMode(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y)
			child.render(lib, child, dt, structs, renderer)
			lib.EndScissorMode()
		end
	end
end

GuiObject.inherit(propTable)

return {
	class = "UIToggle",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		local onValueChanged = signal.new()
		local toggle = gui.toggle({
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			width = 56,
			height = 28,
			value = instance.Value,
			onChanged = function(value)
				instance.Value = value
				onValueChanged:Fire(value)
			end,
		})

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance.OnValueChanged = onValueChanged
		instance._toggle = toggle

		instance.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if object.Visible == false then
				return
			end

			local pos, size = GuiObject.calculatePositions(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)

			toggle.set("obj_rect", arect.new(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y))
			toggle.set("value", object.Value == true)
			toggle.set("offColor", object.OffColor3)
			toggle.set("onColor", object.OnColor3)
			toggle.set("handleColor", object.HandleColor3)

			toggle.render(dt)
			renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer, pos, size)

			return pos, size
		end

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		GuiObject.inherit(tble)
	end,
}

  Code: -- description: "Applies a torsional spring constraint between two attachments."
local Color3 = require("@Color3")
local NetworkOwnership = require("@NetworkOwnership")

local raylib = require("@raylib")
local rl = raylib.lib

local propTable = {
	Attachment0 = nil,
	Attachment1 = nil,
	Enabled = true,
	Visible = true,
	Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0), -- Orange

	MaxAngle = 45,
	Damping = 1,
	Stiffness = 10,
}

return {
	class = "TorsionSpringConstraint",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		local KinemiumPhysicsService = datamodel:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local _activeConstraint = nil

		local function cleanup()
			if _activeConstraint then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.lib.JPH_PhysicsSystem_RemoveConstraint(
					KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.physicsSystem,
					_activeConstraint
				)
				_activeConstraint = nil
			end
		end

		local function rebuild()
			cleanup()

			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end
			if not instance.Attachment0 or not instance.Attachment1 then
				return
			end

			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			local part0 = att0.Parent
			local part1 = att1.Parent

			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return
			end

			if not NetworkOwnership.ShouldSimulateConstraintForMachine(instance, datamodel) then
				return
			end

			local bodyID0 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part0)
			local bodyID1 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part1)
			if not bodyID0 or not bodyID1 then
				task.defer(rebuild)
				return
			end

			local wPos0 = part0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wAxisX0 = part0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.Axis):Unit()
			local wAxisY0 = part0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.SecondaryAxis):Unit()

			local wPos1 = part1.CFrame * att1.Position
			local wAxisX1 = part1.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att1.Axis):Unit()
			local wAxisY1 = part1.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att1.SecondaryAxis):Unit()

			_activeConstraint = KinemiumPhysicsService.CreateTorsionSpring(
				part0,
				part1,
				wPos0,
				wAxisX0,
				wAxisY0,
				wPos1,
				wAxisX1,
				wAxisY1,
				instance.Stiffness,
				instance.Damping,
				math.rad(instance.MaxAngle)
			)

			local function onPartChanged(prop)
				if prop == "Anchored" then
					task.defer(rebuild)
				end
			end
			part0.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
			part1.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
		end

		local function drawGizmo()
			if not instance.Visible or not instance.Attachment0 then
				return
			end
			local att = instance.Attachment0
			local pos = att.Parent.CFrame * att.Position
			local axisX = att.Parent.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att.Axis):Unit()

			local rlPos = vector.create(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
			local rlColorEdge = raylib.structs.Color:new({
				r = instance.Color.R * 255,
				g = instance.Color.G * 255,
				b = instance.Color.B * 255,
				a = 255,
			})

			-- Draw an arc to represent torsion around axis X
			local cx = rlPos.x
			local cy = rlPos.y
			local cz = rlPos.z

			local steps = 16
			local radius = 0.5
			local axisYZ = att.Parent.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att.SecondaryAxis):Unit()
			local axisZZ = att.Parent.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att.Axis:Cross(att.SecondaryAxis)):Unit()

			local lastPoint = nil
			for i = 0, steps do
				local ang = (i / steps) * math.pi * 2
				local pX = cx + axisYZ.X * math.cos(ang) * radius + axisZZ.X * math.sin(ang) * radius
				local pY = cy + axisYZ.Y * math.cos(ang) * radius + axisZZ.Y * math.sin(ang) * radius
				local pZ = cz + axisYZ.Z * math.cos(ang) * radius + axisZZ.Z * math.sin(ang) * radius

				local pt = vector.create(pX, pY, pZ)
				if lastPoint then
					rl.DrawLine3D(lastPoint, pt, rlColorEdge)
				end
				lastPoint = pt
			end
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if
				prop == "Enabled"
				or prop == "Attachment0"
				or prop == "Attachment1"
				or prop == "Stiffness"
				or prop == "Damping"
				or prop == "MaxAngle"
			then
				rebuild()
			end
		end)

		renderer.Pool.new("gizmo", drawGizmo)
		task.spawn(rebuild)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

  Code: -- description: "Creates an anchor layout for UI elements."
local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")

-- UIAnchorLayout: each child declares its own anchor constraints via
-- a UIAnchor modifier child, similar to CSS absolute positioning with
-- top/right/bottom/left/center anchoring
--
-- UIAnchor properties (set on a child of the element you want to anchor):
--   AnchorTop    = UDim  -- distance from parent top edge (nil = unconstrained)
--   AnchorBottom = UDim  -- distance from parent bottom edge (nil = unconstrained)
--   AnchorLeft   = UDim  -- distance from parent left edge (nil = unconstrained)
--   AnchorRight  = UDim  -- distance from parent right edge (nil = unconstrained)
--   CenterX      = bool  -- horizontally center (overrides Left/Right)
--   CenterY      = bool  -- vertically center (overrides Top/Bottom)
--
-- When both opposite edges are constrained (e.g. AnchorLeft + AnchorRight),
-- the child is stretched to fill between them and its Size.X is ignored.
-- When only one edge is constrained, the child keeps its own Size and
-- is pinned to that edge

local propTable = {
	Name = "UIAnchorLayout",
	Enabled = true,

	render = function(lib, object, dt, structs)
		if not object.Enabled then
			return
		end
		local parent = object.Parent
		if not parent then
			return
		end

		local function GetAbsoluteSize(obj)
			if obj.AbsoluteSize then
				return obj.AbsoluteSize
			end
			if obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
				return Vector2.new(lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y)
			else
				local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(obj.Parent)
				return obj.Size:ToPixels(parentSize)
			end
		end

		local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(parent)

		local totalPaddingX = 0
		local totalPaddingY = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child.ClassName == "UIPadding" then
				local px = child.Padding:ToPixels(parentSize)
				totalPaddingX = totalPaddingX + px.X
				totalPaddingY = totalPaddingY + px.Y
			end
		end

		local effectiveWidth = math.max(0, parentSize.X - totalPaddingX * 2)
		local effectiveHeight = math.max(0, parentSize.Y - totalPaddingY * 2)
		local effectiveSize = Vector2.new(effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight)

		local function resolveUDim(udim, axis)
			if not udim then
				return nil
			end
			local scale = axis == "x" and effectiveWidth or effectiveHeight
			return udim.Scale * scale + udim.Offset
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if not child.Visible or child == object or child.ClassName == "UIPadding" then
				continue
			end

			local anchor = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIAnchor")
			if not anchor then
				continue
			end

			rawset(child, "_LayoutControlled", true)

			local childSize = child.Size:ToPixels(effectiveSize)
			local posX, posY, sizeX, sizeY

			local left = resolveUDim(anchor.AnchorLeft, "x")
			local right = resolveUDim(anchor.AnchorRight, "x")
			local centerX = anchor.CenterX

			if centerX then
				sizeX = childSize.X
				posX = totalPaddingX + (effectiveWidth - sizeX) * 0.5
			elseif left ~= nil and right ~= nil then
				posX = totalPaddingX + left
				sizeX = math.max(0, effectiveWidth - left - right)
			elseif left ~= nil then
				posX = totalPaddingX + left
				sizeX = childSize.X
			elseif right ~= nil then
				sizeX = childSize.X
				posX = totalPaddingX + effectiveWidth - right - sizeX
			else
				posX = totalPaddingX + child.Position.X.Scale * effectiveWidth + child.Position.X.Offset
				sizeX = childSize.X
			end

			local top = resolveUDim(anchor.AnchorTop, "y")
			local bottom = resolveUDim(anchor.AnchorBottom, "y")
			local centerY = anchor.CenterY

			if centerY then
				sizeY = childSize.Y
				posY = totalPaddingY + (effectiveHeight - sizeY) * 0.5
			elseif top ~= nil and bottom ~= nil then
				posY = totalPaddingY + top
				sizeY = math.max(0, effectiveHeight - top - bottom)
			elseif top ~= nil then
				posY = totalPaddingY + top
				sizeY = childSize.Y
			elseif bottom ~= nil then
				sizeY = childSize.Y
				posY = totalPaddingY + effectiveHeight - bottom - sizeY
			else
				posY = totalPaddingY + child.Position.Y.Scale * effectiveHeight + child.Position.Y.Offset
				sizeY = childSize.Y
			end

			rawset(child, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(posX, posY))

			if sizeX ~= childSize.X or sizeY ~= childSize.Y then
				rawset(child, "AbsoluteSize", Vector2.new(sizeX, sizeY))
			end
		end
	end,
}

return {
	class = "UIAnchorLayout",
	render = propTable.render,
	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		return instance
	end,
}

local UDim2 = require("@UDim2")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local MouseCursor = require("@Kinemium.MouseCursor")

local aereon = require("@Aereon")
local arect = aereon.rect()

local ZERO_V2 = Vector2.new(0, 0)

local function getParentMetrics(parent)
	local parentAbsPos = ZERO_V2
	local parentSize = ZERO_V2

	if not parent then
		return parentAbsPos, parentSize
	end

	if parent.AbsolutePosition then
		parentAbsPos = parent.AbsolutePosition
	elseif parent.RenderOffset then
		parentAbsPos = parent.RenderOffset
	end

	if parent.AbsoluteSize then
		parentSize = parent.AbsoluteSize
	elseif parent.Size and parent.Size.ToPixels then
		local dpiScale = raylib.lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
		parentSize = parent.Size:ToPixels(Vector2.new(raylib.lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, raylib.lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y))
	end

	return parentAbsPos, parentSize
end

return {
	class = "UIDragDetector",

	callback = function(instance)
		propTable.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if object.Parent then
				local adornee = object.Parent
				if adornee.BaseClass == "GuiObject" then
					local absolutePosition, absoluteSize = adornee.AbsolutePosition, adornee.AbsoluteSize

					if not absolutePosition or not absoluteSize then
						return
					end

					if instance.isDragging == true then
						local mousePos = raylib.lib.GetMousePosition()
						local newAbsX = mousePos.x - instance.dragOffset.X
						local newAbsY = mousePos.y - instance.dragOffset.Y

						if instance.RespectScreenBounds then
							local dpiScale = raylib.lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
							local screenW = raylib.lib.GetScreenWidth() / dpiScale.x
							local screenH = raylib.lib.GetScreenHeight() / dpiScale.y
							newAbsX = math.clamp(
								newAbsX,
								0,
								screenW - absoluteSize.X
							)
							newAbsY = math.clamp(
								newAbsY,
								0,
								screenH - absoluteSize.Y
							)
						end

						local parentAbsPos, parentSize = getParentMetrics(adornee.Parent)
						local anchor = adornee.AnchorPoint or ZERO_V2
						local relativeX = newAbsX - parentAbsPos.X + absoluteSize.X * anchor.X
						local relativeY = newAbsY - parentAbsPos.Y + absoluteSize.Y * anchor.Y
						local scaleXOffset = parentSize.X * adornee.Position.X.Scale
						local scaleYOffset = parentSize.Y * adornee.Position.Y.Scale

						adornee.Position = UDim2.new(
							adornee.Position.X.Scale,
							relativeX - scaleXOffset,
							adornee.Position.Y.Scale,
							relativeY - scaleYOffset
						)

						MouseCursor.request(raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_ALL)
					end

					local new = arect.new(absolutePosition.X, absolutePosition.Y, absoluteSize.X, absoluteSize.Y)
					if arect.MouseIsInRect(new) then
						if raylib.lib.IsMouseButtonDown(0) == 1 then
							if not instance.isDragging then
								local mousePos = raylib.lib.GetMousePosition()
								instance.dragOffset =
									Vector3.new(mousePos.x - absolutePosition.X, mousePos.y - absolutePosition.Y, 0)
							end
							instance.isDragging = true
						elseif raylib.lib.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
							instance.isDragging = false
							MouseCursor.request(raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_DEFAULT)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,

local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")

local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local UDim = require("@UDim")

local propTable = {
	FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 5),
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
	VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
	ItemAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top, -- Alignment of items within a row/column
	Enabled = true,
	Name = "UIFlowLayout",
	render = function(lib, object, dt, structs)
		if not object.Enabled then
			return
		end

		local parent = object.Parent

		if not parent then
			return
		end

		local function GetAbsoluteSize(obj)
			if obj.AbsoluteSize then
				return obj.AbsoluteSize
			end

			if obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				return Vector2.new(lib.GetRenderWidth(), lib.GetRenderHeight())
			end

			local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(obj.Parent)

			return obj.Size:ToPixels(parentSize)
		end

		local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(parent)

		local paddingX, paddingY = 0, 0

		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child.ClassName == "UIPadding" then
				local px = child.Padding:ToPixels(parentSize)

				paddingX += px.X

				paddingY += px.Y
			end
		end

		local containerSize =
			Vector2.new(math.max(0, parentSize.X - paddingX * 2), math.max(0, parentSize.Y - paddingY * 2))

		local children = {}

		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child ~= object and child.Visible and child.ClassName ~= "UIPadding" then
				table.insert(children, child)
			end
		end

		if object.SortOrder == Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder and #children > 1 then
			table.sort(children, function(a, b)
				return (a.LayoutOrder or 0) < (b.LayoutOrder or 0)
			end)
		end

		local paddingPx = object.Padding.Scale
				* (object.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Vertical and containerSize.Y or containerSize.X)
			+ object.Padding.Offset
		local rows = {}
		local currentRow = { children = {}, size = Vector2.new(0, 0) }

		table.insert(rows, currentRow)

		local isHorizontal = object.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal

		for _, child in ipairs(children) do
			local size = child.Size:ToPixels(containerSize)

			if isHorizontal then
				if currentRow.size.X + size.X > containerSize.X and #currentRow.children > 0 then
					currentRow = { children = {}, size = Vector2.new(0, 0) }

					table.insert(rows, currentRow)
				end

				table.insert(currentRow.children, { child = child, size = size })

				currentRow.size = Vector2.new(
					currentRow.size.X + size.X + (#currentRow.children > 1 and paddingPx or 0),
					math.max(currentRow.size.Y, size.Y)
				)
			else
				if currentRow.size.Y + size.Y > containerSize.Y and #currentRow.children > 0 then
					currentRow = { children = {}, size = Vector2.new(0, 0) }

					table.insert(rows, currentRow)
				end

				table.insert(currentRow.children, { child = child, size = size })

				currentRow.size = Vector2.new(
					math.max(currentRow.size.X, size.X),
					currentRow.size.Y + size.Y + (#currentRow.children > 1 and paddingPx or 0)
				)
			end
		end

		local totalSize = Vector2.new(0, 0)

		for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
			if isHorizontal then
				totalSize = Vector2.new(
					math.max(totalSize.X, row.size.X),
					totalSize.Y + row.size.Y + (i > 1 and paddingPx or 0)
				)
			else
				totalSize = Vector2.new(
					totalSize.X + row.size.X + (i > 1 and paddingPx or 0),
					math.max(totalSize.Y, row.size.Y)
				)
			end
		end

		local currentPos = isHorizontal and paddingY or paddingX

		if isHorizontal then
			if object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then
				currentPos += (containerSize.Y - totalSize.Y) * 0.5
			elseif object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom then
				currentPos += (containerSize.Y - totalSize.Y)
			end
		else
			if object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
				currentPos += (containerSize.X - totalSize.X) * 0.5
			elseif object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
				currentPos += (containerSize.X - totalSize.X)
			end
		end

		for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
			local rowCursor = isHorizontal and paddingX or paddingY

			if isHorizontal then
				if object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
					rowCursor += (containerSize.X - row.size.X) * 0.5
				elseif object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
					rowCursor += (containerSize.X - row.size.X)
				end
			else
				if object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then
					rowCursor += (containerSize.Y - row.size.Y) * 0.5
				elseif object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom then
					rowCursor += (containerSize.Y - row.size.Y)
				end
			end

			for _, item in ipairs(row.children) do
				local child = item.child

				local size = item.size

				rawset(child, "_LayoutControlled", true)

				local itemOffset = 0

				if isHorizontal then
					if object.ItemAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then
						itemOffset = (row.size.Y - size.Y) * 0.5
					elseif object.ItemAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom then
						itemOffset = row.size.Y - size.Y
					end

					rawset(child, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(rowCursor, currentPos + itemOffset))

					rowCursor += size.X + paddingPx
				else
					if object.ItemAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
						itemOffset = (row.size.X - size.X) * 0.5
					elseif object.ItemAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
						itemOffset = row.size.X - size.X
					end

					rawset(child, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(currentPos + itemOffset, rowCursor))

					rowCursor += size.Y + paddingPx
				end
			end

			currentPos += (isHorizontal and row.size.Y or row.size.X) + paddingPx
		end
	end,
}

return {
	class = "UIFlowLayout",
	render = propTable.render,
	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		return instance
	end,
}

	AbsolutePosition = nil,

	ImageTransparency = 0,

	GifPath = "",
}

propTable.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
	if not object.Visible then
		return
	end
	if not object._gifbuffer then
		return
	end
	local pos, size = GuiObject.render(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)

	GuiObject.renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)

	object.Duration = gif.GetDuration(object._gifbuffer)
	object.Timestamp = gif.GetTimestamp(object._gifbuffer)

	gif.SetLooping(object._gifbuffer, object.Looped)
	gif.SetLooping(object._gifbuffer, object.Speed)

	if object._gifbuffer then
		gif.Update(object._gifbuffer, dt)
		gif.Draw(object._gifbuffer, pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y, object.ImageColor3:ToRaylib(object.ImageTransparency))
	end

	return pos, size
end

local mainTask

return {
	class = "UIGif",
	render = propTable.render,

	callback = function(instance, renderer)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		-- description: "Pauses the GIF."
		-- args: "self: UIGif"
		-- returns: "any"
		function instance:Pause()
			if not instance._gifbuffer then
				return
			end
			gif.Pause(instance._gifbuffer)
		end

		-- description: "Resumes playing the GIF."
		-- args: "self: UIGif"
		-- returns: "any"
		function instance:Resume()
			if not instance._gifbuffer then
				return
			end
			gif.Resume(instance._gifbuffer)
		end

		-- description: "Changes playback speed of the GIF."
		-- args: "self: UIGif, speed: Number"
		-- returns: "any"
		function instance:SetSpeed(speed: number)
			if not instance._gifbuffer then
				return
			end
			instance.Speed = speed
		end

		instance.Changed:Connect(function()
			if instance.GifPath ~= "" then
				if mainTask then
					return
				end
				if instance._gifbuffer then
					print("got already existing gif..")
					gif.Unload(instance._gifbuffer)
				end
				mainTask = task.spawn(function()
					instance._gifbuffer = gif.Load(instance.GifPath)
				end)
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		GuiObject.inherit(tble)
	end,
}

local propTable = {
	Name = "UIGridLayout",
	Enabled = true,

	CellPaddingX = UDim.new(0, 5), -- horizontal gap between cells
	CellPaddingY = UDim.new(0, 5), -- vertical gap between cells

	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
	VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,

	FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,

	render = function(lib, object, dt, structs)
		if not object.Enabled then
			return
		end
		local parent = object.Parent
		if not parent then
			return
		end

		local function GetAbsoluteSize(obj)
			if obj.AbsoluteSize then
				return obj.AbsoluteSize
			end
			if obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
				return Vector2.new(lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y)

			end

		local totalPaddingY = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child.ClassName == "UIPadding" then
				local px = child.Padding:ToPixels(parentSize)
				totalPaddingX = totalPaddingX + px.X
				totalPaddingY = totalPaddingY + px.Y
			end
		end

		local effectiveWidth = math.max(0, parentSize.X - totalPaddingX * 2)
		local effectiveHeight = math.max(0, parentSize.Y - totalPaddingY * 2)
		local effectiveSize = Vector2.new(effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight)

		local padX = object.CellPaddingX.Scale * effectiveSize.X + object.CellPaddingX.Offset
		local padY = object.CellPaddingY.Scale * effectiveSize.Y + object.CellPaddingY.Offset

		local children = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Visible and child ~= object and child.ClassName ~= "UIPadding" then
				table.insert(children, child)
			end
		end

			table.sort(children, function(a, b)
				return (a.LayoutOrder or 0) < (b.LayoutOrder or 0)
			end)
		end

					table.insert(rows, currentRow)
					currentRow = { child }
					currentRowWidth = size.X
				else

					currentRowWidth = neededWidth
				end
			end
			if #currentRow > 0 then
				table.insert(rows, currentRow)
			end

			local totalContentHeight = 0
			local rowHeights = {}
			for i, row in ipairs(rows) do
				local rowH = 0
				for _, child in ipairs(row) do
					local size = child.Size:ToPixels(effectiveSize)
					rowH = math.max(rowH, size.Y)
				end
				rowHeights[i] = rowH
				totalContentHeight = totalContentHeight + rowH
				if i < #rows then
					totalContentHeight = totalContentHeight + padY

			end

			if object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then

					local size = child.Size:ToPixels(effectiveSize)
					colW = math.max(colW, size.X)
				end
				colWidths[i] = colW
				totalContentWidth = totalContentWidth + colW
				if i < #cols then
					totalContentWidth = totalContentWidth + padX
				end
			end

			local startX = totalPaddingX
			if object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
				startX = totalPaddingX + math.max(0, (effectiveWidth - totalContentWidth) * 0.5)
			elseif object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
				startX = totalPaddingX + math.max(0, effectiveWidth - totalContentWidth)
			end

			local curX = startX
			for i, col in ipairs(cols) do
				local colW = colWidths[i]

				local colHeight = 0
				for j, child in ipairs(col) do
					local size = child.Size:ToPixels(effectiveSize)
					colHeight = colHeight + size.Y
					if j < #col then
						colHeight = colHeight + padY
					end
				end

				local startY = totalPaddingY
				if object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then
					startY = totalPaddingY + math.max(0, (effectiveHeight - colHeight) * 0.5)
				elseif object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom then
					startY = totalPaddingY + math.max(0, effectiveHeight - colHeight)
				end

				local curY = startY
				for _, child in ipairs(col) do
					local size = child.Size:ToPixels(effectiveSize)

					local cellX = curX
					if object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
						cellX = curX + (colW - size.X) * 0.5
					elseif object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
						cellX = curX + (colW - size.X)
					end

					rawset(child, "_LayoutControlled", true)
					rawset(child, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(cellX, curY))

					curY = curY + size.Y + padY
				end

				curX = curX + colW + padX
			end
		end
	end,
}

return {
	class = "UIGridLayout",
	render = propTable.render,

	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		return instance
	end,
}

local propTable = {

				return Vector2.new(lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y)

		--------------------------------------------------

				paddingX += px.X
				paddingY += px.Y
			end
		end

		local containerSize =
			Vector2.new(math.max(0, parentSize.X - paddingX * 2), math.max(0, parentSize.Y - paddingY * 2))

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- Collect children
		--------------------------------------------------
		local children = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child ~= object and child.Visible and child.ClassName ~= "UIPadding" then
				table.insert(children, child)
			end
		end

		if object.SortOrder == Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder and #children > 1 then
			table.sort(children, function(a, b)
				return (a.LayoutOrder or 0) < (b.LayoutOrder or 0)
			end)
		end

		local paddingPx = object.Padding.Scale
				* (object.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Vertical and containerSize.Y or containerSize.X)
			+ object.Padding.Offset

		local totalSpan = 0
		for i, child in ipairs(children) do
			local size = child.Size:ToPixels(containerSize)
			local span = (object.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Vertical) and size.Y or size.X

			totalSpan += span

			if i > 1 then
				totalSpan += paddingPx
			end
		end

		--------------------------------------------------
		-- Viewport culling bounds
		--------------------------------------------------
		local viewMin = -object.Overscan
		local viewMax = (object.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Vertical and containerSize.Y or containerSize.X)
			+ object.Overscan

		local cursor

		if object.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal then
			cursor = paddingX

			if object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
				cursor += (containerSize.X - totalSpan) * 0.5
			elseif object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
				cursor += (containerSize.X - totalSpan)
			end
		else
			cursor = paddingY

			if object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then
				cursor += (containerSize.Y - totalSpan) * 0.5
			elseif object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom then
				cursor += (containerSize.Y - totalSpan)
			end
		end
		--------------------------------------------------
		-- Layout loop (virtualized)
		--------------------------------------------------
		for _, child in ipairs(children) do
			local size = child.Size:ToPixels(containerSize)
			local span = (object.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Vertical) and size.Y or size.X

			local posStart = cursor
			local posEnd = cursor + span

			if not object.Virtualized or (posEnd >= viewMin and posStart <= viewMax) then
				rawset(child, "_LayoutControlled", true)

				if object.FillDirection == Enum.FillDirection.Vertical then
					local x = 0
					if object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
						x = (containerSize.X - size.X) * 0.5
					elseif object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
						x = containerSize.X - size.X
					end

					rawset(child, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(x + paddingX, cursor))
				else
					local y = 0
					if object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then
						y = (containerSize.Y - size.Y) * 0.5
					elseif object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom then
						y = containerSize.Y - size.Y
					end

					rawset(child, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(cursor, y + paddingY))
				end
			end

			cursor += span + paddingPx

			if object.Virtualized and cursor > viewMax then
				break
			end
		end
	end,
}

local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local UDim2 = require("@UDim2")
local UDim = require("@UDim")
local Signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")

local propTable = {
	Name = "UINotificationLayout",
	Enabled = true,

	Anchor = Enum.NotificationAnchor.TopRight,
	Padding = UDim.new(0, 12), -- gap between notifications
	MarginX = UDim.new(0, 16), -- distance from screen edge X
	MarginY = UDim.new(0, 16), -- distance from screen edge Y

	MaxVisible = 5, -- max notifications shown at once
	EnterDuration = 0.25, -- slide-in time
	ExitDuration = 0.2, -- slide-out time
	DefaultTimeout = 4, -- seconds before auto-dismiss (0 = never)

	EnterEasing = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
	ExitEasing = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,

	_notifications = nil, -- internal list, initialized on first render

	render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
		if not object.Enabled then
			return
		end

		if rawget(object, "_notifications") == nil then
			rawset(object, "_notifications", {})
		end

		local notifications = rawget(object, "_notifications")
		local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
		local screenW = lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x
		local screenH = lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y

		local marginX = object.MarginX.Scale * screenW + object.MarginX.Offset
		local marginY = object.MarginY.Scale * screenH + object.MarginY.Offset
		local padding = object.Padding.Scale * screenH + object.Padding.Offset

		local anchor = object.Anchor
		local isRight = anchor == Enum.NotificationAnchor.TopRight or anchor == Enum.NotificationAnchor.BottomRight
		local isBottom = anchor == Enum.NotificationAnchor.BottomLeft or anchor == Enum.NotificationAnchor.BottomRight

		local function ease(t, style)
			if style == Enum.EasingStyle.Linear then
				return t
			elseif style == Enum.EasingStyle.Quad then
				return t < 0.5 and 2 * t * t or 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ^ 2 / 2
			elseif style == Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic then
				return t < 0.5 and 4 * t * t * t or 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ^ 3 / 2
			elseif style == Enum.EasingStyle.Sine then
				return -(math.cos(math.pi * t) - 1) / 2
			elseif style == Enum.EasingStyle.Expo then
				if t == 0 then
					return 0
				end
				if t == 1 then
					return 1
				end
				return t < 0.5 and 2 ^ (20 * t - 10) / 2 or (2 - 2 ^ (-20 * t + 10)) / 2
			end
			return t
		end

		local toRemove = {}
		for i, notif in ipairs(notifications) do
			notif._elapsed = (notif._elapsed or 0) + dt

			if notif.state == Enum.NotificationState.Entering then
				local t = math.clamp(notif._elapsed / object.EnterDuration, 0, 1)
				notif._alpha = ease(t, object.EnterEasing)
				notif._slideT = notif._alpha

				if t >= 1 then
					notif.state = Enum.NotificationState.Visible
					notif._elapsed = 0
					notif._alpha = 1
					notif._slideT = 1
				end
			elseif notif.state == Enum.NotificationState.Visible then
				local timeout = notif.timeout ~= nil and notif.timeout or object.DefaultTimeout
				if timeout > 0 and notif._elapsed >= timeout then
					notif.state = Enum.NotificationState.Exiting
					notif._elapsed = 0
				end
			elseif notif.state == Enum.NotificationState.Exiting then
				local t = math.clamp(notif._elapsed / object.ExitDuration, 0, 1)
				notif._alpha = 1 - ease(t, object.ExitEasing)
				notif._slideT = notif._alpha

				if t >= 1 then
					table.insert(toRemove, i)

					local completedSignal = rawget(object, "_completedSignal")
					if completedSignal then
						completedSignal:Fire(notif.frame)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for i = #toRemove, 1, -1 do
			table.remove(notifications, toRemove[i])
		end

		while #notifications > object.MaxVisible do
			table.remove(notifications, 1)
		end

		local cursor = marginY

		if isBottom then
			local totalH = 0
			for _, notif in ipairs(notifications) do
				local h = notif.frame and notif.frame.AbsoluteSize and notif.frame.AbsoluteSize.Y or 0
				totalH = totalH + h + padding
			end
			cursor = screenH - marginY - totalH
		end

		for _, notif in ipairs(notifications) do
			local frame = notif.frame
			if not frame or not frame.render then
				continue
			end

			local frameW = (frame.AbsoluteSize and frame.AbsoluteSize.X)
				or (frame.Size.X.Scale * screenW + frame.Size.X.Offset)
				or 0
			local frameH = (frame.AbsoluteSize and frame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
				or (frame.Size.Y.Scale * screenH + frame.Size.Y.Offset)
				or 0

			local slideT = notif._slideT or 0

			local posX
			if isRight then
				posX = screenW - marginX - frameW + (1 - slideT) * (frameW + marginX)
			else
				posX = marginX - (1 - slideT) * (frameW + marginX)
			end

			local posY = cursor

			rawset(frame, "_LayoutControlled", false)
			rawset(frame, "_LayoutRelativePosition", nil)
			rawset(frame, "_EditorOverride", false)
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, posX, 0, posY)
			frame.AnchorPoint = vector.create(0, 0, 0)

			if notif._alpha ~= nil then
				local baseTransparency = notif._baseTransparency or 0
				frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (1 - baseTransparency) * notif._alpha
			end

			frame.render(lib, frame, dt, structs, renderer)

			cursor = cursor + frameH + padding
		end
	end,
}

local api = {}

-- description: "Pushes a notification."
-- args: "layoutObject: table, frame: table, options: table"
function api.Push(layoutObject, frame, options)
	options = options or {}
	local notifications = rawget(layoutObject, "_notifications")
	if not notifications then
		notifications = {}
		rawset(layoutObject, "_notifications", notifications)
	end

	table.insert(notifications, {
		frame = frame,
		state = Enum.NotificationState.Entering,
		timeout = options.timeout,
		_elapsed = 0,
		_alpha = 0,
		_slideT = 0,
		_baseTransparency = frame.BackgroundTransparency or 0,
	})
end

-- description: "Dismisses a notification."
-- args: "layout: any, frame: table"
function api.Dismiss(layout, frame)
	local notifications = rawget(layout, "_notifications")
	if not notifications then
		return
	end

	for _, notif in ipairs(notifications) do
		if notif.frame == frame and notif.state ~= Enum.NotificationState.Exiting then
			notif.state = Enum.NotificationState.Exiting
			notif._elapsed = 0
		end
	end
end

-- description: "Dismisses all notifications."
-- args: "layout: any"
function api.DismissAll(layout)
	local notifications = rawget(layout, "_notifications")
	if not notifications then
		return
	end

	for _, notif in ipairs(notifications) do
		if notif.state ~= Enum.NotificationState.Exiting then
			notif.state = Enum.NotificationState.Exiting
			notif._elapsed = 0
		end
	end
end

return {
	class = "UINotificationLayout",
	render = propTable.render,
	api = api,
	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local completedSignal = Signal.new()
		rawset(instance, "_completedSignal", completedSignal)

		-- description: "Pushes a notification."
		-- args: "frame: table, options: table"
		instance.Push = function(frame, options)
			api.Push(instance, frame, options)
		end
		-- description: "Dismisses a notification."
		-- args: "frame: table"
		instance.Dismiss = function(frame)
			api.Dismiss(instance, frame)
		end
		-- description: "Dismisses all notifications."
		instance.DismissAll = function()
			api.DismissAll(instance)
		end
		instance.Completed = completedSignal

		return instance
	end,
}

local UDim2 = require("@UDim2")
local UDim = require("@UDim")
local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")

local propTable = {
	Name = "UIPadding",
	BaseClass = "Instance",

	Padding = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
	PaddingLeft = nil,
	PaddingRight = nil,
	PaddingTop = nil,
	PaddingBottom = nil,

	_CachedParentSize = nil,
	_CachedResolved = nil,
}

local function resolveLegacyPaddingSide(padding, primaryKey, secondaryKey)
	local side = padding and padding[primaryKey]
	if side then
		return side
	end

	return padding and padding[secondaryKey] or UDim.new(0, 0)
end

local function resolvePaddingSide(instance, propertyName, primaryKey, secondaryKey)
	local explicit = instance[propertyName]
	if explicit ~= nil then
		return explicit
	end

	return resolveLegacyPaddingSide(instance.Padding, primaryKey, secondaryKey)
end

-- description: "Gets the resolved padding."
-- args: "parentSize: number"
function propTable:GetResolvedPadding(parentSize)
	local cachedSize = self._CachedParentSize
	local cachedResolved = self._CachedResolved

	if cachedSize and cachedResolved and cachedSize == parentSize then
		return cachedResolved
	end

	local leftUDim = resolvePaddingSide(self, "PaddingLeft", "X", "X")
	local rightUDim = resolvePaddingSide(self, "PaddingRight", "X2", "X")
	local topUDim = resolvePaddingSide(self, "PaddingTop", "Y", "Y")
	local bottomUDim = resolvePaddingSide(self, "PaddingBottom", "Y2", "Y")

	local left = leftUDim.Scale * parentSize.X + leftUDim.Offset
	local right = rightUDim.Scale * parentSize.X + rightUDim.Offset
	local top = topUDim.Scale * parentSize.Y + topUDim.Offset
	local bottom = bottomUDim.Scale * parentSize.Y + bottomUDim.Offset

	local resolved = {
		Left = left,
		Right = right,
		Top = top,
		Bottom = bottom,

		Horizontal = left + right,
		Vertical = top + bottom,
	}

	self._CachedParentSize = parentSize
	self._CachedResolved = resolved

	return resolved
end

-- description: "Get inner padding size."
-- args: "containerSize: number"
function propTable:GetInnerSize(containerSize)
	local p = self:GetResolvedPadding(containerSize)

	return Vector2.new(math.max(0, containerSize.X - p.Horizontal), math.max(0, containerSize.Y - p.Vertical))
end

-- description: "Get cached offset padding (resolved)."
function propTable:GetOffset()
	local p = self._CachedResolved
	return Vector2.new(p.Left, p.Top)
end

-- description: "Applies position to padding"
-- args: "pos: Vector3"
function propTable:ApplyToPosition(pos)
	local p = self._CachedResolved
	return pos + Vector2.new(p.Left, p.Top)
end

-- description: "Gets all UIPadding objects in the container's children"
-- args: "container: number"
function propTable.GetAll(container)
	local out = {}

	for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
		if child.ClassName == "UIPadding" then
			table.insert(out, child)
		end
	end

	return out
end

-- description: "Resolves padding properties."
-- args: "container: number, containerSize: number"
function propTable.ResolveAll(container, containerSize)
	local total = {
		Left = 0,
		Right = 0,
		Top = 0,
		Bottom = 0,
	}

	for _, padding in ipairs(propTable.GetAll(container)) do
		local p = padding:GetResolvedPadding(containerSize)

		total.Left += p.Left
		total.Right += p.Right
		total.Top += p.Top
		total.Bottom += p.Bottom
	end

	total.Horizontal = total.Left + total.Right
	total.Vertical = total.Top + total.Bottom

	return total
end

-- description: "Gets the TotalInnerSize."
-- args: "container: number, containerSize: number"
function propTable.GetTotalInnerSize(container, containerSize)
	local p = propTable.ResolveAll(container, containerSize)

	return Vector2.new(math.max(0, containerSize.X - p.Horizontal), math.max(0, containerSize.Y - p.Vertical))
end

-- description: "Gets the TotalOffset."
-- args: "container: number, containerSize: number"
function propTable.GetTotalOffset(container, containerSize)
	local p = propTable.ResolveAll(container, containerSize)
	return Vector2.new(p.Left, p.Top)
end

return {
	class = "UIPadding",
	render = function()
		-- no render; purely layout modifier
	end,
	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		return instance
	end,
}

	AbsolutePosition = nil,
	Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 20),

	callback = function(instance, renderer, game)
		local progressBar = gui.progressBar({
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			width = 220,
			height = 20,
			progress = instance.Progress,
		})

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		instance._progressBar = progressBar

		instance.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if object.Visible == false then
				return
			end

			local pos, size = GuiObject.calculatePositions(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			local progress = math.clamp(tonumber(object.Progress) or 0, 0, 1)
			if object.Progress ~= progress then

			end

			progressBar.set("obj_rect", arect.new(pos.X, pos.Y, size.X, size.Y))
			progressBar.set("progress", progress)
			progressBar.set("backgroundColor", object.BackgroundColor3)
			progressBar.set("fillColor", object.FillColor3)
			progressBar.render(dt)

			return pos, size
		end

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		GuiObject.inherit(tble)
	end,
}
