  Code: -- description: "A modifier class that detects scale changes on a GUI element."
local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")
local Vector3 = require("@Vector3")
local UDim2 = require("@UDim2")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local MouseCursor = require("@Kinemium.MouseCursor")

local aereon = require("@Aereon")
local arect = aereon.rect()

local ZERO_V2 = Vector2.new(0, 0)
local HANDLE_SZ = 10 -- half-size of each hit region in pixels

local HANDLES = {
	TL = { l = true, r = false, t = true, b = false },
	T = { l = false, r = false, t = true, b = false },
	TR = { l = false, r = true, t = true, b = false },
	L = { l = true, r = false, t = false, b = false },
	R = { l = false, r = true, t = false, b = false },
	BL = { l = true, r = false, t = false, b = true },
	B = { l = false, r = false, t = false, b = true },
	BR = { l = false, r = true, t = false, b = true },
}

local CURSORS = {
	TL = raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_NWSE,
	BR = raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_NWSE,
	TR = raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_NESW,
	BL = raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_NESW,
	T = raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_NS,
	B = raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_NS,
	L = raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_EW,
	R = raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_EW,
}

local function getParentMetrics(parent)
	local parentAbsPos = ZERO_V2
	local parentSize = ZERO_V2
	if not parent then
		return parentAbsPos, parentSize
	end

	if parent.AbsolutePosition then
		parentAbsPos = parent.AbsolutePosition
	elseif parent.RenderOffset then
		parentAbsPos = parent.RenderOffset
	end

	if parent.AbsoluteSize then
		parentSize = parent.AbsoluteSize
	elseif parent.Size and parent.Size.ToPixels then
		local dpiScale = raylib.lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
		parentSize = parent.Size:ToPixels(Vector2.new(raylib.lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, raylib.lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y))
	end

	return parentAbsPos, parentSize
end

local function getHandleRect(key, absPos, absSize)
	local cx, cy

	if key == "TL" then
		cx = absPos.X
		cy = absPos.Y
	elseif key == "T" then
		cx = absPos.X + absSize.X * 0.5
		cy = absPos.Y
	elseif key == "TR" then
		cx = absPos.X + absSize.X
		cy = absPos.Y
	elseif key == "L" then
		cx = absPos.X
		cy = absPos.Y + absSize.Y * 0.5
	elseif key == "R" then
		cx = absPos.X + absSize.X
		cy = absPos.Y + absSize.Y * 0.5
	elseif key == "BL" then
		cx = absPos.X
		cy = absPos.Y + absSize.Y
	elseif key == "B" then
		cx = absPos.X + absSize.X * 0.5
		cy = absPos.Y + absSize.Y
	elseif key == "BR" then
		cx = absPos.X + absSize.X
		cy = absPos.Y + absSize.Y
	end

	return arect.new(cx - HANDLE_SZ, cy - HANDLE_SZ, HANDLE_SZ * 2, HANDLE_SZ * 2)
end

local propTable = {
	Name = "UIScaleDetector",
	isResizing = false,
	activeHandle = nil, -- key into HANDLES
	MinSize = Vector2.new(40, 40),
	RespectScreenBounds = true,

	newSizeCallback = nil, -- function(newSize: Vector2)

	_startMouse = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	_startAbsPos = Vector2.new(0, 0),
	_startAbsSz = Vector2.new(0, 0),
}

return {
	class = "UIScaleDetector",

	callback = function(instance)
		propTable.render = function(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if not object.Parent then
				return
			end
			local adornee = object.Parent
			if adornee.BaseClass ~= "GuiObject" then
				return
			end

			local absPos = adornee.AbsolutePosition
			local absSize = adornee.AbsoluteSize
			if not absPos or not absSize then
				return
			end

			local parentAbsPos, parentSize = getParentMetrics(adornee.Parent)
			local anchor = adornee.AnchorPoint or ZERO_V2
			local mousePos = raylib.lib.GetMousePosition()
			local mx, my = mousePos.x, mousePos.y

			--  Active resize
			if instance.isResizing and instance.activeHandle then
				local hDef = HANDLES[instance.activeHandle]
				local dx = mx - instance._startMouse.X
				local dy = my - instance._startMouse.Y

				-- New absolute rect edges
				local left = instance._startAbsPos.X
				local top = instance._startAbsPos.Y
				local right = left + instance._startAbsSz.X
				local bottom = top + instance._startAbsSz.Y

				if hDef.l then
					left = left + dx
				end
				if hDef.r then
					right = right + dx
				end
				if hDef.t then
					top = top + dy
				end
				if hDef.b then
					bottom = bottom + dy
				end

				-- Enforce min size
				if right - left < instance.MinSize.X then
					if hDef.l then
						left = right - instance.MinSize.X
					else
						right = left + instance.MinSize.X
					end
				end
				if bottom - top < instance.MinSize.Y then
					if hDef.t then
						top = bottom - instance.MinSize.Y
					else
						bottom = top + instance.MinSize.Y
					end
				end

				-- Clamp to screen
				if instance.RespectScreenBounds then
					local dpiScale = raylib.lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
					local screenW = raylib.lib.GetScreenWidth() / dpiScale.x
					local screenH = raylib.lib.GetScreenHeight() / dpiScale.y
					left = math.clamp(left, 0, screenW)
					top = math.clamp(top, 0, screenH)
					right = math.clamp(right, 0, screenW)
					bottom = math.clamp(bottom, 0, screenH)
				end

				local newAbsW = right - left
				local newAbsH = bottom - top

				local newRelX = (left - parentAbsPos.X) + newAbsW * anchor.X
				local newRelY = (top - parentAbsPos.Y) + newAbsH * anchor.Y
				local scaleXOff = parentSize.X * adornee.Position.X.Scale
				local scaleYOff = parentSize.Y * adornee.Position.Y.Scale

				local sScaleXOff = parentSize.X * adornee.Size.X.Scale
				local sScaleYOff = parentSize.Y * adornee.Size.Y.Scale

				local newPos = UDim2.new(
					adornee.Position.X.Scale,
					newRelX - scaleXOff,
					adornee.Position.Y.Scale,
					newRelY - scaleYOff
				)
				local newSize =
					UDim2.new(adornee.Size.X.Scale, newAbsW - sScaleXOff, adornee.Size.Y.Scale, newAbsH - sScaleYOff)
				if instance.newSizeCallback then
					instance.newSizeCallback(newSize, newPos)
				else
					adornee.Position = newPos
					adornee.Size = newSize
				end

				MouseCursor.request(CURSORS[instance.activeHandle])

				if raylib.lib.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
					instance.isResizing = false
					instance.activeHandle = nil
					MouseCursor.request(raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_DEFAULT)
				end

				return
			end

			local hoveredHandle = nil

			for key, _ in pairs(HANDLES) do
				local hr = getHandleRect(key, absPos, absSize)
				if arect.MouseIsInRect(hr) then
					hoveredHandle = key
					MouseCursor.request(CURSORS[key])

					if raylib.lib.IsMouseButtonDown(0) == 1 and not instance.isResizing then
						instance.isResizing = true
						instance.activeHandle = key
						instance._startMouse = Vector3.new(mx, my, 0)
						instance._startAbsPos = Vector2.new(absPos.X, absPos.Y)
						instance._startAbsSz = Vector2.new(absSize.X, absSize.Y)
					end

					break
				end
			end

			if not hoveredHandle then
				MouseCursor.request(raylib.const.MouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_DEFAULT)
			end
		end

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

  Code: -- description: "A modifier class that stacks GUI elements in a vertical or horizontal layout."
local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local UDim2 = require("@UDim2")

local propTable = {
	Name = "UIStackLayout",
	Enabled = true,

	-- "ZIndex" stacks by ZIndex order, "LayoutOrder" stacks by LayoutOrder
	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,

	-- Which corner/edge children anchor to when stacking
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
	VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,

	-- If true, each child fills the full parent size (classic overlay stack)
	-- If false, children keep their own size and are just layered at the alignment point
	FillParent = true,

	-- Offset applied between each layer (creates a "fanned" effect when > 0)
	LayerOffset = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),

	render = function(lib, object, dt, structs)
		if not object.Enabled then
			return
		end
		local parent = object.Parent
		if not parent then
			return
		end

		local function GetAbsoluteSize(obj)
			if obj.AbsoluteSize then
				return obj.AbsoluteSize
			end
			if obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
				return Vector2.new(lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y)
			else
				local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(obj.Parent)
				return obj.Size:ToPixels(parentSize)
			end
		end

		local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(parent)

		local totalPaddingX = 0
		local totalPaddingY = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child.ClassName == "UIPadding" then
				local px = child.Padding:ToPixels(parentSize)
				totalPaddingX = totalPaddingX + px.X
				totalPaddingY = totalPaddingY + px.Y
			end
		end

		local effectiveWidth = math.max(0, parentSize.X - totalPaddingX * 2)
		local effectiveHeight = math.max(0, parentSize.Y - totalPaddingY * 2)
		local effectiveSize = Vector2.new(effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight)

		local offsetX = object.LayerOffset.X.Scale * effectiveSize.X + object.LayerOffset.X.Offset
		local offsetY = object.LayerOffset.Y.Scale * effectiveSize.Y + object.LayerOffset.Y.Offset

		local children = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Visible and child ~= object and child.ClassName ~= "UIPadding" then
				table.insert(children, child)
			end
		end

		if object.SortOrder == Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder and #children > 1 then
			table.sort(children, function(a, b)
				return (a.LayoutOrder or 0) < (b.LayoutOrder or 0)
			end)
		elseif #children > 1 then
			-- ZIndex sort
			table.sort(children, function(a, b)
				return (a.ZIndex or 0) < (b.ZIndex or 0)
			end)
		end

		for i, child in ipairs(children) do
			rawset(child, "_LayoutControlled", true)

			local layerX = totalPaddingX + offsetX * (i - 1)
			local layerY = totalPaddingY + offsetY * (i - 1)

			if object.FillParent then
				-- Each layer fills the full effective area (offset aside)
				rawset(child, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(layerX, layerY))
			else
				-- Position child at the alignment point without resizing it
				local childSize = child.Size:ToPixels(effectiveSize)

				local x = layerX
				if object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
					x = totalPaddingX + (effectiveWidth - childSize.X) * 0.5 + offsetX * (i - 1)
				elseif object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
					x = totalPaddingX + effectiveWidth - childSize.X + offsetX * (i - 1)
				end

				local y = layerY
				if object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then
					y = totalPaddingY + (effectiveHeight - childSize.Y) * 0.5 + offsetY * (i - 1)
				elseif object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom then
					y = totalPaddingY + effectiveHeight - childSize.Y + offsetY * (i - 1)
				end

				rawset(child, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(x, y))
			end
		end
	end,
}

return {
	class = "UIStackLayout",
	render = propTable.render,
	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		return instance
	end,
}

local Vector2 = require("@Vector2")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local UDim = require("@UDim")

local propTable = {
	Name = "UITableLayout",
	Enabled = true,

	Columns = {},

	RowHeight = UDim.new(0, 40), -- height of each row (uniform)
	PaddingX = UDim.new(0, 8), -- horizontal padding inside each cell
	PaddingY = UDim.new(0, 4), -- vertical padding between rows

	SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
	VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,

	FillEmptyColumns = true,

	render = function(lib, object, dt, structs)
		if not object.Enabled then
			return
		end
		local parent = object.Parent
		if not parent then
			return
		end

		local function GetAbsoluteSize(obj)
			if obj.AbsoluteSize then
				return obj.AbsoluteSize
			end
			if obj:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				local dpiScale = lib.GetWindowScaleDPI()
				return Vector2.new(lib.GetRenderWidth() / dpiScale.x, lib.GetRenderHeight() / dpiScale.y)
			else
				local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(obj.Parent)
				return obj.Size:ToPixels(parentSize)
			end
		end

		local parentSize = GetAbsoluteSize(parent)

		local totalPaddingX = 0
		local totalPaddingY = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child.ClassName == "UIPadding" then
				local px = child.Padding:ToPixels(parentSize)
				totalPaddingX = totalPaddingX + px.X
				totalPaddingY = totalPaddingY + px.Y
			end
		end

		local effectiveWidth = math.max(0, parentSize.X - totalPaddingX * 2)
		local effectiveHeight = math.max(0, parentSize.Y - totalPaddingY * 2)
		local effectiveSize = Vector2.new(effectiveWidth, effectiveHeight)

		local padX = object.PaddingX.Scale * effectiveSize.X + object.PaddingX.Offset
		local padY = object.PaddingY.Scale * effectiveSize.Y + object.PaddingY.Offset
		local rowH = object.RowHeight.Scale * effectiveSize.Y + object.RowHeight.Offset

		local children = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Visible and child ~= object and child.ClassName ~= "UIPadding" then
				table.insert(children, child)
			end
		end

		if object.SortOrder == Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder and #children > 1 then
			table.sort(children, function(a, b)
				return (a.LayoutOrder or 0) < (b.LayoutOrder or 0)
			end)
		end

		local rows = {}
		local maxCols = 0

		for _, child in ipairs(children) do
			local cells = {}
			local subChildren = child:GetChildren()

			local visibleSubs = {}
			for _, sub in ipairs(subChildren) do
				if sub.Visible and sub.ClassName ~= "UIPadding" and sub.ClassName ~= "UITableLayout" then
					table.insert(visibleSubs, sub)
				end
			end

			if #visibleSubs > 0 then
				for _, sub in ipairs(visibleSubs) do
					table.insert(cells, sub)
				end
			else
				table.insert(cells, child)
			end

			if #cells > maxCols then
				maxCols = #cells
			end

			table.insert(rows, { container = (#visibleSubs > 0) and child or nil, cells = cells })
		end

		if maxCols == 0 then
			return
		end

		local colDefs = object.Columns or {}
		local colWidths = {}

		if #colDefs > 0 then
			local fixedTotal = 0
			local scaleTotal = 0

			for i = 1, maxCols do
				local def = colDefs[i]
				if def and def.Width then
					local w = def.Width.Scale * effectiveWidth + def.Width.Offset
					colWidths[i] = w
					if def.Width.Scale > 0 then
						scaleTotal = scaleTotal + def.Width.Scale
					else
						fixedTotal = fixedTotal + w
					end
				else
					colWidths[i] = nil
				end
			end

			local remaining = effectiveWidth - fixedTotal
			local undefinedCount = 0
			for i = 1, maxCols do
				if not colWidths[i] then
					undefinedCount = undefinedCount + 1
				end
			end
			if undefinedCount > 0 then
				local share = math.max(0, remaining / undefinedCount)
				for i = 1, maxCols do
					if not colWidths[i] then
						colWidths[i] = share
					end
				end
			end
		else
			local share = effectiveWidth / maxCols
			for i = 1, maxCols do
				colWidths[i] = share
			end
		end

		local colOffsets = {}
		local cursor = totalPaddingX

		local totalTableWidth = 0
		for i = 1, maxCols do
			totalTableWidth = totalTableWidth + (colWidths[i] or 0)
		end

		if object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
			cursor = totalPaddingX + math.max(0, (effectiveWidth - totalTableWidth) * 0.5)
		elseif object.HorizontalAlignment == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
			cursor = totalPaddingX + math.max(0, effectiveWidth - totalTableWidth)
		end

		for i = 1, maxCols do
			colOffsets[i] = cursor
			cursor = cursor + (colWidths[i] or 0)
		end

		local totalTableHeight = #rows * rowH + math.max(0, #rows - 1) * padY
		local startY = totalPaddingY

		if object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center then
			startY = totalPaddingY + math.max(0, (effectiveHeight - totalTableHeight) * 0.5)
		elseif object.VerticalAlignment == Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom then
			startY = totalPaddingY + math.max(0, effectiveHeight - totalTableHeight)
		end

		local curY = startY

		for _, row in ipairs(rows) do
			if row.container then
				rawset(row.container, "_LayoutControlled", true)
				rawset(row.container, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(colOffsets[1], curY))
				rawset(row.container, "_LayoutRowWidth", totalTableWidth)
				rawset(row.container, "_LayoutRowHeight", rowH)
			end

			-- Place each cell
			for colIndex, cell in ipairs(row.cells) do
				if colIndex > maxCols then
					break
				end

				local colX = colOffsets[colIndex]
				local colW = colWidths[colIndex] or 0

				-- Per-column horizontal alignment
				local colDef = colDefs[colIndex]
				local colAlign = (colDef and colDef.HorizontalAlignment) or object.HorizontalAlignment

				-- Cell size (use child's own size, clamped to column width minus padding)
				local cellSize = cell.Size:ToPixels(Vector2.new(colW, rowH))
				local cellW = math.min(cellSize.X, colW - padX * 2)
				local cellH = math.min(cellSize.Y, rowH)

				-- Horizontal position within column
				local cellX = colX + padX
				if colAlign == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center then
					cellX = colX + (colW - cellW) * 0.5
				elseif colAlign == Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right then
					cellX = colX + colW - cellW - padX
				end

				-- Vertical centering within row
				local cellY = curY + (rowH - cellH) * 0.5

				rawset(cell, "_LayoutControlled", true)
				rawset(cell, "_LayoutRelativePosition", Vector2.new(cellX, cellY))
			end

			curY = curY + rowH + padY
		end
	end,
}

return {
	class = "UITableLayout",
	render = propTable.render,

	callback = function(instance)
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)
		return instance
	end,
}

	class = "UniversalConstraint",

	callback = function(instance, renderer, datamodel)
		local KinemiumPhysicsService = datamodel:GetService("UnifiedPhysicsService")
		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		local _activeConstraint = nil

		local function cleanup()
			if _activeConstraint then
				KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.lib.JPH_PhysicsSystem_RemoveConstraint(
					KinemiumPhysicsService.jolt.physicsSystem,
					_activeConstraint
				)
				_activeConstraint = nil
			end
		end

		local function rebuild()
			cleanup()

			if not instance.Enabled then
				return
			end

			if not instance.Attachment0 or not instance.Attachment1 then
				return
			end

			local att0 = instance.Attachment0
			local att1 = instance.Attachment1
			local part0 = att0.Parent
			local part1 = att1.Parent

			if not part0 or not part1 then
				return
			end

			if not NetworkOwnership.ShouldSimulateConstraintForMachine(instance, datamodel) then
				return
			end

			local bodyID0 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part0)
			local bodyID1 = KinemiumPhysicsService.GetBody(part1)
			if not bodyID0 or not bodyID1 then
				task.defer(rebuild)
				return
			end

			local wPos0 = part0.CFrame * att0.Position
			local wAxisX0 = part0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.Axis):Unit()
			local wAxisY0 = part0.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att0.SecondaryAxis):Unit()

			local wPos1 = part1.CFrame * att1.Position
			local wAxisX1 = part1.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att1.Axis):Unit()
			local wAxisY1 = part1.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att1.SecondaryAxis):Unit()

			local limitR = 3.1415
			if instance.LimitsEnabled then
				limitR = math.rad(math.clamp(instance.MaxAngle, 0, 180))
			end

			_activeConstraint = KinemiumPhysicsService.CreateUniversal(
				part0,
				part1,
				wPos0,
				wAxisX0,
				wAxisY0,
				wPos1,
				wAxisX1,
				wAxisY1,
				-limitR,
				limitR,
				-limitR,
				limitR
			)

			local function onPartChanged(prop)
				if prop == "Anchored" then
					task.defer(rebuild)
				end
			end
			part0.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
			part1.Changed:Connect(onPartChanged)
		end

		local function drawGizmo()
			if not instance.Visible or not instance.Attachment0 then
				return
			end
			local att = instance.Attachment0
			local pos = att.Parent.CFrame * att.Position
			local axisZ = att.Parent.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(att.Axis:Cross(att.SecondaryAxis)):Unit()

					if magnitude > 0 then

						local endPos = position + (direction * arrowLength)

						rl.DrawCylinderEx(

							0.1,
							0.1,
							8,
							raylib.structs.Color:new({ r = 0, g = 0, b = 255, a = 255 })
						)

						rl.DrawCubeWiresV(
							vector.create(position.X, position.Y, position.Z),
							vector.create(parent.Size.X, parent.Size.Y, parent.Size.Z),
							raylib.structs.Color:new({ r = 0, g = 0, b = 255, a = 255 })
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		renderer.EventBus:Connect(function(route)
			if route == "RenderStepped" then
				if not instance.Enabled then
					return
				end
				local attach = instance.Attachment0
				if attach and attach:IsA("Attachment") then
					local parent = attach.Parent

						PhysicsService.ApplyImpulse(parent, instance.Force)

local Frame = require("@Frame")
local GuiObject = require("@GuiObject")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local utils = require("@bufferutils")
local r3d = require("@r3d")

local rlib = r3d.lib
local r3dstructs = r3d.structs

local sharedMeshlib = nil
local sharedPreloadedMeshes = nil
local sharedWorkspace = nil

local function ensurePreloaded()
	if sharedPreloadedMeshes or not sharedMeshlib then
		return
	end
	sharedPreloadedMeshes = sharedMeshlib.PreloadStandardMeshes()
end

local function resetRenderTexture(object, width, height)
	local w = math.max(1, math.floor(width or 1))
	local h = math.max(1, math.floor(height or 1))
	if object._rendertexture then
		raylib.lib.UnloadRenderTexture(object._rendertexture)
	end
	local rtx = raylib.lib.LoadRenderTexture(w, h)
	object._rendertexture = rtx
	object._rtWidth = w
	object._rtHeight = h
	local tex = utils.extract.texture(rtx)
	raylib.lib.SetTextureFilter(tex, raylib.const.TextureFilter.TEXTURE_FILTER_TRILINEAR)
	raylib.lib.SetTextureWrap(tex, raylib.const.TextureWrap.TEXTURE_WRAP_CLAMP)
end

local function getRenderableMesh(part)
	if part._mesh then
		return part._mesh
	end
	if part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.MeshObject then
		return part.MeshObject._mesh or part.MeshObject._meshgenHandle
	end
	if not sharedPreloadedMeshes or not part.Shape or not part.Shape.Value then
		return nil
	end
	local meshData = sharedPreloadedMeshes[part.Shape.Value]
	return meshData and meshData[2] or nil
end

local function buildMaterial(part)
	local materialName = part.Material and part.Material.Value
	local matData = nil
	if sharedWorkspace and sharedWorkspace.loadMaterial and materialName then
		matData = sharedWorkspace.loadMaterial(materialName)
	end
	if not matData or not matData.material then
		matData = { material = rlib.R3D_GetDefaultMaterial() }
	end

	local tmpAlbedo = buffer.create(r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size())
	buffer.copy(
		tmpAlbedo,
		0,
		matData.material,
		r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("albedo"),
		r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:size()
	)
	buffer.copy(tmpAlbedo, r3dstructs.R3D_AlbedoMap:offset("color"), part.Color:ToRaylib(part.Transparency or 0))

	local tmpMaterial = buffer.create(r3dstructs.R3D_Material:size())
	buffer.copy(tmpMaterial, 0, matData.material, 0, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:size())
	buffer.copy(tmpMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("albedo"), tmpAlbedo)
	buffer.writei32(tmpMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("transparencyMode"), 1)
	buffer.writei32(tmpMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("cullMode"), 1)

	local size = part.Size
	if size then
		buffer.writef32(tmpMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvScale"), size.X)
		buffer.writef32(tmpMaterial, r3dstructs.R3D_Material:offset("uvScale") + 4, size.Z)
	end

	return tmpMaterial
end

			end

			local framePos, frameSize = GuiObject.render(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			if not framePos or not frameSize then
				return
			end

			local width = math.max(1, math.floor(frameSize.X or 1))
			local height = math.max(1, math.floor(frameSize.Y or 1))

			local rtx = object._rendertexture
			if not rtx or object._rtWidth ~= width or object._rtHeight ~= height then
				resetRenderTexture(object, width, height)
				rtx = object._rendertexture
			end

			local camera = object.Camera
			if rtx and camera and camera._raylibcam then
				lib.BeginTextureMode(rtx)
				lib.ClearBackground(raylib.const.BLANK)
				lib.EndTextureMode()

				rlib.R3D_BeginEx(rtx, camera._raylibcam)
				for _, child in pairs(object:GetDescendants()) do
					if child.BaseClass == "BasePart" then
						if not child.CFrame or not child.Size then
							continue
						end
						local mesh = getRenderableMesh(child)
						if mesh then
							local material = buildMaterial(child)
							local matrix = child.CFrame:ToRaylibMatrixScale(child.Size, raylib.structs)
							rlib.R3D_DrawMeshPro(mesh, material, matrix)
						end
					end
				end
				rlib.R3D_End()

				local tex = utils.extract.texture(rtx)
				local source = structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = width, height = -height })
				local dest = structs.Rectangle:new({
					x = framePos.X,
					y = framePos.Y,
					width = frameSize.X,
					height = frameSize.Y,
				})

				lib.DrawTexturePro(tex, source, dest, vector.create(0, 0), 0, raylib.const.WHITE)
			end

			GuiObject.renderChildren(lib, object, dt, structs, renderer)
			return framePos, frameSize
		end

		instance:SetProperties(propTable)

		resetRenderTexture(instance, 1, 1)

		instance.Changed:Connect(function(prop)
			if prop == "Size" then
				local AbsoluteSize = instance.AbsoluteSize
				if AbsoluteSize then
					resetRenderTexture(instance, AbsoluteSize.X or 1, AbsoluteSize.Y or 1)
				end
			end
		end)

		instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
			if instance._rendertexture then
				raylib.lib.UnloadRenderTexture(instance._rendertexture)
				instance._rendertexture = nil
			end
		end)

		return instance
	end,

	inherit = function(tble)
		for prop, val in pairs(propTable) do
			if tble[prop] then
				continue
			end
			tble[prop] = val
		end
	end,
}

local BlobLoader = Instance.new("BlobLoader")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

BlobLoader.ExplorerHidden = true
BlobLoader._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.FFI

BlobLoader.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	local function byteAt(data, index)
		if type(data) == "buffer" then
			return buffer.readu8(data, index - 1)
		elseif type(data) == "string" then
			return string.byte(data, index)
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function dataLength(data)
		if type(data) == "buffer" then
			return buffer.len(data)
		elseif type(data) == "string" then
			return #data
		end
		return 0
	end

	local function fingerprintBlob(data)
		local len = dataLength(data)
		local hash = 5381
		local step = math.max(1, math.floor(len / 4096))
		for i = 1, len, step do
			local byte = byteAt(data, i) or 0
			hash = ((hash * 33) + byte) % 2147483647
		end
		return `{len}:{hash}`
	end

	local function markBlobTree(root, fingerprint)
		if not root or root.SetMetadata == nil then
			return
		end

		root:SetMetadata("__blobFingerprint", fingerprint)
		for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant.SetMetadata then
				descendant:SetMetadata("__blobFingerprint", fingerprint)
			end
		end
	end

	local function assignBlobNetworkIds(instances)
		local nextBlobNetId = 100
		local reserved = {
			DataModel = 0,
			Workspace = 1,
			Players = 2,
			ReplicatedStorage = 3,
			StarterGui = 4,
			CoreGui = 5,
			InternalStorage = 6,
		}

		local function assign(object)
			if object.NetworkId ~= nil then
				if type(object.NetworkId) == "number" and object.NetworkId >= nextBlobNetId then
					nextBlobNetId = object.NetworkId + 1
				end
				return
			end

			local reservedId = reserved[object.ClassName]
			if reservedId ~= nil then
				object.NetworkId = reservedId
				return
			end

			object.NetworkId = nextBlobNetId
			nextBlobNetId += 1
		end

		for _, root in ipairs(instances or {}) do
			assign(root)
			for _, descendant in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				assign(descendant)
			end
		end
	end

	local function beginReplicationSuppression()
		if datamodel.SetMetadata == nil or IsServer ~= true then
			return
		end

		local count = datamodel:GetMetadata("__replicatorSuppressRuntimeCreate") or 0
		datamodel:SetMetadata("__replicatorSuppressRuntimeCreate", count + 1)
	end

	local function endReplicationSuppression()
		if datamodel.SetMetadata == nil or IsServer ~= true then
			return
		end

		local count = math.max((datamodel:GetMetadata("__replicatorSuppressRuntimeCreate") or 0) - 1, 0)
		datamodel:SetMetadata("__replicatorSuppressRuntimeCreate", count)
	end

	-- Classes that should never be merged or attached from a blob.
	-- Camera is client-side only; merging serialized props corrupts it.
	local SKIP_BLOB_CLASSES = {
		Camera = true,
	}

	local MERGE_SINGLETON_CHILDREN = {
		Workspace = {
			Terrain = true,
			Camera = true,
		},
	}

	local SKIP_MERGED_PROPS = {
		AncestryChanged = true,
		BaseClass = true,
		Changed = true,
		ChildAdded = true,
		ChildRemoved = true,
		Children = true,
		ClassName = true,
		DescendantAdded = true,
		DescendantChanged = true,
		DescendantRemoving = true,
		Destroying = true,
		NetworkId = true,
		Parent = true,
		UniqueId = true,
		_childByName = true,
		_parentID = true,
		attributes = true,
		tags = true,
	}

	local function mergeProps(source, target)
		local props = rawget(source, "_props")
		if not props then
			return
		end

		for key, value in pairs(props) do
			if not SKIP_MERGED_PROPS[key] then
				pcall(function()
					target[key] = value
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	local function attachChildren(sourceRoot, targetRoot)
		for _, child in ipairs(sourceRoot:GetChildren()) do
			-- Preserve singleton children that already exist in the live service.
			-- Camera is handled here so the live singleton is kept and the blob copy
			-- is discarded without destroying the real one.
			local singletonChildren = MERGE_SINGLETON_CHILDREN[targetRoot.ClassName]
			local childName = child.Name
			local existing = singletonChildren
				and singletonChildren[child.ClassName]
				and targetRoot:FindFirstChild(childName)
			if existing and existing.ClassName == child.ClassName then
				if child.ClassName ~= "Camera" then
					mergeProps(child, existing)
				end
				child:Destroy()
				print("Merged ", childName)
				continue
			end

			-- Skip classes that should never be replicated/merged (e.g. Camera outside Workspace)
			if SKIP_BLOB_CLASSES[child.ClassName] then
				child:Destroy()
				print("Skipped (non-replicable) ", child.Name)
				continue
			end

			child.Parent = targetRoot
			print("Attached ", childName)
		end
	end

	local function mergeServiceSnapshot(serviceSnapshot)
		local ok, liveService = pcall(function()
			return datamodel:GetService(serviceSnapshot.Name)
		end)
		if ok and liveService then
			attachChildren(serviceSnapshot, liveService)
			return liveService
		end
		return nil
	end

	BlobLoader:SetProperties({
		MarkBlobLoadingPending = function()
			if datamodel.SetMetadata then
				datamodel:SetMetadata("__blobLoading", true)
			end
		end,

		LoadFileAsGame = function(binary)
			task.spawn(function()
				if datamodel.SetMetadata then
					datamodel:SetMetadata("__blobLoading", true)
				end
				local SerializationService = datamodel:GetService("SerializationService")
				local instances = SerializationService.Deserialize(binary, nil, true)
				print("[DEBUG] Deserialized instances. Root count:", instances and #instances or "nil")
				if not instances then
					if datamodel.SetMetadata then
						datamodel:SetMetadata("__blobLoading", false)
					end
					return false
				end
				local blobFingerprint = fingerprintBlob(binary)
				if datamodel.SetMetadata then
					datamodel:SetMetadata("__blobFingerprint", blobFingerprint)
				end
				assignBlobNetworkIds(instances)
				for _, root in ipairs(instances) do
					markBlobTree(root, blobFingerprint)
				end
				beginReplicationSuppression()
				local ok, err = pcall(function()
					for _, root in ipairs(instances) do
						if root.ClassName == "DataModel" then
							for _, serviceSnapshot in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
								if not mergeServiceSnapshot(serviceSnapshot) then
									log(
										"BlobLoader: no live service found for '"
											.. tostring(serviceSnapshot.Name)
											.. "'"
									)
								end
							end
						else
							print("[DEBUG] Merging root:", root.Name)
							local liveService = mergeServiceSnapshot(root)
							if not liveService then
								print("[DEBUG] Parenting root to Workspace:", root.Name)
								root.Parent = datamodel:GetService("Workspace") or datamodel
								print("[DEBUG] Parented root to Workspace:", root.Name)
							end
						end
					end
				end)
				endReplicationSuppression()
				if not ok then
					warn("BlobLoader: failed to merge blob: " .. tostring(err))
					if datamodel.SetMetadata then
						datamodel:SetMetadata("__blobLoading", false)
					end
					return false
				end
				if datamodel.SetMetadata then
					datamodel:SetMetadata("__blobLoading", false)
				end
				print("[DEBUG] Finished parenting all roots")
			end)

			return datamodel
		end,

		LoadFileAsGameFetch = function(link)
			local _1GB = 1024 * 1024 * 1024
			local ContentService = datamodel:GetService("ContentService")
			local binary = ContentService:GetBinary(link, _1GB)
			local new = BlobLoader.LoadFileAsGame(binary)
			return new
		end,
	})
end

return BlobLoader

-- ============================================================================
-- FFI helpers
-- ============================================================================

local function makeI32(value)
	local ptr = zune.ffi.create(zune.ffi.types.i32)
	ptr:writei32(0, value)
	return ptr
end

local function makeVec2(x, y)
	local grav = bufferUtils:vector2_32(x, y)
	return grav, zune.ffi.ptrFromAddress(grav)
end

local function makeRot(angleRad)
	local rot = box2d.structs.b2Rot:new({
		s = math.sin(angleRad),
		c = math.cos(angleRad),
	})
	return rot, zune.ffi.ptrFromAddress(rot)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- Object helpers
-- ============================================================================

local function getParentAbsPos(object)
	local parent = object.Parent
	if not parent then
		return 0, 0
	end
	if parent.AbsolutePosition then
		return parent.AbsolutePosition.X or 0, parent.AbsolutePosition.Y or 0
	end
	if parent.RenderOffset then
		return parent.RenderOffset.X or 0, parent.RenderOffset.Y or 0
	end
	return 0, 0
end

local function getAnchor(object)
	local anchor = object.AnchorPoint
	if not anchor then
		return 0, 0
	end
	return anchor.X or 0, anchor.Y or 0
end

-- ============================================================================
-- Shape material
-- ============================================================================

local function applyShapeMaterial(object, shapeDef)
	if not shapeDef or shapeDef == zune.ffi.null then
		return
	end

	local density = object.Density
	if density ~= nil then
		shapeDef:writef32(box2d.structs.b2ShapeDef:offset("density"), density)
	end

	local friction = object.Friction
	if friction ~= nil then
		local offset = box2d.structs.b2ShapeDef:offset("material") + box2d.structs.b2SurfaceMaterial:offset("friction")
		shapeDef:writef32(offset, friction)
	end

	local restitution = object.Restitution
	if restitution ~= nil then
		local offset = box2d.structs.b2ShapeDef:offset("material")
			+ box2d.structs.b2SurfaceMaterial:offset("restitution")
		shapeDef:writef32(offset, restitution)
	end

	if object.IsSensor ~= nil then
		shapeDef:writeu8(box2d.structs.b2ShapeDef:offset("isSensor"), object.IsSensor and 1 or 0)
	end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- Body lifecycle
-- ============================================================================

local function createBody(object, worldData)
	if not object.AbsoluteSize then
		return
	end

	local x = object.AbsoluteSize.X
	local y = object.AbsoluteSize.Y
	local motionType = object.Anchored == false and 2 or 0

	local posX = object.AbsolutePosition.X + x / 2
	local posY = object.AbsolutePosition.Y + y / 2

	local _, positionPtr = makeVec2(posX, posY)
	local _, rotationPtr = makeRot(math.rad(object.Rotation or 0))
	local motionPtr = makeI32(motionType)

	local bodyDef = box2d.lib.b2DefaultBodyDef()
	bodyDef:writeptr(box2d.structs.b2BodyDef:offset("position"), positionPtr)
	bodyDef:writeptr(box2d.structs.b2BodyDef:offset("rotation"), rotationPtr)
	bodyDef:writeptr(box2d.structs.b2BodyDef:offset("type"), motionPtr)

	local allowSleep = worldData.object.AllowSleep
	if allowSleep == nil then
		allowSleep = worldData.object.enableSleep
	end
	bodyDef:writeu8(box2d.structs.b2BodyDef:offset("enableSleep"), allowSleep and 1 or 0)
	bodyDef:writeu8(box2d.structs.b2BodyDef:offset("isAwake"), 1)
	bodyDef:writeu8(box2d.structs.b2BodyDef:offset("isEnabled"), 1)

	local bodyID = box2d.lib.b2CreateBody(worldData.worldId, bodyDef)
	if bodyID == zune.ffi.null then
		return
	end

	local box = box2d.lib.b2MakeBox(x / 2, y / 2)
	local shapeDef = box2d.lib.b2DefaultShapeDef()
	applyShapeMaterial(object, shapeDef)
	local shapeID = box2d.lib.b2CreatePolygonShape(bodyID, shapeDef, box)

	object.BodyID = bodyID

	local data = {
		bodyID = bodyID,
		shapeID = shapeID,
		box = box,
		bodyDef = bodyDef,
		motionType = motionType,
		object = object,
		world = worldData,
		lastW = x,
		lastH = y,
	}

	bodies[object] = data
	return data
end

local function updateBodyShape(bodyData)
	local object = bodyData.object
	if not object or not object.AbsoluteSize then
		return false
	end

	local x = object.AbsoluteSize.X
	local y = object.AbsoluteSize.Y

	if bodyData.lastW == x and bodyData.lastH == y then
		return false
	end

	bodyData.lastW = x
	bodyData.lastH = y

	if bodyData.shapeID == zune.ffi.null then
		return false
	end

	local box = box2d.lib.b2MakeBox(x / 2, y / 2)
	bodyData.box = box

	if box2d.lib.b2Shape_SetPolygon then
		box2d.lib.b2Shape_SetPolygon(bodyData.shapeID, box)
	end

	if box2d.lib.b2Body_ApplyMassFromShapes and bodyData.motionType == 2 then
		box2d.lib.b2Body_ApplyMassFromShapes(bodyData.bodyID)
	end

	return true
end

local function syncBodyFromObject(bodyData)
	local object = bodyData.object
	if not object or not object.AbsolutePosition or not object.AbsoluteSize then
		return false
	end

	local x = object.AbsolutePosition.X + object.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
	local y = object.AbsolutePosition.Y + object.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
	local _, posPtr = makeVec2(x, y)
	local _, rotPtr = makeRot(math.rad(object.Rotation or 0))

	box2d.lib.b2Body_SetTransform(bodyData.bodyID, posPtr, rotPtr)
	return true
end

local function updateObjectFromBody(bodyData)
	local object = bodyData.object
	if not object or not object.AbsoluteSize then
		return
	end

	local pos = box2d.lib.b2Body_GetPosition(bodyData.bodyID)
	if pos == zune.ffi.null then
		return
	end

	local x = pos:readf32(0)
	local y = pos:readf32(4)

	local sizeX = object.AbsoluteSize.X
	local sizeY = object.AbsoluteSize.Y

	local parentAbsX, parentAbsY = getParentAbsPos(object)
	local anchorX, anchorY = getAnchor(object)

	local topLeftX = x - sizeX / 2
	local topLeftY = y - sizeY / 2

	local posX = topLeftX - parentAbsX + sizeX * anchorX
	local posY = topLeftY - parentAbsY + sizeY * anchorY

	local newPosition = UDim2.new(object.Position.X.Scale, posX, object.Position.Y.Scale, posY)
	bodyData._ignoreChanges = true
	bodyData.world.body_update(object, newPosition)

	local rot = box2d.lib.b2Body_GetRotation(bodyData.bodyID)
	if rot ~= zune.ffi.null and object.Rotation ~= nil then
		local s = rot:readf32(0)
		local c = rot:readf32(4)
		object.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(s, c))
	end
	bodyData._ignoreChanges = false
end

-- ============================================================================
-- Body type & property changes
-- ============================================================================

local function setBodyType(bodyData, anchored)
	local newType = anchored == false and 2 or 0
	if bodyData.motionType == newType then
		return
	end
	bodyData.motionType = newType
	if box2d.lib.b2Body_SetType then
		box2d.lib.b2Body_SetType(bodyData.bodyID, makeI32(newType))
	end
	if box2d.lib.b2Body_SetAwake then
		box2d.lib.b2Body_SetAwake(bodyData.bodyID, 1)
	end
	if anchored == true then
		syncBodyFromObject(bodyData)
	end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- World body management
-- ============================================================================

local function destroyBody(worldData, object)
	local bodyData = worldData.bodies[object]
	if not bodyData then
		return
	end

	if bodyData.connection then
		bodyData.connection:Disconnect()
	end
	if bodyData.destroyConnection then
		bodyData.destroyConnection:Disconnect()
	end

	if bodyData.bodyID ~= zune.ffi.null then
		box2d.lib.b2DestroyBody(bodyData.bodyID)
	end

	worldData.bodies[object] = nil
	if worldData.object and worldData.object.Bodies then
		worldData.object.Bodies[object] = nil
	end
	bodies[object] = nil

	if object then
		object.BodyID = nil
	end
end

local function registerBody(worldData, object)
	if not object then
		return false
	end
	if object == worldData.object then
		return false
	end
	if object.BaseClass == "UIContainer" then
		return false
	end
	if object.Parent ~= worldData.object then
		return false
	end
	if worldData.bodies[object] then
		return true
	end

	-- Can't register yet if AbsoluteSize hasn't been computed by the renderer
	if not object.AbsoluteSize then
		return false
	end

	local bodyData = createBody(object, worldData)
	if not bodyData then
		return false
	end

	worldData.bodies[object] = bodyData

	if worldData.object and worldData.object.Bodies then
		worldData.object.Bodies[object] = true
	end

	bodyData.connection = object.Changed:Connect(function(property)
		if bodyData._ignoreChanges then
			return
		end

		if property == "Anchored" then
			setBodyType(bodyData, object.Anchored)
		elseif property == "Size" then
			bodyData._shapeDirty = true
		elseif property == "Position" or property == "Rotation" or property == "AnchorPoint" then
			bodyData._transformDirty = true
		elseif
			property == "Density"
			or property == "Friction"
			or property == "Restitution"
			or property == "IsSensor"
		then
			bodyData._shapeDirty = true
		end
	end)

	bodyData.destroyConnection = object.Destroying:Connect(function()
		destroyBody(worldData, object)
	end)

	return true
end

local function clearWorldBodies(worldData)
	local toRemove = {}
	for object in pairs(worldData.bodies) do
		table.insert(toRemove, object)
	end
	for _, object in ipairs(toRemove) do
		destroyBody(worldData, object)
	end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- Per-frame body sync (shared between manual Step and RenderStepped)
-- ============================================================================

local function processWorld(worldData)
	-- Flush pending children whose AbsoluteSize is now available
	if worldData.pendingChildren then
		local stillPending = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(worldData.pendingChildren) do
			if child.Parent ~= worldData.object then
				-- removed before it could be registered, skip
			elseif not registerBody(worldData, child) then
				table.insert(stillPending, child)
			end
		end
		worldData.pendingChildren = stillPending
	end

	-- Sync registered bodies
	for _, body in pairs(worldData.bodies) do
		if body._shapeDirty then
			if updateBodyShape(body) then
				body._shapeDirty = false
			end
		end
		if body._transformDirty then
			if syncBodyFromObject(body) then
				body._transformDirty = false
			end
		end

		if body.object and body.object.Anchored == true then
			syncBodyFromObject(body)
		else
			updateObjectFromBody(body)
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- World settings
-- ============================================================================

local function resolveAllowSleep(worldObject)
	local allowSleep = worldObject.AllowSleep
	if allowSleep == nil then
		allowSleep = worldObject.enableSleep
	end
	return allowSleep
end

local function applyWorldSettings(worldData, property)
	local worldObject = worldData.object

	if property == "Gravity" or property == nil then
		local _, gravPtr = makeVec2(worldObject.Gravity.X or 0, worldObject.Gravity.Y or 981)
		box2d.lib.b2World_SetGravity(worldData.worldId, gravPtr)
	end

	if property == "enableSleep" or property == "AllowSleep" or property == nil then
		if box2d.lib.b2World_EnableSleeping then
			box2d.lib.b2World_EnableSleeping(worldData.worldId, resolveAllowSleep(worldObject) and 1 or 0)
		end
	end

	if property == "enableContinuous" or property == nil then
		if box2d.lib.b2World_EnableContinuous then
			box2d.lib.b2World_EnableContinuous(worldData.worldId, worldObject.enableContinuous and 1 or 0)
		end
	end

	if property == "restitutionThreshold" or property == nil then
		if box2d.lib.b2World_SetRestitutionThreshold then
			box2d.lib.b2World_SetRestitutionThreshold(worldData.worldId, worldObject.restitutionThreshold or 1.0)
		end
	end

	if property == "hitEventThreshold" or property == nil then
		if box2d.lib.b2World_SetHitEventThreshold then
			box2d.lib.b2World_SetHitEventThreshold(worldData.worldId, worldObject.hitEventThreshold or 0.0)
		end
	end

	if property == "maximumLinearSpeed" or property == nil then
		if box2d.lib.b2World_SetMaximumLinearSpeed then
			box2d.lib.b2World_SetMaximumLinearSpeed(worldData.worldId, worldObject.maximumLinearSpeed or 4000.0)
		end
	end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- InitRenderer (public entry point)
-- ============================================================================

Box2DService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, game)
	Box2DService:SetProperties({
		lib = renderer.lib,
		const = renderer.const,
		structs = renderer.structs,

		init = function(World2D, body_update)
			local _, gravPtr = makeVec2(World2D.Gravity.X or 0, World2D.Gravity.Y or 981)

			local motionLocks = World2D.MotionLocks or {}
			local enableSleep = resolveAllowSleep(World2D)

			local wdef = box2d.structs.b2WorldDef:new({
				gravity = gravPtr,
				restitutionThreshold = World2D.restitutionThreshold or 1.0,
				hitEventThreshold = World2D.hitEventThreshold or 0.0,
				contactHertz = World2D.contactHertz or 60.0,
				contactDampingRatio = World2D.contactDampingRatio or 1.0,
				maxContactPushSpeed = World2D.maxContactPushSpeed or 3.0,
				maximumLinearSpeed = World2D.maximumLinearSpeed or 40.0,
				frictionCallback = zune.ffi.null,
				restitutionCallback = zune.ffi.null,
				enableSleep = enableSleep and 1 or 0,
				motionLocks = box2d.structs.b2MotionLocks:new({
					linearX = motionLocks.LinearX or false,
					linearY = motionLocks.LinearY or false,
					angularZ = motionLocks.AngularZ or false,
				}),
				enableContinuous = World2D.enableContinuous and 1 or 0,
				workerCount = World2D.workerCount or 0,
				enqueueTask = zune.ffi.null,
				finishTask = zune.ffi.null,
				userTaskContext = zune.ffi.null,
				userData = zune.ffi.null,
				internalValue = 0x5A55A5A5,
			})

			local worldId = box2d.lib.b2CreateWorld(wdef)
			if worldId == zune.ffi.null then
				error("Failed to create Box2D world")
			end

			local world_data = {
				worldId = worldId,
				object = World2D,
				body_update = body_update,
				bodies = {},
				connections = {},
				pendingChildren = {},
			}

			-- Replace previous world if re-initialized
			local previous = worldsByObject[World2D]
			if previous then
				clearWorldBodies(previous)
				if previous.connections then
					for _, connection in pairs(previous.connections) do
						connection:Disconnect()
					end
				end
				if previous.worldId and previous.worldId ~= zune.ffi.null then
					box2d.lib.b2DestroyWorld(previous.worldId)
				end
				for i, w in pairs(worlds) do
					if w.object == World2D then
						worlds[i] = world_data
						break
					end
				end
			else
				table.insert(worlds, world_data)
			end

			worldsByObject[World2D] = world_data
			World2D._world = world_data

			-- Register existing children (queue those not yet renderable)
			for _, child in pairs(World2D:GetChildren()) do
				if
					not registerBody(world_data, child)
					and child.Parent == World2D
					and child.BaseClass ~= "UIContainer"
				then
					table.insert(world_data.pendingChildren, child)
				end
			end

			-- Listen for new / removed children
			world_data.connections.childAdded = World2D.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if
					not registerBody(world_data, child)
					and child.Parent == World2D
					and child.BaseClass ~= "UIContainer"
				then
					table.insert(world_data.pendingChildren, child)
				end
			end)

			world_data.connections.childRemoved = World2D.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
				destroyBody(world_data, child)
			end)

			-- React to world property changes
			world_data.connections.changed = World2D.Changed:Connect(function(property)
				applyWorldSettings(world_data, property)
			end)

			applyWorldSettings(world_data)

			-- Public API on the World2D object
			World2D.AddBody = function(_, body)
				if body and body.Parent ~= world_data.object then
					body.Parent = world_data.object
				end
				registerBody(world_data, body)
			end

			World2D.RemoveBody = function(_, body)
				destroyBody(world_data, body)
			end

			World2D.Clear = function()
				clearWorldBodies(world_data)
			end

			World2D.Step = function(_, dt)
				if not dt or dt <= 0 then
					return
				end
				box2d.lib.b2World_Step(world_data.worldId, dt, world_data.object.VelocityIterations or 4)
				world_data.object.ElapsedTime += dt
				processWorld(world_data)
			end

			return worldId
		end,
	})

	-- Automatic stepping on RenderStepped
	renderer_signal:Connect(function(route, dt)
		if route ~= "RenderStepped" then
			return
		end

		for _, world in pairs(worlds) do
			local worldObject = world.object
			if worldObject.Paused then
				continue
			end

			local scale = worldObject.TimeScale or 1
			local stepDt = (worldObject.FixedDeltaTime or dt) * scale
			if stepDt <= 0 then
				continue
			end

			if worldObject.FixedDeltaTime and worldObject.FixedDeltaTime > 0 then
				worldObject.Accumulator = (worldObject.Accumulator or 0) + dt * scale
				local maxSteps = 8
				local steps = 0
				while worldObject.Accumulator >= worldObject.FixedDeltaTime do
					box2d.lib.b2World_Step(
						world.worldId,
						worldObject.FixedDeltaTime,
						worldObject.VelocityIterations or 4
					)
					worldObject.Accumulator -= worldObject.FixedDeltaTime
					worldObject.ElapsedTime += worldObject.FixedDeltaTime
					steps += 1
					if steps >= maxSteps then
						worldObject.Accumulator = 0
						break
					end
				end
			else
				box2d.lib.b2World_Step(world.worldId, stepDt, worldObject.VelocityIterations or 4)
				worldObject.ElapsedTime += stepDt
			end

			processWorld(world)
		end
	end)

	-- Cleanup on shutdown
	table.insert(game.ShutdownCallbacks, function()
		for _, world in pairs(worlds) do
			clearWorldBodies(world)
			box2d.lib.b2DestroyWorld(world.worldId)
		end
		bodies = {}
		worlds = {}
		worldsByObject = {}
	end)
end

return Box2DService

local CollectionService = Instance.new("CollectionService")

local objectTags = {} -- [object] = {tag1 = true, tag2 = true}
local tagObjects = {} -- [tag] = {object = true, ...}
local tagSignals = {} -- [tag] = {added = Signal, removed = Signal}
local allTags = {} -- [tag] = true

local function getOrCreateTagSignal(tag)
	if not tagSignals[tag] then
		tagSignals[tag] = {
			added = signal.new(),
			removed = signal.new(),
		}
	end
	return tagSignals[tag]
end

local function addTagToObject(object, tag)
	objectTags[object] = objectTags[object] or {}
	if objectTags[object][tag] then
		return
	end -- already has tag
	objectTags[object][tag] = true

	tagObjects[tag] = tagObjects[tag] or {}
	tagObjects[tag][object] = true

	allTags[tag] = true

	local signals = getOrCreateTagSignal(tag)
	signals.added:Fire(object)
end

local function removeTagFromObject(object, tag)
	if not objectTags[object] or not objectTags[object][tag] then
		return
	end
	objectTags[object][tag] = nil

	if tagObjects[tag] then
		tagObjects[tag][object] = nil
		if next(tagObjects[tag]) == nil then
			tagObjects[tag] = nil
			allTags[tag] = nil
		end
	end

	local signals = getOrCreateTagSignal(tag)
	signals.removed:Fire(object)
end

CollectionService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, game)
	CollectionService:SetProperties({
		AddTag = addTagToObject,

		RemoveTag = removeTagFromObject,

		GetTags = function(object)
			local tags = {}
			if objectTags[object] then
				for tag in pairs(objectTags[object]) do
					table.insert(tags, tag)
				end
			end
			return tags
		end,

		GetAllTags = function()
			local tags = {}
			for tag in pairs(allTags) do
				table.insert(tags, tag)
			end
			return tags
		end,

		GetTagged = function(tag)
			local objs = {}
			if tagObjects[tag] then
				for obj in pairs(tagObjects[tag]) do
					table.insert(objs, obj)
				end
			end
			return objs
		end,

		HasTag = function(object, tag)
			return objectTags[object] and objectTags[object][tag] == true or false
		end,

		GetInstanceAddedSignal = function(tag)
			return getOrCreateTagSignal(tag).added
		end,

		GetInstanceRemovedSignal = function(tag)
			return getOrCreateTagSignal(tag).removed
		end,
	})
end

return CollectionService

local Instance = require("@Instance")

local ContentService = Instance.new("GuiStackService")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

ContentService.ExplorerHidden = true
ContentService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.Network

local net = zune.net
local fs = zune.fs
local raylib = require("@raylib")

local function request(url: string, options: any, bytes: boolean)
	local res = net.http.request(url, options, bytes)
	if res.status_code == 301 or res.status_code == 302 then
		local loc = res.headers["location"]
		if not loc then
			error("HTTP redirect without Location header")
		end
		return request(loc, options, bytes)
	end
	return res
end

local function hash(str: string): string
	local h = 2166136261

	for i = 1, #str do
		h = bit32.bxor(h, string.byte(str, i))
		h = (h * 16777619) % 2 ^ 32
	end

	return string.format("%08x", h)
end

local function getExtension(url: string)
	return url:match("%.([a-zA-Z0-9]+)$") or "bin"
end

ContentService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal)
	ContentService:SetProperties({
		Hash = hash,
	})

	function ContentService:GetBinary(url, maxSize)
		local res = request(url, {
			method = "GET",
			headers = { ["Accept"] = "application/octet-stream, */*" },
			max_body_size = maxSize or (50 * 1024 * 1024),
		}, true)

		if not res.ok then
			error(`Download failed ({res.status_code})`)
		end

		return res.body
	end

	function ContentService:Get(url, maxSize)
		local id = hash(url)
		local ext = getExtension(url)
		local dest = "./src/cache/" .. id .. "." .. ext

		-- cache folder
		if fs.stat("./src/cache").kind == "none" then
			fs.makeDir("./src/cache")
		end

		-- check file cache
		if fs.stat(dest).kind ~= "none" then
			return fs.readFile(dest)
		end

		-- download
		local res = request(url, {
			method = "GET",
			headers = { ["Accept"] = "application/octet-stream, */*" },
			max_body_size = maxSize or (50 * 1024 * 1024),
		}, true)

		if not res.ok then
			error(`Download failed ({res.status_code})`)
		end

		fs.writeFile(dest, res.body :: buffer)
		return res.body
	end

	renderer_signal:Connect(function(route, dt) end)
end

return ContentService

		end
	end

	end

		if type(parameterName) ~= "string" then
			return
		end
		-- value is a variant, basically Any
		CoreGui.CoreGuiChangedSignal:Fire(parameterName, value)

		cores_registry[parameterName] = value
	end

	function CoreGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(coreGuiType)
		if coreGuiType.Name then
			return coreGuiTypes[coreGuiType.Name]
		end
		return false
	end

		if type(child) == "table" and child.BaseClass == "UIContainer" then
			if child["render"] then

				renderId = renderer.Pool.new("2d", function()
					if not child.render then
						renderer.Pool.Destroy(renderId)
						return
					end
					local dt = renderer.Raylib.lib.GetFrameTime()
					child.render(renderer.Raylib.lib, child, dt, renderer.Raylib.structs, renderer, datamodel)
				end, -5)
			end
		end
	end)

local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")

local DebrisService = Instance.new("Debris")
DebrisService.ExplorerHidden = true

local ObjectRemoved = signal.new()

local trackedItems = {}

function DebrisService:AddItem(object, lifetime)
	lifetime = lifetime or 5
	trackedItems[object] = {
		ExpireTime = os.clock() + lifetime,
	}
end

function DebrisService:RemoveItem(object)
	trackedItems[object] = nil
end

DebrisService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	DebrisService:SetProperties({
		AddItem = DebrisService.AddItem,
		RemoveItem = DebrisService.RemoveItem,
		ObjectRemoved = ObjectRemoved,
	})

	renderer_signal:Connect(function(route, dt)
		if route ~= "Heartbeat" then
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		for object, info in pairs(trackedItems) do
			if not object or object.Parent == nil then
				trackedItems[object] = nil
			elseif now >= info.ExpireTime then
				if object.Destroy then
					object:Destroy()
				else
					object.Parent = nil
				end
				ObjectRemoved:Fire(object)
				trackedItems[object] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

	EncodingService:SetProperties({
		Base64Encode = function(data)
			return serde.base64.encode(data)
		end,

		Base64Decode = function(buf)
			return serde.base64.decode(buf)
		end,

		GetDecompressedBufferSize = function(input, algorithim)
			local decompressed = EncodingService.DecompressBuffer(input, algorithim)
			return buffer.len(decompressed)
		end,

			local secret = buffer.tostring(input)
			if algorithim == Enum.HashAlgorithm.Blake2b then

			elseif algorithim == Enum.HashAlgorithm.Blake3 then
				return crypto.createHash("blake3", secret)
			elseif algorithim == Enum.HashAlgorithm.Md5 then
				return crypto.createHash("md5", secret)
			elseif algorithim == Enum.HashAlgorithm.Sha1 then
				return crypto.createHash("sha1", secret)
			elseif algorithim == Enum.HashAlgorithm.Sha256 then
				return crypto.createHash("sha256", secret)
			end
		end,

		CompressBuffer = function(buf, algorithim, compressionLevel: number)
			if algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd then
				return serde.zstd.compress(buf, { level = compressionLevel })
			elseif algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zlib then
				return serde.zlib.compress(buf, { level = compressionLevel })
			elseif algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.lz4 then
				return serde.lz4.compress(buf, { level = compressionLevel })
			elseif algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.flate then
				return serde.flate.compress(buf, { level = compressionLevel })
			elseif algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.brotli then
				return serde.brotli.compress(buf, { level = compressionLevel })
			end
		end,

		DecompressBuffer = function(buf, algorithim)
			if algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zstd then
				return serde.zstd.decompress(buf)
			elseif algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.Zlib then
				return serde.zlib.decompress(buf)
			elseif algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.lz4 then

			elseif algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.flate then

			elseif algorithim == Enum.CompressionAlgorithm.brotli then

  Code: local Instance = require("@Instance")
local BufferUtils = require("@bufferutils")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local FileDialogService = Instance.new("FileDialogService")
FileDialogService.ExplorerHidden = true
FileDialogService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.Filesystem

local ffi = zune.ffi

FileDialogService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal)
	local nfd = require("@nfd")
	local lib = nfd.lib
	local structs = nfd.structs

	local function stringToOSPtr(str)
		if zune.platform.os ~= "windows" then
			return BufferUtils.stringToPtr(str)
		end

		local utf16 = buffer.create((#str + 1) * 2)
		local i = 0
		for _, code in utf8.codes(str) do
			buffer.writeu16(utf16, i, code)
			i += 2
		end
		buffer.writeu16(utf16, i, 0)
		return ffi.dupe(utf16)
	end

	local function buildFilterList(filters)
		if type(filters) ~= "table" or #filters == 0 then
			return nil, nil
		end

		local items = {}
		for _, filter in ipairs(filters) do
			local name = tostring(filter.name or "Files")
			local exts = filter.extensions or {}
			local parts = {}
			for _, ext in ipairs(exts) do
				ext = tostring(ext or "")
				if ext == "*" or ext == ".*" then
					parts = { "*" }
					break
				end
				if ext:sub(1, 1) == "." then
					ext = ext:sub(2)
				end
				if ext ~= "" then
					table.insert(parts, ext)
				end
			end
			local spec = table.concat(parts, ",")
			if spec ~= "" then
				table.insert(items, { name = name, spec = spec })
			end
		end

		if #items == 0 then
			return nil, nil
		end

		local itemSize = structs.nfdnfilteritem_t:size()
		local itemAlign = structs.nfdnfilteritem_t:alignment()
		local listPtr = ffi.alloc(itemSize * #items, itemAlign)
		for i, item in ipairs(items) do
			local namePtr = stringToOSPtr(item.name)
			local specPtr = stringToOSPtr(item.spec)
			local base = (i - 1) * itemSize
			listPtr:writeptr(base + structs.nfdnfilteritem_t:offset("name"), namePtr)
			listPtr:writeptr(base + structs.nfdnfilteritem_t:offset("spec"), specPtr)
		end

		return listPtr, #items
	end

	lib.NFD_Init()

	FileDialogService:SetProperties({
		RequestFile = function(filters)
			local outPath = ffi.alloc(ffi.types.pointer:size())
			local filterList, filterCount = buildFilterList(filters)
			local success: FFIPointer = lib.NFD_OpenDialogN(outPath, filterList, filterCount or 0, nil)
			local code = BufferUtils:readhexa(success)
			if code == 2 then
				return ""
			end
			return BufferUtils.string.ReadOSBased(outPath)
		end,

		RequestFolder = function(filters)
			local outPath = ffi.alloc(ffi.types.pointer:size())
			local success: FFIPointer = lib.NFD_PickFolderN(outPath, nil)
			local code = BufferUtils:readhexa(success)
			if code == 2 then
				return ""
			end
			return BufferUtils.string.ReadOSBased(outPath)
		end,

		RequestSaveFile = function(defaultName, filters)
			local outPath = ffi.alloc(ffi.types.pointer:size())
			local filterList, filterCount = buildFilterList(filters)

			local success: FFIPointer = lib.NFD_SaveDialogN(outPath, filterList, filterCount or 0, nil, defaultName)
			local code = BufferUtils:readhexa(success)

			if code == 2 then -- cancel
				return ""
			end

			return BufferUtils.string.ReadOSBased(outPath)
		end,
	})

	renderer_signal:Connect(function(route, dt) end)
end

return FileDialogService

local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local Registry = require("@Kinemium.registry")

local GeometryService = Instance.new("GeometryService")
GeometryService.ExplorerHidden = true
GeometryService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.CSG

local manifold = require("@manifold")
local gen = manifold.gen

local serviceRenderer = nil
local serviceDatamodel = nil

local function transformManifold(manifoldPtr, cf)
	local out = gen.alloc()
	if not cf or not cf.Position or not cf.Rotation then
		manifold.lib.manifold_copy(out, manifoldPtr)
		return out
	end

	local r = cf.Rotation
	local p = cf.Position
	manifold.lib.manifold_transform(
		out,
		manifoldPtr,
		r[1][1],
		r[2][1],
		r[3][1],
		r[1][2],
		r[2][2],
		r[3][2],
		r[1][3],
		r[2][3],
		r[3][3],
		p.X,
		p.Y,
		p.Z
	)
	return out
end

local function getWorldManifold(part)
	if not part or not part._manifoldptr then
		return nil
	end
	return transformManifold(part._manifoldptr, part.CFrame)
end

local function getManifoldAtCFrame(part, cf)
	if not part or not part._manifoldptr or not cf then
		return nil
	end
	return transformManifold(part._manifoldptr, cf)
end

local function combineManifolds(seedPart, operandParts, combiner)
	local result = getWorldManifold(seedPart)
	if not result then
		return nil
	end

	for _, operand in ipairs(operandParts) do
		local operandWorld = getWorldManifold(operand)
		if operandWorld then
			local combined = combiner(result, operandWorld)
			gen.free(result)
			gen.free(operandWorld)
			result = combined
		end
	end

	return result
end

local function worldResultToLocalSpace(worldManifold, localCFrame)
	if not localCFrame then
		return worldManifold
	end
	local inverse = localCFrame:Inverse()
	local localManifold = transformManifold(worldManifold, inverse)
	gen.free(worldManifold)
	return localManifold
end

local function collectOperandParts(parts)
	local operandParts = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
		if p and p._manifoldptr then
			operandParts[#operandParts + 1] = p
		end
	end
	return operandParts
end

local function applyCsgOptions(instance, primaryPart, options)
	options = options or {}
	instance.Material = primaryPart.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	instance.Color = primaryPart.Color
	instance.Transparency = primaryPart.Transparency or 0
	if options.CollisionFidelity then
		instance.CollisionFidelity = options.CollisionFidelity
	end
	if options.RenderFidelity then
		instance.RenderFidelity = options.RenderFidelity
	end
	if options.FluidFidelity then
		instance.FluidFidelity = options.FluidFidelity
	end
end

local function buildMeshResult(primaryPart, localCFrame, worldManifold)
	local localManifold = worldResultToLocalSpace(worldManifold, localCFrame)
	local built = gen.buildMeshWithDataFromManifold(localManifold, {
		includeNormals = true,
		indicesAreZeroBased = true,
		generateTangents = true,
	})
	gen.free(localManifold)

	if not built then
		return nil, nil
	end

	return built[1], built[2]
end

local function createPartOperationResult(className, primaryPart, operandParts, worldManifold, options)
	local meshData, gpuMesh = buildMeshResult(primaryPart, primaryPart.CFrame, worldManifold)
	if not gpuMesh then
		return {}
	end

	local result = Registry.new(className, serviceRenderer, serviceDatamodel)
	result:SetProperty("_mesh", gpuMesh)
	result:SetProperty("_cpuMeshData", meshData)
	result.CFrame = primaryPart.CFrame
	result.Size = primaryPart.Size
	result.ConnectedParts = operandParts
	applyCsgOptions(result, primaryPart, options)

	return { result }
end

local function createMeshPartResult(primaryPart, localCFrame, worldManifold, options)
	local meshData, gpuMesh = buildMeshResult(primaryPart, localCFrame, worldManifold)
	if not gpuMesh then
		return nil
	end

	local meshPart = Registry.new("MeshPart", serviceRenderer, serviceDatamodel)
	meshPart:SetProperty("_mesh", gpuMesh)
	meshPart:SetProperty("_cpuMeshData", meshData)
	meshPart.CFrame = localCFrame
	meshPart.Size = primaryPart.Size
	applyCsgOptions(meshPart, primaryPart, options)

	return meshPart
end

local function unionOperands(operandParts)
	if #operandParts == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return combineManifolds(operandParts[1], { table.unpack(operandParts, 2) }, gen.union)
end

GeometryService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	serviceRenderer = renderer
	serviceDatamodel = datamodel
	GeometryService:SetProperties({})

	function GeometryService:IntersectAsync(part: Instance, parts: { any }, options: {})
		local operandParts = collectOperandParts(parts)
		if #operandParts == 0 then
			return {}
		end

		local unioned = unionOperands(operandParts)
		if not unioned then
			return {}
		end

		local primaryWorld = getWorldManifold(part)
		if not primaryWorld then
			gen.free(unioned)
			return {}
		end

		local resultPtr = gen.intersection(primaryWorld, unioned)
		gen.free(primaryWorld)
		gen.free(unioned)

		return createPartOperationResult("IntersectOperation", part, operandParts, resultPtr, options)
	end

	function GeometryService:SubtractAsync(part: Instance, parts: { any }, options: {})
		local operandParts = collectOperandParts(parts)
		if #operandParts == 0 then
			return {}
		end

		local subtractVolume = unionOperands(operandParts)
		if not subtractVolume then
			return {}
		end

		local primaryWorld = getWorldManifold(part)
		if not primaryWorld then
			gen.free(subtractVolume)
			return {}
		end

		local resultPtr = gen.difference(primaryWorld, subtractVolume)
		gen.free(primaryWorld)
		gen.free(subtractVolume)

		return createPartOperationResult("NegateOperation", part, operandParts, resultPtr, options)
	end

	function GeometryService:UnionAsync(part: Instance, parts: { any }, options: {})
		local operandParts = collectOperandParts(parts)
		local allParts = { part }
		for _, p in ipairs(operandParts) do
			allParts[#allParts + 1] = p
		end

		if #allParts < 2 then
			return {}
		end

		local worldUnion = unionOperands(allParts)
		if not worldUnion then
			return {}
		end

		return createPartOperationResult("UnionOperation", part, allParts, worldUnion, options)
	end

	function GeometryService:SweepPartAsync(part: Instance, cframes: { any }, options: {})
		options = options or {}
		if not part or not part._manifoldptr or not cframes or #cframes == 0 then
			return nil
		end

		local referenceCFrame = cframes[1] or part.CFrame
		local swept = getManifoldAtCFrame(part, referenceCFrame)
		if not swept then
			return nil
		end

		for i = 2, #cframes do
			local cf = cframes[i]
			if cf then
				local next = getManifoldAtCFrame(part, cf)
				if next then
					local combined = gen.union(swept, next)
					gen.free(swept)
					gen.free(next)
					swept = combined
				end
			end
		end

		return createMeshPartResult(part, referenceCFrame, swept, options)
	end
end

return GeometryService

HttpService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, game)
	HttpService.RequestStarted = signal.new()
	HttpService.RequestFinished = signal.new()
	HttpService.RequestFailed = signal.new()

	local JSON = zune.serde.json

	local function request(method, url, body, headers, opts)
		opts = opts or {}
		headers = headers or {}

		HttpService.RequestStarted:Fire({ Method = method, URL = url })

		local success, response = pcall(function()
			return net.http.request(url, {
				method = method,
				headers = headers,
				body = body,
				timeout = opts.Timeout,
				allow_redirects = opts.AllowRedirects,
			}, opts.ReturnBuffer and true or false)
		end)

		if not success then
			HttpService.RequestFailed:Fire({ Method = method, URL = url, Error = response })
			return response
		end

		local res = {
			Body = response.body,
			StatusCode = response.status_code,
			StatusReason = response.status_reason,
			Headers = response.headers,
			Ok = response.ok,
		}

		HttpService.RequestFinished:Fire(res)
		return res
	end

	function HttpService:GetAsync(url, headers, opts)
		local res = request("GET", url, nil, headers, opts)
		return res.Body, res
	end

	function HttpService:PostAsync(url, body, headers, opts)
		local res = request("POST", url, body, headers, opts)
		return res.Body, res
	end

	function HttpService:JSONEncode(tbl)
		return JSON.encode(tbl)
	end

	function HttpService:JSONDecode(str)
		return JSON.decode(str)
	end

	function HttpService:MsgPackEncode(tbl)
		return msgpack.encode(tbl)
	end

	function HttpService:MsgPackDecode(data)
		return msgpack.decode(data)
	end

	function HttpService:GenerateGUID(curly)
		local function generateGUID(): string
			local template = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
			return template:gsub("[xy]", function(c)
				local r = math.random(0, 15)
				local v = c == "x" and r or (r % 4 + 8)
				return string.format("%x", v)
			end)
		end
		return generateGUID()
	end

	function HttpService:CreateSocket()
		-- TODO: add Socket implementation (using zune.net)
	end

	function HttpService:Websocket(opts, accepted)
		local host = opts.host
		local socketObject = {
			OnMessage = signal.new(),
			OnOpen = signal.new(),
			OnClose = signal.new(),
			OnError = signal.new(),
			OnAccept = signal.new(),
			Host = host,
		}

		local new = zune.net.http.websocket(host, {
			headers = opts.headers,
			timeout = opts.timeout,

			open = function(self)
				socketObject.OnOpen:Fire()
				return true
			end,
			close = function(self, code)
				socketObject.OnClose:Fire(code)
				return true
			end,
			message = function(self, message)
				socketObject.OnMessage:Fire(message)
				return true
			end,
		})

		function socketObject:Destroy(code)
			if new then
				new:close(code)
			end
		end

		function socketObject:isConnected()
			return new ~= nil and new:isConnected()
		end

		function socketObject:Send(message)
			if new then
				new:send(message)
			end
		end

		return socketObject
	end

local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local HUDService = Instance.new("HUDService")
HUDService.ExplorerHidden = true
HUDService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.UI

HUDService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	local pendingActions = {}
	local pendingRuntime = {}
	local pendingNotifications = {}
	local notificationHandler = nil
	local hudSignal = nil
	local runtimeManager = nil
	local rootGui = nil
	local ready = false
	local readyChanged = signal.new()

	local function normalizeArgs(a, b, c, d)
		if a == HUDService then
			return b, c, d
		end
		return a, b, c
	end

	local function cloneValue(value)
		if type(value) ~= "table" then
			return value
		end
		if getmetatable(value) ~= nil then
			return value
		end

		local cloned = {}
		for key, child in pairs(value) do
			cloned[key] = cloneValue(child)
		end
		return cloned
	end

	local function mergeInto(target, source)
		for key, value in pairs(source) do
			if type(value) == "table" and type(target[key]) == "table" then
				mergeInto(target[key], value)
			else
				target[key] = cloneValue(value)
			end
		end
		return target
	end

	local function publishSettings(nextConfig)
		local configService = datamodel:GetService("ConfigService")

		if configService and configService.SetConfig then
			configService.SetConfig(nextConfig)
		end
		return nextConfig
	end

	local function queueAction(message, param, callback)
		table.insert(pendingActions, {
			message = message,
			param = param,
			callback = callback,
		})
	end

	local function flushPendingRuntime()
		if not runtimeManager then
			return
		end

		for key, value in pairs(pendingRuntime) do
			runtimeManager:set("#runtime", key, value)
		end
	end

	local function flushPendingActions()
		if not hudSignal then
			return
		end

		for _, action in ipairs(pendingActions) do
			hudSignal:Fire(action.message, action.param, action.callback)
		end
		table.clear(pendingActions)
	end

	local function dispatch(message, param, callback)
		if hudSignal and ready then
			hudSignal:Fire(message, param, callback)
			return true
		end

		queueAction(message, param, callback)
		return false
	end

	local function sanitizeRouteName(routeName)
		routeName = tostring(routeName or "")
		routeName = routeName:gsub("^/+", "")
		routeName = routeName:gsub("%s+", "-")
		return string.lower(routeName)
	end

	HUDService:SetProperties({
		Ready = false,
		ReadyChanged = readyChanged,

		AttachRuntime = function(a, b)
			local manager = normalizeArgs(a, b)
			runtimeManager = manager
			flushPendingRuntime()
			return runtimeManager
		end,

		AttachClient = function(a, b, c)
			local signalBridge, gui = normalizeArgs(a, b, c)
			hudSignal = signalBridge or hudSignal
			rootGui = gui or rootGui
			flushPendingActions()

			if ready ~= true then
				ready = true
				HUDService.Ready = true
				readyChanged:Fire()
			end

			return hudSignal
		end,

		IsReady = function()
			return ready
		end,

			return rootGui
		end,

			return runtimeManager

		GetRuntime = function(a, b, c)
			local key, fallback = normalizeArgs(a, b, c)
			if runtimeManager then
				local value = runtimeManager:get("#runtime", key)
				if value ~= nil then
					return value
				end
			end

			local pendingValue = pendingRuntime[key]
			if pendingValue ~= nil then
				return pendingValue
			end

			return fallback
		end,

		SetRuntime = function(a, b, c)
			local key, value = normalizeArgs(a, b, c)
			pendingRuntime[key] = value
			if runtimeManager then
				runtimeManager:set("#runtime", key, value)
			end
			return value
		end,

		end,

			dispatch("CloseMenu")
		end,

		ToggleMenu = function()
			dispatch("ToggleMenu")
		end,

		Notify = function(a, b, c, d)
			local title, description, timeout
			if a == HUDService then
				title, description, timeout = b, c, d
			else
				title, description, timeout = a, b, c
			end
			local notif = { title = tostring(title or ""), desc = tostring(description or ""), timeout = timeout }
			if notificationHandler then
				notificationHandler(notif.title, notif.desc, notif.timeout)
			else
				table.insert(pendingNotifications, notif)
			end
		end,

		SetNotificationHandler = function(a, b)
			local handler = normalizeArgs(a, b)
			notificationHandler = handler
			-- Drain any notifications that fired before the handler was registered
			local drained = pendingNotifications
			pendingNotifications = {}
			for _, notif in ipairs(drained) do
				handler(notif.title, notif.desc, notif.timeout)
			end
		end,

		OpenRoute = function(a, b)
			local routeName = sanitizeRouteName(normalizeArgs(a, b))
			dispatch("OpenRoute", routeName)
		end,

		CloseRoute = function()
			dispatch("CloseRoute")
		end,

		AddWindow = function(a, b, c)
			local title, callback = normalizeArgs(a, b, c)
			if type(title) == "table" then
				callback = title.callback or title.build or title.render
				title = title.title or title.name
			end

			if title == nil then
				return nil
			end

			dispatch("MakeWindow", tostring(title), callback)
			return title
		end,

		AddTopbarButton = function(a, b)
			local config = normalizeArgs(a, b)
			if type(config) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end

			local routeName = config.routeName or config.route or config.id or config.title or config.icon
			local payload = {

				open_callback = config.open_callback or config.open or config.onOpen or config.callback,
				close_callback = config.close_callback or config.close or config.onClose,
			}

			dispatch("NewTopbarButton", payload)
			return payload.routeName
		end,

		GetSettings = function()
			local configService = datamodel:GetService("ConfigService")

			if configService and configService.GetConfig then
				return configService.GetConfig()
			end
			return {}
		end,

		MergeSettings = function(a, b)
			local configService = datamodel:GetService("ConfigService")

			local config = normalizeArgs(a, b)
			local currentConfig = {}
			if configService and configService.GetConfig then
				currentConfig = cloneValue(configService.GetConfig() or {})
			end

			return publishSettings(mergeInto(currentConfig, config or {}))
		end,

		AddSettingsSection = function(a, b, c)
			local sectionName, entries = normalizeArgs(a, b, c)
			if sectionName == nil then
				return nil
			end

			return HUDService.MergeSettings({
				[tostring(sectionName)] = entries or {},
			})
		end,

		AddSettingsEntries = function(a, b, c)
			local sectionName, entries = normalizeArgs(a, b, c)
			if sectionName == nil then
				return nil
			end

			return HUDService.MergeSettings({
				[tostring(sectionName)] = entries or {},
			})
		end,

		AddSettingsEntry = function(a, b, c, d)
			local sectionName, entryName, entryData
			if a == HUDService then
				sectionName, entryName, entryData = b, c, d
			else
				sectionName, entryName, entryData = a, b, c
			end

			if sectionName == nil or entryName == nil then
				return nil
			end

			return HUDService.MergeSettings({
				[tostring(sectionName)] = {
					[tostring(entryName)] = entryData or {},
				},
			})
		end,
	})
end

function InputActionService:SetLocalMovementBasisYaw(yaw)
