  Result: MCPService "MCPService" (MCPService)
  Code: local Instance = require("@Instance")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
local KiNet = require("@KiNet")

local MCPService = Instance.new("MCPService")
MCPService.ExplorerHidden = true
MCPService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.Network

local JSON = zune.serde.json
local DEFAULT_ADDRESS = "127.0.0.1"
local DEFAULT_PORT = 7331

local server = nil
local datamodelRef = nil
local isRunning = false
local serverGeneration = 0
local requestHandlers = {}

local function makeError(id, code, message, data)
	return {
		jsonrpc = "2.0",
		id = id,
		error = {
			code = code,
			message = message,
			data = data,
		},
	}
end

local function makeResult(id, result)
	return {
		jsonrpc = "2.0",
		id = id,
		result = result or {},
	}
end

local function decodeRequest(message)
	if type(message) == "table" and type(message.json) == "string" then
		local ok, decoded = pcall(JSON.decode, message.json)
		if ok then
			return decoded
		end
		return nil, "Invalid JSON payload"
	end

	if type(message) == "table" and type(message.method) == "string" then
		return message
	end

	return nil, "Expected a JSON-RPC request in message.json"
end

local function sendResponse(client, response)
	if not server or not client then
		return false
	end

	local encoded = JSON.encode(response)
	server:Send(client, {
		type = "MCP_RESPONSE",
		json = encoded,
	}, false)

	return true
end

local function getServerInfo()
	return {
		name = "Kinemium MCP",
		version = "0.1.0",
	}
end

local function listTools()
	local tools = {}

	for name, handler in pairs(requestHandlers) do
		if handler.tool then
			table.insert(tools, {
				name = name,
				description = handler.description,
				inputSchema = handler.inputSchema or {
					type = "object",
					properties = {},
				},
			})
		end
	end

	table.sort(tools, function(a, b)
		return a.name < b.name
	end)

	return tools
end

local function callTool(name, arguments)
	local handler = requestHandlers[name]
	if not handler or not handler.tool then
		return nil, `Unknown tool: {tostring(name)}`
	end

	return handler.callback(arguments or {})
end

local function handleRequest(request)
	if type(request) ~= "table" then
		return makeError(nil, -32600, "Invalid Request")
	end

	local method = request.method
	if type(method) ~= "string" then
		return makeError(request.id, -32600, "Missing method")
	end

	if method == "initialize" then
		return makeResult(request.id, {
			protocolVersion = request.params and request.params.protocolVersion or "2024-11-05",
			serverInfo = getServerInfo(),
			capabilities = {
				tools = {},
			},
		})
	elseif method == "ping" then
		return makeResult(request.id, {})
	elseif method == "tools/list" then
		return makeResult(request.id, {
			tools = listTools(),
		})
	elseif method == "tools/call" then
		local params = request.params or {}
		local result, err = callTool(params.name, params.arguments)
		if err then
			return makeError(request.id, -32602, err)
		end
		return makeResult(request.id, result)
	elseif method == "notifications/initialized" then
		return nil
	end

	return makeError(request.id, -32601, `Method not found: {method}`)
end

local function registerDefaultTools()
	requestHandlers["kinemium.info"] = {
		tool = true,
		description = "Returns basic information about the active Kinemium data model.",
		inputSchema = {
			type = "object",
			properties = {},
		},
		callback = function()
			local services = {}
			if datamodelRef and datamodelRef.Services then
				for name in pairs(datamodelRef.Services) do
					table.insert(services, name)
				end
				table.sort(services)
			end

			return {
				content = {
					{
						type = "text",
						text = JSON.encode({
							name = datamodelRef and datamodelRef.Name or "datamodel",
							loaded = datamodelRef and datamodelRef.Loaded == true,
							services = services,
						}),
					},
				},
			}
		end,
	}

	requestHandlers["kinemium.echo"] = {
		tool = true,
		description = "Echoes the supplied arguments as JSON text.",
		inputSchema = {
			type = "object",
			properties = {
				message = {
					type = "string",
				},
			},
		},
		callback = function(arguments)
			return {
				content = {
					{
						type = "text",
						text = JSON.encode(arguments or {}),
					},
				},
			}
		end,
	}
end

function MCPService:StartServer(address, port, allowedTokens)
	if isRunning then
		return true, self.Address, self.Port
	end

	serverGeneration += 1
	local generation = serverGeneration
	address = address or GetFlagValue("mcp_address") or DEFAULT_ADDRESS
	port = tonumber(port or GetFlagValue("mcp_port")) or DEFAULT_PORT
	allowedTokens = allowedTokens or {}

	server = KiNet.TCPServer
	server:Init(address, port, allowedTokens)
	server:OnClientConnectionRequest(function(client)
		if generation ~= serverGeneration or not isRunning then
			return
		end

		sendResponse(client, {
			jsonrpc = "2.0",
			method = "notifications/kinemium/ready",
			params = {
				serverInfo = getServerInfo(),
			},
		})
	end)
	server:OnRecieve(function(addr, message)
		if generation ~= serverGeneration or not isRunning then
			return
		end
		if
			type(message) == "table"
			and message.type
			and message.type ~= "MCP_REQUEST"
			and not message.method
			and not message.json
		then
			return
		end

		local client = server.ConnectedClients[`{addr.address}:{addr.port}`] or server.ConnectedClients[addr.address]
		local request, decodeErr = decodeRequest(message)
		if not request then
			sendResponse(client, makeError(nil, -32700, decodeErr))
			return
		end

		local ok, response = pcall(handleRequest, request)
		if not ok then
			sendResponse(client, makeError(request.id, -32603, tostring(response)))
			return
		end
		if response then
			sendResponse(client, response)
		end
	end)
	server:Listen()

	self.Address = address
	self.Port = port
	isRunning = true

	print(`[MCPService] Listening at {address}:{port}`)
	return true, address, port
end

function MCPService:StopServer()
	if not isRunning or not server then
		return false
	end

	serverGeneration += 1
	server:Shutdown()
	isRunning = false
	server = nil
	return true
end

function MCPService:IsRunning()
	return isRunning
end

function MCPService:RegisterTool(name, description, inputSchema, callback)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
		return false, "Tool name must be a non-empty string"
	end
	if type(callback) ~= "function" then
		return false, "Tool callback must be a function"
	end

	requestHandlers[name] = {
		tool = true,
		description = description or "",
		inputSchema = inputSchema,
		callback = callback,
	}

	return true
end

MCPService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, rendererSignal, datamodel)
	datamodelRef = datamodel
	registerDefaultTools()

	MCPService:SetProperties({
		Address = DEFAULT_ADDRESS,
		Port = DEFAULT_PORT,
		StartServer = MCPService.StartServer,
		StopServer = MCPService.StopServer,
		IsRunning = MCPService.IsRunning,
		RegisterTool = MCPService.RegisterTool,
	})

	if FlagExists("mcp") or FlagExists("mcp_server") then
		MCPService:StartServer()
	end

	if datamodel and datamodel.ShutdownCallbacks then
		table.insert(datamodel.ShutdownCallbacks, function()
			MCPService:StopServer()
		end)
	end
end

return MCPService

local currentNavMesh = nil

local function getOrBuildNavMesh(datamodel)
	if not currentNavMesh then
		currentNavMesh = NavMesh.new()
		currentNavMesh:CreateFromWorkspace(datamodel:GetService("Workspace"))

PathfindingService.Initenvironment = function(environment, datamodel)
	if not Enum.PathStatus then
		Enum.PathStatus = {
			Success = 0,
			NoPath = 1,
		}
	end
	if not Enum.PathWaypointAction then
		Enum.PathWaypointAction = {
			Walk = 0,
			Jump = 1,
		}
	end

	PathfindingService:SetProperties({
		CreatePath = function(self, agentParameters)
			agentParameters = agentParameters or {}

			local pathObj = {}
			pathObj.Status = Enum.PathStatus.NoPath
			pathObj._waypoints = {}

			function pathObj:ComputeAsync(startPos, endPos)
				local nav = getOrBuildNavMesh(datamodel)
				local result = nav:FindPath(startPos, endPos)

				if result.success then
					local smoothed = nav:SmoothPath(result.path)
					local waypoints = {}
					for i, point in ipairs(smoothed) do
						table.insert(waypoints, {
							Position = point,
							Action = Enum.PathWaypointAction.Walk,
						})
					end
					self._waypoints = waypoints
					self.Status = Enum.PathStatus.Success
				else
					self._waypoints = {}
					self.Status = Enum.PathStatus.NoPath
				end
			end

			function pathObj:GetWaypoints()
				return self._waypoints
			end

			return pathObj
		end,

		FindPathAsync = function(self, startPos, endPos)
			local nav = getOrBuildNavMesh(datamodel)
			local result = nav:FindPath(startPos, endPos)
			return result.success, nav:SmoothPath(result.path)
		end,

		InvalidateNavMesh = function(self)
			currentNavMesh = nil
		end,
	})

	return PathfindingService
end

return PathfindingService

local PlaytestService = Instance.new("PlaytestService")
PlaytestService.ExplorerHidden = true

local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")

local task = zune.task

local function outputProcess(prefix, proc, cb)
	local buffer = ""
	return task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local err = proc.stderr:read(1024)

			if err and #err > 0 then
				buffer ..= err

				while true do
					local lineEnd = string.find(buffer, "\n")

					if not lineEnd then
						break
					end

					local line = string.sub(buffer, 1, lineEnd - 1)
					buffer = string.sub(buffer, lineEnd + 1)

					if #line > 0 then
						if cb then
							cb(line)
						end
						print(prefix, line)
					end
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.01)
		end
	end)
end

local server_process: ProcessChild
local client_process: ProcessChild

local client_logger
local server_logger

PlaytestService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)

		OnPlaytestFinished = signal.new(),

		CreatePlaytestAsync = function(gameName)
			pcall(function()
				zune.fs.deleteFile("./.temp/" .. gameName .. ".kine")
			end)

			PlaytestService.OnPlaytestStarted:Fire()

			local KineFileService = datamodel:GetService("KineFileService")

			KineFileService.ExportGameAsFile("./.temp/", gameName)

			local Process = datamodel:GetService("Process")

			local serverReady = false

			task.spawn(function()
				server_process = Process.CreateKinemiumServerProcess({
					"--headless",
					"--blob",
					"./.temp/" .. gameName .. ".kine",
				})
				server_logger = outputProcess("[SERVER]", server_process, function(line)
					PlaytestService.OnServerLog:Fire(line)
				end)
			end)

			task.spawn(function()
				-- wait 2 seconds for the server to startup
				task.wait(2)

				local playerName = "Player"
				pcall(function()
					local players = datamodel:GetService("Players")
					if players and players.LocalPlayer and players.LocalPlayer.Name then
						playerName = players.LocalPlayer.Name
					end
				end)
				if playerName == "Player" then
					pcall(function()
						local envName = zune.process.env["USERNAME"] or zune.process.env["USER"]
						if envName and #envName > 0 then
							playerName = envName
						end
					end)
				end

				client_process = Process.CreateKinemiumClientProcess({
					"--username " .. playerName,
				})
				client_logger = outputProcess("[CLIENT]", client_process, function(line)
					PlaytestService.OnClientLog:Fire(line)
				end)
			end)
		end,

		StopCurrentPlaytest = function(gameName)
			PlaytestService.OnPlaytestFinished:Fire()

			pcall(function()
				zune.fs.deleteFile("./.temp/" .. gameName .. ".kine")
			end)
			if client_logger then
				task.cancel(client_logger)
			end
			if server_logger then
				task.cancel(server_logger)
			end

			if client_process then
				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(function()
						client_process:kill()
					end)
				end)
			end
			if server_process then
				task.spawn(function()
					pcall(function()
						server_process:kill()
					end)
				end)
			end
		end,

		IsPlaytesting = true,
	})
end

local function copyTable(source)
	local new = {}
	for k, v in pairs(source or {}) do
		new[k] = v
	end
	return new
end

local function removeArrayValue(list, value)
	for i = #list, 1, -1 do
		if list[i] == value then
			table.remove(list, i)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function colorToRaylib(color, transparency)
	local source = color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local r, g, b = source:ToRGB()
	return structs.Color:new({
		r = r,
		g = g,
		b = b,
		a = math.floor(255 * (1 - (transparency or 0))),
	})
end

local function getRectSize(component)
	if component and component.get_rect then
		local ok, value = pcall(component.get_rect)
		if ok and value then
			return value.width, value.height
		end
	end

	if component and component.get then
		local ok, value = pcall(component.get, "obj_rect")
		if ok and value then
			return value.width, value.height
		end
	end

	return nil, nil
end

local function getAvailableWidgetTypes(gui)
	local types = {}
	for name, factory in pairs(gui) do
		if type(factory) == "function" and not NON_WIDGET_KEYS[name] then
			table.insert(types, name)
		end
	end
	table.sort(types)
	return types
end

local function copyIfMissing(tbl, fromKey, toKey)
	if tbl[toKey] == nil and tbl[fromKey] ~= nil then
		tbl[toKey] = tbl[fromKey]
	end
end

local function unpackXY(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return nil, nil
	end

	return value.X or value.x or value.Width or value.width or value[1],
		value.Y or value.y or value.Height or value.height or value[2]
end

local function getSizePair(value, defaultWidth, defaultHeight)
	local width, height = unpackXY(value)
	return width or defaultWidth, height or defaultHeight
end

		local function resolveWidgetType(widgetType)
			if type(widgetType) ~= "string" then
				error(("Plugin: widget type must be a string, got '%s'"):format(type(widgetType)))
			end

			local resolved = widgetTypeLookup[widgetType] or widgetTypeLookup[string.lower(widgetType)]
			if type(resolved) ~= "string" or NON_WIDGET_KEYS[resolved] then
				error(("Plugin: unknown widget type '%s'"):format(tostring(widgetType)))
			end

			return resolved
		end

		local function mergeEvents(target, source)
			for name, eventSignal in pairs(source or {}) do
				target[name] = eventSignal
			end
		end

		local function bridgeCallback(config, callbackKey, signalNames, candidateKeys)
			local userCallback = nil

			for _, key in ipairs(candidateKeys) do
				if type(config[key]) == "function" then
					userCallback = config[key]
					break
				end
			end

			local eventSignal = signal.new()
			config[callbackKey] = function(...)
				if userCallback then
					userCallback(...)
				end
				eventSignal:Fire(...)
			end

			local events = {}
			for _, name in ipairs(signalNames) do
				events[name] = eventSignal
			end
			return events
		end

		local function normalizeWidgetConfig(widgetType, rawConfig)
			local normalized = copyTable(rawConfig or {})
			local events = {}

			local position = normalized.Position or normalized.position
			if position then
				local x, y = unpackXY(position)
				normalized.x = normalized.x or x or 0
				normalized.y = normalized.y or y or 0
			end

			local size = normalized.Size or normalized.size
			if size then
				local width, height = unpackXY(size)
				normalized.width = normalized.width or width
				normalized.height = normalized.height or height
			end

			copyIfMissing(normalized, "Text", "text")
			copyIfMissing(normalized, "Title", "title")
			copyIfMissing(normalized, "Message", "message")
			copyIfMissing(normalized, "PlaceholderText", "placeholder")
			copyIfMissing(normalized, "FontSize", "fontSize")
			copyIfMissing(normalized, "BackgroundColor3", "backgroundColor")
			copyIfMissing(normalized, "TextColor3", "textColor")
			copyIfMissing(normalized, "Visible", "visible")
			copyIfMissing(normalized, "ZIndex", "zindex")

			if widgetType == "textInput" then
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Value", "text")
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onChange",
						{ "Changed", "TextChanged" },
						{ "onChange", "OnChange", "onChanged", "OnChanged", "Changed", "TextChanged", "Callback" }
					)
				)
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onSubmit",
						{ "Submitted", "ReturnPressed" },
						{ "onSubmit", "OnSubmit", "Submitted", "ReturnPressed" }
					)
				)
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(normalized, "onFocus", { "Focused" }, { "onFocus", "OnFocus", "Focused" })
				)
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onBlur",
						{ "Blurred", "FocusLost" },
						{ "onBlur", "OnBlur", "Blurred", "FocusLost" }
					)
				)
			elseif widgetType == "dropdown" then
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Items", "options")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Options", "options")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "SelectedIndex", "selectedIndex")
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onSelect",
						{ "Changed", "SelectionChanged" },
						{ "onSelect", "OnSelect", "Changed", "SelectionChanged", "Callback" }
					)
				)
			elseif widgetType == "tabs" then
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Items", "tabs")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Tabs", "tabs")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "SelectedIndex", "activeIndex")
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onTabChange",
						{ "Changed", "TabChanged" },
						{ "onTabChange", "OnTabChange", "Changed", "TabChanged", "Callback" }
					)
				)
			elseif widgetType == "slider" then
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Value", "value")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "MinValue", "min")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "MaxValue", "max")
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onChanged",
						{ "Changed" },
						{ "onChanged", "OnChanged", "Changed", "Callback" }
					)
				)
			elseif widgetType == "progressBar" then
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Value", "progress")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Progress", "progress")
			elseif widgetType == "switch" or widgetType == "checkbox" or widgetType == "toggle" then
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Value", "value")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Checked", "value")
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onChanged",
						{ "Changed", "Toggled" },
						{ "onChanged", "OnChanged", "Changed", "Toggled", "Callback" }
					)
				)
			elseif widgetType == "colorPicker" then
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onChanged",
						{ "Changed", "ColorChanged" },
						{ "onChanged", "OnChanged", "Changed", "ColorChanged", "Callback" }
					)
				)
			elseif widgetType == "stepper" then
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "Value", "value")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "MinValue", "min")
				copyIfMissing(normalized, "MaxValue", "max")
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(
						normalized,
						"onChanged",
						{ "Changed" },
						{ "onChanged", "OnChanged", "Changed", "Callback" }
					)
				)
			elseif widgetType == "prompt" then
				mergeEvents(
					events,
					bridgeCallback(normalized, "onClose", { "Closed" }, { "onClose", "OnClose", "Closed", "Callback" })
				)
			else
				if
					widgetType == "button"
					or widgetType == "textButton"
					or widgetType == "iconButton"
					or widgetType == "imageButton"
					or widgetType == "imageTextButton"
				then
					mergeEvents(
						events,
						bridgeCallback(
							normalized,
							"onClick",
							{ "Activated", "Clicked" },
							{ "onClick", "OnClick", "Activated", "Clicked", "Callback" }
						)
					)
				elseif widgetType == "engineUIContainer" then
					copyIfMissing(normalized, "Instance", "instance")
					copyIfMissing(normalized, "Target", "target")
					copyIfMissing(normalized, "DataModel", "datamodel")
					copyIfMissing(normalized, "Game", "game")
					copyIfMissing(normalized, "Renderer", "renderer")
				end
			end

			return normalized, events
		end

		local function componentSet(component, prop, value)
			if not component then
				return false
			end

			if prop == "text" and component.setText then
				component.setText(value)
				return true
			end
			if prop == "value" and component.setValue then
				component.setValue(value)
				return true
			end
			if prop == "selectedIndex" and component.setSelected then
				component.setSelected(value)
				return true
			end
			if prop == "activeIndex" and component.setActive then
				component.setActive(value)
				return true
			end
			if prop == "progress" and component.setProgress then
				component.setProgress(value)
				return true
			end
			if prop == "buttons" and component.setButtons then
				component.setButtons(value)
				return true
			end
			if prop == "bodyRenderer" and component.setBodyRenderer then
				component.setBodyRenderer(value)
				return true
			end
			if prop == "instance" and component.setInstance then
				component.setInstance(value)
				return true
			end

			if component.set then
				local ok = pcall(component.set, prop, value)
				if ok then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function componentGet(component, prop)
			if not component then
				return nil
			end

			if prop == "text" and component.getText then
				return component.getText()
			end
			if prop == "value" and component.getValue then
				return component.getValue()
			end
			if prop == "progress" and component.getProgress then
				return component.getProgress()
			end
			if prop == "selectedIndex" and component.getSelected then
				return select(1, component.getSelected())
			end
			if prop == "selectedItem" and component.getSelected then
				return select(2, component.getSelected())
			end
			if prop == "color" and component.getColor then
				return component.getColor()
			end
			if prop == "alpha" and component.getAlpha then
				return component.getAlpha()
			end
			if prop == "instance" and component.getInstance then
				return component.getInstance()
			end

			if component.get then
				local ok, value = pcall(component.get, prop)
				if ok then
					return value
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function attachFriendlyWidgetApi(widget, widgetType, events)
			widget.Events = events or {}

			for name, eventSignal in pairs(widget.Events or {}) do
				widget[name] = eventSignal
			end

			function widget:Connect(eventName, callback)
				local eventSignal = self.Events[eventName]
				if not eventSignal then
					error(("Plugin widget '%s' has no event '%s'"):format(self.WidgetType, tostring(eventName)))
				end
				return eventSignal:Connect(callback)
			end

			function widget:SetText(value)
				self:Set("text", value)
				return self
			end

			function widget:GetText()
				return self:Get("text")
			end

			function widget:SetValue(value)
				if widgetType == "progressBar" then
					self:Set("progress", value)
				elseif widgetType == "dropdown" then
					self:Set("selectedIndex", value)
				elseif widgetType == "tabs" then
					self:Set("activeIndex", value)
				else
					self:Set("value", value)
				end
				return self
			end

			function widget:GetValue()
				if widgetType == "progressBar" then
					return self:Get("progress")
				end
				if widgetType == "dropdown" then
					return self:Get("selectedIndex")
				end
				if widgetType == "tabs" then
					return self:Get("activeIndex")
				end
				return self:Get("value")
			end

			function widget:Focus()
				if self.component and self.component.focus then
					self.component.focus()
				end
				return self
			end

			function widget:Blur()
				if self.component and self.component.blur then
					self.component.blur()
				end
				return self
			end

			function widget:Submit()
				if self.component and self.component.submit then
					self.component.submit()
				end
				return self
			end

			function widget:SetItems(items)
				if widgetType == "tabs" then
					self:Set("tabs", items)
				else
					self:Set("options", items)
				end
				return self
			end

			function widget:GetItems()
				if widgetType == "tabs" then
					return self:Get("tabs")
				end
				return self:Get("options")
			end

			function widget:SetSelectedIndex(index)
				if widgetType == "tabs" then
					self:Set("activeIndex", index)
				else
					self:Set("selectedIndex", index)
				end
				return self
			end

			function widget:GetSelectedIndex()
				if widgetType == "tabs" then
					return self:Get("activeIndex")
				end
				return self:Get("selectedIndex")
			end

			function widget:GetSelectedItem()
				return self:Get("selectedItem")
			end

			function widget:SetProgress(value)
				self:Set("progress", value)
				return self
			end

			function widget:GetProgress()
				return self:Get("progress")
			end

			function widget:SetInstance(instance)
				self:Set("instance", instance)
				return self
			end

			function widget:GetInstance()
				return self:Get("instance")
			end

			local destroySignals = {}
			for _, eventSignal in pairs(widget.Events) do
				if not table.find(destroySignals, eventSignal) then
					table.insert(destroySignals, eventSignal)
				end
			end

			local oldDestroy = widget.Destroy
			function widget:Destroy()
				if oldDestroy then
					oldDestroy(self)
				end

				for _, eventSignal in ipairs(destroySignals) do
					if eventSignal and eventSignal.Destroy then
						eventSignal:Destroy()
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local function normalizeCreationStructure(structure)
			local normalized = {}
			for name, widgetConfig in pairs(structure or {}) do
				local copied = copyTable(widgetConfig)
				if copied.comp then
					copied.comp = resolveWidgetType(copied.comp)
				end
				normalized[name] = copied
			end
			return normalized
		end

		local function resolveToolbarIcon(icon)
			if not icon or not iconLoader then
				return nil
			end

			if type(icon) == "table" and icon.texture then
				return icon
			end

			if type(icon) ~= "string" then
				return nil
			end

			local path = icon
			if iconLoader.Get then
				local registered = iconLoader.Get(icon)
				if registered then
					path = registered
				end
			end

			if iconLoader.ToTexture then
				local ok, textureData = pcall(iconLoader.ToTexture, path)
				if ok then
					return textureData
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function attachFriendlyFactories(target, createFn)
			function target:CreateAereonWidget(widgetType, config, options)
				return createFn(widgetType, config, options)
			end

			function target:SpawnWidget(widgetType, config, options)
				return createFn(widgetType, config, options)
			end

			function target:SpawnAereonWidget(widgetType, config, options)
				return createFn(widgetType, config, options)
			end

			for methodName, widgetType in pairs(FRIENDLY_WIDGET_METHODS) do
				target[methodName] = function(self, config, options)
					return createFn(widgetType, config, options)
				end
			end
		end

		local function createPluginTextInput(config)
			local componentRect = arect.new(
				config.x or config[1] or 0,
				config.y or config[2] or 0,
				config.width or config[3] or 220,
				config.height or config[4] or 34
			)

			local textbox = textboxModule.new({
				placeholder = config.placeholder,
				fontSize = config.fontSize,
				backgroundColor = config.backgroundColor,
				textColor = config.textColor,
				placeholderColor = config.placeholderColor,
				borderColor = config.borderColor,
				focusBorderColor = config.focusBorderColor,
				selectionColor = config.selectionColor,
				label = config.label,
				labelPosition = config.labelPosition,
				labelWidth = config.labelWidth,
				labelGap = config.labelGap,
				prefix = config.prefix,
				suffix = config.suffix,
				prefixGap = config.prefixGap,
				suffixGap = config.suffixGap,
				numeric = config.numeric,
				numericMin = config.numericMin,
				numericMax = config.numericMax,
				numericStep = config.numericStep,
				numericPrecision = config.numericPrecision,
				showStepButtons = config.showStepButtons,
				slider = config.slider,
				sliderWidth = config.sliderWidth,
				sliderMin = config.sliderMin,
				sliderMax = config.sliderMax,
				sliderStep = config.sliderStep,
				sliderPosition = config.sliderPosition,
				readOnly = config.readOnly,
				maxLength = config.maxLength,
				validator = config.validator,
				selectAllOnFocus = config.selectAllOnFocus,
				blurOnSubmit = config.blurOnSubmit,
				clearOnEscape = config.clearOnEscape,
				escapeBlurs = config.escapeBlurs,
				onSubmit = config.onSubmit,
				onFocus = config.onFocus,
				onBlur = config.onBlur,
			})

			if config.text ~= nil then
				local onChange = textbox.onChange
				textbox.onChange = nil
				textbox:setText(tostring(config.text))
				textbox.onChange = onChange
			end

			local function applyThemeColor(prop, value)
				if not value then
					return false
				end

				if prop == "backgroundColor" then
					textbox.theme.background = value:ToRaylib(textbox.BackgroundTransparency or 0)
					return true
				end
				if prop == "textColor" then
					textbox.TextColor = value
					textbox.theme.text = value:ToRaylib(0)
					return true
				end
				if prop == "placeholderColor" then
					textbox.theme.placeholder = value:ToRaylib(0)
					return true
				end
				if prop == "borderColor" then
					textbox.theme.border = value:ToRaylib(textbox.BorderTransparency or 0)
					return true
				end
				if prop == "focusBorderColor" then
					textbox.theme.focusBorder = value:ToRaylib(textbox.BorderTransparency or 0)
					return true
				end
				if prop == "selectionColor" then
					textbox.theme.selection = value:ToRaylib(0.5)
					return true
				end

				return false
			end

			local wrapper = {}

			wrapper.set = function(prop, value)
				if prop == "obj_rect" then
					componentRect = value
					return wrapper
				end
				if prop == "text" or prop == "value" then
					textbox:setText(tostring(value or ""))
					return wrapper
				end
				if prop == "placeholder" then
					textbox.placeholder = tostring(value or "")
					return wrapper
				end
				if prop == "fontSize" then
					textbox.fontSize = value or textbox.fontSize
					return wrapper
				end

				if applyThemeColor(prop, value) then
					return wrapper
				end

				textbox[prop] = value
				return wrapper
			end

			wrapper.get = function(prop)
				if prop == "obj_rect" then
					return componentRect
				end
				if prop == "text" or prop == "value" then
					return textbox:getText()
				end
				if prop == "focused" or prop == "isFocused" then
					return textbox.isFocused
				end

				return textbox[prop]
			end

			wrapper.get_rect = function()
				return componentRect
			end

			wrapper.render = function(_dt)
				textbox:drawWithExtras(componentRect.x, componentRect.y, componentRect.width, componentRect.height)
			end

			wrapper.setText = function(value)
				textbox:setText(tostring(value or ""))
				return wrapper
			end

			wrapper.getText = function()
				return textbox:getText()
			end

			wrapper.focus = function()
				textbox:focus()
				return wrapper
			end

			wrapper.blur = function()
				textbox:blur()
				return wrapper
			end

			wrapper.submit = function()
				textbox:submit()
				return wrapper
			end

			return wrapper
		end

		local function createRawWidget(widgetType, config)
			local resolvedType = resolveWidgetType(widgetType)
			local normalizedConfig = select(1, normalizeWidgetConfig(resolvedType, config))
			if resolvedType == "textInput" then
				return createPluginTextInput(copyTable(normalizedConfig or {}))
			end
			local factory = gui[resolvedType]

			return factory(copyTable(normalizedConfig or {}))
		end

		local function getWindowContentOrigin(windowData)
			local x = windowData.x + (windowData.ContentPaddingX or 0)
			local y = windowData.y + (windowData.ContentPaddingY or 0)

			if windowData.headerRender ~= false then
				y += 28
			end

			return x, y
		end

		local function makeMountedWidget(windowData, topRenderables, allWidgets, widgetType, config, options)
			options = options or {}
			local resolvedType = resolveWidgetType(widgetType)
			local normalizedConfig, events = normalizeWidgetConfig(resolvedType, config)
			local component = createRawWidget(resolvedType, normalizedConfig)
			local widget = {
				WidgetType = resolvedType,
				component = component,
				x = normalizedConfig.x or normalizedConfig[1] or 0,
				y = normalizedConfig.y or normalizedConfig[2] or 0,
				width = normalizedConfig.width or normalizedConfig[3],
				height = normalizedConfig.height or normalizedConfig[4],
				absolute = options.absolute == true or normalizedConfig.Absolute == true,
				enabled = options.enabled ~= false and normalizedConfig.visible ~= false,
				order = options.order or options.zindex or normalizedConfig.zindex or 0,
				destroyed = false,
				_parentList = nil,
				Events = events,
			}

			function widget:_mountTo(list)
				if self._parentList then
					removeArrayValue(self._parentList, self)
				end

				self._parentList = list
				table.insert(list, self)
			end

			function widget:_applyRect(baseX, baseY, yOffset)
				if self.absolute then
					baseX = 0
					baseY = 0
				end

				local width = self.width
				local height = self.height

				if width == nil or height == nil then
					local dynamicW, dynamicH = getRectSize(self.component)
					width = width or dynamicW or 0
					height = height or dynamicH or 0
				end

				if self.component and self.component.set then
					self.component.set(
						"obj_rect",
						arect.new(baseX + self.x, baseY + self.y + (yOffset or 0), width, height)
					)
				end
			end

			function widget:_render(dt, baseX, baseY, yOffset)
				if self.destroyed or not self.enabled then
					return
				end

				self:_applyRect(baseX, baseY, yOffset)

				if self.component and self.component.render then
					self.component.render(dt)
				end
			end

			function widget:render(dt, _windowData, baseX, baseY)
				self:_render(dt, baseX, baseY, 0)
			end

			function widget:GetComponent()
				return self.component
			end

			function widget:GetRect()
				local width = self.width
				local height = self.height
				if width == nil or height == nil then
					local dynamicW, dynamicH = getRectSize(self.component)
					width = width or dynamicW or 0
					height = height or dynamicH or 0
				end
				return {
					x = self.x,
					y = self.y,
					width = width,
					height = height,
				}
			end

			function widget:Get(prop)
				if prop == "x" or prop == "y" or prop == "width" or prop == "height" then
					return self[prop]
				end
				if prop == "enabled" then
					return self.enabled
				end
				if prop == "absolute" then
					return self.absolute
				end
				if prop == "order" or prop == "zindex" then
					return self.order
				end

				local value = componentGet(self.component, prop)
				if value ~= nil then
					return value
				end

				return nil
			end

			function widget:Set(prop, value)
				if prop == "x" or prop == "y" or prop == "width" or prop == "height" then
					self[prop] = value
					return self
				end
				if prop == "enabled" or prop == "visible" then
					self.enabled = not not value
					return self
				end
				if prop == "absolute" then
					self.absolute = not not value
					return self
				end
				if prop == "order" or prop == "zindex" then
					self.order = value or 0
					return self
				end

				if componentSet(self.component, prop, value) then
					return self
				end
				return self
			end

			function widget:Destroy()
				if self.destroyed then
					return
				end

				self.destroyed = true
				self.enabled = false

				if self._parentList then
					removeArrayValue(self._parentList, self)
					self._parentList = nil
				end

				removeArrayValue(allWidgets, self)
			end

			if options.mount ~= false then
				widget:_mountTo(topRenderables)
			end

			table.insert(allWidgets, widget)
			attachFriendlyWidgetApi(widget, resolvedType, events)
			return widget
		end

		local function createWindowHandle(config)
			local windowConfig = copyTable(config or {})
			local userStep = windowConfig.step
			local topRenderables = {}
			local allWidgets = {}
			local scrollViews = {}

			local windowData
			local function renderPluginUI(dt)
				local baseX, baseY = getWindowContentOrigin(windowData)

				table.sort(topRenderables, function(a, b)
					return (a.order or 0) < (b.order or 0)
				end)

				for _, renderable in ipairs(topRenderables) do
					if
						renderable
						and renderable.render
						and not renderable.destroyed
						and renderable.enabled ~= false
					then
						renderable:render(dt, windowData, baseX, baseY)
					end
				end
			end

			windowConfig.step = function(currentWindow, dt)
				renderPluginUI(dt)
				if userStep then
					userStep(currentWindow, dt)
				end
			end

			windowData = window.create(windowConfig)
			windowData.ContentPaddingX = windowConfig.contentPaddingX or 0
			windowData.ContentPaddingY = windowConfig.contentPaddingY or 0
			windowData.PluginGuiId = windowConfig.pluginGuiId or windowConfig.id
			windowData.Title = windowConfig.title or "Plugin Window"
			windowData.Enabled = windowConfig.enabled ~= false

			function windowData:SetContentPadding(paddingX, paddingY)
				self.ContentPaddingX = paddingX or 0
				self.ContentPaddingY = paddingY or paddingX or 0
				return self
			end

			function windowData:SetTitle(title)
				self.title = title or self.title
				self.Title = self.title
				return self
			end

			function windowData:BindToClose(callback)
				self._onClose = callback
				return self
			end

			local rawClose = windowData.Close
			function windowData:Close()
				if self._onClose then
					pcall(self._onClose, self)
				end
				rawClose(self)
				self.Enabled = false
			end

			local rawOpen = windowData.Open
			function windowData:Open()
				rawOpen(self)
				self.enabled = true
				self.Enabled = true
			end

			function windowData:Show()
				self:Open()
				return self
			end

			function windowData:Hide()
				self:Close()
				return self
			end

			function windowData:SetEnabled(value)
				if value then
					self:Show()
				else
					self:Hide()
				end
				return self
			end

			function windowData:RequestRaise()
				self.enabled = true
				self.Enabled = true
				if self.Closed then
					self:Open()
				end
				return self
			end

			function windowData:GetContentOrigin()
				return getWindowContentOrigin(self)
			end

			function windowData:CreateWidget(widgetType, widgetConfig, options)
				options = copyTable(options or {})
				local container = options.container
				options.container = nil

				if container then
					options.mount = false
				end

				local widget = makeMountedWidget(self, topRenderables, allWidgets, widgetType, widgetConfig, options)

				if container and container.AddWidget then
					container:AddWidget(widget)
				end

				return widget
			end

			function windowData:MountWidget(widget)
				if type(widget) ~= "table" or not widget._mountTo then
					return nil
				end
				widget:_mountTo(topRenderables)
				return widget
			end

			function windowData:CreateWidgetTree(structure, options)
				local created = {}
				local renderList = {}

				for name, widgetConfig in pairs(structure or {}) do
					local copied = copyTable(widgetConfig)
					local typeName = copied.comp and resolveWidgetType(copied.comp) or nil
					if typeName then
						copied.comp = typeName
						created[name] = self:CreateWidget(typeName, copied, options)
						table.insert(renderList, name)
					end
				end

				table.sort(renderList, function(a, b)
					return (created[a].order or 0) < (created[b].order or 0)
				end)

				created.get = function(name)
					return created[name]
				end

				created.setprop = function(name, prop, value)
					local target = created[name]
					if target and target.Set then
						target:Set(prop, value)
					end
				end

				created.render = function(dt, excluded)
					local baseX, baseY = getWindowContentOrigin(self)

					for _, name in ipairs(renderList) do
						if excluded and table.find(excluded, name) then
							continue
						end
						local target = created[name]
						if target and target._render then
							target:_render(dt, baseX, baseY, 0)
						end
					end
				end

				created.destroy = function()
					for _, name in ipairs(renderList) do
						local target = created[name]
						if target and target.Destroy then
							target:Destroy()
						end
					end
				end

				return created
			end

			function windowData:CreateScrollView(configData)
				local scrollConfig = copyTable(configData or {})
				local scrollView = {
					x = scrollConfig.x or 0,
					y = scrollConfig.y or 0,
					width = scrollConfig.width or 220,
					height = scrollConfig.height or 220,
					padding = scrollConfig.padding or 0,
					scrollY = scrollConfig.scrollY or 0,
					contentHeight = scrollConfig.contentHeight,
					wheelStep = scrollConfig.wheelStep or 26,
					showScrollbar = scrollConfig.showScrollbar ~= false,
					scrollbarWidth = scrollConfig.scrollbarWidth or 5,
					scrollbarColor = scrollConfig.scrollbarColor or Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
					scrollbarTransparency = scrollConfig.scrollbarTransparency or 0.6,
					trackColor = scrollConfig.trackColor or Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
					trackTransparency = scrollConfig.trackTransparency or 0.75,
					backgroundColor = scrollConfig.backgroundColor,
					backgroundTransparency = scrollConfig.backgroundTransparency,
					order = scrollConfig.order or scrollConfig.zindex or 0,
					absolute = scrollConfig.absolute == true,
					clip = scrollConfig.clip ~= false,
					enabled = scrollConfig.enabled ~= false,
					children = {},
					destroyed = false,
				}

				local function getChildBottom(widget)
					local rect = widget:GetRect()
					return rect.y + rect.height
				end

				function scrollView:_getContentHeight()
					if self.contentHeight ~= nil then
						return self.contentHeight
					end

					local maxBottom = 0
					for _, child in ipairs(self.children) do
						if not child.destroyed and child.enabled ~= false then
							maxBottom = math.max(maxBottom, getChildBottom(child))
						end
					end
					return maxBottom
				end

				function scrollView:AddWidget(widget)
					if type(widget) ~= "table" or not widget._mountTo then
						error("Plugin ScrollView:AddWidget expects a widget returned by CreateWidget")
					end

					widget:_mountTo(self.children)
					return widget
				end

				function scrollView:CreateWidget(widgetType, widgetConfig, widgetOptions)
					local options = copyTable(widgetOptions or {})
					options.mount = false

					local widget =
						makeMountedWidget(windowData, topRenderables, allWidgets, widgetType, widgetConfig, options)

					return self:AddWidget(widget)
				end

				function scrollView:GetWidgets()
					return self.children
				end

				function scrollView:GetWidgetAliases()
					return Plugin:GetWidgetAliases()
				end

				function scrollView:Set(prop, value)
					if prop == "x" or prop == "y" or prop == "width" or prop == "height" or prop == "padding" then
						self[prop] = value
					elseif prop == "scroll" or prop == "scrollY" then
						self.scrollY = math.max(0, value or 0)
					elseif prop == "enabled" or prop == "visible" then
						self.enabled = not not value
					elseif prop == "absolute" then
						self.absolute = not not value
					elseif prop == "order" or prop == "zindex" then
						self.order = value or 0
					else
						self[prop] = value
					end
					return self
				end

				function scrollView:Get(prop)
					if prop == "scroll" then
						return self.scrollY
					end
					return self[prop]
				end

				function scrollView:SetScroll(value)
					self.scrollY = math.max(0, value or 0)
					return self
				end

				function scrollView:ScrollTo(value)
					return self:SetScroll(value)
				end

				function scrollView:ClearWidgets(destroyChildren)
					for i = #self.children, 1, -1 do
						local child = self.children[i]
						if destroyChildren and child.Destroy then
							child:Destroy()
						else
							child._parentList = nil
							table.remove(self.children, i)
						end
					end
				end

				function scrollView:Destroy()
					if self.destroyed then
						return
					end

					self.destroyed = true
					self.enabled = false
					self:ClearWidgets(false)
					removeArrayValue(topRenderables, self)
					removeArrayValue(scrollViews, self)
				end

				function scrollView:render(dt, _windowState, baseX, baseY)
					if self.destroyed or not self.enabled then
						return
					end

					local viewX = self.absolute and self.x or (baseX + self.x)
					local viewY = self.absolute and self.y or (baseY + self.y)
					local viewWidth = self.width
					local viewHeight = self.height

					if
						self.backgroundColor
						and self.backgroundTransparency ~= nil
						and self.backgroundTransparency < 1
					then
						lib.DrawRectangleRec(
							arect:translate(arect.new(viewX, viewY, viewWidth, viewHeight)),
							colorToRaylib(self.backgroundColor, self.backgroundTransparency)
						)
					end

					local padding = self.padding
					local innerX = viewX + padding
					local innerY = viewY + padding
					local innerWidth = math.max(1, viewWidth - padding * 2)
					local innerHeight = math.max(1, viewHeight - padding * 2)

					local contentHeight = math.max(0, self:_getContentHeight())
					local maxScroll = math.max(0, contentHeight - innerHeight)
					self.scrollY = math.clamp(self.scrollY, 0, maxScroll)

					local viewport = arect.new(viewX, viewY, viewWidth, viewHeight)

					if arect.MouseIsInRect(viewport) then
						local wheel = lib.GetMouseWheelMove()
						if wheel ~= 0 then
							self.scrollY = math.clamp(self.scrollY - wheel * self.wheelStep, 0, maxScroll)
						end
					end

					if self.clip then
						lib.BeginScissorMode(viewX, viewY, viewWidth, viewHeight)
					end

					table.sort(self.children, function(a, b)
						return (a.order or 0) < (b.order or 0)
					end)

					for _, child in ipairs(self.children) do
						if child and child._render then
							child:_render(dt, innerX, innerY, -self.scrollY)
						end
					end

					if self.clip then
						lib.EndScissorMode()
					end

					if self.showScrollbar and maxScroll > 0 then
						local trackX = viewX + viewWidth - self.scrollbarWidth - 2
						local trackY = viewY + 2
						local trackHeight = viewHeight - 4

						lib.DrawRectangleRec(
							arect:translate(arect.new(trackX, trackY, self.scrollbarWidth, trackHeight)),
							colorToRaylib(self.trackColor, self.trackTransparency)
						)

						local thumbHeight = math.max(20, (innerHeight / contentHeight) * trackHeight)
						local thumbTravel = trackHeight - thumbHeight
						local thumbY = trackY + (self.scrollY / maxScroll) * thumbTravel

						lib.DrawRectangleRec(
							arect:translate(arect.new(trackX, thumbY, self.scrollbarWidth, thumbHeight)),
							colorToRaylib(self.scrollbarColor, self.scrollbarTransparency)
						)
					end
				end

				table.insert(topRenderables, scrollView)
				table.insert(scrollViews, scrollView)
				attachFriendlyFactories(scrollView, function(widgetType, widgetConfig, widgetOptions)
					return scrollView:CreateWidget(widgetType, widgetConfig, widgetOptions)
				end)
				return scrollView
			end

			function windowData:AddRenderCallback(callback, order)
				local renderable = {
					order = order or 0,
					enabled = true,
					destroyed = false,
				}

				function renderable:SetEnabled(value)
					self.enabled = not not value
				end

				function renderable:Destroy()
					if self.destroyed then
						return
					end
					self.destroyed = true
					self.enabled = false
					removeArrayValue(topRenderables, self)
				end

				function renderable:render(dt, currentWindow, baseX, baseY)
					callback(dt, currentWindow, baseX, baseY)
				end

				table.insert(topRenderables, renderable)
				return renderable
			end

			function windowData:GetWidgets()
				return allWidgets
			end

			function windowData:GetScrollViews()
				return scrollViews
			end

			function windowData:ClearWidgets(destroyWidgets)
				for i = #allWidgets, 1, -1 do
					local widget = allWidgets[i]
					if destroyWidgets == false then
						widget.destroyed = true
						widget.enabled = false
						if widget._parentList then
							removeArrayValue(widget._parentList, widget)
							widget._parentList = nil
						end
						table.remove(allWidgets, i)
					else
						widget:Destroy()
					end
				end

				for i = #scrollViews, 1, -1 do
					local scrollView = scrollViews[i]
					scrollView:Destroy()
				end

				for i = #topRenderables, 1, -1 do
					local item = topRenderables[i]
					if item.destroyed ~= false and item.destroyed ~= nil then
						table.remove(topRenderables, i)
					end
				end
			end

			function windowData:Destroy()
				self:ClearWidgets(true)
				self.Closed = true
				self.enabled = false
				self.Enabled = false
			end

			function windowData:GetAvailableWidgets()
				return availableWidgetTypes
			end

			function windowData:GetWidgetAliases()
				return Plugin:GetWidgetAliases()
			end

			attachFriendlyFactories(windowData, function(widgetType, widgetConfig, widgetOptions)
				return windowData:CreateWidget(widgetType, widgetConfig, widgetOptions)
			end)

			return windowData
		end

		local function layoutToolbar(toolbar)
			local contentWidth = math.max(toolbar.Window.width - (toolbar.Window.ContentPaddingX or 0) * 2 - 10, 140)
			local currentX = 0
			local currentY = 0
			local rowHeight = 28

			for _, button in ipairs(toolbar.Buttons) do
				local textLength = #(button.Text or "")
				local buttonWidth = button.Width or math.max(74, math.min(180, 26 + textLength * 8))

				if currentX > 0 and currentX + buttonWidth > contentWidth then
					currentX = 0
					currentY += rowHeight + 6
				end

				button.Widget:Set("x", currentX)
				button.Widget:Set("y", currentY)
				button.Widget:Set("width", buttonWidth)
				button.Widget:Set("height", rowHeight)
				currentX += buttonWidth + 6
			end

			local totalHeight = math.max(currentY + rowHeight, rowHeight)
			toolbar.Window:Resize(toolbar.Window.width, math.max(68, totalHeight + 38))
		end

		local function styleToolbarButton(button)
			local background
			local hover
			local pressed

			if button.Enabled == false then
				background = Color3.new(0.16, 0.16, 0.18)
				hover = Color3.new(0.16, 0.16, 0.18)
				pressed = Color3.new(0.16, 0.16, 0.18)
			elseif button.Active then
				background = Color3.new(0.09, 0.43, 0.88)
				hover = Color3.new(0.13, 0.5, 0.97)
				pressed = Color3.new(0.08, 0.34, 0.74)
			else
				background = Color3.new(0.22, 0.22, 0.25)
				hover = Color3.new(0.28, 0.28, 0.32)
				pressed = Color3.new(0.17, 0.17, 0.2)
			end

			if button.WidgetType == "iconButton" then
				button.Widget:Set("icon", button.Icon)
			else
				button.Widget:Set("text", button.Text)
			end
			button.Widget:Set("backgroundColor", background)
			button.Widget:Set("hoverColor", hover)
			button.Widget:Set("pressColor", pressed)
			if button.WidgetType ~= "iconButton" then
				button.Widget:Set(
					"textColor",
					button.Enabled == false and Color3.new(0.55, 0.55, 0.58) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				)
			end
		end

		local function createToolbar(name)
			local toolbarWindow = createWindowHandle({
				title = name or "Toolbar",
				x = 16,
				y = 16 + (#toolbars * 84),
				width = 280,
				height = 68,
				contentPaddingX = 8,
				contentPaddingY = 8,
				pluginGuiId = tostring(name or "Toolbar"),
			})

			local toolbar = {
				Name = name or "Toolbar",
				Window = toolbarWindow,
				Buttons = {},
				ButtonCreated = signal.new(),
			}

			function toolbar:CreateButton(buttonId, tooltip, icon, text)
				local label = text or tooltip or buttonId or "Button"
				local resolvedIcon = resolveToolbarIcon(icon)
				local widget

				if resolvedIcon then
					widget = self.Window:CreateWidget("iconButton", {
						icon = resolvedIcon,
						size = 30,
					})
				else
					widget = self.Window:CreateTextButton({
						text = label,
						width = math.max(74, math.min(180, 26 + #label * 8)),
						height = 28,
					})
				end

				local button = {
					Id = buttonId or label,
					Text = label,
					Tooltip = tooltip,
					Icon = resolvedIcon,
					Widget = widget,
					WidgetType = resolvedIcon and "iconButton" or "textButton",
					Enabled = true,
					Active = false,
					Width = resolvedIcon and 34 or nil,
					Click = signal.new(),
				}

				styleToolbarButton(button)

				widget:Connect("Activated", function(...)
					if button.Enabled == false then
						return
					end
					button.Click:Fire(...)
				end)

				function button:SetActive(value)
					self.Active = not not value
					styleToolbarButton(self)
					return self
				end

				function button:SetEnabled(value)
					self.Enabled = not not value
					styleToolbarButton(self)
					return self
				end

				function button:SetText(value)
					self.Text = tostring(value or "")
					styleToolbarButton(self)
					layoutToolbar(toolbar)
					return self
				end

				function button:Destroy()
					self.Widget:Destroy()
					self.Click:Destroy()
					removeArrayValue(toolbar.Buttons, self)
					layoutToolbar(toolbar)
				end

				table.insert(self.Buttons, button)
				layoutToolbar(self)
				self.ButtonCreated:Fire(button)
				return button
			end

			function toolbar:GetButtons()
				return self.Buttons
			end

			function toolbar:Destroy()
				for i = #self.Buttons, 1, -1 do
					self.Buttons[i]:Destroy()
				end
				self.ButtonCreated:Destroy()
				self.Window:Destroy()
				removeArrayValue(toolbars, self)
			end

			table.insert(toolbars, toolbar)
			return toolbar
		end

		local function normalizeDockWidgetConfig(pluginGuiId, dockInfo)
			local config = copyTable(dockInfo or {})
			local width, height = getSizePair(config.FloatingSize or config.InitialSize or config.Size, 360, 260)
			local x = config.x or config.X or 80
			local y = config.y or config.Y or 80

			return {
				id = pluginGuiId,
				pluginGuiId = pluginGuiId,
				title = config.Title or config.Name or tostring(pluginGuiId),
				x = x,
				y = y,
				width = width,
				height = height,
				enabled = config.Enabled ~= false and config.InitialEnabled ~= false,
				headerRender = config.HeaderRender ~= false,
				contentPaddingX = config.ContentPaddingX or 12,
				contentPaddingY = config.ContentPaddingY or 12,
				showStatusBar = config.ShowStatusBar == true,
				statusText = config.StatusText or "",
				tabs = config.Tabs,
				defaultTab = config.DefaultTab,
			}
		end

		function Plugin:CreateWindow(config)
			return createWindowHandle(config or {})
		end

		function Plugin:CreateDockWidgetPluginGui(pluginGuiId, dockInfo)

		end

		function Plugin:CreateToolbar(name)
			return createToolbar(name)
		end

		function Plugin:CreateWidget(widgetType, config)
			return createRawWidget(widgetType, config)
		end

		function Plugin:CreateAereonWidget(widgetType, config)
			return createRawWidget(widgetType, config)
		end

		function Plugin:SpawnWidget(widgetType, config)
			return createRawWidget(widgetType, config)
		end

		function Plugin:SpawnAereonWidget(widgetType, config)
			return createRawWidget(widgetType, config)
		end

		function Plugin:CreateWidgetTree(structure)
			return aereon.create(normalizeCreationStructure(structure))
		end

		function Plugin:GetAvailableWidgets()
			return availableWidgetTypes
		end

		function Plugin:GetWidgetAliases()
			local aliases = {}
			for alias in pairs(widgetTypeLookup) do
				if alias == string.lower(alias) and widgetTypeLookup[alias] then
					continue
				end
				table.insert(aliases, alias)
			end
			table.sort(aliases)
			return aliases
		end

		function Plugin:ResolveWidgetType(widgetType)
			return resolveWidgetType(widgetType)
		end

		Plugin.WidgetTypes = availableWidgetTypes
		Plugin.WidgetAliases = Plugin:GetWidgetAliases()
		Plugin.Ready = true

		renderer.Pool.new("2d", function()
			if not game.GetService then
				return
			end
			local StudioThemeService = game:GetService("StudioThemeService")
			if StudioThemeService then
				local dt = lib.GetFrameTime()
				window.update(dt, StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.aereon)
				window.draw(dt, StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.aereon)
			end
		end)
	end)

	return Plugin
end

local function parseSemver(v)
	local major, minor, patch = v:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)%.(%d+)$")
	if not major then
		return nil
	end
	return { major = tonumber(major), minor = tonumber(minor), patch = tonumber(patch) }
end

local function resolveUrl(baseUrl, maybeRelative)
	if type(maybeRelative) ~= "string" or maybeRelative == "" then
		return nil
	end

	if maybeRelative:match("^https?://") then
		return maybeRelative
	end

	local base = tostring(baseUrl or "")
	local origin = base:match("^(https?://[^/]+)")
	if not origin then
		return maybeRelative
	end

	if maybeRelative:sub(1, 1) == "/" then
		return origin .. maybeRelative
	end

	local baseDir = base:match("^(https?://.*/)") or (origin .. "/")
	return baseDir .. maybeRelative
end

-- Supports: "1.2.3" (exact), "^1.2.3" (compatible), ">=1.2.3" (minimum)
local function satisfiesVersion(wanted, got)
	local gotV = parseSemver(got)
	if not gotV then
		return false
	end

	local op, vstr = wanted:match("^([%^><=~]*)(.+)$")
	local wantedV = parseSemver(vstr)
	if not wantedV then
		return false
	end

	if op == "^" then
		-- Same major, got >= wanted
		return gotV.major == wantedV.major
			and (gotV.minor > wantedV.minor or (gotV.minor == wantedV.minor and gotV.patch >= wantedV.patch))
	elseif op == ">=" then
		return gotV.major > wantedV.major
			or (gotV.major == wantedV.major and gotV.minor > wantedV.minor)
			or (gotV.major == wantedV.major and gotV.minor == wantedV.minor and gotV.patch >= wantedV.patch)
	elseif op == "" or op == "=" then
		-- Exact match
		return gotV.major == wantedV.major and gotV.minor == wantedV.minor and gotV.patch == wantedV.patch
	end

	return false
end

})

local loadedPlugins = {}
local marketplaceCache = nil

local function getMarketplace()
	if not marketplaceCache then
		marketplaceCache = PluginLoader.GetPluginsMarketplace()
	end
	return marketplaceCache
end

local kilang = require("@Kilang")
local Transpiler = require("@Transpiler")

PluginLoader.InitRenderer = function(renderer, signal, datamodel)
	PluginLoader:SetProperties({

		LoadPluginDir = function(path)
			local manifest = fs.readFile(path .. "/manifest.json")
			local json = serde.json.decode(manifest)
			local main = fs.readFile(path .. "/" .. json.main, true)

			local success, result = PluginLoader.LoadPluginCode({
				["manifest.json"] = buffer.fromstring(manifest),
				[json.main] = main,
			})

			print("Got result from plugin " .. json.id .. "\n" .. tostring(success) .. "\n" .. tostring(result))

			return success, result
		end,

		LoadPluginCode = function(files)
			repeat
				task.wait()
			until datamodel.Loaded == true

			local success, result = pcall(function()
				-- find manifest inside zip
				local manifestRaw = files["manifest.json"]
				if not manifestRaw then
					print("Manifest does not exist in zip")
					return false
				end

				local json = serde.json.decode(buffer.tostring(manifestRaw))
				if not json then
					print("Failed to decode manifest")
					return false
				end

				local plugin_id = json.id
				local plugin_boot = json.main
				local plugin_intents = json.intents

				local resolved_intents = {}

				for i, intent in pairs(plugin_intents) do
					resolved_intents[i] = Enum.PluginIntents[intent]
				end

				if loadedPlugins[plugin_id] then
					print("Plugin already loaded")
					return false
				end

				-- dependency check
				if json.dependencies then
					for dep in pairs(json.dependencies) do
						if not loadedPlugins[dep] then
							print("Missing dependency: " .. dep)
							return false
						end
					end
				end

				-- schema validation
				local ok, path, err = plugin_schema:validate(json)
				if not ok then
					print("Invalid manifest at", path, "-", err)
					return false
				end

				-- resolve deps
				if json.dependencies then
					for dep, versionWanted in pairs(json.dependencies) do
						local existing = loadedPlugins[dep]

						if existing then
							local gotVersion = existing.manifest.version
							if not satisfiesVersion(versionWanted, gotVersion) then
								print(
									`Dependency "{dep}" loaded as {gotVersion} but {plugin_id} requires {versionWanted}`
								)
								return
							end
						else
							local marketplace = getMarketplace()
							local depEntry = marketplace[dep]

							if not depEntry then
								print(`Missing dependency "{dep}" not found in marketplace`)
								return
							end

							if not satisfiesVersion(versionWanted, depEntry.manifest.version) then
								print(
									`Marketplace has "{dep}@{depEntry.manifest.version}" but {plugin_id} requires {versionWanted}`
								)
								return
							end

							local depSuccess, depResult = PluginLoader.DownloadPlugin(depEntry.manifest, true)
							if not depSuccess then
								print(`Failed to auto-install dependency "{dep}": {tostring(depResult)}`)
								return
							end
						end
					end
				end

				-- read main file directly from zip
				local mainPath = plugin_boot
				local plugin_boot_read = files[mainPath]

				if not plugin_boot_read then
					print("Main file does not exist in zip:", mainPath)
					return false
				end

				local source = buffer.tostring(plugin_boot_read)

				local plugin_require

				local function plugin_run(source, path)
					local _, success, result = kilang:execute(source, {
						SecurityCapabilities = Enum.SecurityCapabilities.Internals,
						StackId = path,
					}, {
						GetFileContents = function(fileName)
							return files[fileName]
						end,
						require = plugin_require,
						ThreadPluginIntents = resolved_intents,
						PluginId = plugin_id,
					})

					return success, result
				end

				local requireCache = {}

				plugin_require = function(filePath)
					if requireCache[filePath] ~= nil then
						return requireCache[filePath]
					end

					if filePath:sub(1, 1) == "@" then
						local rest = filePath:sub(2)

						if rest == "Transpiler" then
							requireCache[filePath] = Transpiler
							return Transpiler
						end

						-- @engine/libname -> engine library via host require
						local engineLib = rest:match("^engine/(.+)$")
						if engineLib then
							local result = require("@" .. engineLib)
							requireCache[filePath] = result
							return result
						end

						-- @pluginid -> inter-plugin require
						local plugin = loadedPlugins[rest]
						if plugin then
							requireCache[filePath] = plugin.module
							return plugin.module
						end

						-- fallback to host require
						return require(filePath)
					end

					local normalized = filePath:gsub("^%./", "")
					local file: buffer? = files[normalized]

					if not file then
						warn(`[PluginLoader] require("{filePath}") -> file not found in plugin bundle`)
						return nil
					end

					local ext = normalized:match("%.([^%.]+)$")
					if ext == "lua" or ext == "luau" then
						local source = buffer.tostring(file)
						local success, result = plugin_run(source, filePath)

						if not success then
							warn("[PluginLoader] Failed to load file: " .. tostring(filePath), result)
							return nil
						end
						requireCache[filePath] = result
						return result
					else
						requireCache[filePath] = file
						return file
					end
				end

				local success, result = plugin_run(source, plugin_id)

				if not success then
					print(`Failed to load plugin {plugin_id}: {result}`)
					return false
				end

				loadedPlugins[plugin_id] = {
					manifest = json,
					module = result,
					files = files, -- keep zip in memory
				}

				if type(result) ~= "table" then
					print(`Plugin {plugin_id} does not return table`)
					return false
				end

				if type(result.activate) ~= "function" then
					print(`Expected function for activate, got {type(result.activate)}`)
					return false
				end

				if type(result.deactivate) ~= "function" then
					print(`Expected function for deactivate, got {type(result.deactivate)}`)
					return false
				end

				result.activate({
					Renderer = renderer,
					Signal = signal,
				})

				return true
			end)

			return success, result
		end,

		DownloadPlugin = function(pluginManifest, autoLoad)
			if type(pluginManifest) == "string" then
				local marketplace = PluginLoader.GetPluginsMarketplace()
				local found = marketplace and marketplace[string.lower(pluginManifest)]

				if not found then
					return false, "Plugin not found"
				end

				pluginManifest = found.manifest
			end
			local downloader = require("@Downloader")

			local function repoToZip(url, refType, ref)
				local user, repo = url:match("github%.com/([^/]+)/([^/]+)")
				if not user or not repo then
					return nil, "Invalid GitHub URL"
				end

				repo = repo:gsub("%.git$", "")

				refType = refType or "branch"
				ref = ref or "main"

				local typePath = refType == "tag" and "tags" or "heads"

				return ("https://github.com/%s/%s/archive/refs/%s/%s.zip"):format(user, repo, typePath, ref)
			end

			local dest = "./plugins/" .. pluginManifest.id .. ".kineplug"
			local zip = repoToZip(pluginManifest.repository, "branch", pluginManifest.branch or "main")

			local downloaded = downloader.download(zip, dest)

			local decoded = libzip.read(downloaded :: buffer)
			local normalized = {}

			for path, data in pairs(decoded) do
				local stripped = path:gsub("^[^/]+/", "")
				normalized[stripped] = data
			end

			local success, result

			if autoLoad then
				success, result = PluginLoader.LoadPluginCode(normalized)
			end

			return success, result, normalized
		end,

		UnloadPlugin = function(pluginId)
			local plugin = loadedPlugins[pluginId]

			if not plugin then
				print(`Plugin {pluginId} does not exist`)
				return
			end

			plugin.module.deactivate({
				Renderer = renderer,
				Signal = signal,
			})

			loadedPlugins[pluginId] = nil
		end,

		GetLoadedPlugins = function()
			return loadedPlugins
		end,

		GetPluginApi = function(id)
			local plugin = loadedPlugins[id]
			return plugin and plugin.module or nil
		end,

		GetPluginsMarketplace = function()
			local HttpService = datamodel:GetService("HttpService")

			local decoded, response = HttpService:GetAsync(ENGINE_ENDPOINT.MARKETPLACE, {
				["User-Agent"] = "Kinemium-Engine",
			})

			if type(response) == "string" then
				if string.find(response, "UnknownHostName") then
					return nil, "Invalid host name"
				end
			end

			local success, result = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(decoded)
			end)

			if not success then
				print("Failed decoding json: " .. result)
				return {}
			end

			decoded = result

			local base64 = zune.serde.base64
			local marketplaceUrl = ENGINE_ENDPOINT.MARKETPLACE

			local function decodeImageBlob(value)
				if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" then
					return nil
				end

				local b64 = value:match("^data:[^;]+;base64,(.+)$")
				if b64 then
					return base64.decode(buffer.fromstring(b64))
				end

				-- keep remote assets as URLs; do not fetch here to avoid blocking UI thread
				if value:match("^https?://") then
					return nil
				end

				-- plain base64 payload without data: prefix
				local ok, decodedValue = pcall(base64.decode, buffer.fromstring(value))
				if ok then
					return decodedValue
				end

				return nil
			end

			local list = {}

			for _, entry in ipairs(decoded.plugins or {}) do
				local manifest = entry.manifest
				if not manifest or not manifest.id then
					continue
				end

				local iconBlob = decodeImageBlob(entry.icon)
				local thumbnailBlob = decodeImageBlob(entry.thumbnail)

				if not iconBlob and entry.assets and entry.assets.iconUrl then
					iconBlob = decodeImageBlob(entry.assets.iconUrl)
				end

				if not thumbnailBlob and entry.assets and entry.assets.thumbnailUrl then
					thumbnailBlob = decodeImageBlob(entry.assets.thumbnailUrl)
				end

				list[manifest.id] = {
					manifest = manifest,
					url = entry.url
						or (entry.download and resolveUrl(marketplaceUrl, entry.download.url))
						or resolveUrl(marketplaceUrl, entry.detailsUrl),
					thumbnail = thumbnailBlob,
					icon = iconBlob,
					iconUrl = resolveUrl(marketplaceUrl, entry.icon or (entry.assets and entry.assets.iconUrl)),
					thumbnailUrl = resolveUrl(
						marketplaceUrl,
						entry.thumbnail or (entry.assets and entry.assets.thumbnailUrl)
					),
				}
			end

			return list
		end,
	})

	task.spawn(function()
		local entries = zune.fs.entries("./plugins")
		for _, entry in pairs(entries) do
			local path = "./plugins/" .. entry.name
			if entry.kind == "directory" then
				PluginLoader.LoadPluginDir(path)
			elseif entry.kind == "file" and string.find(entry.name, ".kineplug") then
				local contents = fs.readFile(path, true)
				local decoded = libzip.read(contents)
				local normalized = {}

				for path, data in pairs(decoded) do
					local stripped = path:gsub("^[^/]+/", "")
					normalized[stripped] = data
				end
				PluginLoader.LoadPluginCode(normalized)
			end
		end
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until datamodel.Loaded == true
		local pluginArg = GetFlagValue("plugin")
		if pluginArg then
			PluginLoader.LoadPluginDir(pluginArg)
		end
	end)
end

return PluginLoader

local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local ProjectLoaderService = Instance.new("LogService")
ProjectLoaderService.ExplorerHidden = true
ProjectLoaderService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.Filesystem

export type ProjectConfig = {
	info: {
		name: string,
		icon: string,
		desc: string,
	},

	pointers: {
		assets: string,
		server: string,
		client: string,
		gui: string,
		objects: string,
	},

	plugins: {
		[string]: any,
	},

	sync: {
		live: boolean,
		debounce: number,
		ignore: {
			git: string,
			vscode: string,
		},
	},

	backups: {
		interval: number,
	},

	scripting: {
		polyglot: boolean,
		ncg: boolean,
	},
}

local function buildProjectConfig(name, iconPath, description, PluginLoader)
	local plugins_built = {}

	for i, data in pairs(PluginLoader.GetLoadedPlugins()) do
		plugins_built[data.manifest.name] =
			{ id = i, version = data.manifest.version, author = data.manifest.author, autoload = true }
	end

	return {
		info = {
			name = name,
			icon = iconPath,
			desc = description,
		},
		pointers = {
			assets = "game.ReplicatedStorage",
			server = "game.ServerScriptService",
			client = "game.StarterPlayer",
			gui = "game.StarterGui",
			objects = "game.Workspace",
		},
		plugins = plugins_built,

		sync = {
			live = false,
			debounce = 0.35,
			ignore = { git = ".git", vscode = ".vscode" },
		},
		backups = {
			interval = 300,
		},
		scripting = {
			polyglot = true,
			ncg = true,
		},
	}
end

ProjectLoaderService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	ProjectLoaderService:SetProperties({
		GetProjects = function()
			local success, read = pcall(fs.readFile, projectsFile)
			if not success or read == "" then
				return {}
			end

			local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(toml.decode, read)
			if not decodeSuccess then
				return {}
			end

			if data then
				if data.projects then
					local result = {}

					for _, project in pairs(data.projects) do
						if zune.fs.stat(project.path).kind ~= "directory" then
							continue
						end
						if zune.fs.stat(project.path .. "/kproj.toml").kind ~= "file" then
							continue
						end
						project.manifest = zune.serde.toml.decode(fs.readFile(project.path .. "/kproj.toml"))
						table.insert(result, project)
					end

					return result
				else
					return {}
				end
			end
			return {}
		end,

		StartObserve = function(path) end,

		NewProject = function(name, path, iconPath, description)
			if not name then
				return
			end
			if not path then
				return
			end

			local kprojFile = path .. "/kproj.toml"
			-- write to projects list
			local projects = ProjectLoaderService.GetProjects()

			projects[name] = {
				icon = iconPath,
				path = path,
				name = name,
				engine_version = ENGINE_VERSION,
				last_opened = os.time(),
			}

			local encoded = toml.encode({
				projects = projects,
			})

			fs.writeFile(projectsFile, encoded)

			-- write project settings file
			local success, result = pcall(function()
				fs.makeDir(path .. "/assets", true)
				fs.makeDir(path .. "/server", true)
				fs.makeDir(path .. "/client", true)
				fs.makeDir(path .. "/gui", true)
				fs.makeDir(path .. "/objects", true)
				fs.makeDir(path .. "/.vscode", true)

				fs.writeFile(
					path .. "/.vscode/settings.json",
					zune.serde.json.encode(settings, {
						pretty_indent = 1,
					})
				)

				repeat
					task.wait()
				until datamodel:GetService("PluginLoader")

				local config = buildProjectConfig(name, iconPath, description, datamodel:GetService("PluginLoader"))
				local encodedProject = serde.toml.encode(config)
				fs.writeFile(kprojFile, encodedProject)
			end)

			if not success then
				print(result)
			end

			return encoded
		end,

		LoadProject = function(projectPath, conf: { manifest: ProjectConfig })
			local ProjectSyncService = datamodel:GetService("ProjectSyncService")
			local PluginLoader = datamodel:GetService("PluginLoader")
			local loadedPlugins = PluginLoader.GetLoadedPlugins()

			datamodel:SetMetadata("ProjectManif", conf.manifest)

			-- not sure how to separate backups from the syncing function, maybe later
			if conf.manifest.sync.live == true then
				ProjectSyncService:StartSyncing(projectPath)
			end

			-- spawn in separate thread
			zune.task.spawn(function()
				-- check if conf.manifest.plugins exists (for backwards compat)
				if conf.manifest.plugins then
					for id, data in pairs(conf.manifest.plugins) do
						-- if plugin's autoload is not true then skip
						if data.autoload == false then
							continue
						end

						id = data.id

						if loadedPlugins[id] then
							local manifest = loadedPlugins[id].manifest
							-- if project plugin version is not the same as the installed plugin
							if data.version ~= manifest.version then
								-- remove plugin
								PluginLoader.UnloadPlugin(id)
								PluginLoader.DownloadPlugin(id, true)
							end

							continue
						end

						-- if the user does not have the plugin the project requires, install it
						local success, result = PluginLoader.DownloadPlugin(id, true)

						if not success then
							print(`Error while downloading project dependency {id}: {result}`)
							continue
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end,

		GetGamesAsSubmenu = function(func)
			local read = fs.readFile(projectsFile)
			local data = toml.decode(read)
			local result = {}

			if data then
				local pjs = data.projects

				if pjs then
					for _, projectData in pairs(pjs) do
						table.insert(result, {
							label = projectData.name,
							onClick = function()
								func(projectData)
							end,
						})
					end
				end
			end

			return result
		end,
	})
end

return ProjectLoaderService

local function resolvePath(root, path)
	local current = root

	for segment in path:gmatch("[^%.]+") do
		if segment == "game" then
			current = root
		else
			if not current then
				return nil
			end
			current = current:FindFirstChild(segment)
		end
	end

	return current
end
