local clientExts = {
	[".client.luau"] = Enum.Language.Luau,
	[".client.ts"] = Enum.Language.Luau,
	[".client.py"] = Enum.Language.Luau,
	[".client.wasm"] = Enum.Language.Luau,
}
local moduleExts = {
	[".luau"] = Enum.Language.Luau,
	[".ts"] = Enum.Language.Luau,
	[".py"] = Enum.Language.Luau,
	[".wasm"] = Enum.Language.Luau,
}

local function makeScript(scriptType, name, source, language, runContext)
	local new = Instance.new(scriptType)
	new.Source = source
	new.Name = name
	new.Language = language
	new.RunContext = runContext or Enum.RunContext.Server
	new.BaseClass = "ScriptContainer"
	return new
end

local function getExtension(name: string): string
	local double = name:match("%.[^.]+%.[^.]+$")
	if double then
		return double
	end
	return name:match("%.[^.]+$") or ""
end

local function stripExtension(name: string, ext: string): string
	return name:sub(1, #name - #ext)
end

local function buildDefaultProjectConfig(projectPath)
	local projectName = fs.path.basename(projectPath)

	return {
		info = {
			name = projectName,
		},
		pointers = {
			assets = "game.ReplicatedStorage",
			server = "game.ServerScriptService",
			client = "game.StarterPlayerScripts",
			gui = "game.StarterGui",
			objects = "game.Workspace",
		},
		sync = {
			live = false,
			debounce = 0.35,
			ignore = { ".git", ".vscode", "autosave", "backups" },
		},
		backups = {
			interval = 300,
		},
		scripting = {
			polyglot = true,
			ntvcg = true,
		},
	}
end

local function canRepairProjectConfig(projectPath)
	local required = { "assets", "server", "client", "gui", "objects" }

	for _, dirName in ipairs(required) do
		local stat = fs.stat(fs.path.join(projectPath, dirName))
		if stat.kind ~= "directory" then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

local function joinRelative(base, child)
	if not base or base == "" then
		return child
	end
	return base .. "/" .. child
end

local function normalizeProjectId(projectPath)
	local ok, result = pcall(fs.realPath, projectPath)
	if ok and result and result ~= "" then
		return result
	end
	return projectPath
end

local function makeIgnoreLookup(configIgnore)
	local lookup = {}

	for name, enabled in pairs(DEFAULT_IGNORE) do
		if enabled then
			lookup[name] = true
		end
	end

	if type(configIgnore) == "table" then
		for _, name in ipairs(configIgnore) do
			if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then
				lookup[name] = true
			end
		end

		for name, enabled in pairs(configIgnore) do
			if type(name) == "string" and enabled == true then
				lookup[name] = true
			end
		end
	end

	return lookup
end

local function shouldIgnoreName(name, ignoreLookup)
	if ignoreLookup[name] then
		return true
	end

	if name:sub(1, 1) == "." and not name:match("^init%.") then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local function getScriptDescriptor(name)
	local ext = getExtension(name)
	local scriptType = "ModuleScript"
	local language = Enum.Language.Luau
	local runContext = Enum.RunContext.Server

	if serverExts[ext] then
		scriptType = "Script"
		language = serverExts[ext]
		runContext = Enum.RunContext.Server
	elseif clientExts[ext] then
		scriptType = "LocalScript"
		language = clientExts[ext]
		runContext = Enum.RunContext.Client
	elseif moduleExts[ext] then
		language = moduleExts[ext]
	else
		return nil
	end

	return {
		ext = ext,
		scriptType = scriptType,
		language = language,
		runContext = runContext,
	}
end

local function tagManagedInstance(state, pointerName, instance, sourcePath, relativePath)
	instance:SetAttribute(ATTR_PROJECT, state.projectId)
	instance:SetAttribute(ATTR_POINTER, pointerName)
	instance:SetAttribute(ATTR_SOURCE, sourcePath)
	instance:SetAttribute(ATTR_RELATIVE, relativePath)
	state.syncedObjects += 1
end

local function isSerializableInstance(instance)
	return instance.ClassName == "Folder"
		or instance.BaseClass == "ScriptContainer"
		or instance.ClassName == "Script"
		or instance.ClassName == "LocalScript"
		or instance.ClassName == "ModuleScript"
end

local function markDiskWrite(state, path)
	if state and path then
		state.localWrites[path] = true
	end
end

local function writeFileFromEngine(state, path, contents)
	markDiskWrite(state, path)
	fs.writeFile(path, contents or "")
end

local function scheduleSourceWrite(state, instance, path, contents)
	if not state or activeState ~= state or state.active ~= true then
		return
	end

	state.pendingSourceWrites = state.pendingSourceWrites or {}
	state.pendingSourceWriteTasks = state.pendingSourceWriteTasks or {}
	state.pendingSourceWrites[path] = {
		instance = instance,
		contents = contents or "",
	}

	if state.pendingSourceWriteTasks[path] then
		return
	end

	state.pendingSourceWriteTasks[path] = task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(0.5)
		state.pendingSourceWriteTasks[path] = nil

		if activeState ~= state or state.active ~= true then
			return
		end

		local pending = state.pendingSourceWrites and state.pendingSourceWrites[path]
		if not pending then
			return
		end
		state.pendingSourceWrites[path] = nil

		if pending.instance ~= instance then
			return
		end

		local nextSource = pending.contents
		local okRead, currentSource = pcall(fs.readFile, path)
		if okRead and currentSource == nextSource then
			return
		end

		local okWrite, err = pcall(writeFileFromEngine, state, path, nextSource)
		if not okWrite then
			state.lastError = tostring(err)
			warn(`[ProjectSync] Failed writing script source '{path}': {state.lastError}`)
		end
	end)
end

local function connectSyncListener(state, connection)
	state.syncConnections = state.syncConnections or {}
	table.insert(state.syncConnections, connection)
end

local function getDiskPathForAddedChild(parent, child)
	local parentSource = parent:GetAttribute(ATTR_SOURCE)
	if not parentSource then
		return nil
	end

	local diskParentPath = parentSource
	local statOk, stat = pcall(fs.stat, parentSource)
	if statOk and stat and stat.kind == "file" then
		diskParentPath = fs.path.dirname(parentSource)
	end

	if child.ClassName == "Folder" then
		return fs.path.join(diskParentPath, child.Name)
	end

	if
		child.BaseClass == "ScriptContainer"
		or child.ClassName == "Script"
		or child.ClassName == "LocalScript"
		or child.ClassName == "ModuleScript"
	then
		local serializableChildren = {}
		for _, grandchild in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
			if isSerializableInstance(grandchild) then
				table.insert(serializableChildren, grandchild)
			end
		end

		local ext = getScriptExtension(child.ClassName, child.Language)
		if #serializableChildren == 0 then
			return fs.path.join(diskParentPath, child.Name .. ext)
		end
		return fs.path.join(diskParentPath, child.Name, "init" .. ext)
	end

	return nil
end

local function clearManagedChildren(target, projectId, pointerName)
	local children = target:GetChildren()

	for _, child in ipairs(children) do
		if child:GetAttribute(ATTR_PROJECT) == projectId and child:GetAttribute(ATTR_POINTER) == pointerName then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function sortEntries(entries)
	table.sort(entries, function(a, b)
		if a.kind ~= b.kind then
			return a.kind == "directory"
		end
		return string.lower(a.name) < string.lower(b.name)
	end)
end

local function getManagedRemovalPath(instance)
	local sourcePath = instance:GetAttribute(ATTR_SOURCE)
	if not sourcePath then
		return nil
	end

	if instance.ClassName == "Folder" then
		return sourcePath
	end

	local sourceName = fs.path.basename(sourcePath)
	if sourceName and sourceName:match("^init%.") then
		return fs.path.dirname(sourcePath)
	end

	return sourcePath
end

local function syncDirectory(state, pointerName, dirPath, parentObject, isRoot, ignoreLookup, relativePath)
	local entries = fs.entries(dirPath)
	sortEntries(entries)

	local initEntry = nil
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		if entry.kind == "file" and not shouldIgnoreName(entry.name, ignoreLookup) and entry.name:match("^init%.") then
			initEntry = entry
			break
		end
	end

	local container
	if isRoot then
		container = parentObject
	elseif initEntry then
		local initPath = fs.path.join(dirPath, initEntry.name)
		local source = fs.readFile(initPath)
		local descriptor = getScriptDescriptor(initEntry.name)
		if not descriptor then
			error(`[ProjectSync] Unsupported init script '{initEntry.name}' in '{dirPath}'`)
		end

		local dirName = fs.path.basename(dirPath)
		container = makeScript(descriptor.scriptType, dirName, source, descriptor.language, descriptor.runContext)
		tagManagedInstance(state, pointerName, container, initPath, relativePath)
		container.Parent = parentObject
		registerManagedInstance(state, pointerName, container)
	else
		local dirName = fs.path.basename(dirPath)
		container = Instance.new("Folder")
		container.Name = dirName
		tagManagedInstance(state, pointerName, container, dirPath, relativePath)
		container.Parent = parentObject
		registerManagedInstance(state, pointerName, container)
	end

	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		if shouldIgnoreName(entry.name, ignoreLookup) then
			continue
		end

		if entry.kind == "file" and entry.name:match("^init%.") then
			continue
		end

		local entryPath = fs.path.join(dirPath, entry.name)
		local entryRelativePath = joinRelative(relativePath, entry.name)

		if entry.kind == "directory" then
			syncDirectory(state, pointerName, entryPath, container, false, ignoreLookup, entryRelativePath)
		elseif entry.kind == "file" then
			local descriptor = getScriptDescriptor(entry.name)
			if not descriptor then
				continue
			end

			local source = fs.readFile(entryPath)
			local name = stripExtension(entry.name, descriptor.ext)
			local child = makeScript(descriptor.scriptType, name, source, descriptor.language, descriptor.runContext)
			tagManagedInstance(state, pointerName, child, entryPath, entryRelativePath)
			child.Parent = container
			registerManagedInstance(state, pointerName, child)
		end
	end
end

local function readProjectConfig(projectPath)
	local configPath = projectPath .. "/kproj.toml"
	local okRead, configFile = pcall(fs.readFile, configPath)

	if not okRead then
		error(`[ProjectSync] Failed to read project config '{configPath}': {tostring(configFile)}`)
	end

	local trimmed = string.gsub(configFile or "", "%s+", "")
	if trimmed == "" then
		if canRepairProjectConfig(projectPath) then
			local repaired = buildDefaultProjectConfig(projectPath)
			fs.writeFile(configPath, toml.encode(repaired))
			warn(`[ProjectSync] Repaired empty project config at '{configPath}'`)
			return repaired, configPath
		end

		error(`[ProjectSync] Project config is empty: '{configPath}'`)
	end

	local okDecode, decoded = pcall(toml.decode, configFile)
	if not okDecode then
		if canRepairProjectConfig(projectPath) then
			local repaired = buildDefaultProjectConfig(projectPath)
			fs.writeFile(configPath, toml.encode(repaired))
			warn(`[ProjectSync] Repaired invalid project config at '{configPath}'`)
			return repaired, configPath
		end

		error(`[ProjectSync] Failed to decode project config '{configPath}': {tostring(decoded)}`)
	end

	if decoded == nil then
		if canRepairProjectConfig(projectPath) then
			local repaired = buildDefaultProjectConfig(projectPath)
			fs.writeFile(configPath, toml.encode(repaired))
			warn(`[ProjectSync] Repaired undecodable project config at '{configPath}'`)
			return repaired, configPath
		end

		error(`[ProjectSync] Project config decoded to nil: '{configPath}'`)
	end

	return decoded, configPath
end

local function resolveRoots(projectPath, config, game)
	local roots = {}
	local missing = {}
	local pointers = config.pointers or {}

	for dirName, pointer in pairs(pointers) do
		local service = resolvePath(game, pointer)
		if not service then
			table.insert(missing, `[ProjectSync] Could not resolve pointer '{pointer}' for '{dirName}'`)
			continue
		end

		local dirPath = fs.path.join(projectPath, dirName)
		local stat = fs.stat(dirPath)
		if stat.kind ~= "directory" then
			table.insert(missing, `[ProjectSync] Missing project directory '{dirPath}'`)
			continue
		end

		table.insert(roots, {
			name = dirName,
			pointer = pointer,
			dirPath = dirPath,
			target = service,
		})
	end

	table.sort(roots, function(a, b)
		return string.lower(a.name) < string.lower(b.name)
	end)

	return roots, missing
end

local function shouldEnableWatch(state)
	if state.options.watch ~= nil then
		return state.options.watch == true
	end

	local syncConfig = state.config and state.config.sync or nil
	if type(syncConfig) == "table" then
		if syncConfig.live ~= nil then
			return syncConfig.live == true
		end
		if syncConfig.watch ~= nil then
			return syncConfig.watch == true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function getDebounceDelay(state)
	if type(state.options.debounce) == "number" then
		return math.max(state.options.debounce, 0)
	end

	local syncConfig = state.config and state.config.sync or nil
	if type(syncConfig) == "table" and type(syncConfig.debounce) == "number" then
		return math.max(syncConfig.debounce, 0)
	end

	return 0.35
end

local function stopWatcher(state)
	if state and state.watcher then
		pcall(function()
			state.watcher:stop()
		end)
		state.watcher = nil
	end
end

disconnectSyncListeners = function(state)
	if not state or not state.syncConnections then
		return
	end

	for _, connection in ipairs(state.syncConnections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	state.syncConnections = {}
	state.registeredInstances = {}
end

local function cancelPendingRefresh(state)
	if state and state.pendingRefresh then
		pcall(task.cancel, state.pendingRefresh)
		state.pendingRefresh = nil
	end
end

local function snapshotState(state)
	if not state then
		return {
			active = false,
		}
	end

	local roots = {}
	for _, root in ipairs(state.roots or {}) do
		table.insert(roots, {
			name = root.name,
			pointer = root.pointer,
			dirPath = root.dirPath,
			target = root.target and root.target:GetFullName() or nil,
		})
	end

	return {
		active = state.active == true,
		projectPath = state.projectPath,
		projectId = state.projectId,
		watching = state.watcher ~= nil,
		lastReason = state.lastReason,
		lastError = state.lastError,
		lastSyncAt = state.lastSyncAt,
		syncCount = state.syncCount or 0,
		syncedObjects = state.syncedObjects or 0,
		lastWatchPath = state.lastWatchPath,
		lastWatchEvents = state.lastWatchEvents,
		lastBackupPath = state.lastBackupPath,
		lastBackupAt = state.lastBackupAt,
		roots = roots,
	}
end

local function getBackupInterval(config)
	local backupsConfig = config and config.backups or nil
	if type(backupsConfig) == "table" and type(backupsConfig.interval) == "number" then
		return math.max(backupsConfig.interval, 0)
	end

	local syncConfig = config and config.sync or nil
	if type(syncConfig) == "table" then
		if type(syncConfig.backupInterval) == "number" then
			return math.max(syncConfig.backupInterval, 0)
		end
		if type(syncConfig.backup_interval) == "number" then
			return math.max(syncConfig.backup_interval, 0)
		end
		if type(syncConfig.backupEvery) == "number" then
			return math.max(syncConfig.backupEvery, 0)
		end
	end

	return 300
end

local function getBackupDirectory(projectPath)
	return fs.path.join(projectPath, "backups")
end

local function getBackupName()
	return os.date("backup-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S.kine")
end

local function getBackupInstances(datamodel)
	local saved = {}
	for _, service in ipairs(datamodel:GetChildren()) do
		if service.Name == "Players" then
			continue
		end

		if service:GetChildren()[1] ~= nil then
			table.insert(saved, service)
		end
	end
	return saved
end

local function saveProjectBackup(state, reason)
	if not state or state.active ~= true then
		return nil
	end

	local SerializationService = state.game:GetService("SerializationService")
	local serialized = SerializationService.SerializeInstancesAsync(getBackupInstances(state.game))
	if not serialized then
		return nil
	end

	local backupsPath = getBackupDirectory(state.projectPath)
	fs.makeDir(backupsPath, true)

	local backupPath = fs.path.join(backupsPath, getBackupName())
	fs.writeFile(backupPath, serialized)
	state.lastBackupPath = backupPath
	state.lastBackupAt = os.time()
	state.lastBackupReason = reason or "interval"
	return backupPath
end

local function saveProjectBackupSafe(state, reason)
	if not state or state.active ~= true then
		return nil
	end

	local isCloseSave = reason == "close_request" or reason == "shutdown_hook" or reason == "stop_syncing"
	if isCloseSave and state.closeRequestBackupSaved then
		return state.lastBackupPath
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(saveProjectBackup, state, reason)
	if not ok then
		state.lastError = tostring(result)
		warn(`[ProjectSync] Backup failed ({reason or "manual"}): {state.lastError}`)
		return nil
	end

	if isCloseSave and result ~= nil then
		state.closeRequestBackupSaved = true
	end

	return result
end

local function saveActiveProjectBackup(reason)
	if not activeState or activeState.active ~= true then
		return nil
	end

	return saveProjectBackupSafe(activeState, reason)
end

local function getLatestBackupPath(projectPath)
	local backupsPath = getBackupDirectory(projectPath)
	local ok, entries = pcall(fs.entries, backupsPath)
	if not ok or not entries then
		return nil
	end

	local latest = nil
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		if entry.kind == "file" and entry.name:match("%.kine$") then
			if not latest or entry.name > latest.name then
				latest = entry
			end
		end
	end

	return latest and fs.path.join(backupsPath, latest.name) or nil
end

local function shouldPreserveRuntimeChild(target, child)
	if not target or not child then
		return false
	end

	if target.ClassName == "Workspace" and child.ClassName == "Camera" then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local function restoreBackupInstance(datamodel, instance)
	local target = datamodel:FindFirstChild(instance.Name)
	if target then
		for _, child in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do
			if child:GetAttribute(ATTR_PROJECT) == nil and not shouldPreserveRuntimeChild(target, child) then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if shouldPreserveRuntimeChild(target, child) then
				child:Destroy()
				continue
			end
			child.Parent = target
		end

		instance:Destroy()

		if target.ClassName == "Workspace" and target.Camera == nil then
			for _, child in ipairs(target:GetChildren()) do
				if child.ClassName == "Camera" then
					pcall(function()
						target.Camera = child
					end)
					break
				end
			end
		end
	else
		instance.Parent = datamodel
	end
end

local function loadLatestProjectBackup(state)
	local backupPath = getLatestBackupPath(state.projectPath)
	if not backupPath then
		return nil
	end

	local SerializationService = state.game:GetService("SerializationService")
	local read = fs.readFile(backupPath, true)
	local deserialized = SerializationService.Deserialize(read, nil, true)
	if not deserialized then
		return nil
	end

	local restored = 0
	if type(deserialized) == "table" and deserialized[1] ~= nil then
		for _, instance in ipairs(deserialized) do
			restoreBackupInstance(state.game, instance)
			restored += 1
		end
	else
		restoreBackupInstance(state.game, deserialized)
		restored += 1
	end

	state.lastBackupPath = backupPath
	return restored
end

local function stopBackupLoop(state)
	if state and state.backupTask then
		pcall(task.cancel, state.backupTask)
		state.backupTask = nil
	end
end

local function startBackupLoop(state)
	stopBackupLoop(state)

	local interval = getBackupInterval(state.config)
	if interval <= 0 then
		return
	end

	state.backupTask = task.spawn(function()
		while activeState == state and state.active == true do
			task.wait(interval)
			if activeState ~= state or state.active ~= true then
				break
			end

			saveProjectBackupSafe(state, "interval")
		end
	end)
end

local function cleanupManagedRoots(state)
	if not state or state.options.clearManaged == false then
		return
	end

	for _, root in ipairs(state.roots or {}) do
		clearManagedChildren(root.target, state.projectId, root.name)
	end
end

local function performSync(state, reason)
	local config, configPath = readProjectConfig(state.projectPath)
	local roots, warnings = resolveRoots(state.projectPath, config, state.game)
	local ignoreLookup = makeIgnoreLookup(config.sync and config.sync.ignore)

	disconnectSyncListeners(state)
	cleanupManagedRoots(state)

	state.config = config
	state.roots = roots
	state.ignoreLookup = ignoreLookup
	state.lastReason = reason or "manual"
	state.lastError = nil
	state.syncedObjects = 0
	state.lastConfigPath = configPath

	for _, warningMessage in ipairs(warnings) do
		warn(warningMessage)
	end

	state.syncingFromDisk = true
	local okSync, syncErr = pcall(function()
		for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
			syncDirectory(state, root.name, root.dirPath, root.target, true, ignoreLookup, "")
		end
	end)
	state.syncingFromDisk = false

	if not okSync then
		error(syncErr)
	end

	for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
		registerManagedInstance(state, root.name, root.target, root.dirPath, "")
	end

	state.syncCount = (state.syncCount or 0) + 1
	state.lastSyncAt = os.time()
end

local function scheduleRefresh(state, reason, changedPath, events)
	cancelPendingRefresh(state)
	state.lastWatchPath = changedPath
	state.lastWatchEvents = events

	state.pendingRefresh = task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(getDebounceDelay(state))
		state.pendingRefresh = nil

		if activeState ~= state or state.active ~= true then
			return
		end

		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			performSync(state, reason or "watch")
		end)

		if not ok then
			state.lastError = tostring(err)
			warn(`[ProjectSync] Refresh failed: {state.lastError}`)
		end
	end)
end

local function startWatcher(state)
	stopWatcher(state)

	if not shouldEnableWatch(state) then
		return
	end

	state.watcher = fs.watch(state.projectPath, function(changedPath, events)
		if state.localWrites and state.localWrites[changedPath] then
			state.localWrites[changedPath] = nil
			return
		end
		if type(changedPath) == "string" and changedPath:gsub("\\", "/"):find("/backups/", 1, true) then
			return
		end
		scheduleRefresh(state, "watch", changedPath, events)
	end)
end

local function stopState(state, clearManaged)
	if not state then
		return
	end

	cancelPendingRefresh(state)
	stopWatcher(state)
	stopBackupLoop(state)
	disconnectSyncListeners(state)
	state.active = false

	if clearManaged == true then
		local old = state.options.clearManaged
		state.options.clearManaged = true
		cleanupManagedRoots(state)
		state.options.clearManaged = old
	end
end

getScriptExtension = function(className, language)
	local langExt = "luau"
	if language == Enum.Language.JavaScript then
		langExt = "ts"
	elseif language == Enum.Language.Python then
		langExt = "py"
	elseif language == Enum.Language.WASM then
		langExt = "wasm"
	end

	if className == "Script" then
		return ".server." .. langExt
	elseif className == "LocalScript" then
		return ".client." .. langExt
	else
		return "." .. langExt
	end
end

deleteRecursive = function(path)
	local ok, stat = pcall(fs.stat, path)
	if not ok or not stat or stat.kind == "none" then
		return
	end
	if stat.kind == "file" then
		pcall(fs.deleteFile, path)
	elseif stat.kind == "directory" then
		local entries = fs.entries(path)
		if entries then
			for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
				deleteRecursive(fs.path.join(path, entry.name))
			end
		end
		pcall(fs.deleteDir, path)
		pcall(fs.removeDir, path)
		pcall(fs.deleteFile, path)
		pcall(fs.removeFile, path)
	end
end

writeInstanceToDisk = function(instance, diskParentPath)
	if instance.ClassName == "Folder" then
		local dirPath = fs.path.join(diskParentPath, instance.Name)
		pcall(fs.makeDir, dirPath, true)
		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			writeInstanceToDisk(child, dirPath)
		end
	elseif
		instance.BaseClass == "ScriptContainer"
		or instance.ClassName == "Script"
		or instance.ClassName == "LocalScript"
		or instance.ClassName == "ModuleScript"
	then
		local serializableChildren = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if
				child.ClassName == "Folder"
				or child.BaseClass == "ScriptContainer"
				or child.ClassName == "Script"
				or child.ClassName == "LocalScript"
				or child.ClassName == "ModuleScript"
			then
				table.insert(serializableChildren, child)
			end
		end

		if #serializableChildren == 0 then
			local ext = getScriptExtension(instance.ClassName, instance.Language)
			local fileName = instance.Name .. ext
			pcall(fs.writeFile, fs.path.join(diskParentPath, fileName), instance.Source or "")
		else
			local dirPath = fs.path.join(diskParentPath, instance.Name)
			pcall(fs.makeDir, dirPath, true)
			local ext = getScriptExtension(instance.ClassName, instance.Language)
			local initName = "init" .. ext
			pcall(fs.writeFile, fs.path.join(dirPath, initName), instance.Source or "")
			for _, child in ipairs(serializableChildren) do
				writeInstanceToDisk(child, dirPath)
			end
		end
	end
end

registerManagedInstance = function(state, pointerName, instance, sourcePath, relativePath)
	if not state or not instance or state.active == false then
		return
	end

	if state.registeredInstances and state.registeredInstances[instance] then
		return
	end

	state.registeredInstances = state.registeredInstances or {}
	state.registeredInstances[instance] = true

	if sourcePath then
		instance:SetAttribute(ATTR_PROJECT, state.projectId)
		instance:SetAttribute(ATTR_POINTER, pointerName)
		instance:SetAttribute(ATTR_SOURCE, sourcePath)
		instance:SetAttribute(ATTR_RELATIVE, relativePath or "")
	end

	if
		instance.BaseClass == "ScriptContainer"
		or instance.ClassName == "Script"
		or instance.ClassName == "LocalScript"
		or instance.ClassName == "ModuleScript"
	then
		connectSyncListener(
			state,
			instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Source"):Connect(function()
				if activeState ~= state or state.active ~= true or state.syncingFromDisk == true then
					return
				end

				local path = instance:GetAttribute(ATTR_SOURCE)
				if not path then
					return
				end

				scheduleSourceWrite(state, instance, path, instance.Source or "")
			end)
		)
	end

	connectSyncListener(
		state,
		instance.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if activeState ~= state or state.active ~= true or state.syncingFromDisk == true then
				return
			end

			if not isSerializableInstance(child) then
				return
			end

			task.spawn(function()
				local path = getDiskPathForAddedChild(instance, child)
				if not path then
					return
				end

				local parentRelative = instance:GetAttribute(ATTR_RELATIVE) or ""
				local relativeName = child.ClassName == "Folder" and child.Name or fs.path.basename(path)
				local childRelative = joinRelative(parentRelative, relativeName)

				local okWrite, err = pcall(function()
					local parentSource = instance:GetAttribute(ATTR_SOURCE)
					local diskParentPath = parentSource
					local okStat, stat = pcall(fs.stat, parentSource)
					if okStat and stat and stat.kind == "file" then
						diskParentPath = fs.path.dirname(parentSource)
					end
					writeInstanceToDisk(child, diskParentPath)
				end)

				if not okWrite then
					state.lastError = tostring(err)
					warn(`[ProjectSync] Failed writing added instance '{child.Name}': {state.lastError}`)
					return
				end

				tagManagedInstance(state, pointerName, child, path, childRelative)
				registerManagedInstance(state, pointerName, child)
			end)
		end)
	)

	connectSyncListener(
		state,
		instance.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
			if activeState ~= state or state.active ~= true or state.syncingFromDisk == true then
				return
			end

			task.spawn(function()
				local path = getManagedRemovalPath(child)
				if not path or child:GetAttribute(ATTR_PROJECT) ~= state.projectId then
					return
				end

				local okDelete, err = pcall(deleteRecursive, path)
				if not okDelete then
					state.lastError = tostring(err)
					warn(`[ProjectSync] Failed deleting removed instance '{path}': {state.lastError}`)
				end
			end)
		end)
	)
end

ProjectSyncService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, game)
	if not shutdownHookBound and renderer and renderer.Hook and renderer.Hook.new then
		shutdownHookBound = true
		renderer.Hook.new("Shutdown", function()
			saveActiveProjectBackup("shutdown_hook")
		end)
	end

	if closeRequestConnection == nil and renderer_signal and renderer_signal.Connect then
		closeRequestConnection = renderer_signal:Connect(function(route)
			if route == "CloseRequested" or route == "ShutdownRequested" then
				saveActiveProjectBackup("close_request")
			end
		end)
	end

	ProjectSyncService:SetProperties({
		StartSyncing = function(self, projectPath, options)
			if not projectPath or projectPath == "" then
				return nil
			end

			if activeState then
				stopState(activeState, true)
			end

			local state = {
				active = true,
				projectPath = projectPath,
				projectId = normalizeProjectId(projectPath),
				game = game,
				options = options or {},
				roots = {},
				config = nil,
				ignoreLookup = nil,
				watcher = nil,
				pendingRefresh = nil,
				syncConnections = {},
				registeredInstances = {},
				localWrites = {},
				pendingSourceWrites = {},
				pendingSourceWriteTasks = {},
				backupTask = nil,
				lastBackupPath = nil,
				lastBackupAt = nil,
				lastBackupReason = nil,
				closeRequestBackupSaved = false,
				syncingFromDisk = false,
				lastError = nil,
				lastReason = "start",
				lastSyncAt = nil,
				syncCount = 0,
				syncedObjects = 0,
			}

			activeState = state
			print(`[ProjectSync] StartSyncing: {projectPath}`)

			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				loadLatestProjectBackup(state)
				performSync(state, "start")
				startWatcher(state)
				startBackupLoop(state)
			end)

			if not ok then
				state.lastError = tostring(err)
				activeState = nil
				stopState(state, true)
				print("Failed syncing project: " .. err)
			end

			return snapshotState(state)
		end,

		Refresh = function(self)
			if not activeState then
				return nil
			end

			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				performSync(activeState, "manual_refresh")
				startWatcher(activeState)
				startBackupLoop(activeState)
			end)

			if not ok then
				activeState.lastError = tostring(err)
				error(err)
			end

			return snapshotState(activeState)
		end,

		StopSyncing = function(self, clearManaged)
			if not activeState then
				return {
					active = false,
				}
			end

			local state = activeState
			saveProjectBackupSafe(state, "stop_syncing")
			activeState = nil
			stopState(state, clearManaged == true)
			return snapshotState(state)
		end,

		SyncToDirectory = function(self, projectPath)
			if not projectPath or projectPath == "" then
				if activeState then
					projectPath = activeState.projectPath
				else
					return nil, "No active project and no project path provided"
				end
			end

			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local config = readProjectConfig(projectPath)
				local roots, warnings = resolveRoots(projectPath, config, game)

				for _, root in ipairs(roots) do
					local dirPath = root.dirPath
					-- Clean the directory on disk recursively
					local statOk, stat = pcall(fs.stat, dirPath)
					if statOk and stat and stat.kind == "directory" then
						local entries = fs.entries(dirPath)
						if entries then
							for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
								deleteRecursive(fs.path.join(dirPath, entry.name))
							end
						end
					else
						pcall(fs.makeDir, dirPath, true)
					end

					-- Sync children of root.target to disk
					for _, child in ipairs(root.target:GetChildren()) do
						writeInstanceToDisk(child, dirPath)
					end
				end
			end)

			if not ok then
				warn(`[ProjectSync] SyncToDirectory failed: {tostring(err)}`)
				return false, tostring(err)
			end

			return true
		end,

		IsSyncing = function()
			return activeState ~= nil and activeState.active == true
		end,

		GetStatus = function()
			return snapshotState(activeState)
		end,

		GetConfig = function(self, projectPath)
			if projectPath == nil or projectPath == "" then
				if not activeState then
					return nil
				end
				return activeState.config
			end

			local config = readProjectConfig(projectPath)
			return config
		end,

		ScheduleRefresh = function(self, reason)
			if not activeState then
				return nil
			end

			scheduleRefresh(activeState, reason or "scheduled")
			return true
		end,
	})
end

return ProjectSyncService

local function bufferToHex(value)
	local bytes = table.create(buffer.len(value))
	for index = 0, buffer.len(value) - 1 do
		bytes[index + 1] = string.format("%02x", buffer.readu8(value, index))
	end

	return table.concat(bytes)
end

local function mapImportedInstance(value, instanceMap)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	local mapped = instanceMap[value]
	if mapped == false then
		return nil
	end

	return mapped
end

local function deserializeEnumItem(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end

	local enumType = value.EnumType
	local enumTypeName = if type(enumType) == "table" then enumType.Name else nil
	if not enumTypeName then
		return value
	end

	local engineEnumType = Enum[enumTypeName]
	if not engineEnumType then
		return value
	end

	local byName = engineEnumType[value.Name]
	if byName then
		return byName
	end

	if type(engineEnumType.GetEnumItems) == "function" then
		for _, item in ipairs(engineEnumType:GetEnumItems()) do
			if item.Value == value.Value then
				return item
			end
		end
	end

	return value
end

local function deserializeVector2(value)
	local x = (value._internal and (value._internal.x or value._internal.X)) or value.X or value.x or 0
	local y = (value._internal and (value._internal.y or value._internal.Y)) or value.Y or value.y or 0
	return Vector2.new(x, y)
end

local function deserializeVector3(value)
	local x = (value._internal and (value._internal.x or value._internal.X)) or value.x or value.X or 0
	local y = (value._internal and (value._internal.y or value._internal.Y)) or value.y or value.Y or 0
	local z = (value._internal and (value._internal.z or value._internal.Z)) or value.z or value.Z or 0
	return Vector3.new(x, y, z)
end

	local offset = value.Offset or 0
	return UDim.new(scale, offset)
end

	local xo = value.X and value.X.Offset or 0
	local ys = value.Y and value.Y.Scale or 0
	local yo = value.Y and value.Y.Offset or 0
	return UDim2.new(xs, xo, ys, yo)
end

local function deserializeCFrame(value)
	local position = value.Position
	local xVec = value.XVector or value.RightVector
	local yVec = value.YVector or value.UpVector
	local zVec = value.ZVector

	if not zVec and value.LookVector then
		zVec = { x = -value.LookVector.x, y = -value.LookVector.y, z = -value.LookVector.z }
	end

	local function getX(v)
		return v and ((v._internal and (v._internal.x or v._internal.X)) or v.x or v.X) or 0
	end
	local function getY(v)
		return v and ((v._internal and (v._internal.y or v._internal.Y)) or v.y or v.Y) or 0
	end
	local function getZ(v)
		return v and ((v._internal and (v._internal.z or v._internal.Z)) or v.z or v.Z) or 0
	end

	local px = getX(position)
	local py = getY(position)
	local pz = getZ(position)

	-- Engine rotation matrix is column-major: each column is Right, Up, -Look
	-- Row 0: [Right.X, Up.X, (-Look).X]
	-- Row 1: [Right.Y, Up.Y, (-Look).Y]
	-- Row 2: [Right.Z, Up.Z, (-Look).Z]
	local r00 = xVec and getX(xVec) or 1
	local r01 = yVec and getX(yVec) or 0
	local r02 = zVec and getX(zVec) or 0

	local r10 = xVec and getY(xVec) or 0
	local r11 = yVec and getY(yVec) or 1
	local r12 = zVec and getY(zVec) or 0

	local r20 = xVec and getZ(xVec) or 0
	local r21 = yVec and getZ(yVec) or 0
	local r22 = zVec and getZ(zVec) or 1

	return CFrame.new(px, py, pz, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22)
end

local function deserializeGeneric(value, instanceMap, visited)
	local mappedInstance = mapImportedInstance(value, instanceMap)
	if mappedInstance then
		return mappedInstance
	end

	local valueType = type(value)
	if valueType == "buffer" then
		return "0x" .. bufferToHex(value)
	end

	if valueType ~= "table" then
		return value
	end

	if value.EnumType and value.Name and value.Value ~= nil then
		return deserializeEnumItem(value)
	end

	visited = visited or {}
	local existing = visited[value]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end

	local clone = {}
	visited[value] = clone

	for key, nestedValue in pairs(value) do
		clone[key] = deserializeGeneric(nestedValue, instanceMap, visited)
	end

	return clone
end

local function deserializeValue(propertyType, value, instanceMap)

		propertyType = types[propertyType] or propertyType
	end

	if value == nil then
		return nil
	end

	if
		propertyType == types.Unknown
		or propertyType == types.String
		or propertyType == types.Bool
		or propertyType == types.Int
		or propertyType == types.Float
		or propertyType == types.Double
		or propertyType == types.SharedString
	then
		return value
	elseif propertyType == types.UDim then
		return deserializeUDim(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.UDim2 then
		return deserializeUDim2(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Ray then
		return deserializeRay(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Faces then
		return deserializeFaces(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Axes then
		return deserializeAxes(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.BrickColor then
		return deserializeBrickColor(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Color3 or propertyType == types.Color3uint8 then
		return deserializeColor3(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Vector2 then
		return deserializeVector2(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Vector3 then
		return deserializeVector3(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.CFrame or propertyType == types.Quaternion or propertyType == types.OptionalCFrame then
		return deserializeCFrame(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Enum then
		return deserializeEnumItem(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Ref then
		return mapImportedInstance(value, instanceMap)
	elseif propertyType == types.Vector3int16 then
		return Vector3int16.new(value.X, value.Y, value.Z)
	elseif propertyType == types.NumberSequence then
		return deserializeNumberSequence(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.ColorSequence then
		return deserializeColorSequence(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.NumberRange then
		return NumberRange.new(value.Min, value.Max)
	elseif propertyType == types.Rect then
		return deserializeRect(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.PhysicalProperties then
		return deserializePhysicalProperties(value)
	elseif propertyType == types.Int64 then
		return if type(value) == "buffer" then "0x" .. bufferToHex(value) else value
	elseif propertyType == types.UniqueId then
		return {
			type = "UniqueId",
			Index = value.Index,
			Time = value.Time,
			Random = if type(value.Random) == "buffer" then "0x" .. bufferToHex(value.Random) else value.Random,
		}
	elseif propertyType == types.Font then

	elseif propertyType == types.SecurityCapabilities then

	elseif propertyType == types.Content then
		local mappedObject = mapImportedInstance(value.Object, instanceMap)
		if value.Uri ~= nil then
			return value.Uri
		end
		if mappedObject then
			return mappedObject
		end

		return {
			type = "Content",
			Uri = value.Uri,
			Object = mappedObject,
			SourceType = deserializeEnumItem(value.SourceType),
		}
	end

	return deserializeGeneric(value, instanceMap)

RBXModelImporter.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	local function decodeObject(rootObject)
		local instanceMap = {}

		local function createInstances(object)
			if instanceMap[object] ~= nil then
				return instanceMap[object]
			end

			local className = object.ClassName
			local success, newInstance = pcall(function()
				return registry.new(className, renderer, datamodel)
			end)

			if success and newInstance then
				instanceMap[object] = newInstance
			else
				print(newInstance)
				instanceMap[object] = false
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
				createInstances(child)
			end

			return instanceMap[object]
		end

		local function linkHierarchy(object)
			local parentInstance = instanceMap[object]
			for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
				local childInstance = instanceMap[child]
				if parentInstance and childInstance then
					childInstance.Parent = parentInstance
				end
				linkHierarchy(child)
			end
		end

		local function applyProperties(object)
			local newInstance = instanceMap[object]
			local rawInstance = rawget(object, "@instance")
			local props = rawInstance.properties

			if newInstance then
				local finalPropsToApply = {}
				for prop, propdata in pairs(props) do
					if prop ~= "UniqueId" and prop ~= "Parent" then
						local mappedProp = prop

						if mappedProp == "size" then
							mappedProp = "Size"
						end
						if mappedProp:lower() == "color3uint8" then
							mappedProp = "Color"
						end

						if newInstance[mappedProp] == nil then
							local tryCap = mappedProp:sub(1, 1):upper() .. mappedProp:sub(2)
							if newInstance[tryCap] ~= nil then
								mappedProp = tryCap
							else
								local engineProps = rawget(newInstance, "_props") or newInstance
								local lowerProp = mappedProp:lower()
								for k, _ in pairs(engineProps) do
									if type(k) == "string" and k:lower() == lowerProp then
										mappedProp = k
										break
									end
								end
							end
						end

						local deserialized = deserializeValue(propdata.type, propdata.value, instanceMap)

						-- Discard property conflicts caused by rbimport's loadDefaultProperties fallback injections
						local isDefaultInjection = false
						if newInstance:IsA("BasePart") then
							if prop == "Position" or prop == "Rotation" or prop == "Orientation" then
								isDefaultInjection = true
							end
						end

						if prop == "Size" and (props["size"] ~= nil) then
							isDefaultInjection = true
						end
						if
							prop == "Color"
							and (
								props["Color3uint8"] ~= nil
								or props["color3uint8"] ~= nil
								or props["brickColor"] ~= nil
							)
						then
							isDefaultInjection = true
						end

						if not isDefaultInjection then
							finalPropsToApply[mappedProp] = deserialized
						end
					end
				end

				-- Apply all verified properties to the instance
				for propName, val in pairs(finalPropsToApply) do
					newInstance[propName] = val
				end
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
				applyProperties(child)
			end
		end

		local function findFirstImportedInstance(object)
			local mapped = instanceMap[object]
			if mapped then
				return mapped
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(object:GetChildren()) do
				local found = findFirstImportedInstance(child)
				if found then
					return found
				end
			end
		end

		createInstances(rootObject)
		linkHierarchy(rootObject)
		applyProperties(rootObject)

		return findFirstImportedInstance(rootObject)
	end

	RBXModelImporter:SetProperties({
		ImportModel = function(binary)
			local decoded = rbxImport.deserializeModel(binary)
			return decodeObject(decoded[1])
		end,

		ImportPlace = function(binary)
			local decoded = rbxImport.deserializePlace(binary)
			local results = {}
			for _, root in ipairs(decoded) do
				local inst = decodeObject(root)
				if inst then
					table.insert(results, inst)
				end
			end
			return results
		end,

		ImportPlaceFile = function(path)
			local file = fs.readFile(path, true) -- return buffer
			if file then
				local decoded = rbxImport.deserializePlace(file)
				local converted = {}

				for _, service in pairs(decoded:GetChildren()) do
					converted[service.Name] = {}

					for _, child in pairs(service:GetChildren()) do
						if child.Name == "Camera" then
							continue
						end

						local inst = decodeObject(child)
						if inst then
							table.insert(converted[service.Name], inst)
						end

						task.wait()
					end

					task.wait()
				end
				return converted
			end
			return false
		end,
	})
end
return RBXModelImporter

local net = zune.net

RojoSyncService.ExplorerHidden = true

RojoSyncService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, game)
	task.spawn(function()
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until game["GetService"] and game:GetService("HttpService")
		local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

		local function decodePropertyValue(prop)
			if type(prop) ~= "table" then
				return prop
			end

			if prop.Float32 ~= nil then
				return prop.Float32
			elseif prop.Float64 ~= nil then
				return prop.Float64
			elseif prop.Int32 ~= nil then
				return prop.Int32
			elseif prop.Int64 ~= nil then
				return prop.Int64
			elseif prop.Bool ~= nil then
				return prop.Bool
			elseif prop.String ~= nil then
				return prop.String
			elseif prop.Vector3 ~= nil then
				local v = prop.Vector3
				return Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3])
			elseif prop.Color3 ~= nil then
				local c = prop.Color3
				if not c[1] then
					return
				end
				return Color3.new(c[1], c[2], c[3])
			elseif prop.CFrame ~= nil then
				return CFrame.new(unpack(prop.CFrame))
			elseif prop.Enum ~= nil then
				return prop.Enum
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function normalizeId(id)
			if type(id) == "string" then
				return id:gsub("-", "")
			end
			return id
		end

		local function constructInstance(id, parent, patchAdded)
			local virtualInstance = patchAdded[id] or patchAdded[normalizeId(id)]
			if not virtualInstance then
				return
			end

			local nid = normalizeId(id)
			local inst = instanceMap.fromIds[nid]

			if inst == nil then
				local className = virtualInstance.ClassName
				local ok, created = pcall(Instance.new, className)
				if not ok or created == nil then
					return
				end

				pcall(Registry.InitCallbackClass, created, className, renderer, game)
				inst = created
				inst.Name = virtualInstance.Name
				inst.Parent = parent
				instanceMap.fromIds[nid] = inst
				instanceMap.fromInstances[inst] = nid
			end

			if virtualInstance.Properties then
				for propName, propValue in pairs(virtualInstance.Properties) do
					local decoded = decodePropertyValue(propValue)
					if decoded ~= nil then
						pcall(function()
							inst[propName] = decoded
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			if virtualInstance.Children then
				for _, childId in ipairs(virtualInstance.Children) do
					constructInstance(normalizeId(childId), inst, patchAdded)
				end
			end

			return inst
		end

		local SERVICE_CLASSES = {
			"Workspace",
			"Players",
			"Lighting",
			"ReplicatedStorage",
			"ReplicatedFirst",
			"ServerScriptService",
			"ServerStorage",
			"StarterGui",
			"StarterPack",
			"StarterPlayer",
			"SoundService",
			"Teams",
			"TextChatService",
			"TweenService",
			"RunService",
			"UserInputService",
			"HttpService",
			"CollectionService",
			"DataStoreService",
			"PathfindingService",
			"PhysicsService",
			"ChatService",
		}

		local function applyFullSnapshot(instances)
			-- Destroy only non-service, non-game instances
			for _, inst in pairs(instanceMap.fromIds) do
				if inst ~= game then
					local ok, cls = pcall(function()
						return inst.ClassName
					end)
					local isService = false
					if ok then
						for _, sc in ipairs(SERVICE_CLASSES) do
							if sc == cls then
								isService = true
								break
							end
						end
					end
					if not isService then
						pcall(function()
							inst:Destroy()
						end)
					end
				end
			end

			local normRoot = normalizeId(rootInstanceId)
			instanceMap.fromIds = { [normRoot] = game }
			instanceMap.fromInstances = { [game] = normRoot }

			-- Build a normalized-key copy of instances so lookups always work
			local normInstances = {}
			if type(instances) == "table" then
				for k, v in pairs(instances) do
					normInstances[normalizeId(k)] = v
				end
			end

			-- Pre-seed known services so constructInstance reuses singletons
			for nid, vInst in pairs(normInstances) do
				if nid ~= normRoot and vInst.ClassName then
					for _, sc in ipairs(SERVICE_CLASSES) do
						if sc == vInst.ClassName then
							local ok, svc = pcall(function()
								return game:GetService(sc)
							end)
							if ok and svc then
								instanceMap.fromIds[nid] = svc
								instanceMap.fromInstances[svc] = nid
							end
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local rootSnap = normInstances[normRoot]
			if rootSnap and rootSnap.Children then
				for _, childId in ipairs(rootSnap.Children) do
					constructInstance(normalizeId(childId), game, normInstances)
				end
			end
		end

		local function fetchReadSnapshot(baseUrl)
			if rootInstanceId == nil then
				return nil
			end

			local ok, readRes = pcall(net.http.request, baseUrl .. "/api/read/" .. tostring(rootInstanceId), {
				headers = { ["Accept"] = "application/json" },
			})

			if not ok or not readRes or not readRes.ok then
				return nil
			end

			local readSuccess, readData = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, readRes.body)
			if not readSuccess or type(readData) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end

			return readData
		end

		local function applyPatch(patch)
			-- Handle Removed
			if patch.removed then
				for _, id in ipairs(patch.removed) do
					local inst = instanceMap.fromIds[normalizeId(id)]
					if inst then
						inst:Destroy()
						instanceMap.fromIds[normalizeId(id)] = nil
						instanceMap.fromInstances[inst] = nil
					end
				end
			end

			-- Handle Added
			if patch.added then
				local normAdded = {}
				for id, virtualInstance in pairs(patch.added) do
					normAdded[normalizeId(id)] = virtualInstance
				end
				for id, virtualInstance in pairs(normAdded) do
					if not instanceMap.fromIds[id] then
						local parentInst = instanceMap.fromIds[normalizeId(virtualInstance.Parent)]
						local isChildOfAddition = normAdded[normalizeId(virtualInstance.Parent)] ~= nil
						if not isChildOfAddition then
							if parentInst then
								constructInstance(id, parentInst, normAdded)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- Handle Updated
			if patch.updated then
				for _, update in ipairs(patch.updated) do
					local inst = instanceMap.fromIds[normalizeId(update.id)]
					if inst then
						if update.changedName then
							inst.Name = update.changedName
						end
						if update.changedProperties then
							for propName, propValue in pairs(update.changedProperties) do
								local decoded = decodePropertyValue(propValue)
								if decoded ~= nil then
									pcall(function()
										inst[propName] = decoded
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		function RojoSyncService:Connect(port)
			if isConnected then
				return true
			end
			port = port or 3487

			local baseUrl = "http://localhost:" .. tostring(port)
			local wsBaseUrl = "ws://localhost:" .. tostring(port)

			print("RojoSyncService: Connecting to " .. baseUrl)

			if socket then
				pcall(function()
					if socket.close then
						socket:close(1000)
					elseif socket.Destroy then
						socket:Destroy()
					end
				end)
				socket = nil
			end

			local ok, res = pcall(net.http.request, baseUrl .. "/api/rojo", {
				headers = { ["Accept"] = "application/json" },
			})
			if not ok or not res or not res.ok then
				print("RojoSyncService: Failed to connect to Rojo server.")
				return false
			end

			local success, serverInfo = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.body)
			if not success then
				print("RojoSyncService: Failed to decode JSON from /api/rojo")
				return false
			end

			rootInstanceId = serverInfo.rootInstanceId
			sessionId = serverInfo.sessionId
			if rootInstanceId == nil then
				print("RojoSyncService: Missing rootInstanceId in /api/rojo response")
				return false
			end

			local readData = fetchReadSnapshot(baseUrl)
			if not readData then
				print("RojoSyncService: Failed to fetch initial snapshot from /api/read")
				return false
			end

			messageCursor = tonumber(readData.messageCursor) or -1

			applyFullSnapshot(readData.instances)

			print("Finished making instances")

			local function resyncFromRead(reason)
				local data = fetchReadSnapshot(baseUrl)
				if not data then
					print("RojoSyncService: Failed to resync snapshot (" .. tostring(reason) .. ")")
					return false
				end
				messageCursor = tonumber(data.messageCursor) or messageCursor
				applyFullSnapshot(data.instances)
				print("RojoSyncService: Resynced from /api/read (cursor " .. tostring(messageCursor) .. ")")
				return true
			end

			local function applyMessageEntry(entry)
				if type(entry) ~= "table" then
					return false
				end

				if entry.removed ~= nil or entry.added ~= nil or entry.updated ~= nil then
					applyPatch(entry)
					return true
				end

				return false
			end

			local function handleSocketMessage(rawMessage)
				local decodedOk, packet = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, rawMessage)
				if not decodedOk or type(packet) ~= "table" then
					print("RojoSyncService: Failed to decode websocket message")
					return
				end

				-- If the session changed (Rojo restarted), do a full resync
				if packet.sessionId ~= nil and packet.sessionId ~= sessionId then
					print("RojoSyncService: Session changed, resyncing...")
					sessionId = packet.sessionId
					local resynced = resyncFromRead("session-change")
					if not resynced then
						return
					end
				end

				if packet.packetType ~= "messages" then
					if packet.packetType == "reset" then
						resyncFromRead("reset")
					end
					return
				end

				local body = packet.body
				if type(body) ~= "table" then
					return
				end

				if body.messageCursor ~= nil then
					messageCursor = tonumber(body.messageCursor) or messageCursor
				end

				for _, message in ipairs(body.messages or {}) do
					if not applyMessageEntry(message) and type(message) == "table" then
						for _, nested in ipairs(message) do
							applyMessageEntry(nested)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local wsUrl = wsBaseUrl .. "/api/socket/" .. tostring(messageCursor)
			local socketOk, openedSocket = pcall(net.http.websocket, wsUrl, {
				timeout = -1,

				message = function(self, msg)
					handleSocketMessage(msg)
					return true
				end,
				close = function(self, code)
					print("RojoSyncService: Websocket closed (" .. tostring(code) .. ")")
					isConnected = false
					socket = nil
					return true
				end,
			})

			if not socketOk or not openedSocket then
				print("RojoSyncService: Failed to open websocket")
				return false
			end

			socket = openedSocket
			isConnected = true
			print("RojoSyncService: Connected (websocket mode)")

			return true
		end

		function RojoSyncService:Disconnect()
			if socket then
				pcall(function()
					if socket.close then
						socket:close(1000)
					elseif socket.Destroy then
						socket:Destroy()
					end
				end)
				socket = nil
			end
			isConnected = false
		end

		function RojoSyncService:IsConnected()
			return isConnected
		end
	end)
end

return RojoSyncService

local renderBindingsDirty = false

function RunService:BindToRenderStep(name, priority, callback)
	renderBindings[name] = { priority = priority, callback = callback }
	renderBindingsDirty = true
end

function RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(name)
	renderBindings[name] = nil
	renderBindingsDirty = true
end

local simulationBindings = {}
local predictedInstances = {}
local currentTick = 0
local SIMULATION_DT = 1 / 60
local accumulator = 0

function RunService:BindToSimulation(callback, frequency)
	table.insert(simulationBindings, callback)
end

function RunService:GetSimulationBindings()
	return simulationBindings
end

function RunService:GetSimulationTick()
	return currentTick
end

function RunService:GetSimulationDT()
	return SIMULATION_DT
end

function RunService:PerformRollback(rollbackTick)
	if not RollbackEngine:RestoreState(rollbackTick) then
		return
	end

	local targetTick = currentTick
	currentTick = rollbackTick

	while currentTick < targetTick do
		currentTick += 1
		for _, callback in ipairs(simulationBindings) do
			callback(SIMULATION_DT)
		end

		local predicted = RunService:GetPredictedInstances()
		RollbackEngine:CaptureState(currentTick, predicted)
	end
end

function RunService:SetPredictionMode(context, mode)
	if type(context) == "table" then
		rawset(context, "_predictionMode", mode)
		if mode == Enum.PredictionMode.On or mode == Enum.PredictionMode.Automatic then
			predictedInstances[context] = true
		else
			predictedInstances[context] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RunService:GetPredictedInstances()
	local list = {}
	for instance in pairs(predictedInstances) do
		if instance.Parent then
			table.insert(list, instance)
		else
			predictedInstances[instance] = nil
		end
	end
	return list
end

function RunService:GetPredictionStatus(context)
	if type(context) == "table" then
		local mode = rawget(context, "_predictionMode") or Enum.PredictionMode.Automatic
		if mode == Enum.PredictionMode.Off then
			return Enum.PredictionStatus.NotPredicted
		end
	end
	return Enum.PredictionStatus.Predicted
end

local function runRenderBindings(dt)
	if renderBindingsDirty then
		table.clear(sortedRenderBindings)
		for _, data in pairs(renderBindings) do
			table.insert(sortedRenderBindings, data)
		end
		table.sort(sortedRenderBindings, function(a, b)
			return a.priority < b.priority
		end)
		renderBindingsDirty = false
	end

	for _, binding in ipairs(sortedRenderBindings) do
		binding.callback(dt)
	end
end

local status = {
	IsClient = true,
	IsServer = false,
	IsStudio = true,
	IsRunMode = false,
	IsRunning = false,
	IsEdit = true,
	IsPaused = false,
}

local scheduled = {}

RunService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal)
	RunService:SetProperties({
		RenderStepped = RenderStepped,
		Heartbeat = Heartbeat,
		Stepped = Stepped,
		GuiRender = GuiRender,
		PreRender = PreRender,
		PreGuiRender = PreGuiRender,

		IsClient = function()
			return IsClient
		end,
		IsServer = function()
			return IsServer
		end,
		IsStudio = function()
			return status.IsStudio
		end,
		IsRunMode = function()
			return status.IsRunMode
		end,
		IsRunning = function()
			return status.IsRunning
		end,
		IsEdit = function()
			return status.IsEdit
		end,

		GetFPS = function()
			return lib.GetFPS()
		end,
	})

	renderer_signal:Connect(function(route, dt)
		if route == "RenderStepped" then
			RenderStepped:Fire(dt)
			runRenderBindings(dt)
		elseif route == "PreRender" then
			PreRender:Fire(dt)
		elseif route == "Heartbeat" then
			if not status.IsPaused then
				Heartbeat:Fire(dt)

				accumulator += dt
				while accumulator >= SIMULATION_DT do
					currentTick += 1
					for _, callback in ipairs(simulationBindings) do
						callback(SIMULATION_DT)
					end

					local predicted = RunService:GetPredictedInstances()
					RollbackEngine:CaptureState(currentTick, predicted)

					accumulator -= SIMULATION_DT
				end
			end
		elseif route == "Stepped" then
			if not status.IsPaused then
				Stepped:Fire(dt)
			end
		elseif route == "GuiRender" then
			GuiRender:Fire(dt)
		elseif route == "PreGuiRender" then
			PreGuiRender:Fire(dt)
		end
	end)
end

function RunService:Pause()
	status.IsPaused = true
end

function RunService:Resume()
	status.IsPaused = false
end

function RunService:IsPaused()
	return status.IsPaused
end

function RunService:SetSchedulerFPS(fps)
	local dt = 1 / fps
	local last = os.clock()
	return function()
		local now = os.clock()
		local elapsed = now - last
		if elapsed < dt then
			return false
		end
		last = now
		return true
	end
end

return RunService

		if type(source) ~= "string" then
			return false
		end

		return withoutTrailingWhitespace:match("return%s+nil%s*$") ~= nil

	end

		if type(source) ~= "string" then
			return false

	end

			local initModule = target:FindFirstChild("init") or target:FindFirstChild("Init")
			if initModule and initModule.ClassName == "ModuleScript" then
				return initModule

	end

						require = function(target)
							if type(target) == "string" then
								if target:match("^@kine/") then
									local name = string.sub(target, 7)
									local api = require(`@{name}`) or require("../src/environment/builtin/" .. name)
									if api then
										return api:init(renderer, datamodel)
									end
								end
								local api = pluginLoader.GetPluginApi(target)
								if api then
									return api
								end
								return require(target)
							end

							if type(target) ~= "table" then
								print("require: expected ModuleScript or string, got " .. type(target), 2)
								return
							end

							local moduleScript = tryResolveModuleScript(target)
							if not moduleScript then
								print(
									`require: cannot require {target.ClassName} '{target.Name}'; expected ModuleScript`,
									2
								)
								return
							end
							target = moduleScript

							local cached = requiredCache[target]
							if cached == REQUIRE_NIL then
								return nil
							end
							if cached == REQUIRE_LOADING then
								print(`require: circular dependency detected on '{target.Name}'`, 2)
								return
							end
							if cached ~= nil then
								return cached
							end

							requiredCache[target] = REQUIRE_LOADING

							local source = target.Source
							local success, result, id, thread, getResult
							if source and type(source) == "string" then
								id, success, result, thread, getResult = kilang:execute(
									source,
									{ StackId = getModuleStackId(target) },
									{
										script = target,
										src = target,
										loader = scriptObject,
										require = script_environment.require,
									}
								)
							end

							if getResult then
								success, result = getResult()
								if id then
									kilang:remove(id)
								end
							end

							if thread then
								-- save thread
								if not activeThreads["Luau"] then
									activeThreads["Luau"] = {}
								end
								activeThreads["Luau"][target.UniqueId] = thread
							end

							if success == false then
								requiredCache[target] = nil
								print(`require: ModuleScript '{target.Name}' failed: {tostring(result)}`, 2)
								return
							end

							if result == nil and not hasExplicitNilReturn(source) then
								requiredCache[target] = REQUIRE_NIL
								if not hasReturnStatement(source) then
									print(`require: ModuleScript '{target.Name}' did not return a value`, 2)
								end
								return nil
							elseif result == nil then
								requiredCache[target] = REQUIRE_NIL
								return nil
							end

							requiredCache[target] = result
							return result
						end,
					}

					local source = scriptObject.Source

					if not activeThreads["Luau"] then
						activeThreads["Luau"] = {}
					end

					local id, success, result, thread = kilang:execute(
						source,
						{ StackId = `{scriptObject.Name} ({scriptObject:GetFullName()})` },
						script_environment
					)

					-- add to thread table
					activeThreads["Luau"][scriptObject.UniqueId] = thread

					return thread, id, success, result
				end,

				killthread = function(uniqueId)
					local thread = activeThreads["Luau"][uniqueId]
					if thread then
						task.cancel(thread)
						activeThreads["Luau"][uniqueId] = nil
					end
				end,
			},
		}

		local function runScriptOfClass(object, class)
			for _, descendant in pairs(object:GetDescendantsOfClass(class)) do
				if descendant.Enabled == false then
					return
				end
				task.spawn(function()
					ScriptContext.MakeThreadObject(descendant)
				end)
			end

			object.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
				if descendant.ClassName == class then
					if descendant.Enabled == false then
						return
					end
					task.spawn(function()
						ScriptContext.MakeThreadObject(descendant)
					end)
				end
			end)

			object.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(descendant)
				if descendant.ClassName == class then
					ScriptContext.KillThread(descendant.UniqueId, descendant.Language)
				end
			end)
		end

		ScriptContext:SetProperties({
			NewRuntime = function(api: LanguageRuntime)
				local name = api.name

				if not api.newthread then
					print("Runtime function newthread not found")
					return
				end

				if not api.killthread then
					print("Runtime function killthread not found")
					return
				end

				runtimes[name] = api

				Enum.newValue(name, math.random(1, 1000), Enum.Language)

				return Enum.Language[name]
			end,

			GetActiveThreads = function()
				return activeThreads
			end,

			GetRuntimeThreadsActive = function(language)
				return activeThreads[language.Name]
			end,

			KillThread = function(uniqueId: string, language: Enum.Language)
				local api = runtimes[language.Name]
				if api then
					api.killthread(uniqueId)
				end
			end,

			MakeThreadObject = function(scriptInstance: Script | LocalScript)
				local language = scriptInstance.Language.Name
				if language then
					if runtimes[language] then
						local api: LanguageRuntime? = runtimes[language]
						if api then
							return api.newthread(scriptInstance, datamodel)
						end
					else
						print("No runtime found for language " .. language)
						return
					end
				end
				return
			end,

			RunSource = function(source: string, language: string, name: string?)
				language = language or "Luau"
				name = name or "AnonymousScript" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1e9))

				local fakeScript = {
					ClassName = "Script",
					Name = name,
					Source = source,
					Enabled = true,
					UniqueId = name .. "_" .. tostring(math.random(1, 1e9)),
					Language = Enum.Language[language],
					GetFullName = function()
						return name
					end,
				}

				local api = runtimes[language]
				if not api then
					print("No runtime found for language " .. language)
					return nil
				end

				return api.newthread(fakeScript, datamodel)
			end,

			RunClientScripts = function()
				local StarterPlayer, Players, CoreGui, InternalStorage, StarterClientScripts, StarterCharacterScripts =
					getserv("StarterPlayer"),
					getserv("Players"),
					getserv("CoreGui"),
					getserv("InternalStorage"),
					datamodel.StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts,
					datamodel.StarterPlayer.StarterCharacterScripts

				runScriptOfClass(StarterPlayer, "LocalScript")
				runScriptOfClass(Players, "LocalScript")
				runScriptOfClass(CoreGui, "LocalScript")
				runScriptOfClass(InternalStorage, "LocalScript")
				runScriptOfClass(StarterClientScripts, "LocalScript")
				runScriptOfClass(StarterCharacterScripts, "LocalScript")

				return true
			end,

			RunServerScripts = function()
				local ServerScriptService, ServerStorage, Workspace, StarterGui =
					getserv("ServerScriptService"),
					getserv("ServerStorage"),
					getserv("Workspace"),
					getserv("StarterGui")

				runScriptOfClass(ServerScriptService, "Script")
				runScriptOfClass(ServerStorage, "Script")
				runScriptOfClass(Workspace, "Script")
				runScriptOfClass(StarterGui, "Script")

				return true
			end,
		})
	end)
end

return ScriptContext

				return true
			else
				return false
			end
		end,

		Set = function(data)
			selected = {} -- clear
			for _, v in ipairs(data) do
				Selection.SelectionAdded:Fire(v)

				table.insert(selected, v)
			end
		end,

local TYPE_DESERIALIZERS = {
	EnumItem = function(v)
		local enumTypeName = if type(v) == "table" and type(v.EnumType) == "table" then v.EnumType.Name else v.EnumType
		if type(v) ~= "table" or type(enumTypeName) ~= "string" or type(v.Name) ~= "string" then
			return nil
		end
		local enumGroup = Enum[enumTypeName]
		if enumGroup == nil then
			warn("[SerializationService] Unknown EnumType '" .. enumTypeName .. "' during deserialization")
			return nil
		end
		local item = enumGroup[v.Name]
		if item == nil then
			warn(
				"[SerializationService] Unknown Enum value '"
					.. enumTypeName
					.. "."
					.. v.Name
					.. "' during deserialization"
			)
		end
		return item
	end,
	Content = function(v)
		if type(v) ~= "table" then
			return v
		end

		local objectRef = v.Object
		if type(objectRef) == "table" and objectRef.__ref then
			return objectRef
		end
		if objectRef ~= nil then
			return objectRef
		end

		if type(v.Uri) == "string" then
			return v.Uri
		end

		return nil
	end,
	Buf = function(v)
		if type(v.value) ~= "string" then
			return nil
		end
		local decoded = zune.serde.base64.decode(v.value)
		return buffer.fromstring(decoded)
	end,
}

local warnedUnknownTypeTags = {}

local function isSignalLikeTable(value)
	return type(value) == "table"
		and rawget(value, "_connections") ~= nil
		and rawget(value, "_queuedFires") ~= nil
		and rawget(value, "_history") ~= nil
end

for name, datatype in pairs(Datatypes) do
	if datatype.FromTable then
		TYPE_DESERIALIZERS[name] = datatype.FromTable
	end
end

local workers = {}
local pendingRequests = {}
local reqIdCounter = 0
local nextWorkerIndex = 1
local MAX_WORKERS = 18

local function initWorkers()
	if #workers > 0 then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, MAX_WORKERS do
		local w = zune.thread.fromModule("@SerialWorker")
		w:start()
		table.insert(workers, w)

		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				local res = w:receive()
				if res and res.id and pendingRequests[res.id] then
					print(`[SerializationService] Worker {i} finished task {res.id}`)
					local t = pendingRequests[res.id]
					pendingRequests[res.id] = nil
					task.spawn(t, res)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function getNextWorker()
	initWorkers()
	local w = workers[nextWorkerIndex]
	nextWorkerIndex = (nextWorkerIndex % MAX_WORKERS) + 1
	return w
end

local UseWorkers = true

local function sanitizeForThread(value, seen)
	local valueType = type(value)
	if valueType == "number" or valueType == "string" or valueType == "boolean" or value == nil then
		return value
	end

	if valueType == "buffer" then
		return { __buf = zune.serde.base64.encode(buffer.tostring(value)) }
	end

	if valueType ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end

	seen = seen or {}
	if seen[value] then
		return nil
	end
	seen[value] = true

	local copy = {}
	for key, child in pairs(value) do
		local keyType = type(key)
		if keyType == "string" or keyType == "number" or keyType == "boolean" then
			copy[key] = sanitizeForThread(child, seen)
		end
	end

	seen[value] = nil
	return copy
end

local function compress(tbl)
	if not UseWorkers then
		local encoder = require("./_encoder")
		local encoded = encoder.encode(tbl)
		return zune.serde.zstd.compress(encoded, { level = 1 })
	end

	local w = getNextWorker()
	reqIdCounter += 1
	local id = reqIdCounter
	pendingRequests[id] = coroutine.running()
	print(`[SerializationService] Sending compress task {id} to worker...`)
	w:send({ id = id, action = "compress", data = sanitizeForThread(tbl) })
	local res = coroutine.yield()
	if res.error then
		error(res.error)
	end
	return res.result
end

local function decompress(str)
	if not UseWorkers then
		local encoder = require("./_encoder")
		local decompressed = zune.serde.zstd.decompress(str)
		return encoder.decode(decompressed)
	end

	local w = getNextWorker()
	reqIdCounter += 1
	local id = reqIdCounter
	pendingRequests[id] = coroutine.running()
	print(`[SerializationService] Sending decompress task {id} to worker...`)
	w:send({ id = id, action = "decompress", data = str })
	local res = coroutine.yield()
	if res.error then
		print("[SerializationService] Failed to decode serialized payload: " .. tostring(res.error))
		return nil
	end
	return res.result
end

local sharedVisited = {}

local function serialize_value(value, visited)
	local luaType = type(value)

	if luaType == "function" or luaType == "thread" or luaType == "userdata" then
		return nil, false
	end

	if luaType == "number" or luaType == "string" or luaType == "boolean" or value == nil then
		return value, true
	end

	if luaType == "buffer" then
		return { type = "Buf", value = zune.serde.base64.encode(buffer.tostring(value)) }, true
	end

	if BLACKLISTED_TYPES[luaType] then
		return nil, false
	end

	if isSignalLikeTable(value) then
		return nil, false
	end

	-- Instance reference (has ClassName, _props, and UniqueId)
	if luaType == "table" then
		local props = rawget(value, "_props")
		if props and props.ClassName then
			local uid = props.UniqueId
			if uid then
				return { __ref = uid }, true
			end
			return nil, false
		end
	end

	-- Typed userdata (CFrame, Vector3, Color3, etc.)
	local robloxType = luaType
	if luaType == "table" and value.__type then
		robloxType = value.__type
	end

	if luaType == "table" and robloxType ~= "table" then
		if type(value.ToTable) == "function" then
			return value:ToTable(), true
		end
		local datatype = Datatypes[robloxType]
		if datatype and value ~= datatype and datatype.ToTable then
			return datatype.ToTable(value), true
		end
		if not TYPE_DESERIALIZERS[robloxType] then
			return nil, false
		end
	end

	if luaType == "table" then
		if visited[value] then
			return nil, false
		end
		visited[value] = true

		local dict = {}

		if robloxType ~= "table" then
			dict.type = robloxType
		end
		for k, v in pairs(value) do
			local sv, ok = serialize_value(v, visited)
			if ok then
				dict[k] = sv
			end
		end

		visited[value] = nil
		return dict, true
	end

	return nil, false
end

local function serialize_object(object, obj_visited)
	if obj_visited[object] then
		return nil
	end
	obj_visited[object] = true

	local props = object._props
	local result = {
		c = object.ClassName,
		n = object.Name,
		p = {},
		ch = {},
		at = {},
		t = {},
		uid = props.UniqueId,
	}

	local visited = sharedVisited
	local resultProps = result.p
	for propname, propvalue in pairs(props) do
		if SKIP_PROPS[propname] then
			continue
		end
		if object.ClassName == "Player" and propname == "Character" then
			continue
		end
		local propType = type(propname)
		if string.sub(propname, 1, 1) == "_" and propname ~= "_mesh" then
			continue
		end
		if propType == "buffer" or type(propvalue) == "buffer" then
			resultProps[propname] = {
				type = "Buf",
				value = zune.serde.base64.encode(buffer.tostring(propvalue)),
			}
			print("Saved buffer: " .. propname)
			print(`Buffer length: #{buffer.len(propvalue)}`)
			print(propvalue)
			continue
		end
		local serialized, ok = serialize_value(propvalue, visited)
		if ok then
			resultProps[propname] = serialized
		end
		for k in pairs(visited) do
			visited[k] = nil
		end
	end

	local attrs = object:GetAttributes()
	if next(attrs) then
		local resultAttrs = result.at
		for attrname, attrvalue in pairs(attrs) do
			local serialized, ok = serialize_value(attrvalue, visited)
			if ok then
				resultAttrs[attrname] = serialized
			end
			for k in pairs(visited) do
				visited[k] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local tags = object:GetTags()
	if #tags > 0 then
		result.t = tags -- Directly assign  no need to copy one-by-one
	end

	local children = object:GetChildren()
	local resultChildren = result.ch
	local childCount = 0
	for i = 1, #children do
		if children[i].ClassName == "Camera" then
			continue
		end
		local serialized_child = serialize_object(children[i], obj_visited)
		if serialized_child then
			childCount += 1
			resultChildren[childCount] = serialized_child
		end
	end

	return result
end

local function deserialize_value(v)
	if type(v) ~= "table" then
		return v
	end
	if v.__ref then
		return v
	end
	if v.type then
		local deserializer = TYPE_DESERIALIZERS[v.type]
		if deserializer then
			return deserializer(v)
		else
			local typeTag = tostring(v.type)
			if not warnedUnknownTypeTags[typeTag] then
				warn("Unknown type tag during deserialization: " .. typeTag)
				warnedUnknownTypeTags[typeTag] = true
			end
			return v
		end
	end
	local dict = {}
	for key, val in pairs(v) do
		dict[key] = deserialize_value(val)
	end
	return dict
end

SerializationService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	SerializationService:SetProperties({
		SerializeInstancesAsync = function(instances)
			print("[DEBUG] SerializeInstancesAsync called for", #instances, "instances")
			local objects = {}
			local objVisited = {}
			for i = 1, #instances do
				objects[i] = serialize_object(instances[i], objVisited)
			end
			print("[DEBUG] SerializeInstancesAsync compressing objects")
			local res = compress(objects)
			print("[DEBUG] SerializeInstancesAsync compress done")
			return res
		end,
		Deserialize = function(str, cb)
			local tbl = decompress(str)
			if not tbl then
				return {}
			end
			local instances = {}
			local id_map = {}
			local instanceCount = 0

			local function create_object(objTbl)
				local className = objTbl.c
				if type(className) ~= "string" or className == "" then
					return nil
				end

				if Registry.ClassValid(className) then
					return Registry.new(className, renderer, datamodel, true)
				end

				return Instance.new(className)
			end

			local function deserialize_object_with_map(objTbl)
				local obj = create_object(objTbl)
				if not obj then
					return nil
				end
				obj.Name = objTbl.n

				if cb then
					cb(obj)
				end

				if objTbl.uid then
					id_map[objTbl.uid] = obj
					obj._props.UniqueId = objTbl.uid
				end

				local objProps = obj._props
				for k, v in pairs(objTbl.p) do
					objProps[k] = deserialize_value(v)
				end

				local objAttrs = objTbl.at
				if objAttrs and next(objAttrs) then
					for k, v in pairs(objAttrs) do
						obj:SetAttribute(k, deserialize_value(v))
					end
				end

				obj.tags = objTbl.t or {}

				local objChildren = objTbl.ch
				if objChildren then
					for i = 1, #objChildren do
						local child = deserialize_object_with_map(objChildren[i])
						if child then
							child.Parent = obj
						end
					end
				end

				return obj
			end

			for i = 1, #tbl do
				local ok, result = pcall(deserialize_object_with_map, tbl[i])
				if ok and result then
					instanceCount += 1
					instances[instanceCount] = result
				else
					warn(("Failed to deserialize object of class %q: %s"):format(tostring(tbl[i].c), tostring(result)))
				end
			end

			for i = 1, instanceCount do
				local stack = { instances[i] }
				local stackSize = 1
				while stackSize > 0 do
					local inst = stack[stackSize]
					stackSize -= 1

					-- Resolve refs in _props
					local instProps = inst._props
					if instProps then
						for k, v in pairs(instProps) do
							if type(v) == "table" then
								if v.__ref then
									instProps[k] = id_map[v.__ref]
								end
							end
						end
					end

					-- Resolve refs in attributes
					local instAttrs = inst.attributes
					if instAttrs then
						for k, v in pairs(instAttrs) do
							if type(v) == "table" and v.__ref then
								instAttrs[k] = id_map[v.__ref]
							end
						end
					end

					-- Push children onto stack
					local children = inst:GetChildren()
					for j = 1, #children do
						stackSize += 1
						stack[stackSize] = children[j]
					end
				end
			end

			return instances
		end,

		userdata = {
			Encode = function(value)
				local serialized, ok = serialize_value(value, {})
				if ok then
					return serialized
				end
				return nil
			end,
			Decode = function(value)
				return deserialize_value(value)
			end,
		},
	})
