  Result: SoundService "SoundService" (SoundService)
  Code: local Instance = require("@Instance")
local raylib = require("@raylib")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local SoundService = Instance.new("SoundService")
SoundService.ExplorerHidden = true
SoundService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.Audio

SoundService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	SoundService.GlobalVolume = 1.0

	renderer.Pool.new("3d", function()
		local workspace = datamodel:GetService("Workspace")
		if not workspace then
			return
		end
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return
		end
		local camPos = camera.CFrame.Position
		local camRight = camera.CFrame:GetRightVector()

		for _, obj in pairs(datamodel:GetDescendants()) do
			if obj.class == "Sound" and obj.Playing and obj.IsLoaded then
				if obj.IsStream then
					raylib.lib.UpdateMusicStream(obj._raylibSound)
				end

				if obj.Is3D then
					local pos = obj.Parent and obj.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Parent.Position or obj.Position
					local dist = (pos - camPos):Magnitude()

					local attenuation = 1.0
					if dist < obj.MinDistance then
						attenuation = 1.0
					elseif dist > obj.MaxDistance then
						attenuation = 0.0
					else
						if obj.RollOffMode == 0 then -- Linear
							attenuation = 1.0 - ((dist - obj.MinDistance) / (obj.MaxDistance - obj.MinDistance))
						elseif obj.RollOffMode == 1 then -- Inverse
							attenuation = obj.MinDistance / dist
						elseif obj.RollOffMode == 2 then -- InverseTapered
							attenuation = obj.MinDistance / (dist + obj.MinDistance)
						end
					end

					local dirToSound = (pos - camPos):Unit()
					local rightDot = camRight:Dot(dirToSound)
					-- pan: 0 = left, 1 = right, 0.5 = center
					local pan = (rightDot + 1) / 2

					local groupVol = obj.SoundGroup and obj.SoundGroup.Volume or 1.0
					local finalVol = obj.Volume * groupVol * obj._fadeVolume * attenuation * SoundService.GlobalVolume

					if obj.IsStream then
						raylib.lib.SetMusicVolume(obj._raylibSound, finalVol)
						raylib.lib.SetMusicPan(obj._raylibSound, pan)
					else
						raylib.lib.SetSoundVolume(obj._raylibSound, finalVol)
						raylib.lib.SetSoundPan(obj._raylibSound, pan)
					end
				else
					local groupVol = obj.SoundGroup and obj.SoundGroup.Volume or 1.0
					local finalVol = obj.Volume * groupVol * obj._fadeVolume * SoundService.GlobalVolume

					if obj.IsStream then
						raylib.lib.SetMusicVolume(obj._raylibSound, finalVol)
						raylib.lib.SetMusicPan(obj._raylibSound, 0.5)
					else
						raylib.lib.SetSoundVolume(obj._raylibSound, finalVol)
						raylib.lib.SetSoundPan(obj._raylibSound, 0.5)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return SoundService

local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local SQLiteService = Instance.new("SQLiteBaseService")
SQLiteService.ExplorerHidden = true
SQLiteService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.Filesystem

local SQLiteBases = {}

SQLiteService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, datamodel)
	task.spawn(function()
		local sqlite = zune.sqlite
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until datamodel.SerializationService
		local SerializationService = datamodel.SerializationService
		local userdata = SerializationService.userdata

		SQLiteService:SetProperties({
			CreateBase = function(name: string)
				if SQLiteBases[name] then
					return SQLiteBases[name]
				end
				local store = Instance.new("SQLiteStore")
				store.Name = name
				SQLiteBases[name] = store

				local db = sqlite.open(name .. ".db")

				db:exec("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datastore(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT)")

				store:SetProperties({
					Open = function(self)
						return db
					end,

					GetAsync = function(key, callback)
						task.spawn(function()
							local success, result = pcall(function()
								local stmt = db:query("SELECT value FROM datastore WHERE key = :key")
								local row = stmt:get({ [":key"] = key })
								if row then
									return userdata.Decode(row.value)
								end
								return nil
							end)
							if callback then
								callback(success, result)
							end
							return result
						end)
					end,

					SetAsync = function(key, value, callback)
						task.spawn(function()
							local success, err = pcall(function()
								db:exec(
									"INSERT INTO datastore(key, value) VALUES (:key, :value) ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value=excluded.value",
									{ [":key"] = key, [":value"] = userdata.Encode(value) }
								)
							end)
							if callback then
								callback(success, err)
							end
						end)
					end,

					UpdateAsync = function(self, key, transform)
						local old = store:GetAsync(key)
						local new = transform(old)
						store:SetAsync(key, new)
						return new
					end,

					Close = function(self)
						db:close()
					end,
				})

				return store
			end,
		})
	end)
end

return SQLiteService

StarterGui.InitRenderer = function(renderer, signal, datamodel)
	task.spawn(function()
		repeat
			task.wait()
		until datamodel.Loaded == true

		local CoreGui = datamodel:GetService("CoreGui")

		local cache = {}

		local function renderGui(child)
			if cache[child.UniqueId] then
				return
			end

			if type(child) == "table" and child.BaseClass == "UIContainer" then
				if child["render"] then
					local renderId
					renderId = renderer.Pool.new("2d", function()
						if not child.render then
							renderer.Pool.Destroy(renderId)
							return
						end
						local dt = renderer.Raylib.lib.GetFrameTime()
						child.render(renderer.Raylib.lib, child, dt, renderer.Raylib.structs, renderer, datamodel)
					end, -5)
					cache[child.UniqueId] = renderId
				end
			end
		end

		StarterGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			renderGui(child)
		end)

		for _, child in pairs(StarterGui:GetChildren()) do
			renderGui(child)
		end

		function StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(coreGuiType, enabled: boolean)
			CoreGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(coreGuiType, enabled)
		end

		function StarterGui:GetCore(coreName)
			return CoreGui:GetCore(coreName)
		end

		function StarterGui:SetCore(parameterName: string, value)
			CoreGui:SetCore(parameterName, value)
		end

		function StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(coreGuiType)
			return CoreGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled(coreGuiType)
		end
	end)

local raylib = require("@raylib")

local TextService = Instance.new("TextService")
TextService.ExplorerHidden = true
TextService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.UI

TextService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, signal, datamodel)
	TextService:SetProperties({
		MeasureText = function(text, font, textSize, spacing)
			local baseFontName
			if type(font) == "table" and font.Value then
				baseFontName = font.Value
			elseif type(font) == "string" then
				baseFontName = font
			else
				baseFontName = Enum.Font.DefaultEngineFont.Value
			end
			local resolvedFont = renderer.Font.Get(baseFontName)
			if not resolvedFont then
				resolvedFont = renderer.Font.Get(Enum.Font.DefaultEngineFont.Value) or raylib.lib.GetFontDefault()
			end
			local measured = raylib.lib.MeasureTextEx(resolvedFont, text, textSize, spacing)
			return Vector2.new(measured.x, measured.y)
		end,
		measureMultilineText = function(text, font, textSize, spacing)
			local lines = text:split("\n")
			local maxWidth = 0
			local totalHeight = 0

			for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
				local size = TextService.MeasureText(line == "" and " " or line, font, textSize, spacing)
				maxWidth = math.max(maxWidth, size.X)
				totalHeight = totalHeight + size.Y
			end

			totalHeight = totalHeight + (#lines - 1) * (spacing * 2)

			return Vector2.new(maxWidth, totalHeight)
		end,
	})
end

return TextService

Created thread stack5543343: 
  Success: true
  Result: TweenService "TweenService" (TweenService)
  Code: local Instance = require("@Instance")
local signal = require("@Kinemium.signal")
local Enum = require("@EnumMap")

local TweenService = Instance.new("TweenService")
TweenService.ExplorerHidden = true
TweenService._Intents = Enum.PluginIntents.Graphics

local TweenCompleted = signal.new()
local activeTweens = {}

-- Easing Functions
local pow = math.pow
local sin = math.sin
local cos = math.cos
local pi = math.pi
local sqrt = math.sqrt
local exp = math.exp

local function linear(t)
	return t
end

local function sine(t)
	return 1 - cos((t * pi) / 2)
end

local function quad(t)
	return t * t
end

local function cubic(t)
	return t * t * t
end

local function quart(t)
	return t * t * t * t
end

local function quint(t)
	return t * t * t * t * t
end

local function expo(t)
	return t == 0 and 0 or pow(2, 10 * (t - 1))
end

local function circ(t)
	return 1 - sqrt(1 - t * t)
end

local function back(t)
	local c1 = 1.70158
	local c3 = c1 + 1
	return c3 * t * t * t - c1 * t * t
end

local function elastic(t)
	if t == 0 then
		return 0
	end
	if t == 1 then
		return 1
	end
	local c4 = (2 * pi) / 3
	return -pow(2, 10 * t - 10) * sin((t * 10 - 10.75) * c4)
end

local function bounce(t)
	local n1 = 7.5625
	local d1 = 2.75

	if t < 1 / d1 then
		return n1 * t * t
	elseif t < 2 / d1 then
		t = t - 1.5 / d1
		return n1 * t * t + 0.75
	elseif t < 2.5 / d1 then
		t = t - 2.25 / d1
		return n1 * t * t + 0.9375
	else
		t = t - 2.625 / d1
		return n1 * t * t + 0.984375
	end
end

local function smooth(t)
	return t * t * (3 - 2 * t)
end

local function smoother(t)
	return t * t * t * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10)
end

local function ridiculousWiggle(t)
	return sin(t * pi * 10) * (1 - t)
end

local function revBack(t)
	local c1 = 1.70158
	local c3 = c1 + 1
	return 1 - (c3 * (1 - t) * (1 - t) * (1 - t) - c1 * (1 - t) * (1 - t))
end

local function spring(t)
	return 1 + (-exp(-6 * t) * cos(10 * t)) / (1 + (t * 2)) -- Dampened
end

local function softSpring(t)
	return 1 - cos(t * pi * 2) * exp(-4 * t)
end

local easings = {
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Linear] = linear,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Sine] = sine,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Quad] = quad,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Cubic] = cubic,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Quart] = quart,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Quint] = quint,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Expo] = expo,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Circular] = circ,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Back] = back,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic] = elastic,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Bounce] = bounce,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Smooth] = smooth,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Smoother] = smoother,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.RidiculousWiggle] = ridiculousWiggle,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.RevBack] = revBack,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.Spring] = spring,
	[Enum.EasingStyle.SoftSpring] = softSpring,
}

local customEasings = {}

function TweenService:RegisterEasingStyle(name, easingFunction)
	assert(type(name) == "string", "Easing style name must be a string")
	assert(type(easingFunction) == "function", "Easing style must be a function")
	customEasings[name] = easingFunction
end

function TweenService:GetValue(alpha, style, direction)
	local easeFunc = easings[style] or customEasings[style]

	-- Support passing a function directly
	if type(style) == "function" then
		easeFunc = style
	end

	if not easeFunc then
		easeFunc = linear
	end

	if style == Enum.EasingStyle.Linear or style == Enum.EasingStyle.RidiculousWiggle then
		return easeFunc(alpha)
	end

	if direction == Enum.EasingDirection.In then
		return easeFunc(alpha)
	elseif direction == Enum.EasingDirection.Out then
		return 1 - easeFunc(1 - alpha)
	elseif direction == Enum.EasingDirection.InOut then
		if alpha < 0.5 then
			return easeFunc(2 * alpha) / 2
		else
			return 1 - easeFunc(2 * (1 - alpha)) / 2
		end
	end
	return alpha
end

function TweenService:GetActiveTweens()
	local list = {}
	for t, _ in pairs(activeTweens) do
		table.insert(list, t)
	end
	return list
end

function TweenService:CancelAll()
	for t, _ in pairs(activeTweens) do
		t:Cancel()
	end
	activeTweens = {}
end

local function lerp(a, b, t)
	return a + (b - a) * t
end

local function getTypeOf(v)
	if type(v) == "table" then
		if getmetatable(v) and type(v.Lerp) == "function" then
			return "Instance" -- Placeholder or specific type check if possible
		end
	end
	return type(v)
end

local function lerpProp(startVal, endVal, alpha)
	if type(startVal) == "number" then
		return lerp(startVal, endVal, alpha)
	elseif type(startVal) == "table" and startVal.Lerp then
		return startVal:Lerp(endVal, alpha)
	end
	return startVal
end

local function createTween(object, tweenInfo, properties)
	local tween = {}

	tween.TweenInfo = tweenInfo
	tween.Instance = object
	tween.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Begin

	tween._time = 0
	tween._delayElapsed = 0
	tween._playing = false
	tween._completed = false
	tween._reversing = false
	tween._cycleCount = 0
	tween._initialValues = {}
	tween._targetValues = properties

	tween.Completed = signal.new()

	for prop, _ in pairs(properties) do
		tween._initialValues[prop] = object[prop]
	end

	function tween:Play()
		if self.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
			return
		end

		if self.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed or self.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled then
			self._time = 0
			self._delayElapsed = 0
			self._cycleCount = 0
			self._reversing = false
		end

		self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Playing
		self._playing = true
		activeTweens[self] = true
	end

	function tween:Pause()
		if self.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Playing then
			self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Paused
			self._playing = false
			activeTweens[self] = nil
		end
	end

	function tween:Cancel()
		if self.PlaybackState == Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled then
			return
		end

		self.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled
		self._playing = false
		activeTweens[self] = nil
		self.Completed:Fire(Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled)
	end

	function tween:Destroy()
		self:Cancel()
	end

	return tween
end

function TweenService:Create(object, tweenInfo, properties)
	return createTween(object, tweenInfo, properties)
end

TweenService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal)
	TweenService:SetProperties({
		Create = TweenService.Create,
		Completed = TweenCompleted,
		GetValue = TweenService.GetValue,
		RegisterEasingStyle = TweenService.RegisterEasingStyle,
	})

	renderer_signal:Connect(function(route, dt)
		if route ~= "Heartbeat" then
			return
		end

		for tween, _ in pairs(activeTweens) do
			if tween._playing then
				local info = tween.TweenInfo

				if tween._delayElapsed < info.DelayTime then
					-- do nothing, just wait
				else
					tween._time = tween._time + dt
					local rawTime = tween._time
					local duration = info.Time

					local totalCycleTime = duration
					if info.Reverses then
						totalCycleTime = duration * 2
					end

					local currentCycleIndex = math.floor(rawTime / totalCycleTime)

					local finished = false
					if info.RepeatCount >= 0 and currentCycleIndex > info.RepeatCount then
						finished = true
						rawTime = totalCycleTime * (info.RepeatCount + 1)
					end

					local cycleTime = rawTime % totalCycleTime
					if finished then
						cycleTime = totalCycleTime
					end

					local alpha = 0

					if info.Reverses then
						if cycleTime <= duration then
							alpha = cycleTime / duration
						else
							alpha = 1 - ((cycleTime - duration) / duration)
						end
					else
						alpha = cycleTime / duration
					end

					if alpha > 1 then
						alpha = 1
					end
					if alpha < 0 then
						alpha = 0
					end

					local easedAlpha = TweenService:GetValue(alpha, info.EasingStyle, info.EasingDirection)

					for prop, endVal in pairs(tween._targetValues) do
						local startVal = tween._initialValues[prop]
						tween.Instance[prop] = lerpProp(startVal, endVal, easedAlpha)
					end

					if finished then
						tween._playing = false
						tween.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
						activeTweens[tween] = nil
						tween.Completed:Fire(Enum.PlaybackState.Completed)
						TweenCompleted:Fire(tween)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

return TweenService

function UnifiedPhysicsService:RegisterEngine(name, handler)
	engines[name] = handler
end

function UnifiedPhysicsService:SetPrimaryEngine(name)
	if activeEngineName == name then
		return
	end
	local newHandler = engines[name]
	if not newHandler then
		warn("[UPS] Attempted to set unknown physics engine: " .. tostring(name))
		return
	end

	-- Teardown old engine
	if activeEngineHandler then
		if activeEngineHandler.Unload then
			pcall(activeEngineHandler.Unload)
		end
		for k, v in pairs(activeEngineHandler) do
			if type(v) == "function" then
				UnifiedPhysicsService._props[k] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	activeEngineName = name
	activeEngineHandler = newHandler

	-- Map new functions
	for k, v in pairs(newHandler) do
		if type(v) == "function" then
			UnifiedPhysicsService._props[k] = v
		end
	end

	-- Reconstruction Sweep
	if datamodel_ref then
		for _, descendant in ipairs(datamodel_ref:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant.BaseClass == "BasePart" then
				if activeEngineHandler.AddBody then
					activeEngineHandler.AddBody(descendant)
				end
			end
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(datamodel_ref:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant.ClassName and descendant.ClassName:match("Constraint$") then
				if descendant.Enabled ~= nil then
					local state = descendant.Enabled
					descendant.Enabled = not state
					descendant.Enabled = state
				end
			end
		end
	end

	print("[UPS] Active Physics Engine set to: " .. name)
end

function UnifiedPhysicsService:GetPrimaryEngineName()
	return activeEngineName
end

UnifiedPhysicsService.InitRenderer = function(renderer, renderer_signal, game)
	datamodel_ref = game

	renderer_signal:Connect(function(route, data)
		if activeEngineHandler and activeEngineHandler.HandleRendererSignal then
			activeEngineHandler.HandleRendererSignal(route, data)
		else
			if route == "UpdatePart" or route == "AddedPartToRenderPool" then
				if activeEngineHandler and activeEngineHandler.UpdatePart then
					activeEngineHandler.UpdatePart(data)
				elseif activeEngineHandler and activeEngineHandler.AddBody and route == "AddedPartToRenderPool" then
					activeEngineHandler.AddBody(data)
				end
			elseif route == "RemovedPartFromRenderPool" then
				if activeEngineHandler and activeEngineHandler.RemoveBody then
					activeEngineHandler.RemoveBody(data)
				end
			elseif route == "UpdateSoftBody" then
				if activeEngineHandler and activeEngineHandler.UpdateSoftBody then
					activeEngineHandler.UpdateSoftBody(data)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	if engines["Jolt"] and not activeEngineName then
		UnifiedPhysicsService:SetPrimaryEngine("Jolt")
	end
end

return UnifiedPhysicsService
