changed_signal:Connect(function(message, status)
	if message == "TopbarEnabled" then
		Gui.Enabled = status
	end
end)

main_signal:Connect(function(message, param, cb)
	if message == "OpenMenu" then
		menuActive = true
		OpenMenu()
	elseif message == "CloseMenu" then
		menuActive = false
		CloseMenu()
	elseif message == "ToggleMenu" then
		menuActive = not menuActive
		if menuActive then
			OpenMenu()
		else
			CloseMenu()
		end
	elseif message == "RemoveMenu" then
		Gui.Enabled = false
	elseif message == "DestroyMenu" then
		Gui:Destroy()
	elseif message == "EnableMenu" then
		Gui.Enabled = true
	elseif message == "OpenRoute" then
		Route.handle("/" .. param)
	elseif message == "CloseRoute" then
		Route.deselect()
	elseif message == "MakeWindow" then
		createWindow(param, cb)
		local newTabs = tabs.Tabs
		table.insert(newTabs, param)
		tabs.Tabs = newTabs -- reassign to trigger __newindex so UITabs re-renders
		if tabs.ActiveIndex == nil or tabs.ActiveIndex < 1 then
			tabs.ActiveIndex = 1
		end
	elseif message == "NewTopbarButton" then
		newTopbarButton(param.icon, param.routeName, param.open_callback, param.close_callback)
	end
end)

local screenGui = CoreGui.KinemiumCoreGui

local sign = ishared.CoreGuiSignal
local manager = ishared.ReactPointer
local renderer = KinemiumRaylib.renderer

local vend = KinemiumFontService.GetDefaultFontSmall()

local function runtime(key, fallback)
	local value = manager:get("#runtime", key)
	if value == nil then
		return fallback
	end
	return value
end

local function bindRuntime(object, props)
	for property, key in pairs(props) do
		manager:bind(object, property, "#runtime." .. key)
	end
end

local function bindCorner(corner, radiusKey)
	radiusKey = radiusKey or "corner"
	bindRuntime(corner, {
		CornerRadius = radiusKey,
		TopLeftRadius = radiusKey,
		TopRightRadius = radiusKey,
		BottomLeftRadius = radiusKey,
		BottomRightRadius = radiusKey,
	})
end

local function springTarget(object, props)
	Spring.target(object, runtime("damping", 2), runtime("frequency", 5), props)
end

local function runtimeCellFont(fallback)
	local runtimeFont = runtime("font", Enum.Font.DefaultEngineFont)
	if type(runtimeFont) == "table" and runtimeFont.Value and renderer and renderer.Font and renderer.Font.Get then
		local resolvedFont = renderer.Font.Get(runtimeFont.Value)
		if resolvedFont then
			return resolvedFont
		end
	end
	return fallback
end

local function newPlayerCell(playerObject: Player)
	return {
		name = playerObject.Name,
		description = tostring(playerObject.UserId),
		font = runtimeCellFont(vend),
		backgroundColor = runtime("secondarybackground", Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
		textColor = runtime("text", Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
		descriptionColor = runtime("mutedtext", Color3.new(0.85, 0.85, 0.85)),
		value = true,
	}
end

local function applyCellTheme(sections)
	for _, entries in pairs(sections) do
		if type(entries) ~= "table" then
			continue
		end
		entries.titleFont = runtimeCellFont(vend)
		for _, cell in ipairs(entries) do
			if type(cell) ~= "table" then
				continue
			end
			cell.font = runtimeCellFont(vend)
			cell.backgroundColor = runtime("secondarybackground", Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
			cell.textColor = runtime("text", Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			cell.descriptionColor = runtime("mutedtext", Color3.new(0.85, 0.85, 0.85))
		end
	end
end

local function cloneSections(sections)
	local cloned = {}
	for name, entries in pairs(sections) do
		cloned[name] = entries
	end
	return cloned
end

sign:Fire("MakeWindow", "Players", function(window)
	local cellList = Instance.new("UICellList")
	cellList.Parent = window
	cellList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
	cellList.Sections = {
		Players = {},
	}
	applyCellTheme(cellList.Sections)

	local localSections = {
		Players = {},
	}

	local function rebuildLocalSections()
		local playerCells = localSections.Players
		applyCellTheme(localSections)
		cellList.Sections = cloneSections(localSections)
	end

	Players.ChildAdded:Connect(function(new)
		if new:IsA("Player") then
			table.insert(localSections.Players, newPlayerCell(new))
			rebuildLocalSections()
		end
	end)

	Players.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(old)
		if old:IsA("Player") then
			for i, cell in ipairs(localSections.Players) do
				if cell.description == tostring(old.UserId) then
					table.remove(localSections.Players, i)
					break
				end
			end
			rebuildLocalSections()
		end
	end)

	for _, player in pairs(Players:GetChildren()) do
		table.insert(localSections.Players, newPlayerCell(player))
	end

	rebuildLocalSections()

	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "background", rebuildLocalSections)
	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "secondarybackground", rebuildLocalSections)
	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "text", rebuildLocalSections)
	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "mutedtext", rebuildLocalSections)
	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "font", rebuildLocalSections)
end)

local function runtime(key, fallback)
	local value = manager:get("#runtime", key)
	if value == nil then
		return fallback
	end
	return value
end

local function runtimeCellFont(fallback)
	local runtimeFont = runtime("font", Enum.Font.DefaultEngineFont)
	if type(runtimeFont) == "table" and runtimeFont.Value and renderer and renderer.Font and renderer.Font.Get then
		local resolvedFont = renderer.Font.Get(runtimeFont.Value)
		if resolvedFont then
			return resolvedFont
		end
	end
	return fallback
end

local function applyCellTheme(sections)
	for _, entries in pairs(sections) do
		if type(entries) ~= "table" then
			continue
		end
		entries.titleFont = runtimeCellFont(vend)
		for _, cell in ipairs(entries) do
			if type(cell) ~= "table" then
				continue
			end
			cell.font = runtimeCellFont(vend)
			cell.backgroundColor = runtime("secondarybackground", Color3.new(0, 0, 0))
			cell.textColor = runtime("text", Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
			cell.descriptionColor = runtime("mutedtext", Color3.new(0.85, 0.85, 0.85))
		end
	end
end

local function cloneSections(sections)
	local cloned = {}
	for name, entries in pairs(sections) do
		cloned[name] = entries
	end
	return cloned
end

local function buildSettingsSections()
	local sections = {}
	local canvasSize = 0

	for section, entries in pairs(ConfigService.GetConfig() or {}) do
		local values = {}

		for propName, propData in pairs(entries) do
			if type(propData) ~= "table" then
				continue
			end

			table.insert(values, {
				name = propName,
				description = propData.Description,
				font = runtimeCellFont(vend),
				backgroundColor = runtime("secondarybackground", Color3.new(0, 0, 0)),
				textColor = runtime("text", Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
				descriptionColor = runtime("mutedtext", Color3.new(0.85, 0.85, 0.85)),
				value = propData.Value,
			})
			canvasSize += 100
		end

		sections[section] = values
	end

	applyCellTheme(sections)

	return sections, canvasSize
end

sign:Fire("MakeWindow", "Settings", function(window)
	window.ClipsDescendants = true

	local ScrollingFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	ScrollingFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	ScrollingFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
	ScrollingFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	ScrollingFrame.AutoScrollSize = false
	ScrollingFrame.Parent = window

	local cellList = Instance.new("UICellList")
	cellList.Parent = ScrollingFrame
	cellList.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
	cellList.Sections = {}

	local function refreshSections()
		local sections, canvasSize = buildSettingsSections()
		cellList.Sections = cloneSections(sections)
		ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize = canvasSize
	end

	refreshSections()
	ConfigService.ConfigChanged:Connect(refreshSections)

	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "background", function()
		refreshSections()
	end)
	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "secondarybackground", function()
		refreshSections()

	end)
	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "mutedtext", function()
		refreshSections()
	end)
	manager:subscribe("#runtime", "font", function()
		refreshSections()
	end)
end)

local function runtime(key, fallback)
	local value = manager:get("#runtime", key)
	if value == nil then
		return fallback
	end
	return value
end

local function bindRuntime(object, props)
	for property, key in pairs(props) do
		manager:bind(object, property, "#runtime." .. key)
	end
end

local function bindCorner(corner, radiusKey)
	radiusKey = radiusKey or "corner"
	bindRuntime(corner, {
		CornerRadius = radiusKey,
		TopLeftRadius = radiusKey,
		TopRightRadius = radiusKey,
		BottomLeftRadius = radiusKey,
		BottomRightRadius = radiusKey,
	})
end

local function springTarget(object, props)
	Spring.target(object, runtime("damping", 2), runtime("frequency", 5), props)
end

			end
		end
	end
	scrollList.CanvasSize -= 100
	refreshSidebarSections()
end)

local function getClassCategory(className)
	local lowerName = className:lower()

	-- Services
	if lowerName:find("service") then
		return "Services"
	end

	-- UI
	if
		lowerName:find("gui")
		or lowerName:find("screen")
		or lowerName:find("frame")
		or lowerName:find("text")
		or lowerName:find("button")
		or lowerName:find("scroll")
		or lowerName:find("image")
		or lowerName:find("textbox")
		or lowerName:find("viewport")
		or lowerName:find("billboard")
		or lowerName:find("surface")
	then
		return "UI"
	end

	-- Effects
	if
		lowerName:find("particle")
		or lowerName:find("light")
		or lowerName:find("beam")
		or lowerName:find("trail")
		or lowerName:find("fire")
		or lowerName:find("smoke")
		or lowerName:find("sparkles")
		or lowerName:find("constraint")
	then
		return "Effects"
	end

	-- Scripting
	if
		lowerName:find("script")
		or lowerName:find("module")
		or lowerName:find("bindable")
		or lowerName:find("remote")
	then
		return "Scripting"
	end

	-- Objects
	if
		lowerName:find("part")
		or lowerName:find("mesh")
		or lowerName:find("model")
		or lowerName:find("attachment")
		or lowerName:find("motor")
		or lowerName:find("weld")
	then
		return "Objects"
	end

	-- Data
	if
		lowerName:find("value")
		or lowerName:find("object")
		or lowerName:find("bool")
		or lowerName:find("number")
		or lowerName:find("string")
		or lowerName:find("vector")
		or lowerName:find("color")
		or lowerName:find("cframe")
		or lowerName:find("udim")
		or lowerName:find("brick")
	then
		return "Data"
	end

	-- Audio
	if
		lowerName:find("sound")
		or lowerName:find("audio")
		or lowerName:find("reverb")
		or lowerName:find("echo")
		or lowerName:find("distortion")
		or lowerName:find("flange")
		or lowerName:find("chorus")
		or lowerName:find("equalizer")
	then
		return "Audio"
	end

	-- Animation
	if
		lowerName:find("animation")
		or lowerName:find("animator")
		or lowerName:find("humanoid")
		or lowerName:find("character")
	then
		return "Animation"
	end

	-- Camera
	if lowerName:find("camera") then
		return "Camera"
	end

	return "Other"
end

local function getTagsForInstance(instance)
	local ok, tags = pcall(function()
		if instance.GetTags then
			return instance:GetTags()
		end
		local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
		return CollectionService:GetTags(instance)
	end)
	if ok and type(tags) == "table" then
		return tags
	end
	return {}
end

local function getAttributesForInstance(instance)
	local ok, attrs = pcall(function()
		return instance:GetAttributes()
	end)
	if ok and type(attrs) == "table" then
		return attrs
	end
	return {}
end

local function instanceMatches(instance, query, mode)
	local q = string.lower(query or "")
	if q == "" then
		return true
	end

	if mode == "Name" then
		return string.find(instance.Name:lower(), q, 1, true) ~= nil
	elseif mode == "ClassName" then
		return string.find((instance.ClassName or ""):lower(), q, 1, true) ~= nil
	elseif mode == "Property" then
		local propName, propValue = q:match("^%s*([^:]+)%s*:%s*(.+)%s*$")
		if not propName then
			propName = q
		end
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return instance[propName]
		end)
		if ok then
			if propValue then
				return string.find(tostring(value):lower(), propValue, 1, true) ~= nil
			end
			return true
		end
		return false
	elseif mode == "Tags" then
		for _, tag in ipairs(getTagsForInstance(instance)) do
			if string.find(string.lower(tag), q, 1, true) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	elseif mode == "Attributes" then
		local attrName, attrValue = q:match("^%s*([^:]+)%s*:%s*(.+)%s*$")
		local attrs = getAttributesForInstance(instance)
		if attrName then
			local value = attrs[attrName]
			if value == nil then
				return false
			end
			return string.find(tostring(value):lower(), attrValue, 1, true) ~= nil
		end
		for key, value in pairs(attrs) do
			if string.find(string.lower(key), q, 1, true) or string.find(tostring(value):lower(), q, 1, true) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	elseif mode == "All" then
		if string.find(instance.Name:lower(), q, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
		if string.find((instance.ClassName or ""):lower(), q, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
		if instanceMatches(instance, query, "Property") then
			return true
		end
		if instanceMatches(instance, query, "Tags") then
			return true
		end
		if instanceMatches(instance, query, "Attributes") then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	return string.find(instance.Name:lower(), q, 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function matchesSearch(instance, query, mode)
	if instanceMatches(instance, query, mode) then
		return true
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
		if matchesSearch(child, query, mode) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function isMouseInRect(rect, mousePos)
	return mousePos.x >= rect.x
		and mousePos.x <= rect.x + rect.width
		and mousePos.y >= rect.y
		and mousePos.y <= rect.y + rect.height
end

local function hasSelectedDescendant(instance)
	for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
		if Selection.IsSelected(child) or hasSelectedDescendant(child) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function canReparent(instance, newParent)
	if instance == newParent then
		return false
	end
	if instance.BaseClass == "Singleton" then
		return false
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return newParent:IsDescendantOf(instance)
	end)
	if ok and result then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local function isRectVisible(rect, windowRect)
	return rect.x + rect.width >= windowRect.x
		and rect.x <= windowRect.x + windowRect.width
		and rect.y + rect.height >= windowRect.y
		and rect.y <= windowRect.y + windowRect.height
end

local function DoubleClicked(instance)
	local isScript = instance.BaseClass == "ScriptContainer"
	EngineSignal:Fire("idestate", isScript, instance)
end

local function getServicesInOrder()
	local services = {}
	local serviceSet = {}

	for _, name in ipairs(SERVICE_ORDER) do
		local success, svc = pcall(game.GetService, game, name)
		if success and svc then
			table.insert(services, svc)
			serviceSet[svc] = true
		end
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(game:GetChildren()) do
		if not serviceSet[child] then
			table.insert(services, child)
		end
	end

	return services
end

local function handleSelection(instance, rectData, mousePos)
	if
		not isMouseInRect(rectData, mousePos)
		or rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) ~= 1
		or ContextMenuOpen
		or addMenuOpenBool
		or isDragging
	then
		return
	end

	local currentTime = os.clock()
	local ctrl = rl.IsKeyDown(341) == 1 or rl.IsKeyDown(345) == 1
	local shift = rl.IsKeyDown(340) == 1 or rl.IsKeyDown(344) == 1

	if lastClickTime[instance] and (currentTime - lastClickTime[instance]) < DOUBLE_CLICK_THRESHOLD then
		DoubleClicked(instance)
		expanded[instance] = not expanded[instance]
		lastClickTime[instance] = nil
		return
	end

	lastClickTime[instance] = currentTime

	if shift and lastClicked and instance.Parent then
		local siblings = instance.Parent:GetChildren()
		local startIndex, endIndex

		for i, obj in ipairs(siblings) do
			if obj == lastClicked then
				startIndex = i
			end
			if obj == instance then
				endIndex = i
			end
		end

		if startIndex and endIndex then
			if startIndex > endIndex then
				startIndex, endIndex = endIndex, startIndex
			end

			for i = startIndex, endIndex do
				if not Selection.IsSelected(siblings[i]) then
					Selection.Add(siblings[i])
				end
			end
		end
	elseif ctrl then
		if Selection.IsSelected(instance) then
			Selection.Remove(instance)
		else
			Selection.Add(instance)
		end
	else
		Selection.Clear()
		Selection.Add(instance)
		lastClicked = instance
	end
end

local function drawAdditionMenu(instance, mousePos, btnY, toggleX)
	if not addMenuOpen[instance] then
		return
	end

	addMenuScroll[instance] = addMenuScroll[instance] or 0
	addMenuScrollTarget[instance] = addMenuScrollTarget[instance] or 0
	addMenuSearch[instance] = addMenuSearch[instance] or ""

	local instanceTypes = Instance.getClasses()

	local sortedClasses = {}
	for class in pairs(instanceTypes) do
		table.insert(sortedClasses, class)
	end

	table.sort(sortedClasses, function(a, b)
		return a < b -- alphabetical
	end)

	-- Filter classes based on search query
	local filteredClasses = {}
	local searchQuery = addMenuSearch[instance]:lower()
	for _, class in ipairs(sortedClasses) do
		if searchQuery == "" or class:lower():find(searchQuery, 1, true) then
			table.insert(filteredClasses, class)
		end
	end

	-- Group classes by category
	local categoryBuckets = {}
	local categoryOrder = {}
	for _, class in ipairs(filteredClasses) do
		local category = getClassCategory(class)
		if not categoryBuckets[category] then
			categoryBuckets[category] = {}
			table.insert(categoryOrder, category)
		end
		table.insert(categoryBuckets[category], class)
	end

	table.sort(categoryOrder, function(a, b)
		return a < b
	end)

	-- Initialize category expansion state
	if not addMenuExpandedCategories[instance] then
		addMenuExpandedCategories[instance] = {}
	end

	-- Calculate total visible items (only count expanded categories)
	local totalVisibleItems = 0
	for _, category in ipairs(categoryOrder) do
		if addMenuExpandedCategories[instance][category] ~= false then
			totalVisibleItems = totalVisibleItems + #categoryBuckets[category]
		end
		totalVisibleItems = totalVisibleItems + 1 -- +1 for category header
	end

	local totalItems = totalVisibleItems

	local menuHeight = math.min(totalItems, MAX_VISIBLE_ITEMS) * ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT
		+ MENU_PADDING * 2
		+ ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT
		+ ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT
	local contentHeight = totalItems * ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT + #categoryOrder * CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT
	local menuX = toggleX - ADD_MENU_WIDTH - 10
	local menuY = btnY + 30

	-- Draw menu background
	rl.DrawRectangleRounded(
		structs.Rectangle:new({ x = menuX, y = menuY, width = ADD_MENU_WIDTH, height = menuHeight }),
		StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
		StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
		Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(0)
	)

	-- Draw title
	rl.DrawTextEx(
		vend,
		"Add Object",
		vector.create(menuX + MENU_PADDING, menuY + MENU_PADDING),
		18,
		StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
		StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextTransparency)
	)

	local menuRect = { x = menuX, y = menuY, width = ADD_MENU_WIDTH, height = menuHeight }
	local itemsRect = {
		x = menuX,
		y = menuY + MENU_PADDING + ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT + ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT,
		width = ADD_MENU_WIDTH,
		height = menuHeight - MENU_PADDING * 2 - ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT - ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT,
	}

	-- Handle mouse wheel scrolling on items area
	if isMouseInRect(itemsRect, mousePos) then
		local mouseWheel = rl.GetMouseWheelMove()
		if math.abs(mouseWheel) > 0.01 then
			addMenuScrollTarget[instance] = addMenuScrollTarget[instance] - (mouseWheel * ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT * 2)
			local maxScroll = math.max(0, contentHeight - (MAX_VISIBLE_ITEMS * ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT))
			addMenuScrollTarget[instance] = math.max(0, math.min(addMenuScrollTarget[instance], maxScroll))
		end
	end

	-- Smooth interpolation for scroll
	local dt = rl.GetFrameTime()
	local maxScroll = math.max(0, contentHeight - (MAX_VISIBLE_ITEMS * ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT))
	addMenuScrollTarget[instance] = math.clamp(addMenuScrollTarget[instance], 0, maxScroll)
	addMenuScroll[instance] = addMenuScroll[instance]
		+ (addMenuScrollTarget[instance] - addMenuScroll[instance]) * math.min(dt * 18, 1)

	-- Draw search textbox
	local searchBoxX = menuX + MENU_PADDING
	local searchBoxY = menuY + MENU_PADDING + ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT
	local searchBoxW = ADD_MENU_WIDTH - MENU_PADDING * 2
	addMenuSearchBox:drawWithExtras(searchBoxX, searchBoxY, searchBoxW, ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT - 6)

	-- Update search query from textbox
	local currentSearchText = addMenuSearchBox:getText() or ""
	if currentSearchText ~= addMenuSearch[instance] then
		addMenuSearch[instance] = currentSearchText
		addMenuScroll[instance] = 0 -- Reset scroll when search changes
		addMenuScrollTarget[instance] = 0
	end

	-- Draw items with scissor
	local scissorPadding = 2
	rl.BeginScissorMode(
		math.floor(menuX + scissorPadding),
		math.floor(menuY + MENU_PADDING + ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT + ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT),
		math.floor(ADD_MENU_WIDTH - scissorPadding * 2),
		math.floor(menuHeight - MENU_PADDING * 2 - ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT - ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT)
	)

	local cursorY = menuY + MENU_PADDING + ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT + ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT - addMenuScroll[instance]

	for _, category in ipairs(categoryOrder) do
		local categoryY = cursorY
		cursorY = cursorY + CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT

		-- Draw category header in inspector style
		local labelText = string.upper(category)
		local labelSize = rl.MeasureTextEx(vend, labelText, 11, 1.5)
		local indicatorText = addMenuExpandedCategories[instance][category] ~= false and "v" or ">"
		local indicatorSize = rl.MeasureTextEx(vend, indicatorText, 11, 1)

		local gap = 5
		local blockW = indicatorSize.x + gap + labelSize.x
		local blockX = menuX + MENU_PADDING
		local centerY = categoryY + (CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT / 2)
		local lineColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(0)

		rl.DrawRectangle(menuX, centerY, MENU_PADDING - 4, 1, lineColor)
		rl.DrawTextEx(
			boldFont,
			indicatorText,
			vector.create(blockX, centerY - 6),
			11,
			1,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextTransparency)
		)
		rl.DrawTextEx(
			boldFont,
			labelText,
			vector.create(blockX + indicatorSize.x + gap, centerY - 6),
			11,
			1.5,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextTransparency)
		)
		local lineStartX = blockX + blockW + MENU_PADDING - 4
		rl.DrawRectangle(lineStartX, centerY, ADD_MENU_WIDTH - lineStartX + menuX, 1, lineColor)

		-- Handle category click
		local categoryRect = { x = menuX, y = categoryY, width = ADD_MENU_WIDTH, height = CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT }
		local isCategoryHovered = isMouseInRect(categoryRect, mousePos)
			and mousePos.y >= menuY + MENU_PADDING + ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT + ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT
			and mousePos.y <= menuY + menuHeight - MENU_PADDING

		if isCategoryHovered and rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 then
			addMenuExpandedCategories[instance][category] = not addMenuExpandedCategories[instance][category]
		end

		-- Draw items in this category if expanded
		local isExpanded = addMenuExpandedCategories[instance][category] ~= false
		if isExpanded then
			for _, class in ipairs(categoryBuckets[category]) do
				local itemY = cursorY
				cursorY = cursorY + ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT

				if itemY + ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT < menuY or itemY > menuY + menuHeight then
					continue
				end

				local itemRect = { x = menuX, y = itemY, width = ADD_MENU_WIDTH, height = ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT }
				local isHovered = isMouseInRect(itemRect, mousePos)
					and mousePos.y >= menuY + MENU_PADDING + ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT + ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT
					and mousePos.y <= menuY + menuHeight - MENU_PADDING

				-- Initialize and animate hover state
				local itemKey = instance.UniqueId .. class
				addMenuHoverAnim[itemKey] = addMenuHoverAnim[itemKey] or 0
				local hoverTarget = isHovered and 1 or 0
				addMenuHoverAnim[itemKey] = addMenuHoverAnim[itemKey]
					+ (hoverTarget - addMenuHoverAnim[itemKey]) * math.min(dt * 15, 1)

				if addMenuHoverAnim[itemKey] > 0.01 then
					rl.DrawRectangle(
						menuX,
						itemY,
						ADD_MENU_WIDTH,
						ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT,
						Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2):ToRaylib(addMenuHoverAnim[itemKey])
					)
				end

				if isHovered and rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 and not addMenuSearchBox.isFocused then
					local success, newObj = pcall(Instance.new, class)
					if success then
						newObj.Parent = instance
					end
					addMenuOpen[instance] = false
					addMenuOpenBool = false
					addMenuScroll[instance] = 0
					addMenuScrollTarget[instance] = 0
					addMenuSearch[instance] = ""
					addMenuSearchBox:setText("")
				end

				local iconTex = loadedIcon[class]
				if not iconTex then
					local svg = KinemiumIconLoader.Get(class .. ".png") or KinemiumIconLoader.Get(class .. ".svg")
					if svg then
						iconTex = KinemiumIconLoader.ToTexture(svg)
						loadedIcon[class] = iconTex
					else
						iconTex = notfound_tex
					end
				end
				if iconTex and iconTex.texture then
					local iconSize = ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT - 6
					rl.DrawTexturePro(
						iconTex.texture,
						structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = iconTex.x, height = iconTex.y }),
						structs.Rectangle:new({ x = menuX + 4, y = itemY + 3, width = iconSize, height = iconSize }),
						vector.create(0, 0),
						0,
						StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageColor:ToRaylib(
							StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageTransparency
						)
					)
				end

				-- Draw text
				rl.DrawTextEx(
					vend,
					class,
					vector.create(menuX + ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT + 4, itemY + 3),
					17,
					1,
					StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor:ToRaylib(
						StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextTransparency
					)
				)
			end
		end
	end

	rl.EndScissorMode()

	-- Draw scrollbar
	if contentHeight > MAX_VISIBLE_ITEMS * ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT then
		local scrollbarWidth = 8
		local scrollbarX = menuX + ADD_MENU_WIDTH - scrollbarWidth - 2
		local scrollbarHeight = menuHeight - MENU_PADDING * 2 - ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT - ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT
		local scrollbarTrackHeight = scrollbarHeight - 4
		local scrollbarY = menuY + MENU_PADDING + ADD_MENU_SEARCH_HEIGHT + ADD_MENU_TITLE_HEIGHT

		local thumbHeight =
			math.max(20, (scrollbarTrackHeight * (MAX_VISIBLE_ITEMS * ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT)) / contentHeight)
		local maxScroll = contentHeight - (MAX_VISIBLE_ITEMS * ADD_MENU_ITEM_HEIGHT)
		local thumbY = scrollbarY + 2 + (addMenuScroll[instance] / maxScroll) * (scrollbarTrackHeight - thumbHeight)

		-- Track
		rl.DrawRectangleRounded(
			structs.Rectangle:new({
				x = scrollbarX,
				y = scrollbarY + 2,
				width = scrollbarWidth,
				height = scrollbarTrackHeight,
			}),
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			Color3.new(0.08, 0.08, 0.08):ToRaylib(0)
		)

		-- Thumb
		rl.DrawRectangleRounded(
			structs.Rectangle:new({
				x = scrollbarX,
				y = thumbY,
				width = scrollbarWidth,
				height = thumbHeight,
			}),
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3):ToRaylib(0)
		)
	end

	addMenuRect = menuRect
end

-- Tree drawing
local function DrawTree(instance, indent, winX, winY, winWidth, isLastChild)
	if instance.Destroyed or instance.ExplorerHidden then
		return
	end
	if isSearching and not matchesSearch(instance, searchQuery, searchFilterMode) then
		return
	end
	if isDragging and instance == dragInstance then
		return
	end

	local children = instance:GetChildren()
	local hasChildren = #children > 0

	local btnX = winX + 25 + winWidth - NODE_WIDTH - PADDING - (indent * -INDENT_SIZE)
	local btnY = winY + 10 + yOffset - scrollOffset
	local rectData = { x = btnX, y = btnY, width = NODE_WIDTH, height = NODE_HEIGHT }
	local toggleX = btnX + NODE_WIDTH

	local mousePos = rl.GetMousePosition()
	local treeTop = winY + 10
	local treeHeight = (windowObject and windowObject.height or 600) - 80
	local windowRect = { x = winX, y = treeTop, width = winWidth, height = treeHeight }

	-- Early culling check (only skip drawing, still process height/children)
	local isVisible = isRectVisible(rectData, windowRect)

	-- While dragging, detect drop target
	if isDragging and dragInstance ~= instance and canReparent(dragInstance, instance) then
		if isMouseInRect(rectData, mousePos) then
			dragTargetInstance = instance
		end
	end

	if isVisible then
		-- Draw simple vertical guide line for hierarchy
		if indent > 0 then
			local lineX = btnX - INDENT_SIZE / 2
			local lineColor = Theme.SecondaryTextColor
			lineColor = Color3.new(lineColor.R * 0.5, lineColor.G * 0.5, lineColor.B * 0.5)

			-- Vertical line - only go up to the middle for last child, otherwise go through entire node
			local lineEndY = isLastChild and (btnY + NODE_HEIGHT / 2) or (btnY + NODE_HEIGHT)
			rl.DrawLine(lineX, btnY, lineX, lineEndY, lineColor:ToRaylib(0.3))

			-- Horizontal line connecting to node
			rl.DrawLine(lineX, btnY + NODE_HEIGHT / 2, btnX - 2, btnY + NODE_HEIGHT / 2, lineColor:ToRaylib(0.3))
		end
		-- Determine visual state
		local isHovered = isMouseInRect(rectData, mousePos)
		local isSelected = Selection.IsSelected(instance)
		local isDragSource = isDragging and dragInstance == instance
		local isDropTarget = isDragging and dragTargetInstance == instance
		local transparency = isSelected and 0 or (isDragSource and 0.6 or (isHovered and 0.5 or 1))
		local color = isSelected and Color3.new(0, 0.533333, 1)
			or (isDropTarget and Color3.new(0, 0.7, 0.3))
			or Color3.new()

		-- Draw node background
		rl.DrawRectangleRounded(
			structs.Rectangle:new(rectData),
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			color:ToRaylib(transparency)
		)

		-- Record drop animation target position
		if dropAnimInstance == instance and dropAnimStart > 0 then
			dropAnimToX = rectData.x
			dropAnimToY = rectData.y
		end

		if not loadedIcon[instance.ClassName] then
			local svg = KinemiumIconLoader.Get(instance.ClassName .. ".png")
			if svg then
				loadedIcon[instance.ClassName] = KinemiumIconLoader.ToTexture(svg)
			else
				loadedIcon[instance.ClassName] = notfound_tex
			end
		end

		-- Draw icon
		local icon = loadedIcon[instance.ClassName] or notfound_tex
		local iconSize = instance.IconSize or NODE_HEIGHT - 4
		rl.DrawTexturePro(
			icon.texture,
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = icon.x, height = icon.y }),
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = btnX + 2, y = btnY + 2, width = iconSize, height = iconSize }),
			vector.create(0, 0),
			0,
			instance:GetMetadata("ExplorerIconColor")
					and instance
						:GetMetadata("ExplorerIconColor")
						:ToRaylib(instance:GetMetadata("ExplorerIconTransparency"))
				or StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageColor:ToRaylib(
					StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageTransparency
				)
		)

		-- Draw text
		rl.DrawTextEx(
			vend,
			instance.Name,
			vector.create(btnX + 28, btnY + 1),
			18,
			1,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextTransparency)
		)

		if isHovered and not isDragging then
			local addData = { x = toggleX - 50, y = btnY + 2, width = iconSize, height = iconSize }

			rl.DrawTexturePro(
				addIcon.texture,
				structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = addIcon.x, height = addIcon.y }),
				structs.Rectangle:new(addData),
				vector.create(0, 0),
				0,
				StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageTransparency)
			)

			if isMouseInRect(addData, mousePos) and rl.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
				-- Close all other menus
				for key in pairs(addMenuOpen) do
					addMenuOpen[key] = false
				end
				addMenuOpenBool = true
				addMenuOpen[instance] = not addMenuOpen[instance]

				if addMenuOpen[instance] then
					-- Initialize search textbox when menu opens
					addMenuSearchBox:setText(addMenuSearch[instance] or "")
					addMenuScroll[instance] = 0
					addMenuScrollTarget[instance] = 0
				else
					-- Reset search when menu closes
					addMenuSearch[instance] = ""
					addMenuScroll[instance] = 0
					addMenuScrollTarget[instance] = 0
				end

				activeAddMenu = addMenuOpen[instance]
						and {
							instance = instance,
							btnY = btnY,
							toggleX = toggleX,
						}
					or nil
			end

			-- Selection Menu
			if rl.IsMouseButtonReleased(1) == 1 then
				if isSelected then
					SelectionMenu.set("obj_rect", arect.new(mousePos.x, mousePos.y, 200, 0))
					SelectionMenu:show()
					ContextMenuOpen = true
				else
					SelectionMenu:hide()
					ContextMenuOpen = false
				end
			end
		end

		-- Record drag source on mouse press
		if isHovered and rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 and not addMenuOpenBool and not ContextMenuOpen then
			dragInstance = instance
			dragMouseStart = mousePos
		end

		-- Handle selection
		handleSelection(instance, rectData, mousePos)

		if hasChildren then
			local toggleTexture = expanded[instance] and ArrowDown or ArrowRight
			local buttonData = { x = rectData.x - 25, y = rectData.y, width = TOGGLE_SIZE, height = TOGGLE_SIZE }

			rl.DrawTexturePro(
				toggleTexture.texture,
				structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = toggleTexture.x, height = toggleTexture.y }),
				structs.Rectangle:new(buttonData),
				vector.create(0, 0),
				0,
				StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageTransparency)
			)

			if isMouseInRect(buttonData, mousePos) and rl.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
				expanded[instance] = not expanded[instance]
			end
		end
	end

	yOffset = yOffset + NODE_HEIGHT + 2

	local shouldExpand = expanded[instance]
		or (isSearching and matchesSearch(instance, searchQuery, searchFilterMode))
		or hasSelectedDescendant(instance)

	if hasChildren and shouldExpand then
		for i, child in ipairs(children) do
			local isLastChild = i == #children
			DrawTree(child, indent + 1, winX, winY, winWidth, isLastChild)
		end
	end
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "Explorer"
screenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Position = Theme.WindowConfig.Explorer.position
frame.AnchorPoint = Theme.WindowConfig.Explorer.anchorPoint
frame.Size = Theme.WindowConfig.Explorer.size
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
frame.Parent = screenGui

repeat
	task.wait()
until frame.AbsolutePosition and frame.AbsoluteSize

local window = aereon.window(game)
local explorerWindow = window.create({
	title = "Explorer",
	x = frame.AbsolutePosition.X,
	y = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y,
	width = frame.AbsoluteSize.X,
	height = frame.AbsoluteSize.Y,
})

window.focused = function(window)
	_G.IsHoveringOnWindow = true
end

window.unfocused = function(window)
	_G.IsHoveringOnWindow = false
end

local renderer = KinemiumRaylib.GetRenderer()

renderer.Pool.new("2d", function(data)
	local dt = rl.GetFrameTime()
	local mainTheme = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme

	if game.Context == Enum.GameContext.Editor then
		window.update(dt)
		window.draw(dt, mainTheme.aereon)
	end

	if rl.IsWindowResized() == 1 then
		explorerWindow.x = frame.AbsolutePosition.X
		explorerWindow.y = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y
		explorerWindow.width = frame.AbsoluteSize.X
		explorerWindow.height = frame.AbsoluteSize.Y
	end

	if activeAddMenu then
		drawAdditionMenu(activeAddMenu.instance, rl.GetMousePosition(), activeAddMenu.btnY, activeAddMenu.toggleX)
	end
end, 9999)

explorerWindow.stepped = function(windowData)
	if windowData.title ~= "Explorer" then
		return
	end

	searchQuery = searchBox:getText() or ""
	isSearching = #searchQuery > 0

	local dt = rl.GetFrameTime()

	windowData.Scrollable = true

	hoverspring:step(dt)

	windowObject = windowData
	yOffset = 0
	if windowData._scrollArea and windowData._scrollArea.get then
		scrollOffset = windowData._scrollArea.get("scrollOffset") or 0
	else
		scrollOffset = 0
	end

	if windowData._scrollArea then
		windowData._scrollArea.set("enabled", not addMenuOpenBool and not isDragging)
	end

	-- Drag and drop lifecycle
	local mousePos = rl.GetMousePosition()

	-- Start drag when mouse moves beyond threshold while held
	if not isDragging and dragInstance and rl.IsMouseButtonDown(0) == 1 then
		local dx = mousePos.x - dragMouseStart.x
		local dy = mousePos.y - dragMouseStart.y
		if math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) > DRAG_THRESHOLD then
			if dragInstance.BaseClass ~= "Singleton" then
				isDragging = true
			end
		end
	end

	-- End drag on mouse release
	if isDragging and rl.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
		if dragInstance and dragTargetInstance then
			local ok = pcall(function()
				dragInstance.Parent = dragTargetInstance
			end)
			if ok then
				expanded[dragTargetInstance] = true
				dropAnimInstance = dragInstance
				dropAnimStart = os.clock()
				dropAnimFromX = mousePos.x - NODE_WIDTH / 2
				dropAnimFromY = mousePos.y - NODE_HEIGHT / 2
				dropAnimToX = nil
				dropAnimToY = nil
			end
		end
		isDragging = false
		dragInstance = nil
		dragMouseStart = nil
		dragTargetInstance = nil
	end

	-- Clear drag state if mouse button released without dragging
	if not isDragging and dragInstance and rl.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
		dragInstance = nil
		dragMouseStart = nil
	end

	-- Update drop animation
	if dropAnimStart > 0 then
		local elapsed = os.clock() - dropAnimStart
		if elapsed > DROP_ANIM_DURATION then
			dropAnimStart = 0
			dropAnimInstance = nil
		end
	end
	local titleBarH = windowData._titleBarH or 28
	local windowRect = {
		x = windowData.x,
		y = windowData.y,
		width = windowData.width,
		height = windowData.height,
	}

	local boxWidth = windowRect.width * 0.95
	local boxX = windowRect.x + (windowRect.width - boxWidth) * 0.5
	local filterBtnSize = 30
	local filterGap = 8
	local searchWidth = boxWidth - filterBtnSize - filterGap

	local contentY = windowData.y + titleBarH
	rl.BeginScissorMode(windowData.x, contentY, windowData.width, windowData.height - titleBarH)

	searchBox:drawWithExtras(boxX, windowRect.y + 35, searchWidth, 30)
	if not searchFilterButton then
		searchFilterButton = gui.imageButton({
			image = filterIcon,
			imageScale = 0.7,
			backgroundColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
			hoverColor = Theme.BackgroundColor,
			rounded = { 0, StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius },
			pressColor = Theme.BackgroundColor,
			onClick = function()
				searchFilterMenuVisible = not searchFilterMenuVisible
				if searchFilterMenuVisible then
					local menuW = 180
					local itemH = 24
					local menuH = (#searchFilterOptions * itemH) + 8
					local menuX = boxX + searchWidth + filterGap
					local menuY = windowRect.y + 35 + filterBtnSize + 6
					local maxX = windowRect.x + windowRect.width - menuW - 4
					local maxY = windowRect.y + windowRect.height - menuH - 4
					menuX = math.max(windowRect.x + 4, math.min(menuX, maxX))
					menuY = math.max(windowRect.y + 4, math.min(menuY, maxY))
					searchFilterMenu.set("obj_rect", arect.new(menuX, menuY, menuW, 0))
					searchFilterMenu:show()
				else
					searchFilterMenu:hide()
				end
			end,
		})
	end
	searchFilterButton.set(
		"obj_rect",
		arect.new(boxX + searchWidth + filterGap, windowRect.y + 35, filterBtnSize, filterBtnSize)
	)
	searchFilterButton.render(dt)

	if not searchFilterMenu then
		local items = {}
		for _, opt in ipairs(searchFilterOptions) do
			table.insert(items, {
				label = opt,
				onClick = function()
					searchFilterMode = opt
					searchFilterMenuVisible = false
					searchFilterMenu:hide()
				end,
			})
		end
		searchFilterMenu = gui.menu({
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			width = 180,
			Font = vend,
			backgroundColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
			textColor = Theme.TextColor,
			hoverColor = Theme.BackgroundColor,
			items = items,
		})
		searchFilterMenu:hide()
	end

	local services = getServicesInOrder()
	-- Switch scissor mode to tree region to prevent overlapping the search bar and going out of bounds
	local treeScissorY = windowData.y + 70
	local treeScissorH = windowData.height - 80
	rl.BeginScissorMode(windowData.x, treeScissorY, windowData.width, treeScissorH)

	for _, child in ipairs(services) do
		DrawTree(child, 0, windowData.x - 50, windowData.y + 60, windowData.width, false)
	end

	rl.EndScissorMode()

	-- Draw dragged item following mouse
	if isDragging and dragInstance then
		local dragW = NODE_WIDTH
		local dragH = NODE_HEIGHT
		local dragX = mousePos.x - dragW / 2
		local dragY = mousePos.y - dragH / 2

		rl.DrawRectangleRounded(
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = dragX, y = dragY, width = dragW, height = dragH }),
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			Color3.new(0, 0.533333, 1):ToRaylib(0.25)
		)

		local icon = loadedIcon[dragInstance.ClassName] or notfound_tex
		local iconSize = dragH - 4
		rl.DrawTexturePro(
			icon.texture,
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = icon.x, height = icon.y }),
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = dragX + 2, y = dragY + 2, width = iconSize, height = iconSize }),
			vector.create(0, 0),
			0,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ImageTransparency)
		)

		rl.DrawTextEx(
			vend,
			dragInstance.Name,
			vector.create(dragX + 28, dragY + 5),
			18,
			1,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextTransparency)
		)
	end

	-- Draw drop animation (lerp from drop position to tree position)
	if dropAnimStart > 0 and dropAnimToX and dropAnimToY and dropAnimInstance then
		local progress = math.min((os.clock() - dropAnimStart) / DROP_ANIM_DURATION, 1)
		local t = progress * progress * (3 - 2 * progress)
		local animW = NODE_WIDTH
		local animH = NODE_HEIGHT
		local animX = dropAnimFromX + (dropAnimToX - dropAnimFromX) * t
		local animY = dropAnimFromY + (dropAnimToY - dropAnimFromY) * t
		local bgAlpha = 0.3 + 0.7 * progress
		local fgAlpha = progress

		rl.DrawRectangleRounded(
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = animX, y = animY, width = animW, height = animH }),
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			Color3.new(0, 0.533333, 1):ToRaylib(bgAlpha)
		)

		local icon = loadedIcon[dropAnimInstance.ClassName] or notfound_tex
		local iconSize = animH - 4
		rl.DrawTexturePro(
			icon.texture,
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = icon.x, height = icon.y }),
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = animX + 2, y = animY + 2, width = iconSize, height = iconSize }),
			vector.create(0, 0),
			0,
			Color3.new(1, 1, 1):ToRaylib(fgAlpha)
		)

		rl.DrawTextEx(
			vend,
			dropAnimInstance.Name,
			vector.create(animX + 28, animY + 5),
			18,
			1,
			Color3.new(1, 1, 1):ToRaylib(fgAlpha)
		)
	end

	windowData._contentHeight = yOffset + 100

	SelectionMenu.render(dt)

	-- Close addition menu when clicking outside
	if addMenuOpenBool and rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 then
		local mousePos = rl.GetMousePosition()
		if addMenuRect and not isMouseInRect(addMenuRect, mousePos) then
			for key in pairs(addMenuOpen) do
				addMenuOpen[key] = false
			end
			addMenuOpenBool = false
			addMenuRect = nil
			activeAddMenu = nil
		end
	end

	-- Close selection/context menu when clicking outside
	if ContextMenuOpen and rl.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
		local obj_rect = SelectionMenu.get("obj_rect")
		if obj_rect and arect.MouseIsOutsideRect(obj_rect) then
			ContextMenuOpen = false
			SelectionMenu:hide()
		end
	end

	local ctrl = rl.IsKeyDown(341) == 1 or rl.IsKeyDown(345) == 1

	if rl.IsKeyReleased(261) == 1 then
		Selection.Clear()
	end

	-- Handle cloning
	if ctrl then
		game.Stop3DInput = true

		if rl.IsKeyReleased(68) == 1 then
			local selected = Selection.Get()
			for _, v in pairs(selected) do
				if v.BaseClass == "Singleton" then
					continue
				end
				local clone = v:Clone()
				clone.Parent = v.Parent
			end
		end
	end

	vend = KinemiumFontService.GetDefaultFont()

	if searchFilterMenuVisible then
		searchFilterMenu.render(dt)
	end
end

frame.Size = Theme.WindowConfig.GameSettings.size
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
frame.Parent = screenGui

game.EngineSignal:Connect(function(prop, data)
	if prop == "EnableGameSettingsMenu" then
		main_window:Open()
		main_window.Closed = false
		main_window.Resizable = false
		main_window.Draggable = false
		enabled = true
	elseif prop == "CreateGameSettingsTab" then
		table.insert(main_window.tabs, data)
	end
end)

renderer.Hook.new("After2D", function(data)
	if game.Context ~= Enum.GameContext.Editor then
		return
	end
	local dt = rl.GetFrameTime()
	local mainTheme = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme
	main_window.x = frame.AbsolutePosition.X
	main_window.y = frame.AbsolutePosition.Y
	main_window.width = frame.AbsoluteSize.X
	main_window.height = frame.AbsoluteSize.Y

	if not enabled then
		return
	end
	window.update(dt)
	window.draw(dt, mainTheme.aereon)
end)

local function drawHandles(absPos, absSize, object)
	-- draw handles
	local hs = handleSize / 2
	local cx, cy = absPos.X + absSize.X / 2, absPos.Y + absSize.Y / 2

	local btmRight = vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X, absPos.Y + absSize.Y)
	local btmRightText = vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X, absPos.Y + absSize.Y + 15)

	local handles = {
		{ pos = vector.create(absPos.X, absPos.Y), sx = -1, sy = -1 }, -- TL
		{ pos = vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X, absPos.Y), sx = 1, sy = -1 }, -- TR
		{ pos = vector.create(absPos.X, absPos.Y + absSize.Y), sx = -1, sy = 1 }, -- BL
		{ pos = vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X, absPos.Y + absSize.Y), sx = 1, sy = 1 }, -- BR

		{ pos = vector.create(cx, absPos.Y), sx = 0, sy = -1 }, -- top
		{ pos = vector.create(cx, absPos.Y + absSize.Y), sx = 0, sy = 1 }, -- bottom
		{ pos = vector.create(absPos.X, cy), sx = -1, sy = 0 }, -- left
		{ pos = vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X, cy), sx = 1, sy = 0 }, -- right
	}

	for _, h in ipairs(handles) do
		local r = Arect.new(h.pos.X - hs, h.pos.Y - hs, handleSize, handleSize)
		local isHovering = Arect.MouseIsInRect(r)

		local currentHandleSize = isHovering and handleHoverSize or handleSize
		local chs = currentHandleSize / 2

		-- Draw circular handle
		lib.DrawCircleV(vector.create(h.pos.X, h.pos.Y), chs, structs.Color:new({ r = 255, g = 255, b = 255, a = 255 }))
		lib.DrawCircleLinesV(vector.create(h.pos.X, h.pos.Y), chs, SelectionBorderColor)

		if isHovering then
			if raylib.lib.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 then
				activeHandle = h
				dragStartMouse = raylib.lib.GetMousePosition()
				dragStartPos = absPos
				dragStartSize = absSize
				object._EditorOverride = true
			end
		end
	end

	if activeHandle and raylib.lib.IsMouseButtonDown(0) == 1 then
		local mouse = raylib.lib.GetMousePosition()
		local dx = mouse.x - dragStartMouse.x
		local dy = mouse.y - dragStartMouse.y

		local newSize = dragStartSize
		local newPos = dragStartPos

		if activeHandle.sx ~= 0 then
			newSize = vector.create(dragStartSize.X + dx * activeHandle.sx, newSize.Y)

			if activeHandle.sx == -1 then
				newPos = vector.create(dragStartPos.X + dx, newPos.Y)
			end
		end

		if activeHandle.sy ~= 0 then
			newSize = vector.create(newSize.X, dragStartSize.Y + dy * activeHandle.sy)

			if activeHandle.sy == -1 then
				newPos = vector.create(newPos.X, dragStartPos.Y + dy)
			end
		end

		object.AbsolutePosition = newPos
		object.AbsoluteSize = newSize

		local parent = object.Parent
		local parentAbsPos = Vector2.new(0, 0)
		if parent and parent.AbsolutePosition then
			parentAbsPos = parent.AbsolutePosition
		end

		local anchor = object.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0)
		local relativeX = newPos.X - parentAbsPos.X + newSize.X * anchor.X
		local relativeY = newPos.Y - parentAbsPos.Y + newSize.Y * anchor.Y

		object.Size = UDim2.new(0, newSize.X, 0, newSize.Y)
		object.Position = UDim2.new(0, relativeX, 0, relativeY)
	end

	if raylib.lib.IsMouseButtonReleased(0) == 1 then
		if activeHandle then
			object._EditorOverride = nil
			activeHandle = nil
		end
	end

	local text = absSize.X .. "x" .. absSize.Y
	local fontSize = 17
	local padding = 6

	local textSize = raylib.lib.MeasureTextEx(vend, text, fontSize, 1)

	local bgX = absPos.X + absSize.X - textSize.X - padding * 2
	local bgY = absPos.Y + absSize.Y - textSize.Y - padding * 2

	local backgroundRect = Arect.new(bgX, bgY, textSize.X + padding * 2, textSize.Y + padding * 2)

	raylib.lib.DrawRectangleRec(Arect:translate(backgroundRect), backgroundColor)
	raylib.lib.DrawTextEx(vend, text, vector.create(bgX + padding, bgY + padding), fontSize, 1, TextColor)
end

local function highlight(selected)
	if not selected then
		return
	end
	local ancestor = selected:FindFirstAncestor("ScreenGui")
	if not ancestor then
		return
	end

	local absPos, absSize = selected.AbsolutePosition, selected.AbsoluteSize
	if not absPos or not absSize then
		return
	end

	local objRect = Arect.new(absPos.X, absPos.Y, absSize.X, absSize.Y)

	lib.DrawRectangleLinesEx(Arect:translate(objRect), 2, SelectionBorderColor)

	local parent = selected.Parent
	if parent and parent.AbsolutePosition and parent.AbsoluteSize then
		local pAbsPos = parent.AbsolutePosition
		local pAbsSize = parent.AbsoluteSize

		local guideColor = structs.Color:new({ r = 0, g = 170, b = 255, a = 100 })

		lib.DrawLineEx(
			vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X / 2, absPos.Y),
			vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X / 2, pAbsPos.Y),
			1,
			guideColor
		)

		lib.DrawLineEx(
			vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X / 2, absPos.Y + absSize.Y),
			vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X / 2, pAbsPos.Y + pAbsSize.Y),
			1,
			guideColor
		)

		lib.DrawLineEx(
			vector.create(absPos.X, absPos.Y + absSize.Y / 2),
			vector.create(pAbsPos.X, absPos.Y + absSize.Y / 2),
			1,
			guideColor
		)

		lib.DrawLineEx(
			vector.create(absPos.X + absSize.X, absPos.Y + absSize.Y / 2),
			vector.create(pAbsPos.X + pAbsSize.X, absPos.Y + absSize.Y / 2),
			1,
			guideColor
		)
	end

	drawHandles(absPos, absSize, selected)
end

renderer.Pool.new("2d", function()
	local dt = raylib.lib.GetFrameTime()
	local mousePos = raylib.lib.GetMousePosition()

	local selected = Selection:Get()
	local first = Selection:Get()[1]

	currentObject = first

	for _, v in pairs(selected) do
		highlight(v)
	end

	if first and game.Stop3DInput ~= true then
		if first.MouseIsInObject == true then
			game.Stop3DInput = true

			if lib.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 then
				dragging = first
				dragging._EditorOverride = true
				dragStartOffset =
					Vector2.new(mousePos.X - dragging.AbsolutePosition.X, mousePos.Y - dragging.AbsolutePosition.Y)
			end

			if lib.IsMouseButtonPressed(1) == 1 then
				menuTarget = first
				utilsMenu:show()
				utilsMenu.set("obj_rect", Arect.new(mousePos.X + 5, mousePos.Y + 5, 200, 400))
			end
		else
			game.Stop3DInput = false
		end
	end

	if dragging then
		if lib.IsMouseButtonDown(0) == 1 then
			local newAbsPos = Vector2.new(mousePos.X - dragStartOffset.X, mousePos.Y - dragStartOffset.Y)
			dragging.AbsolutePosition = newAbsPos

			local parent = dragging.Parent
			local parentAbsPos = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			if parent and parent.AbsolutePosition then
				parentAbsPos = parent.AbsolutePosition
			end

			local anchor = dragging.AnchorPoint or Vector2.new(0, 0)
			local size = dragging.AbsoluteSize or Vector2.new(0, 0)
			local relativeX = newAbsPos.X - parentAbsPos.X + size.X * anchor.X
			local relativeY = newAbsPos.Y - parentAbsPos.Y + size.Y * anchor.Y

			dragging.Position = UDim2.new(0, relativeX, 0, relativeY)
		else
			dragging._EditorOverride = nil
			dragging = nil
		end
	end

	utilsMenu.render(dt)
end, -5)

local snapMoveEnabled = true
local snapRotEnabled = true

local function snap(v)
	if not snapMoveEnabled then
		return v
	end
	return math.round(v / ishared.Grid) * ishared.Grid
end

local function snapVec3(v)
	return Vector3.new(snap(v.X), snap(v.Y), snap(v.Z))
end

local function isModel(obj)
	return obj ~= nil and obj.ClassName == "Model"
end

local function getObjectPivot(obj)
	if obj == nil then
		return nil
	end
	if isModel(obj) then
		return obj:GetPivot()
	elseif obj.CFrame ~= nil then
		return obj.CFrame
	end
	return nil
end

local function setObjectCFrame(obj, cf)
	if obj == nil or cf == nil then
		return
	end
	if isModel(obj) then
		obj:PivotTo(cf)
	elseif obj.CFrame ~= nil then
		obj.CFrame = cf
	end
end

local function getObjectExtents(obj)
	if obj == nil then
		return Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
	end
	if isModel(obj) then
		local s = obj:GetExtentsSize()
		return Vector3.new(math.max(s.X, 0.001), math.max(s.Y, 0.001), math.max(s.Z, 0.001))
	elseif obj.Size ~= nil then
		return obj.Size
	end
	return Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
end

--

local function isMovable(object)
	return object:IsA("BasePart") or isModel(object) or object:GetMetadata("IsMovable")
end

local function getSelectionCenter()
	local selection = Selection:Get()
	if #selection == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local sum = Vector3.zero
	local count = 0

	for _, obj in ipairs(selection) do
		local pivot = getObjectPivot(obj)
		if pivot ~= nil then
			sum += pivot.Position
			count += 1
		end
	end

	if count == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return sum / count
end

--  Movement

local _moveConnection = Movement.MouseDrag:Connect(function(newCF)
	if not ishared.ForceMoveObject then
		return
	end
	local selection = Selection:Get()
	if #selection == 0 then
		return
	end

	if not MoveDragging then
		MoveDragging = true
		MoveOffsets = {}

		local center = getSelectionCenter()
		MoveStartPivot = CFrame.new(center)

		for _, obj in ipairs(selection) do
			if isMovable(obj) then
				local pivot = getObjectPivot(obj)
				if pivot ~= nil then
					table.insert(MoveOffsets, {
						obj = obj,
						pos = MoveStartPivot:ToObjectSpace(pivot),
						size = getObjectExtents(obj),
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local snappedPos = snapVec3(newCF.Position)
	local snappedPivot = CFrame.new(snappedPos) * (newCF - newCF.Position)

	for _, offset in ipairs(MoveOffsets) do
		local obj = offset.obj
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			local finalCF = snappedPivot * offset.pos
			setObjectCFrame(obj, finalCF)
		end
	end
end)

--  Rotation

local _rotationConnection = Rotation.MouseDrag:Connect(function(newCF)
	if not ishared.ForceMoveObject then
		return
	end
	local selection = Selection:Get()
	if #selection == 0 then
		return
	end

	if not RotDragging then
		RotDragging = true
		RotOffsets = {}

		local center = getSelectionCenter()
		RotStartPivot = CFrame.new(center)

		for _, obj in ipairs(selection) do
			if isMovable(obj) then
				local pivot = getObjectPivot(obj)
				if pivot ~= nil then
					table.insert(RotOffsets, {
						obj = obj,
						rel = RotStartPivot:ToObjectSpace(pivot),
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Rotation is already snapped by the Handles gizmo
	local snappedCF = newCF

	for _, offset in ipairs(RotOffsets) do
		local obj = offset.obj
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			setObjectCFrame(obj, snappedCF * offset.rel)
		end
	end
end)

--  Scale / Resize

local _resizeConnection = Resize.MouseDrag:Connect(function(newCF, newSize)
	if not ishared.ForceMoveObject then
		return
	end
	local selection = Selection:Get()
	if #selection == 0 then
		return
	end

	if not ScaleDragging then
		ScaleDragging = true
		ScaleOffsets = {}

		local center = getSelectionCenter()
		ScaleStartPivot = CFrame.new(center)

		for _, obj in ipairs(selection) do
			if isMovable(obj) then
				local pivot = getObjectPivot(obj)
				if pivot ~= nil then
					local entry = {
						obj = obj,
						rel = ScaleStartPivot:ToObjectSpace(pivot),
						startSize = getObjectExtents(obj),
						lastScale = 1,
					}

					table.insert(ScaleOffsets, entry)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local snappedSize = snapVec3(newSize)

	for _, offset in ipairs(ScaleOffsets) do
		local obj = offset.obj
		if obj and obj.Parent then
			if isModel(obj) then
				local startSize = offset.startSize
				local avgStart = (startSize.X + startSize.Y + startSize.Z) / 3
				local avgNew = (snappedSize.X + snappedSize.Y + snappedSize.Z) / 3
				local targetScale = math.max(avgNew / avgStart, 0.001)
				local delta = targetScale / offset.lastScale
				obj:ScaleTo(delta)
				offset.lastScale = targetScale
				obj:PivotTo(newCF * offset.rel)
			else
				-- BasePart: apply size and position directly
				obj.Size = snappedSize
				obj.CFrame = newCF * offset.rel
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function updateAdornees()
	local selected = Selection:Get()[1]
	Movement.Adornee = nil
	Resize.Adornee = nil
	Rotation.Adornee = nil

	if selected and isMovable(selected) then
		if handlestype == "MOVEMENT" then
			Movement.Adornee = selected
		elseif handlestype == "SCALE" then
			Resize.Adornee = selected
		elseif handlestype == "ROTATE" then
			Rotation.Adornee = selected
		end
	end
end

--  Focus

local function Focus()
	local selected = Selection:Get()[1]
	if not selected then
		return
	end
	local padding = 20

	-- Works for both BaseParts (via CFrame.Position) and Models (via GetPivot)
	local pivot = getObjectPivot(selected)
	if not pivot then
		return
	end
	local partPos = pivot.Position

	local camCF = freecam.GetCFrame()
	local dir = camCF.Position - partPos
	if dir:Magnitude() < 1e-4 then
		dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	else
		dir = dir:Unit()
	end

	local newCamPos = partPos + dir * padding
	_focusTargetCF = CFrame.lookAt(newCamPos, partPos)
	_focusAlpha = 0
end

--  Render loop

renderer.Pool.new("gizmo", function()
	if ishared.MouseDragging then
		Movement.Adornee = nil
		Resize.Adornee = nil
		Rotation.Adornee = nil
	end

	Movement.render(Movement, renderer, game)
	Resize.render(Resize, renderer, game)
	Rotation.render(Rotation, renderer, game)

	local selection = Selection:Get()
	local selected = selection[1]

	-- Reset dragging states when mouse is released
	if lib.IsMouseButtonDown(const.MouseButton.MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT) == 0 then
		MoveDragging = false
		RotDragging = false
		ScaleDragging = false
	end

	if selected then
		if not isMovable(selected) then
			return
		end

		if handlestype == "MOVEMENT" then
			if not Movement.Transform then
				return
			end
			local newCF = CFrame.new(snapVec3(Movement.Transform.Position))
			if selected:IsA("BasePart") then
				selected.CFrame = newCF
			elseif selected:IsA("Model") then
				selected:PivotTo(newCF)
			end
		end

		if handlestype == "ROTATE" then
			if not Rotation.Transform then
				return
			end

			local pos = Rotation.Transform.Position

			local x, y, z = Rotation.Transform:ToOrientation()

			local snap = math.rad(15) -- 15 degree snapping

			x = math.round(x / snap) * snap
			y = math.round(y / snap) * snap
			z = math.round(z / snap) * snap

			local newCF = CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.fromOrientation(x, y, z)

			if selected:IsA("BasePart") then
				selected.CFrame = newCF
			elseif selected:IsA("Model") then
				selected:PivotTo(newCF)
			end
		end

		if lib.IsKeyDown(const.KeyboardKey.KEY_F) == 1 then
			Focus()
		end

		if lib.IsKeyPressed(const.KeyboardKey.KEY_Z) == 1 then
			local center = getSelectionCenter()
			if center then
				local camCF = freecam.GetCFrame()
				local dir = (center - camCF.Position):Unit()
				local zoomAmount = 10

				if lib.IsKeyDown(const.KeyboardKey.KEY_LEFT_CONTROL) == 1 then
					zoomAmount = -zoomAmount
				end

				local newPos = camCF.Position + dir * zoomAmount
				_focusTargetCF = CFrame.lookAt(newPos, center)
				_focusAlpha = 0
			end
		end

		if lib.IsKeyPressed(const.KeyboardKey.KEY_HOME) == 1 then
			freecam.SetCFrame(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 20, 40), Vector3.zero))
		end
	else
		MoveDragging = false
		RotDragging = false
		ScaleDragging = false
		MoveOffsets = {}
		RotOffsets = {}
		ScaleOffsets = {}
	end

	if _focusTargetCF then
		_focusAlpha = math.min(_focusAlpha + 0.08, 1)
		freecam.SetCFrame(_focusTargetCF)

		if _focusAlpha >= 1 then
			_focusTargetCF = nil
		end
	end
end)

game.EngineSignal:Connect(function(Route)
	if Route == "CameraFocus" then
		Focus()
	end
end)

local picker = gui.colorPicker({
	x = 100,
	y = 100,
	width = 260,
	height = 500,

	onChanged = function(color, alpha)
		local selected = Selection.Get()[1]
		if selected then
			if selected:IsA("BasePart") then
				selected.Color = color
				selected.Transparency = alpha
			elseif selected:IsA("GuiObject") then
				selected.BackgroundColor3 = color
				selected.BackgroundTransparency = alpha
			elseif selected:IsA("Model") then
				for _, object in pairs(selected:GetDescendants()) do
					if object:IsA("BasePart") then
						object.Color = color
						object.Transparency = alpha
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end,
})

	if game.Context ~= Enum.GameContext.Editor then

	end
end)

local importButton = gui:CreateButton({
	Text = "Import",
	x = PAD,
	y = nextY(32, 6),
	width = W,
	height = 32,
	Activated = function()
		if importSettings.path == "" then
			statusLabel:SetText("No file path set.")
			return
		end

		progressBar:Set("visible", true)
		progressBar:SetProgress(0)
		statusLabel:SetText("Importing...")

		task.spawn(function()
			for i = 1, 20 do
				task.wait(0.04)
				progressBar:SetProgress(i / 20)
			end

			local R3D_IMPORT_MESH_DATA = 1
			local R3D_Model = r3d.lib.R3D_LoadModelEx(importSettings.path, R3D_IMPORT_MESH_DATA)
			local meshCount = buffer.readi32(R3D_Model, r3d.structs.R3D_Model:offset("meshCount"))

			if meshCount == 0 then
				print("No meshes found in model")
				return
			end

			local file_name = string.match(importSettings.path, "([^/\\]+)%.%w+$")

			local parentFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			parentFolder.Name = file_name

			local selected = Selection.Get()[1]
			parentFolder.Parent = selected or game.Workspace

			for i = 0, meshCount - 1 do
				local mesh = meshgen.extractModelMesh(R3D_Model, i)
				if not mesh then
					continue
				end

				local aabb = mesh.aabb
				local size = Vector3.new(
					(aabb.max.x - aabb.min.x) * importSettings.scale,
					(aabb.max.y - aabb.min.y) * importSettings.scale,
					(aabb.max.z - aabb.min.z) * importSettings.scale
				)
				local center = Vector3.new(
					(aabb.min.x + aabb.max.x) / 2 * importSettings.scale,
					(aabb.min.y + aabb.max.y) / 2 * importSettings.scale,
					(aabb.min.z + aabb.max.z) / 2 * importSettings.scale
				)

				local new = Instance.new("MeshPart")
				new.Name = if meshCount > 1 then file_name .. "_" .. i else file_name
				new.MeshObject = mesh
				new.Size = size
				new.CFrame = CFrame.new(center)
				new.Anchored = true
				new.Transparency = 0
				new.Parent = parentFolder
			end

			statusLabel:SetText("Done.")
			progressBar:Set("visible", false)
		end)
	end,
})

gui:CreateButton({
	Text = "Reset",
	x = PAD,
	y = nextY(28, 0),
	width = W,
	height = 28,
	Activated = function()

		progressBar:Set("visible", false)
		statusLabel:SetText("")

	end,
})

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Selection = game:GetService("Selection")

if RunService:IsClient() then
	return

_G.IsHoveringOnWindow = _G.IsHoveringOnWindow or false

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
while not player do
	task.wait()
	player = Players.LocalPlayer
end

local mouse = player:GetMouse()

local Highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
Highlight.FillTransparency = 0.9
Highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
Highlight.FillColor = Color3.new(0, 0.682, 1)
Highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.new(0, 0.306, 1)
Highlight.Parent = game.InternalStorage

local dragging = false
local draggedObject = nil
local rotationCF = CFrame.new()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if dragging and draggedObject and mouse.Hit then
		local ROTATION_STEP = math.rad(90)

		if UserInputService:IsKeyReleased(Enum.KeyCode.R) then
			rotationCF = rotationCF * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(0, ROTATION_STEP, 0)
		elseif UserInputService:IsKeyReleased(Enum.KeyCode.T) then
			rotationCF = rotationCF * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(ROTATION_STEP, 0, 0)
		elseif UserInputService:IsKeyReleased(Enum.KeyCode.Y) then
			rotationCF = rotationCF * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(0, 0, ROTATION_STEP)
		end

		local normal = mouse.TargetSurface or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

		local right = rotationCF:GetRightVector()
		local up = rotationCF:GetUpVector()
		local look = rotationCF:GetLookVector()
		if not draggedObject.Size then
			return
		end
		local size = draggedObject.Size * 0.5

		local extent = math.abs(normal:Dot(right)) * size.X
			+ math.abs(normal:Dot(up)) * size.Y
			+ math.abs(normal:Dot(look)) * size.Z

		local targetPos = mouse.Hit.Position + normal * extent

		local grid = ishared.Grid or 0
		if grid > 0 then
			targetPos = Vector3.new(
				math.round(targetPos.X / grid) * grid,
				math.round(targetPos.Y / grid) * grid,
				math.round(targetPos.Z / grid) * grid
			)
		end

		draggedObject.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos) * rotationCF

		if UserInputService:IsMouseButtonReleased(Enum.MouseButton.Left) then
			dragging = false
			Selection.Remove({ draggedObject })
			draggedObject = nil
			mouse.TargetFilter = {}
			ishared.ForceMoveObject = true
			ishared.MouseDragging = false
			if ishared.Update3DHandles then
				ishared.Update3DHandles()
			end
		end

		return
	end

	if UserInputService:IsMouseButtonDown(Enum.MouseButton.Left) then
		if ishared.isToolsActive then
			return
		end
		if _G.IsHoveringOnWindow == true then
			return
		end
		if mouse.Target and mouse.Target:IsA("BasePart") then
			if mouse.Target.Size.X > 200 or mouse.Target.Size.Y > 200 or mouse.Target.Size.Z > 200 then
				return
			end
			if mouse.Target.Transparency > 0.3 then
				return
			end
			if Selection.Get()[1] and Selection.Get()[1]:IsA("Model") then
				if mouse.Target:IsDescendantOf(Selection.Get()[1]) then
					return
				end
			end

			dragging = true
			draggedObject = mouse.Target
			mouse.TargetFilter = { draggedObject }
			rotationCF = draggedObject.CFrame - draggedObject.CFrame.Position
			Selection.Add(draggedObject)
			ishared.MouseDragging = true
			ishared.ForceMoveObject = false
		end
	end

	if mouse.Target then
		if ishared.isToolsActive then
			return
		end
		if _G.IsHoveringOnWindow == true then
			return
		end
		if mouse.Target.BaseClass ~= "BasePart" then
			return
		end
		if Selection.Get()[1] and Selection.Get()[1]:IsA("Model") then
			if mouse.Target:IsDescendantOf(Selection.Get()[1]) then
				return
			end
		end
		if mouse.Target.Size.X > 200 or mouse.Target.Size.Y > 200 or mouse.Target.Size.Z > 200 then
			return
		end
		if mouse.Target.Transparency > 0.3 then
			return
		end
		Highlight.Adornee = mouse.Target
		mouse.Icon = Enum.KinemiumMouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_POINTING_HAND
	else
		Highlight.Adornee = nil
		mouse.Icon = Enum.KinemiumMouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_DEFAULT
	end
end)

local function parseAnsi(text)
	local segments = {}
	local currentColor = raylib.const.WHITE
	local pos = 1
	while pos <= #text do
		local s, e = string.find(text, "\x1b%[.-m", pos)
		if not s then
			table.insert(segments, { text = string.sub(text, pos), color = currentColor })
			break
		end
		if s > pos then
			table.insert(segments, { text = string.sub(text, pos, s - 1), color = currentColor })
		end
		local code = string.sub(text, s + 2, e - 1)
		pos = e + 1
		if code == "0" then
			currentColor = raylib.const.WHITE
		elseif code ~= "1" then
			local fn = ansiColors[code]
			if fn then
				currentColor = fn()
			end
		end
	end
	return segments
end

	onSubmit = function()
		if localServerProcess then
			local code = commandTextbox:getText()
			if #code > 0 then

					localServerProcess.stdin:write(code .. "\n")
				end)
				commandTextbox:setText("")
			end
		end
	end,
})

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		if localServerProcess then
			local err = localServerProcess.stderr:read(1024)
			if err and #err > 0 then
				logBuffer = logBuffer .. err
			end

			if err and #err > 0 then
				while true do
					local lineEnd = string.find(logBuffer, "\n")
					if not lineEnd then
						break
					end
					local line = string.sub(logBuffer, 1, lineEnd - 1)
					logBuffer = string.sub(logBuffer, lineEnd + 1)
					if #line > 0 then
						table.insert(localServerLogs, line)
						if #localServerLogs > 15 then
							table.remove(localServerLogs, 1)
						end
					end
				end
			end

			local port = tonumber(hostPortTextbox:getText()) or 1234
			local info, p_err = NetworkService:Ping("127.0.0.1", port)
			if info then
				localServerInfo = info
			else
				localServerInfo = nil
			end
		else
			localServerInfo = nil
			localServerLogs = {}
		end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
end)

local function stopServer()
	pcall(function()
		localServerProcess:kill()
	end)
	localServerProcess = nil
	group.manageServerPrompt.set("buttons", {
		{
			text = "Start Server",
			color = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.Accent,
			onClick = function()
				group.manageServerPrompt.get("buttons")[1].onClick()
			end,
		},
	})
end

local function startServer()
	local port = tonumber(hostPortTextbox:getText()) or 1234
	local maxPlayers = tonumber(maxPlayersTextbox:getText()) or 16
	localServerProcess = ProcessService.CreateKinemiumServerProcessPiped("0.0.0.0", port, maxPlayers)

	local sName = nameTextbox:getText()
	if sName == "" then
		sName = "My Server"
	end
	local sMotd = motdTextbox:getText()
	if sMotd == "" then
		sMotd = "A Kinemium server is online."
	end
	local sDesc = descriptionTextbox:getText()
	local sMap = mapTextbox:getText()
	if sMap == "" then
		sMap = "MapName"
	end
	local sMode = modeTextbox:getText()
	if sMode == "" then
		sMode = "Survival"
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(1.5)
		if localServerProcess then
			local code = string.format(
				"pcall(function() game:GetService('NetworkService'):SetPreviewData({name='%s', motd='%s', description='%s', map='%s', mode='%s'}) end)\n",
				sName,
				sMotd,
				sDesc,
				sMap,
				sMode
			)
			pcall(function()
				localServerProcess.stdin:write(code)
			end)
		end
	end)

	group.manageServerPrompt.set("buttons", {
		{
			text = "Stop Server",
			color = Color3.new(0.8, 0.2, 0.2),
			onClick = function()
				stopServer()
			end,
		},
	})
end

		return col:ToRaylib(1 - (a or 1) * alpha)

			vector.create(startX, headerDesc),
			16,
			1,
			fade(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryTextColor, 1)
		)
	end

	-- Render scroll area

	serverStack.set("width", screenx - 180)
	scrollArea.render(dt)
	vend = KinemiumFontService.GetDefaultFontSmall()

	group.manageServerPrompt.render(dt)
	group.newProjectPrompt.render(dt)
end

local StudioThemeService = game:GetService("StudioThemeService")

local marketplaceSearchBox
local marketplaceFilterDropdown
local marketplaceSearchText = ""
local marketplaceFilter = "All"
local marketplaceEntries = {}
local marketplaceFilterOptions = { "All" }
local detailText = "Loading plugins..."

local function rebuildMarketplaceFilterOptions()
	local options = { "All" }
	local seen = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(marketplaceEntries) do
		local manifest = entry.plugin.manifest or {}
		local keywords = manifest.keywords or {}
		local category = keywords[1] or "Plugin"
		if not seen[category] then
			seen[category] = true
			table.insert(options, category)
		end
	end
	marketplaceFilterOptions = options
	if marketplaceFilterDropdown then
		marketplaceFilterDropdown.set("options", options)
		local idx = 1
		for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
			if opt == marketplaceFilter then
				idx = i
				break
			end
		end
		marketplaceFilterDropdown.set("selectedIndex", idx)
	end
end

local function applyMarketplaceFilter()
	local query = string.lower(marketplaceSearchText or "")
	for _, entry in ipairs(marketplaceEntries) do
		local manifest = entry.plugin.manifest or {}
		local name = string.lower(manifest.name or "")
		local desc = string.lower(manifest.description or "")
		local keywords = manifest.keywords or {}
		local category = keywords[1] or "Plugin"
		local matchesFilter = marketplaceFilter == "All" or category == marketplaceFilter
		local matchesSearch = query == "" or string.find(name, query, 1, true) or string.find(desc, query, 1, true)
		entry.card.set("visible", matchesFilter and matchesSearch)
	end
end

local function createCard(plugin, textureData, thumbnailData)

		icon = textureData,
		bannerImage = thumbnailData,

		font = vend,

		backgroundColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,

		textColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor,

		end,

	return card
end

		headerBg = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
		iconBg = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
		text = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor,
		muted = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryTextColor,
		bg = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.BackgroundColor,
		lightText = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.LightText,
		sidebarBg = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
		buttonBg = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.Accent,
		buttonBgHover = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.Accent,
		white = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,

		icon = textureData,
		bannerImage = thumbnailData,

		onDownload = function()
			modcard.set("downloadText", "Installing..")

			local success, result = game.PluginLoader.DownloadPlugin(plugin.manifest, true)
			if success then
				modcard.set("downloadText", "Installed")
			end
		end,
	})
	return modcard
end

local pages = {}

local function getImageExt(path)
	if type(path) ~= "string" then
		return ".png"
	end
	local ext = path:match("(%.[%a%d]+)$")
	return ext or ".png"
end

local function fetchRemoteTexture(url, ext)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, body = pcall(HttpService.GetAsync, HttpService, url, {
		["User-Agent"] = "Kinemium-Engine",
	})
	if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" or #body == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	return KinemiumIconLoader.ToTextureBuffer(buffer.fromstring(body), ext or getImageExt(url))
end

local function loadPlugins()
	if not plugins and not isLoadingPlugins then
		isLoadingPlugins = true
		task.spawn(function()
			plugins, result = game.PluginLoader.GetPluginsMarketplace()

			if not plugins then
				isLoadingPlugins = false
				detailText = result
				return
			end

			for _, plugin in pairs(plugins) do
				local textureData
				if plugin.icon then
					textureData = KinemiumIconLoader.ToTextureBuffer(plugin.icon, plugin.manifest.icon or ".png")
				end
				if not textureData then
					textureData = kilLogo
				end

				local thumbnailData
				if plugin.thumbnail then
					thumbnailData =
						KinemiumIconLoader.ToTextureBuffer(plugin.thumbnail, plugin.manifest.thumbnail or ".png")
				end

				local card = createCard(plugin, textureData, thumbnailData)
				local page = createPage(plugin, textureData, thumbnailData)
				card.set("font", vend)
				marketplaceFlex.add(card)
				pages[plugin.manifest.id] = page
				table.insert(marketplaceEntries, { plugin = plugin, card = card })
				rebuildMarketplaceFilterOptions()
				applyMarketplaceFilter()

				if not plugin.icon and plugin.iconUrl then
					task.spawn(function()
						local iconTexture =
							fetchRemoteTexture(plugin.iconUrl, plugin.manifest.icon or getImageExt(plugin.iconUrl))
						if iconTexture then
							card.set("icon", iconTexture)
							page.set("icon", iconTexture)
						end
					end)
				end

				if not plugin.thumbnail and plugin.thumbnailUrl then
					task.spawn(function()
						local thumbTexture = fetchRemoteTexture(
							plugin.thumbnailUrl,
							plugin.manifest.thumbnail or getImageExt(plugin.thumbnailUrl)
						)
						if thumbTexture then
							card.set("bannerImage", thumbTexture)
							page.set("bannerImage", thumbTexture)
						end
					end)
				end

				task.wait()
			end
			rebuildMarketplaceFilterOptions()
			applyMarketplaceFilter()
			isLoadingPlugins = false
		end)
	end
end

game.EngineSignal:Connect(function(prop)
	if prop == "LoadPlugins" then
		loadPlugins()
	end
end)

local generated_card_projects = {}

local function applyProjectFilter()
	local query = string.lower(projectSearchText or "")
	local now = os.time()
	for _, entry in ipairs(projectEntries) do
		local projectData = entry.project
		local name = string.lower(projectData.name or "")
		local path = string.lower(projectData.path or "")
		local matchesSearch = query == "" or string.find(name, query, 1, true) or string.find(path, query, 1, true)
		local isRecent = projectData.last_opened and (now - projectData.last_opened) <= (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)
		local matchesFilter = true
		if projectFilter == "Recent" then
			matchesFilter = isRecent
		elseif projectFilter == "Older" then
			matchesFilter = not isRecent
		end
		entry.card.set("visible", matchesSearch and matchesFilter)
	end
end

local function generateProjectCards()
	projects = ProjectLoaderService.GetProjects() or {}

	for _, projectData in pairs(projects) do
		-- if projectData.path already has a card, skip it
		if generated_card_projects[projectData.path] then
			continue
		end
		generated_card_projects[projectData.path] = true

		local icon

		if projectData.icon then
			icon = KinemiumIconLoader.ToTexture(projectData.icon)
		else
			icon = logoIcon
		end
		local stat = fs.stat(projectData.path)
		if stat.kind == "none" then
			continue
		end
		local card = gui.projectCard({
			comp = "projectCard",
			x = 0,
			y = 0,
			width = screenx - 135,
			title = projectData.name,
			subtext = "Edited on " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", projectData.last_opened),
			tags = {},
			backgroundColor = SecondaryBackgroundColor,
			icon = icon,
			font = vend,
			zindex = 3,
			rounded = { 0, StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius },

			onClick = function()
				if project_prompt_active then
					return
				end
				ishared.GameName = projectData.name
				ishared.FolderPath = projectData.path
				ishared.GameIcon = projectData.icon
				ishared.EnableHomescreen = false
				ProjectLoaderService.LoadProject(ishared.FolderPath, projectData)
				renderer:SetDimension("3D")
				_G.IsHoveringOnWindow = true
			end,
		})

		cardStack.add(card)
		table.insert(projectEntries, { project = projectData, card = card })
	end
end
