ishared.Home.pages["Projects"] = function(dt, alpha, slideOffset)
	local fade = function(col, a)
		return col:ToRaylib(1 - (a or 1) * alpha)
	end

	if ishared.Home.activePage ~= "Projects" and ishared.Home.previousPage ~= "Projects" then
		return
	end

	screenx, screeny = lib.GetRenderWidth(), lib.GetScreenHeight()

	local startX = 100
	local headerY = 80 + slideOffset
	local controlsY = headerY + 90
	local searchHeight = 32
	local dropdownWidth = 180
	local gap = 12

	SecondaryBackgroundColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryBackgroundColor

	group.addButton.set("obj_rect", arect.new(screenx - 50, 110 + slideOffset, 30, 30))
	group.newProjectPrompt.set("obj_rect", arect.new(0, 0, 600, 250))
	group.render(dt, { "newProjectPrompt" })

	if vend then
		raylib.lib.DrawTextEx(
			boldFont,
			"Projects",
			vector.create(startX, headerY),
			42,
			1,
			fade(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor, 1)
		)
		raylib.lib.DrawTextEx(
			vend,
			"Manage and open your Kinemium Engine projects",
			vector.create(startX, headerY + 50),
			18,
			1,
			fade(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryTextColor, 1)
		)
	end

	-- Search + Filter
	if not projectSearchBox then
		projectSearchBox = textbox.new({
			padding = 8,
			backgroundColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
			textColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor,
			placeholderColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryTextColor,
			cornerRadius = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
			BackgroundTransparency = 0,
			BorderTransparency = 1,
			placeholder = "Search projects...",
			fontSize = 14,

			escapeBlurs = false,
			blurOnSubmit = false,
			onChange = function(text)
				projectSearchText = text or ""
				applyProjectFilter()
			end,
		})
	end

	local searchWidth = screenx - 170 - dropdownWidth - gap
	projectSearchBox:drawWithExtras(startX, controlsY + slideOffset, searchWidth, searchHeight)
	local currentSearch = projectSearchBox:getText() or ""
	if currentSearch ~= projectSearchText then
		projectSearchText = currentSearch
		applyProjectFilter()
	end

	if not projectFilterDropdown then
		projectFilterDropdown = gui.dropdown({
			x = startX + searchWidth + gap,
			y = controlsY + slideOffset,
			width = dropdownWidth,
			height = searchHeight,
			options = { "All", "Recent", "Older" },
			font = vend,
			rounded = { 0, StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius },

			selectedIndex = 1,
			backgroundColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
			hoverColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.ThirdBackgroundColor,
			textColor = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.TextColor,
			borderTransparency = 1,
			onSelect = function(index, value)
				projectFilter = value or "All"
				applyProjectFilter()
			end,
			onExpand = function()
				if group.newProjectPrompt.get("visible") then
					return
				end
				project_prompt_active = projectFilterDropdown.get("expanded")
			end,
			onCollapse = function()
				if group.newProjectPrompt.get("visible") then
					return
				end
				project_prompt_active = projectFilterDropdown.get("expanded")
			end,
		})
	end
	projectFilterDropdown.set(
		"obj_rect",
		arect.new(startX + searchWidth + gap, controlsY + slideOffset, dropdownWidth, searchHeight)
	)

	-- Render scroll area
	local scrollY = controlsY + searchHeight + 16 + slideOffset
	scrollArea.set("obj_rect", arect.new(100, scrollY, screenx - 170, screeny - (scrollY + 50)))
	cardStack.set("width", screenx - 180) -- Adjust stack width for scrollbar
	scrollArea.render(dt)
	vend = KinemiumFontService.GetDefaultFontSmall()

	projectFilterDropdown.render(dt)

	group.newProjectPrompt.render(dt)
end

-- helpers

local function round(n)
	return math.floor(n * 1000 + 0.5) / 1000
end

local function makeTextbox(opts)
	local base = {
		padding = 4,
		backgroundColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
		textColor = Theme.TextColor,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.1,
		BorderTransparency = 1,
		cornerRadius = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.CornerRadius,
	}
	if opts then
		for k, v in pairs(opts) do
			base[k] = v
		end
	end
	return textbox.new(base)
end

local function numTb(col, onSubmit)
	return makeTextbox({ numeric = true, TextColor = col:ToRaylib(0), onSubmit = onSubmit })
end

local IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = { ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".bmp", ".tga" }
local AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = { ".mp3", ".wav", ".ogg", ".flac", ".xm", ".mod" }

local function isAudioPath(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" or #s < 5 then
		return false
	end
	local ls = s:lower()
	for _, ext in ipairs(AUDIO_EXTENSIONS) do
		if ls:sub(-#ext) == ext then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function isImagePath(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" or #s < 5 then
		return false
	end
	local ls = s:lower()
	-- print("isImagePath checking:", ls)
	for _, ext in ipairs(IMAGE_EXTENSIONS) do
		if ls:sub(-#ext) == ext then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local textureCache = {}
local function getTexture(path)
	if textureCache[path] then
		return textureCache[path]
	end
	path = zembed.AssetPath(path)
	local ok, tex = pcall(function()
		return rl.LoadTexture(path)
	end)
	if ok and tex then
		textureCache[path] = tex
		return tex
	end
	return nil
end

local pathIcon = nil
local function getPathIcon()
	if not pathIcon then
		local tex = rl.LoadTexture(zembed.AssetPath("kineasset://images/icons/Folder.png"))
		if tex then
			pathIcon = {
				texture = tex,
				x = buffer.readi32(tex, 4),
				y = buffer.readi32(tex, 8),
			}
		end
	end
	return pathIcon
end

local function getCPIcon()
	if not colorPickerIcon then
		local cpTex = rl.LoadTexture(zembed.AssetPath("kineasset://images/icons/ColorPicker.png"))
		colorPickerIcon = {
			texture = cpTex,
			x = buffer.readi32(cpTex, 4),
			y = buffer.readi32(cpTex, 8),
		}
	end
	return colorPickerIcon
end

local function openColorPicker(selected, propName, initialColor, kpIndex)
	colorPickerTarget = { selected = selected, propName = propName, kpIndex = kpIndex }
	if not colorPickerComp then
		colorPickerComp = gui.colorPicker({
			backgroundColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
			backgroundTransparency = Theme.BackgroundTransparency,

			onChanged = function(newColor)
				if not colorPickerTarget then
					return
				end
				local s = colorPickerTarget.selected
				local p = colorPickerTarget.propName
				local idx = colorPickerTarget.kpIndex

				local localColor = Color3.new(newColor.R, newColor.G, newColor.B)

				if idx then
					local cs = s[p]
					local kps = cs.Keypoints
					kps[idx] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(kps[idx].Position, localColor)
					s[p] = ColorSequence.new(kps)
				else
					s[p] = localColor
				end
			end,
		})
	end
	colorPickerComp.setColor(initialColor)
end

-- datatypes
--
-- each datatype table can contain:
--   build(selected, propName, propValue) ΓåÆ comp
--   render(comp, ex, ey, ew, eh)
--   cellHeight(comp)  [optional] ΓåÆ number   (total height this entry occupies)
--   onRowClick(comp, propName)  [optional]  (called when the parent row is clicked)

local datatypes = {}

-- string
datatypes["string"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local comps = {}
		comps.tb = makeTextbox({
			onSubmit = function(new)
				selected[propName] = type(propValue) == "number" and (tonumber(new) or 0) or new
			end,
		})
		comps.tb:setText(tostring(propValue))

		local isSoundProp = propName == "SoundId" and selected.ClassName == "Sound"

		comps.explorer = gui.imageButton({
			image = getPathIcon(),
			imageScale = 0.6,
			backgroundColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
			onClick = function()
				local FileDialogService = game:GetService("FileDialogService")
				local exts = isSoundProp
						and {
							{ name = "Audio", extensions = { "mp3", "wav", "ogg", "flac" } },
							{ name = "All Files", extensions = { "*" } },
						}
					or {
						{ name = "Images", extensions = { "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "bmp", "gif" } },
						{ name = "All Files", extensions = { "*" } },
					}
				local path = FileDialogService.RequestFile(exts)
				if path then
					selected[propName] = path
					comps.tb:setText(path)
				end
			end,
		})

		if isSoundProp then
			comps.selected = selected
			comps.volumeDisplay = selected.Volume
		end

		return comps
	end,
	cellHeight = function(comp, propName, propValue)
		if isAudioPath(propValue) and comp and comp.selected then
			return CELL_HEIGHT + 80
		end
		if isImagePath(propValue) then
			return CELL_HEIGHT + 180
		end
		return CELL_HEIGHT
	end,
	render = function(comps, ex, ey, ew, eh, propName, propValue)
		local btnW = 24
		local sp = 3

		local mainH = CELL_HEIGHT
		local mainY = ey

		if isAudioPath(propValue) and comps.selected then
			local previewH = 75
			local previewY = ey + 5
			mainY = ey + previewH + 5

			rl.DrawRectangle(ex, previewY, ew, previewH, Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(0))

			local sel = comps.selected
			local mousePos = rl.GetMousePosition()

			-- Play/Pause button
			local btnSize = 26
			local btnX = ex + 8
			local btnY = previewY + 6
			local isPlaying = sel.Playing
			local playBtnRect = { x = btnX, y = btnY, width = btnSize, height = btnSize }
			rl.DrawRectangleRounded(structs.Rectangle:new(playBtnRect), 0.3, 8, Theme.BackgroundColor:ToRaylib(0))

			local btnLabel = isPlaying and "||" or ">"
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				btnLabel,
				vector.create(btnX + (btnSize - 8) / 2, btnY + (btnSize - 14) / 2),
				14,
				1,
				Theme.TextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)

			if
				rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1
				and mousePos.x >= playBtnRect.x
				and mousePos.x <= playBtnRect.x + playBtnRect.width
				and mousePos.y >= playBtnRect.y
				and mousePos.y <= playBtnRect.y + playBtnRect.height
			then
				if isPlaying then
					sel:Pause()
				elseif sel.IsLoaded then
					sel:Play()
				end
			end

			-- Volume label + slider
			local lblX = btnX + btnSize + 8
			local lblY = btnY + 2
			rl.DrawTextEx(vend, "Volume", vector.create(lblX, lblY), 11, 1, Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0))

			local sliderY = lblY + 14
			local sliderH = 14
			local sliderW = math.max(40, ew - (lblX - ex) - 8)
			local sliderX = lblX
			local trackH = 4
			local trackY = sliderY + (sliderH - trackH) / 2

			-- Slider interaction (sets target value directly)
			local isDragging = rl.IsMouseButtonDown(0) == 1
				and mousePos.x >= sliderX
				and mousePos.x <= sliderX + sliderW
				and mousePos.y >= sliderY
				and mousePos.y <= sliderY + sliderH

			if isDragging then
				comps.volumeDisplay = math.clamp((mousePos.x - sliderX) / sliderW, 0, 1)
				sel.Volume = comps.volumeDisplay
			end

			-- Lerp display value toward target when not dragging
			local dt = rl.GetFrameTime()
			comps.volumeDisplay = comps.volumeDisplay + (sel.Volume - comps.volumeDisplay) * math.min(dt * 8, 1)

			-- Track background
			rl.DrawRectangleRounded(
				structs.Rectangle:new({ x = sliderX, y = trackY, width = sliderW, height = trackH }),
				0.5,
				4,
				Color3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15):ToRaylib(0)
			)

			-- Fill
			local fillW = sliderW * comps.volumeDisplay
			if fillW > 0 then
				rl.DrawRectangleRounded(
					structs.Rectangle:new({ x = sliderX, y = trackY, width = fillW, height = trackH }),
					0.5,
					4,
					Color3.new(0.02, 0.5, 1):ToRaylib(0)
				)
			end

			-- Handle
			local handleX = sliderX + fillW
			local handleY = sliderY + sliderH / 2
			local handleR = 6
			rl.DrawCircleV(vector.create(handleX, handleY), handleR, Color3.new(1, 1, 1):ToRaylib(0))

			-- File name
			local fileName = propValue:match("[^/\\]+$") or propValue
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				fileName,
				vector.create(ex + 8, previewY + previewH - 38),
				12,
				1,
				Theme.TextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)

			-- Status
			local status = sel.IsLoaded and (sel.Playing and "Playing" or "Stopped") or "Not Loaded"
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				status,
				vector.create(ex + 8, previewY + previewH - 22),
				11,
				1,
				Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)
		elseif isImagePath(propValue) then
			local previewH = 170
			local previewY = ey + 5
			mainY = ey + 175

			-- Checkerboard background
			local checkerX, checkerY = ex, previewY
			local checkerW, checkerH = ew, previewH - 5
			rl.DrawRectangle(checkerX, checkerY, checkerW, checkerH, Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(0))

			local size = 10
			for r = 0, math.ceil(checkerH / size) - 1 do
				for c = 0, math.ceil(checkerW / size) - 1 do
					if (r + c) % 2 == 0 then
						rl.DrawRectangle(
							checkerX + c * size,
							checkerY + r * size,
							math.min(size, checkerW - c * size),
							math.min(size, checkerH - r * size),
							Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2):ToRaylib(0)
						)
					end
				end
			end

			-- Render image preview
			local tex = getTexture(propValue)
			if tex then
				local tw = buffer.readi32(tex, 4)
				local th = buffer.readi32(tex, 8)

				local drawW = math.min(ew - 20, (previewH - 60) * (tw / th))
				local drawH = drawW * (th / tw)
				if drawH > previewH - 60 then
					drawH = previewH - 60
					drawW = drawH * (tw / th)
				end

				local drawX = ex + (ew - drawW) / 2
				local drawY = previewY + (previewH - 60 - drawH) / 2 + 10

				rl.DrawTexturePro(
					tex,
					structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = tw, height = th }),
					structs.Rectangle:new({ x = drawX, y = drawY, width = drawW, height = drawH }),
					vector.create(0, 0),
					0,
					Color3.new(1, 1, 1):ToRaylib(0)
				)

				-- Metadata
				local metaX = ex + 10
				local metaY = previewY + previewH - 45
				rl.DrawTextEx(
					vend,
					string.format("%dx%d", tw, th),
					vector.create(metaX, metaY),
					13,
					1,
					Theme.TextColor:ToRaylib(0)
				)
				rl.DrawTextEx(
					vend,
					"Memory: " .. string.format("%.2f MiB", (tw * th * 4) / (1024 * 1024)),
					vector.create(metaX, metaY + 15),
					11,
					1,
					Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
				)
			else
				rl.DrawTextEx(
					vend,
					"Failed to load texture",
					vector.create(ex + 10, previewY + 10),
					13,
					1,
					Color3.new(1, 0.4, 0.4):ToRaylib(0)
				)
			end
		end

		comps.tb:drawWithExtras(ex, mainY + (CELL_HEIGHT - 22) / 2, ew - sp - btnW, 22)
		comps.explorer.set("obj_rect", arect.new(ex + ew - btnW, mainY + (CELL_HEIGHT - 22) / 2, btnW, 22))
		comps.explorer.render(rl.GetFrameTime())
	end,
}

-- number
datatypes["number"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local tb = makeTextbox({
			numeric = true,
			numericMin = 0,
			numericMax = 100000,
			numericStep = 1,
			showStepButtons = true,
			onSubmit = function(new)
				selected[propName] = tonumber(new) or 0
			end,
		})
		tb:setText(tostring(propValue))
		return tb
	end,
	render = function(comp, ex, ey, ew, eh)
		comp:drawWithExtras(ex, ey, ew, eh)
	end,
}

-- boolean
datatypes["boolean"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		return gui.checkbox({
			value = propValue,
			onChanged = function(new)
				selected[propName] = new
			end,
		})
	end,
	render = function(comp, ex, ey, ew, eh)
		comp.set("obj_rect", arect.new(ex, ey, 22, 22))
		comp.render(rl.GetFrameTime())
	end,
}

-- Vector2
datatypes["Vector2"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local comps = {
			x = numTb(Color3.new(1, 0, 0), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = Vector2.new(tonumber(v) or 0, c.Y)
			end),
			y = numTb(Color3.new(0, 1, 0), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = Vector2.new(c.X, tonumber(v) or 0)
			end),
		}
		comps.x:setText(tostring(propValue.X))
		comps.y:setText(tostring(propValue.Y))
		return comps
	end,
	render = function(comps, ex, ey, ew, eh)
		local sp = 3
		local w = (ew - sp) / 2
		comps.x:drawWithExtras(ex, ey, w, eh)
		comps.y:drawWithExtras(ex + w + sp, ey, w, eh)
	end,
}

		comps.y:drawWithExtras(ex + w + sp, ey, w, eh)
	end,

				selected[propName] = NumberRange.new(tonumber(v) or 0, c.Max)
			end),
			max = numTb(Color3.new(0.4, 0.8, 1), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = NumberRange.new(c.Min, tonumber(v) or 0)
			end),
		}
		comps.min:setText(tostring(propValue.Min))
		comps.max:setText(tostring(propValue.Max))
		return comps
	end,
	render = function(comps, ex, ey, ew, eh)
		local sp = 3
		local w = (ew - sp) / 2
		comps.min:drawWithExtras(ex, ey, w, eh)
		comps.max:drawWithExtras(ex + w + sp, ey, w, eh)
	end,
}

-- Vector3
datatypes["Vector3"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local comps = {
			x = numTb(Color3.new(1, 0, 0), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = Vector3.new(tonumber(v), c.Y, c.Z)
			end),
			y = numTb(Color3.new(0, 1, 0.27), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = Vector3.new(c.X, tonumber(v), c.Z)
			end),
			z = numTb(Color3.new(0.2, 0.4, 1), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = Vector3.new(c.X, c.Y, tonumber(v))
			end),
		}
		comps.x:setText(tostring(propValue.X))
		comps.y:setText(tostring(propValue.Y))
		comps.z:setText(tostring(propValue.Z))
		return comps
	end,
	render = function(comps, ex, ey, ew, eh)
		local sp = 3
		local w = (ew - sp * 2) / 3
		comps.x:drawWithExtras(ex, ey, w, eh)
		comps.y:drawWithExtras(ex + (w + sp), ey, w, eh)
		comps.z:drawWithExtras(ex + (w + sp) * 2, ey, w, eh)
	end,
}

-- Color3
datatypes["Color3"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local function tb(col, idx)
			return makeTextbox({
				numeric = true,
				numericMin = 0,
				numericMax = 1,
				numericStep = 0.01,
				TextColor = col:ToRaylib(0),
				onSubmit = function(new)
					local r, g, b = selected[propName].R, selected[propName].G, selected[propName].B
					local vals = { r, g, b }
					vals[idx] = tonumber(new) or vals[idx]
					selected[propName] = Color3.new(vals[1], vals[2], vals[3])
				end,
			})
		end
		local comps = {
			r = tb(Color3.new(1, 0, 0), 1),
			g = tb(Color3.new(0, 1, 0), 2),
			b = tb(Color3.new(0.2, 0.4, 1), 3),
			pick = gui.imageButton({
				image = getCPIcon(),
				imageScale = 0.8,
				onClick = function()
					openColorPicker(selected, propName, selected[propName])
				end,
			}),
		}
		comps.r:setText(tostring(round(propValue.R)))
		comps.g:setText(tostring(round(propValue.G)))
		comps.b:setText(tostring(round(propValue.B)))
		return comps
	end,
	render = function(comps, ex, ey, ew, eh)
		local sp = 3
		local btnW = 24
		local w = (ew - sp * 3 - btnW) / 3
		comps.r:drawWithExtras(ex, ey, w, eh)
		comps.g:drawWithExtras(ex + (w + sp), ey, w, eh)
		comps.b:drawWithExtras(ex + (w + sp) * 2, ey, w, eh)
		comps.pick.set("obj_rect", arect.new(ex + (w + sp) * 3, ey, btnW, eh))
		comps.pick.render(rl.GetFrameTime())
	end,
}

-- UDim2
local udim2Expanded = {}

datatypes["UDim2"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local cyan = Color3.new(0.4, 1, 1):ToRaylib(0)
		local white = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):ToRaylib(0)
		local function tb(col, fn)
			return makeTextbox({ numeric = true, TextColor = col, onSubmit = fn })
		end
		local comps = {
			_isUDim2 = true,
			sx = tb(cyan, function(v)
				local u = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = UDim2.new(tonumber(v) or 0, u.X.Offset, u.Y.Scale, u.Y.Offset)
			end),
			ox = tb(white, function(v)
				local u = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, tonumber(v) or 0, u.Y.Scale, u.Y.Offset)
			end),
			sy = tb(cyan, function(v)
				local u = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, u.X.Offset, tonumber(v) or 0, u.Y.Offset)
			end),
			oy = tb(white, function(v)
				local u = selected[propName]
				selected[propName] = UDim2.new(u.X.Scale, u.X.Offset, u.Y.Scale, tonumber(v) or 0)
			end),
		}
		comps.sx:setText(tostring(propValue.X.Scale))
		comps.ox:setText(tostring(propValue.X.Offset))
		comps.sy:setText(tostring(propValue.Y.Scale))
		comps.oy:setText(tostring(propValue.Y.Offset))
		return comps
	end,

	cellHeight = function(comp, propName)
		return udim2Expanded[propName] and CELL_HEIGHT * 3 or CELL_HEIGHT
	end,

	onRowClick = function(comp, propName)
		udim2Expanded[propName] = not udim2Expanded[propName]
	end,

	render = function(comp, ex, ey, ew, eh, propName, propValue)
		-- summary on parent row
		if propValue then
			local summary = string.format(
				"{%s, %s}, {%s, %s}",
				propValue.X.Scale,
				propValue.X.Offset,
				propValue.Y.Scale,
				propValue.Y.Offset
			)
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				summary,
				vector.create(ex, ey + (CELL_HEIGHT - 14) / 2),
				13,
				1,
				Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)
		end

		if not udim2Expanded[propName] then
			return
		end

		local rx2 = ex - PADDING - NAME_COL_WIDTH
		local rw2 = ew + NAME_COL_WIDTH + PADDING
		local subIndent = 16
		local subY1 = ey + CELL_HEIGHT
		local subY2 = ey + CELL_HEIGHT * 2
		local edH = CELL_HEIGHT - 8

		local function drawSubRow(subY, label, tb1, tb2)
			rl.DrawRectangle(
				rx2,
				subY,
				rw2,
				CELL_HEIGHT,
				Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
			)
			rl.DrawRectangle(
				rx2 + subIndent - 4,
				subY,
				1,
				CELL_HEIGHT,
				Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
			)
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				label,
				vector.create(rx2 + subIndent, subY + (CELL_HEIGHT - 13) / 2),
				13,
				1,
				Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)

			local divX = rx2 + NAME_COL_WIDTH
			rl.DrawRectangle(
				divX,
				subY,
				1,
				CELL_HEIGHT,
				Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
			)

			local sp = 3
			local w = (ew - sp) / 2
			local edY = subY + (CELL_HEIGHT - edH) / 2
			tb1:drawWithExtras(ex, edY, w, edH)
			tb2:drawWithExtras(ex + w + sp, edY, w, edH)
		end

		drawSubRow(subY1, "Scale", comp.sx, comp.sy)
		drawSubRow(subY2, "Offset", comp.ox, comp.oy)
	end,
}

-- EnumItem
datatypes["EnumItem"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local items = propValue.EnumType:GetItemsNames()
		local selIdx = 1
		for i, name in ipairs(items) do
			if name == propValue.Name then
				selIdx = i
				break
			end
		end
		local dp = gui.dropdown({
			options = items,
			font = vend,
			selectedIndex = selIdx,
			backgroundColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
			hoverColor = Theme.BackgroundColor,
			onSelect = function(_, option)
				selected[propName] = Enum[propValue.EnumType.Name][option]
			end,
		})
		return { _isDropdown = true, dp = dp }
	end,
	render = function(comp, ex, ey, ew, eh)
		comp.dp.set("obj_rect", arect.new(ex, ey, ew, eh))
		comp.dp.render(rl.GetFrameTime())
	end,
}

-- CFrame
-- renders as:
--   [CFrame]          ΓåÉ parent row, click to expand/collapse
--     [Position]  X Y Z sub-row
--     [Orientation] X Y Z sub-row

local cfExpanded = {} -- [propName] = bool

datatypes["CFrame"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local comps = {
			_isCFrame = true,
			px = numTb(Color3.new(1, 0, 0), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				local rx, ry, rz = c:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				selected[propName] = CFrame.new(tonumber(v) or c.Position.X, c.Position.Y, c.Position.Z)
					* CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
			end),
			py = numTb(Color3.new(0, 1, 0.27), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				local rx, ry, rz = c:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				selected[propName] = CFrame.new(c.Position.X, tonumber(v) or c.Position.Y, c.Position.Z)
					* CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
			end),
			pz = numTb(Color3.new(0.2, 0.4, 1), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				local rx, ry, rz = c:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				selected[propName] = CFrame.new(c.Position.X, c.Position.Y, tonumber(v) or c.Position.Z)
					* CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
			end),
			rx = numTb(Color3.new(1, 0, 0), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				local _, ry, rz = c:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				selected[propName] = CFrame.new(c.Position.X, c.Position.Y, c.Position.Z)
					* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(tonumber(v) or 0), ry, rz)
			end),
			ry = numTb(Color3.new(0, 1, 0.27), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				local rx, _, rz = c:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				selected[propName] = CFrame.new(c.Position.X, c.Position.Y, c.Position.Z)
					* CFrame.Angles(rx, math.rad(tonumber(v) or 0), rz)
			end),
			rz = numTb(Color3.new(0.2, 0.4, 1), function(v)
				local c = selected[propName]
				local rx, ry, _ = c:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				selected[propName] = CFrame.new(c.Position.X, c.Position.Y, c.Position.Z)
					* CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, math.rad(tonumber(v) or 0))
			end),
		}
		local ex, ey, ez = propValue:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
		comps.px:setText(tostring(round(propValue.Position.X)))
		comps.py:setText(tostring(round(propValue.Position.Y)))
		comps.pz:setText(tostring(round(propValue.Position.Z)))
		comps.rx:setText(tostring(round(math.deg(ex))))
		comps.ry:setText(tostring(round(math.deg(ey))))
		comps.rz:setText(tostring(round(math.deg(ez))))
		return comps
	end,

	-- total height: parent row + (if expanded) 2 sub-rows
	cellHeight = function(comp, propName)
		if cfExpanded[propName] then
			return CELL_HEIGHT * 3
		end
		return CELL_HEIGHT
	end,

	-- called when the parent row header is clicked
	onRowClick = function(comp, propName)
		cfExpanded[propName] = not cfExpanded[propName]
	end,

	-- ex,ey,ew,eh is the full allocated rect (may be 1 or 3 rows tall)
	render = function(comp, ex, ey, ew, eh, propName, propValue)
		-- summary text on the parent row (always shown in right column)
		if propValue then
			local summary = string.format(
				"%s, %s, %s",
				round(propValue.Position.X),
				round(propValue.Position.Y),
				round(propValue.Position.Z)
			)
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				summary,
				vector.create(ex, ey + (CELL_HEIGHT - 14) / 2),
				13,
				1,
				Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)
		end

		if not cfExpanded[propName] then
			return
		end

		-- sub-row backgrounds
		local rx2 = ex - PADDING - NAME_COL_WIDTH -- back to full row left edge
		local rw2 = ew + NAME_COL_WIDTH + PADDING -- full row width

		local subIndent = 16
		local subNameW = NAME_COL_WIDTH - subIndent
		local subY1 = ey + CELL_HEIGHT
		local subY2 = ey + CELL_HEIGHT * 2

		local function drawSubRow(subY, label, tbx, tby, tbz)
			-- background (slightly inset)
			rl.DrawRectangle(
				rx2,
				subY,
				rw2,
				CELL_HEIGHT,
				Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
			)

			-- indent line
			rl.DrawRectangle(
				rx2 + subIndent - 4,
				subY,
				1,
				CELL_HEIGHT,
				Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
			)

			-- sub-label
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				label,
				vector.create(rx2 + subIndent, subY + (CELL_HEIGHT - 13) / 2),
				13,
				1,
				Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)

			-- divider
			local divX = rx2 + NAME_COL_WIDTH
			rl.DrawRectangle(divX, subY, 1, CELL_HEIGHT, Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(0))

			-- three textboxes
			local sp = 3
			local w = (ew - sp * 2) / 3
			local edY = subY + (CELL_HEIGHT - (CELL_HEIGHT - 8)) / 2
			local edH = CELL_HEIGHT - 8
			tbx:drawWithExtras(ex, edY, w, edH)
			tby:drawWithExtras(ex + (w + sp), edY, w, edH)
			tbz:drawWithExtras(ex + (w + sp) * 2, edY, w, edH)
		end

		drawSubRow(subY1, "Position", comp.px, comp.py, comp.pz)
		drawSubRow(subY2, "Orientation", comp.rx, comp.ry, comp.rz)
	end,
}

-- NumberSequence
datatypes["NumberSequence"] = {
	build = function(selected, propName, propValue)
		local comps = { _isSequence = true, keypoints = {} }
		for i, kp in ipairs(propValue.Keypoints) do
			local kcomps = {
				time = numTb(Color3.new(1, 1, 0), function(v)
					local ns = selected[propName]
					local kps = ns.Keypoints
					kps[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(tonumber(v) or kps[i].Time, kps[i].Value)
					selected[propName] = NumberSequence.new(kps)
				end),
				value = numTb(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), function(v)
					local ns = selected[propName]
					local kps = ns.Keypoints
					kps[i] = NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kps[i].Time, tonumber(v) or kps[i].Value)
					selected[propName] = NumberSequence.new(kps)
				end),
			}
			kcomps.time:setText(tostring(kp.Time))
			kcomps.value:setText(tostring(kp.Value))
			table.insert(comps.keypoints, kcomps)
		end
		return comps
	end,
	cellHeight = function(comp, propName)
		if expandedSequences[propName] and comp and comp.keypoints then
			return CELL_HEIGHT * (1 + #comp.keypoints)
		end
		return CELL_HEIGHT
	end,
	onRowClick = function(comp, propName)
		expandedSequences[propName] = not expandedSequences[propName]
	end,
	render = function(comp, ex, ey, ew, eh, propName, propValue)
		if propValue then
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				string.format("[%d points]", #propValue.Keypoints),
				vector.create(ex, ey + (CELL_HEIGHT - 14) / 2),
				13,
				1,
				Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)
		end

		if not expandedSequences[propName] or not comp then
			return
		end

		local rx2 = ex - PADDING - NAME_COL_WIDTH
		local rw2 = ew + NAME_COL_WIDTH + PADDING
		local subIndent = 16

		for i, kcomps in ipairs(comp.keypoints) do
			local subY = ey + CELL_HEIGHT * i
			rl.DrawRectangle(
				rx2,
				subY,
				rw2,
				CELL_HEIGHT,
				Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
			)
			rl.DrawRectangle(
				rx2 + subIndent - 4,
				subY,
				1,
				CELL_HEIGHT,
				Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
			)
			rl.DrawTextEx(
				vend,
				"Point " .. i,
				vector.create(rx2 + subIndent, subY + (CELL_HEIGHT - 13) / 2),
				12,
				1,
				Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
			)

			local divX = rx2 + NAME_COL_WIDTH
			rl.DrawRectangle(
				divX,
				subY,
				1,
				CELL_HEIGHT,
				Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
			)

			local sp = 3
			local w = (ew - sp) / 2
			local edH = CELL_HEIGHT - 8
			local edY = subY + (CELL_HEIGHT - edH) / 2
			kcomps.time:drawWithExtras(ex, edY, w, edH)
			kcomps.value:drawWithExtras(ex + w + sp, edY, w, edH)
		end
	end,
}

			kcomps.pick.render(rl.GetFrameTime())
		end
	end,

--  filtering

local function isBlacklisted(propName, propValue)
	if table.find(blacklisted, propName) then
		return true
	end
	if type(propValue) == "function" then
		return true
	end
	if string.find(propName, "_") then
		return true
	end
	if type(propValue) == "userdata" then
		return true
	end
	if type(propValue) == "table" then
		if propValue.__type == "KinemiumSignal" or propValue.__type == "KinemiumConnection" then
			return true
		end
		if propValue._history then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function getPropTypeName(propValue)
	return type(propValue) == "table" and propValue.__type or type(propValue)
end

local function getEntryHeight(entry)
	local typeName = getPropTypeName(entry.propValue)
	local dt = datatypes[typeName]
	if dt and dt.cellHeight then
		local ec = editorComps[entry.propName]
		return dt.cellHeight(ec and ec.comp, entry.propName, entry.propValue)
	end
	return CELL_HEIGHT
end

local function buildBuckets(selected)
	local buckets, seen = {}, {}

	for propName, propValue in pairs(selected._props) do
		if isBlacklisted(propName, propValue) then
			continue
		end
		local cat = PropertyCategories.getPropertyCategory(propName) or "Other"
		if not buckets[cat] then
			buckets[cat] = {}
		end
		table.insert(buckets[cat], { propName = propName, propValue = propValue, displayName = propName })
		seen[cat] = true
	end

	local order = {}
	for _, cat in ipairs(CATEGORY_ORDER) do
		if seen[cat] then
			table.insert(order, cat)
		end
	end

	for _, cat in ipairs(order) do
		table.sort(buckets[cat], function(a, b)
			return a.displayName < b.displayName
		end)
	end
	return buckets, order
end

--  selection

Selection.SelectionAdded:Connect(function(selected)
	table.clear(editorComps)
	table.clear(overlapping)
	table.clear(cfExpanded)
	table.clear(udim2Expanded)
	table.clear(expandedSequences)
	scrollOffset = 0

	if not selected then
		return
	end

	for propName, propValue in pairs(selected._props) do
		if isBlacklisted(propName, propValue) then
			continue
		end
		local typeName = getPropTypeName(propValue)
		local dt = datatypes[typeName]
		if dt then
			local comp = dt.build(selected, propName, propValue)
			editorComps[propName] = { comp = comp, typeName = typeName, displayName = propName }
			if type(comp) == "table" and comp._isDropdown then
				overlapping[propName] = comp
			end
		end
	end
end)

--  draw category header

local function drawCategoryHeader(winX, winW, y, label, isOpen, mousePos)
	local w = winW - 12

	local labelText = string.upper(label)
	local labelSize = rl.MeasureTextEx(vend, labelText, 11, 1.5)
	local indicatorText = isOpen and "v" or ">"
	local indicatorSize = rl.MeasureTextEx(vend, indicatorText, 11, 1)

	local gap = 5
	local blockW = indicatorSize.x + gap + labelSize.x
	local blockX = winX + PADDING
	local centerY = y + (CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT / 2)
	local lineColor = Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)

	rl.DrawRectangle(winX, centerY, PADDING - 4, 1, lineColor)
	rl.DrawTextEx(
		boldFont,
		indicatorText,
		vector.create(blockX, centerY - 6),
		11,
		1,
		Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0.4)
	)
	rl.DrawTextEx(
		boldFont,
		labelText,
		vector.create(blockX + indicatorSize.x + gap, centerY - 6),
		11,
		1.5,
		Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0)
	)
	local lineStartX = blockX + blockW + PADDING - 4
	rl.DrawRectangle(lineStartX, centerY, w - lineStartX + winX, 1, lineColor)

	if
		rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1
		and mousePos.x >= winX
		and mousePos.x <= winX + w
		and mousePos.y >= y
		and mousePos.y <= y + CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT
	then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

--  draw property row

local function drawPropertyRow(winX, winW, y, i, propName, propValue, selected, mousePos, winY, winH)
	local rw = winW - 12
	local rh = CELL_HEIGHT
	local divX = winX + NAME_COL_WIDTH

	local isHovered = mousePos.x >= winX and mousePos.x <= winX + rw and mousePos.y >= y and mousePos.y <= y + rh

	local tr = StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency

	local bgCol = isHovered and Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.06):ToRaylib(tr)
		or (i % 2 == 0 and Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(tr) or Theme.BackgroundColor:ToRaylib(tr))

	rl.DrawRectangle(winX, y, rw, rh, bgCol)
	rl.DrawRectangle(
		divX,
		y,
		1,
		rh,
		Theme.ThirdBackgroundColor:ToRaylib(StudioThemeService.SelectedTheme.WindowBackgroundTransparency)
	)

	local entry = editorComps[propName]
	local displayName = entry and entry.displayName or propName

	local function drawName(indent)
		local textX = winX + PADDING + (indent or 0)
		local textY = y + (rh - 14) / 2
		local maxWidth = NAME_COL_WIDTH - PADDING * 2 - (indent or 0)

		-- Measure text to check if it needs clipping
		local measured = rl.MeasureTextEx(vend, displayName, 14, 1)
		if measured.x <= maxWidth then
			-- Text fits, draw normally
			rl.DrawTextEx(vend, displayName, vector.create(textX, textY), 14, 1, TextColor)
		else
			-- Text is too long, use scissor mode to clip it
			rl.BeginScissorMode(textX, y, maxWidth, rh)
			rl.DrawTextEx(vend, displayName, vector.create(textX, textY), 14, 1, TextColor)
			rl.EndScissorMode()
		end
	end

	if not entry then
		-- no editor, just draw name plainly
		drawName(0)
		return
	end

	local dt = datatypes[entry.typeName]
	local comp = entry.comp
	local editorX = divX + PADDING
	local editorW = rw - NAME_COL_WIDTH - PADDING * 2
	local editorH = rh - 8
	local editorY = y + (rh - editorH) / 2

	local isExpandable = type(comp) == "table" and (comp._isCFrame or comp._isUDim2 or comp._isSequence)

	if isExpandable then
		local expanded = false
		if comp._isCFrame then
			expanded = cfExpanded[propName]
		elseif comp._isUDim2 then
			expanded = udim2Expanded[propName]
		elseif comp._isSequence then
			expanded = expandedSequences[propName]
		end

		local ind = expanded and "v" or ">"
		rl.DrawTextEx(
			vend,
			ind,
			vector.create(winX + PADDING, y + (rh - 13) / 2),
			12,
			1,
			Theme.SecondaryTextColor:ToRaylib(0.5)
		)
		drawName(14)

		if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 and isHovered and dt.onRowClick then
			dt.onRowClick(comp, propName)
		end
		if dt.render then
			dt.render(comp, editorX, y, editorW, editorH, propName, propValue)
		end
	elseif type(comp) == "table" and comp._isDropdown then
		drawName(0)
	else
		drawName(0)
		if dt then
			local entryH = getEntryHeight(entry)
			dt.render(comp, editorX, editorY, editorW, entryH - 8, propName, propValue)
		end
	end
end

window.stepped = function(windowData)
	for _, ov in pairs(overlapping) do
		ov._framePos = nil
	end
	if windowData.title ~= "Inspector" then
		return
	end

	Theme = game:GetService("StudioThemeService").SelectedTheme

	windowObject = windowData

	local winX = windowData.x
	local titleBarH = windowData._titleBarH or 28
	local winY = windowData.y + titleBarH
	local winW = windowData.width
	local winH = windowData.height - titleBarH

	local dt = rl.GetFrameTime()
	local mousePos = rl.GetMousePosition()

	-- Divider drag handling
	local divX = winX + NAME_COL_WIDTH
	local mousePressed = rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1
	local mouseDown = rl.IsMouseButtonDown(0) == 1

	-- Check if mouse is over divider
	local isOverDivider = mousePos.x >= divX - 3
		and mousePos.x <= divX + 3
		and mousePos.y >= winY
		and mousePos.y <= winY + winH

	-- Start drag
	if mousePressed and isOverDivider and not dividerDrag.active then
		dividerDrag.active = true
		dividerDrag.startX = mousePos.x
		dividerDrag.startWidth = NAME_COL_WIDTH
	end

	-- Handle dragging
	if dividerDrag.active and mouseDown then
		local dx = mousePos.x - dividerDrag.startX
		NAME_COL_WIDTH = math.clamp(dividerDrag.startWidth + dx, 80, winW - 100)
	elseif not mouseDown then
		dividerDrag.active = false
	end

	-- Change cursor when hovering over divider
	if isOverDivider then
		local MouseCursor = require("@Kinemium.MouseCursor")
		local Enum = require("@EnumMap")
		MouseCursor.request(Enum.KinemiumMouseCursor.MOUSE_CURSOR_RESIZE_EW.Value)
	end

	local selected = Selection.Get()[1]
	if not selected or selected.Destroyed then
		return
	end

	gui.clear()

	local buckets, order = buildBuckets(selected)

	-- total scrollable height (respects per-entry heights)
	local totalH = 0
	for _, cat in ipairs(order) do
		totalH = totalH + CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT
		if openCategories[cat] ~= false then
			for _, entry in ipairs(buckets[cat]) do
				totalH = totalH + getEntryHeight(entry)
			end
		end
	end

	local inspectorContent
	inspectorContent = {
		get_rect = function()
			return arect.new(0, 0, winW, totalH)
		end,
		set = function(prop, value)
			if prop == "obj_rect" then
				inspectorContent.rect = value
			end
		end,
		render = function(dt)
			local r = inspectorContent.rect
			local cursorY = r.y

			for _, cat in ipairs(order) do
				local props = buckets[cat]
				local isOpen = openCategories[cat] ~= false

				if cursorY + CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT >= winY and cursorY <= winY + winH then
					if drawCategoryHeader(winX + 1, winW - 1, cursorY, cat, isOpen, mousePos) then
						openCategories[cat] = not isOpen
						isOpen = not isOpen
					end
				end
				cursorY = cursorY + CATEGORY_HEADER_HEIGHT

				if isOpen then
					for i, entry in ipairs(props) do
						local entryH = getEntryHeight(entry)
						local rowY = cursorY

						if rowY + entryH >= winY and rowY <= winY + winH then
							drawPropertyRow(
								winX + 1,
								winW - 1,
								rowY,
								i,
								entry.propName,
								entry.propValue,
								selected,
								mousePos,
								winY,
								winH
							)

							local ov = overlapping[entry.propName]
							if ov then
								local rw = winW - 12
								local editorX = winX + NAME_COL_WIDTH + PADDING
								local editorW = rw - NAME_COL_WIDTH - PADDING * 2
								local editorH = CELL_HEIGHT - 8
								ov._framePos = {
									ex = editorX,
									ey = rowY + (CELL_HEIGHT - editorH) / 2,
									ew = editorW,
									eh = editorH,
								}
							end
						end
						cursorY = cursorY + entryH
					end
				end
			end
		end,
	}

	if not scrollableComp then
		scrollableComp = gui.scrollable({
			child = inspectorContent,
			input = rl,
			inputButtons = raylib.lib,
			disableClipping = true,
			debug = false,
			scrollbarWidth = 6,
			scrollbarColor = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3),
			scrollbarHoverColor = Color3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4),
			scrollbarBackgroundTransparency = 1,
		})
	end

	scrollableComp.set("child", inspectorContent)
	scrollableComp.set("obj_rect", arect.new(winX, winY, winW, winH))
	scrollableComp.set("contentHeight", totalH)

	raylib.lib.BeginScissorMode(winX, winY, winW, winH)
	scrollableComp.render(dt)

	for _, ov in pairs(overlapping) do
		if ov._framePos then
			local p = ov._framePos
			if p.ey + p.eh >= winY and p.ey <= winY + winH then
				datatypes["EnumItem"].render(ov, p.ex, p.ey, p.ew, p.eh)
			end
		end
	end
	raylib.lib.EndScissorMode()

	vend = KinemiumFontService.GetDefaultFont()

	if colorPickerTarget then
		local cpW, cpH = 240, winH
		local cpX = winX + winW + 5
		local cpY = winY

		if cpX + cpW > rl.GetRenderWidth() then
			cpX = winX - cpW - 5
		end

		colorPickerComp.set("obj_rect", arect.new(cpX, cpY, cpW, cpH))
		colorPickerComp.render(dt)

		if rl.IsMouseButtonPressed(0) == 1 then
			local m = rl.GetMousePosition()
			if not (m.x >= cpX and m.x <= cpX + cpW and m.y >= cpY and m.y <= cpY + cpH) then
				colorPickerTarget = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

local LOG_FONT_SIZE = 17
local LOG_FONT_SPACING = 1
local MIN_CELL_HEIGHT = 25

local logLayoutCache = {}

local function getLineHeight()
	local size = rl.MeasureTextEx(vend, "Ag", LOG_FONT_SIZE, LOG_FONT_SPACING)
	return math.max(16, math.floor(size.y + 2))
end

local function wrapTextToWidth(text, maxWidth)
	local lines = {}
	local lineWidthLimit = math.max(32, maxWidth)
	local source = tostring(text or "")

	local function measureWidth(s)
		return rl.MeasureTextEx(vend, s, LOG_FONT_SIZE, LOG_FONT_SPACING).x
	end

	for rawLine in (source .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do
		if rawLine == "" then
			table.insert(lines, "")
		else
			local remaining = rawLine
			while #remaining > 0 do
				if measureWidth(remaining) <= lineWidthLimit then
					table.insert(lines, remaining)
					break
				end

				local cut = 1
				local lastWhitespace = nil
				for i = 1, #remaining do
					local ch = remaining:sub(i, i)
					if ch == " " or ch == "\t" then
						lastWhitespace = i
					end

					local part = remaining:sub(1, i)
					if measureWidth(part) > lineWidthLimit then
						if lastWhitespace and lastWhitespace > 1 then
							cut = lastWhitespace
						else
							cut = math.max(1, i - 1)
						end
						break
					end
					cut = i
				end

				local chunk = remaining:sub(1, cut)
				if chunk == "" then
					chunk = remaining:sub(1, 1)
					cut = 1
				end

				table.insert(lines, chunk)
				remaining = remaining:sub(cut + 1)
			end
		end
	end

	if #lines == 0 then
		table.insert(lines, "")
	end

	return lines
end

local function isMouseInRect(rect, mousePos)
	return mousePos.x >= rect.x
		and mousePos.x <= rect.x + rect.width
		and mousePos.y >= rect.y
		and mousePos.y <= rect.y + rect.height
end

local function stringifyLogMessage(message)
	if message == nil then
		return "nil"
	end

	if type(message) == "string" then
		return message
	end

	if type(message) == "table" then
		local ok, asString = pcall(repr, message)
		if ok and type(asString) == "string" then
			return asString
		end
		return "<table>"
	end

	local ok, asString = pcall(tostring, message)
	if ok then
		return asString
	end
	return "<unprintable>"
end

local function createPumpTabRenderFn(tabName)
	return function(windowData)
		local dt = rl.GetFrameTime()
		local titleBarH = windowData._titleBarH or 28
		local tabBarH = windowData._tabBarH or 28
		local contentOffsetY = titleBarH + tabBarH
		local winX = windowData.x
		local winY = windowData.y + contentOffsetY
		local winWidth, winHeight = windowData.width, windowData.height
		local padding = 2
		local lineHeight = getLineHeight()
		local lines = pumpTabData[tabName] or {}
		local textWidth = math.max(64, winWidth - 26)

		local listHeight = math.max(0, winHeight - contentOffsetY - padding * 2)
		local totalHeight = 0
		local wrappedLines = {}
		for _, line in ipairs(lines) do
			local wrapped = wrapTextToWidth(line, textWidth)
			table.insert(wrappedLines, wrapped)
			totalHeight = totalHeight + math.max(MIN_CELL_HEIGHT, #wrapped * lineHeight + 8) + padding
		end

		local listRect = {
			x = winX,
			y = winY,
			width = winWidth,
			height = listHeight,
		}

		local consoleContent
		consoleContent = {
			get_rect = function()
				return arectlib.new(0, 0, textWidth + 16, totalHeight)
			end,
			set = function(prop, value)
				if prop == "obj_rect" then
					consoleContent.rect = value
				end
			end,
			render = function(dt)
				local r = consoleContent.rect
				local currentY = r.y
				for i, wrapped in ipairs(wrappedLines) do
					local cellHeight = math.max(MIN_CELL_HEIGHT, #wrapped * lineHeight + 8)
					local cellRect = arectlib.new(winX + 5, currentY, winWidth - 10, cellHeight)
					if currentY + cellHeight >= listRect.y and currentY <= listRect.y + listRect.height then
						for lineIndex, lineText in ipairs(wrapped) do
							local textY = cellRect.y + 4 + (lineIndex - 1) * lineHeight
							rl.DrawTextEx(
								vend,
								lineText,
								vector.create(cellRect.x + 8, textY),
								LOG_FONT_SIZE,
								LOG_FONT_SPACING,
								TextColor
							)
						end
					end
					currentY = currentY + cellHeight + padding
				end
			end,
		}

		if not pumpTabScrollables[tabName] then
			pumpTabScrollables[tabName] = aereon.gui.scrollable({
				child = consoleContent,
				scrollbarWidth = 6,
				scrollbarColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
				scrollbarHoverColor = Theme.Accent,
				scrollbarBackgroundTransparency = 1,
			})
		end
		local scrollable = pumpTabScrollables[tabName]
		local maxScroll = math.max(0, totalHeight - listRect.height)
		scrollable.set("scrollTarget", maxScroll)
		scrollable.set("obj_rect", arectlib.new(listRect.x, listRect.y, listRect.width, listRect.height))
		scrollable.set("contentHeight", totalHeight)
		scrollable.render(dt)
	end
end

local function create_window(title, frame)

	local initialSize = frame.AbsoluteSize or vector.create(800, 200)

	local myWindow = window.create({

							end
						end,

													LOG_FONT_SIZE,

game.EngineSignal:Connect(function(prop, data)
	if prop == "NewOutputTab" then
		table.insert(propback.tabs, data)
	elseif prop == "PumpOutputToTab" then
		local tabName = data.tab
		local rawData = data.data
		if type(tabName) ~= "string" or type(rawData) ~= "table" then
			return
		end

		if not pumpTabData[tabName] then
			pumpTabData[tabName] = {}
			local tabExists = false
			for _, t in ipairs(propback.tabs) do
				if t.name == tabName then
					tabExists = true
					break
				end
			end
			if not tabExists then
				table.insert(propback.tabs, {
					name = tabName,
					render = createPumpTabRenderFn(tabName),
				})
			end
		end

		for _, line in ipairs(rawData) do
			table.insert(pumpTabData[tabName], tostring(line))
		end
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local object = Selection:Get()[1]
	if object then
		local chain = {}
		local current = object
		while current do
			table.insert(chain, 1, current)
			current = current.Parent
		end

		local parts = {}
		for _, ancestor in ipairs(chain) do
			if ancestor.Destroyed then
				continue
			end
			local icon = `  <image:./src/assets/images/icons/{ancestor.ClassName}.png,size:20,20>`
			table.insert(parts, icon .. " " .. ancestor.Name)
		end
		local replaced = table.concat(parts, " > ")

		local stripped = string.gsub(replaced, "<image:[^>]+>", "")
		local size = TextService.MeasureText(stripped, Enum.Font.DefaultEngineFont, 15, 1)
		label.Size = UDim2.new(0, size.X + 20, 0, size.Y + 25)
		label.Text = replaced
	end

	label.Position = ishared.ToolbarMinimized == true and UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30) or UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 180)
	label.TextTransparency = ishared.path_enabled and 0 or 1
end)

local NewCategoryToolbar = ishared.NewCategoryToolbar

local Process = game:GetService("Process")
local processes = {}

local playerCount = 1
local offlinePlayerCount = 1

local function readStderr(proc)
	local logBuffer = ""
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			if proc then
				local err = proc.stderr:read(1024)
				if err and #err > 0 then
					logBuffer = logBuffer .. err
				end

				if err and #err > 0 then
					while true do
						local lineEnd = string.find(logBuffer, "\n")
						if not lineEnd then
							break
						end
						local line = string.sub(logBuffer, 1, lineEnd - 1)
						logBuffer = string.sub(logBuffer, lineEnd + 1)
						if #line > 0 then
							table.insert(localServerLogs, line)
							if #localServerLogs > 15 then
								table.remove(localServerLogs, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			else
				localServerInfo = nil
				localServerLogs = {}
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

NewCategoryToolbar:Fire("Playtest", {
	elements = {

			hoverTransparency = 0.5,
			text = "Stop",

					table.insert(

							"run",
							"engine",
							"--client",
							"--username",
							"Player" .. playerCount,
						})
					)
					playerCount += 1
				end)
			end,
			hoverTransparency = 0.5,
			hoverColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			roundness = 0.2,
			texture = KinemiumIconLoader.ToTexture("./src/assets/images/icons/MultipleDevices.png"),
		},
		{
			type = "ImageButton",
			text = "Offline Client",
			callback = function()
				task.spawn(function()
					local gameName = ishared.GameName or "Game"

					pcall(function()
						zune.fs.deleteFile("./.temp/offline_" .. gameName .. ".kine")
					end)

					KineFileService.ExportGameAsFile("./.temp/", "offline_" .. gameName)

					local new = Process.RunProcessZune({
						"run",
						"game",
						"--client",
						"--offline",
						"--no-multiplayer",
						"--blob",
						"./.temp/offline_" .. gameName .. ".kine",
						"--username",
						"OfflinePlayer" .. offlinePlayerCount,
					}, { stdin = "inherit", stdout = "inherit", stderr = "piped" })

					table.insert(processes, new)

					task.spawn(function()
						local buffer = ""
						while new do
							local ok, err = pcall(function()
								return new.stderr:read(1024)
							end)
							if not ok then
								break
							end
							if err == nil then
								break
							end
							if #err > 0 then
								buffer = buffer .. err
							end

							local lines = {}
							while true do
								local lineEnd = string.find(buffer, "\n")
								if not lineEnd then
									break
								end
								local line = string.sub(buffer, 1, lineEnd - 1)
								buffer = string.sub(buffer, lineEnd + 1)
								if #line > 0 then
									table.insert(lines, line)
								end
							end
							if #lines > 0 then
								game.EngineSignal:Fire("PumpOutputToTab", {
									tab = string.format("Playtest Output (%d)", new.pid),
									data = lines,
								})
							end
							task.wait()
						end
					end)

					offlinePlayerCount += 1
				end)
			end,
			hoverTransparency = 0.5,
			hoverColor = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			roundness = 0.2,
			texture = KinemiumIconLoader.ToTexture("./src/assets/images/icons/NetworkController.png"),
		},
	},

		if value == true then
			if activeTabs[Script.UniqueId] then
				for i, tab in ipairs(ide.buffers) do
					if tab.name == Script.Name then
						ide:activateBuffer(i)
						break
					end
				end
				enableIDE = true
				currentObject = Script
				ide.text:clear()
				ide.text:insertString(currentObject.Source)
				ide.text:setCursor(1, 1)
				ide._highlightCache = {}

				game.Stop3DInput = true
				return
			end
			ide:openTab(Script.Name, Script.Source)
			activeTabs[Script.UniqueId] = true
			-- activateBuffer is already called inside openTab via #self.buffers
			enableIDE = true
			currentObject = Script
			game.Stop3DInput = true
		else
			enableIDE = false
			currentObject = nil
			game.Stop3DInput = false
		end
	end
end)

local function create_window(title, frame)
	local initialPos = frame.AbsolutePosition or vector.create(0, 0)
	local initialSize = frame.AbsoluteSize or vector.create(800, 170)

	local myWindow = window.create({
		title = title,
		x = initialPos.X,
		y = initialPos.Y,
		width = initialSize.X,
		DisableClipping = true,
		height = initialSize.Y,
		headerRender = true,
		Draggable = false,
		Resizable = false,
		Minimized = true,

		tabs = {
			{
				name = "File",
				render = function(windowData)
					local menuRect = aRect.new(windowData.x, windowData.y + 60, 200, 300)
					fileMenu.set("backgroundColor", Theme.aereon.window.BackgroundColor)
					fileMenu.set("textColor", Theme.TextColor)
					fileMenu.set("obj_rect", menuRect)
					renderFileMenu = true
				end,
			},
			{
				name = "Help",
				render = function(windowData) end,
			},
		},
	})
	myWindow:SetTab(nil)
	return myWindow
end

local function create_window_back(screenGui, title, AnchorPoint, size)
	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Position = Theme.WindowConfig.Toolbar.position
	frame.AnchorPoint = AnchorPoint
	frame.Size = size or UDim2.new(0, 400, 0.5, 0)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Parent = screenGui

	return create_window(title, frame), frame
end

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "Toolbar"
screenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui

local propback, frame =
	create_window_back(screenGui, "Toolbar", Theme.WindowConfig.Toolbar.anchorPoint, Theme.WindowConfig.Toolbar.size)

local function measureTextWidth(text)
	if rl.MeasureTextEx then
		local vec = rl.MeasureTextEx(vend, text, 18, 1)
		return vec.x
	end
	return #text * 9
end

local function drawTooltip(text, x, y)
	local padding = 8
	local textW = measureTextWidth(text)
	local textH = 18
	local boxW = textW + padding * 2
	local boxH = textH + padding * 2

	local screenW = rl.GetScreenWidth and rl.GetScreenWidth() or 1920
	if x + boxW > screenW - 4 then
		x = screenW - boxW - 4
	end

	local bgColor = Color3.new(0.08, 0.08, 0.08):ToRaylib(0.1)
	local borderColor = Color3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4):ToRaylib(0)
	rl.DrawRectangleRounded({ x = x, y = y, width = boxW, height = boxH }, 0.4, 8, bgColor)
	rl.DrawRectangleRoundedLines({ x = x, y = y, width = boxW, height = boxH }, 0.4, 8, 1, borderColor)
	rl.DrawTextEx(vend, text, vector.create(x + padding, y + padding), 18, 1, TextColor)
end

local function updateTooltip(dt, hoveredKey, hoveredText, mouseX, mouseY)
	if hoveredKey ~= nil then
		if tooltipState.hoveredKey == hoveredKey then
			tooltipState.hoverTimer = tooltipState.hoverTimer + dt
		else
			tooltipState.hoveredKey = hoveredKey
			tooltipState.hoverTimer = 0
			tooltipState.visible = false
		end

		if tooltipState.hoverTimer >= tooltipState.showDelay then
			tooltipState.visible = true
			tooltipState.text = hoveredText
			tooltipState.x = mouseX + 12
			tooltipState.y = mouseY + 20
		end
	else
		if tooltipState.hoveredKey == nil then
			tooltipState.hoverTimer = 0
			tooltipState.visible = false
		end
	end
end

local function renderButton(xPos, name, element, windowData, dt)
	local winX, winY = windowData.x, windowData.y + 80
	local cellWidth = element.width or 50
	local cellHeight = element.height or 80
	local labelWidth = name and measureTextWidth(name) or 0
	local effectiveWidth = math.max(cellWidth, labelWidth + 10)

	local key = element
	local aereonElement = componentCache[key]
	if not aereonElement then
		aereonElement = gui.button({
			x = winX + xPos,
			y = winY,
			width = effectiveWidth,
			height = cellHeight,
			text = "",
			backgroundTransparency = 1,
			backgroundColor = element.backgroundColor or Color3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.18),
			hoverColor = element.hoverColor or Color3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35),
			onClick = function()
				element.callback(element, aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY, effectiveWidth, cellHeight))
			end,
		})
		componentCache[key] = aereonElement
	end

	local currentRect = aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY, effectiveWidth, cellHeight)
	aereonElement.set("obj_rect", currentRect)
	aereonElement.render(dt)

	if element.texture then
		local scale = element.scale or 2.0
		local texW = element.texture.x * scale
		local texH = element.texture.y * scale

		local iconX = currentRect.x + effectiveWidth / 2 - texW / 2
		local iconY = currentRect.y + (name and (cellHeight / 2 - texH / 2 - 8) or (cellHeight / 2 - texH / 2))

		local iconRect = aRect.new(iconX, iconY, texW, texH)

		rl.DrawTexturePro(
			element.texture.texture,
			structs.Rectangle:new({
				x = 0,
				y = 0,
				width = element.texture.x,
				height = element.texture.y,
			}),
			aRect:translate(iconRect),
			vector.create(0, 0),
			element.rotation or 0,
			ImageColor
		)
	end

	if name then
		local textX = currentRect.x + effectiveWidth / 2 - labelWidth / 2
		local textY = currentRect.y + cellHeight - 18
		rl.DrawTextEx(vend, name, vector.create(textX, textY), 16, 1, TextColor)
	end

	if aRect.MouseIsInRect(currentRect) and element.tooltip then
		local mx = rl.GetMouseX and rl.GetMouseX() or currentRect.x
		local my = rl.GetMouseY and rl.GetMouseY() or currentRect.y
		updateTooltip(dt, tostring(element), element.tooltip, mx, my)
	end

	return effectiveWidth + (element.padding or 5)
end

local function renderToggleButton(xPos, name, element, windowData, dt)
	local winX, winY = windowData.x, windowData.y + 80
	local cellWidth = element.width or 50
	local cellHeight = element.height or 60
	local labelWidth = name and measureTextWidth(name) or 0
	local effectiveWidth = math.max(cellWidth, labelWidth + 10)

	local key = element
	if toggleStates[key] == nil then
		toggleStates[key] = element.defaultOn or false
	end
	local isOn = toggleStates[key]

	local aereonElement = componentCache[key]
	if not aereonElement then
		aereonElement = gui.button({
			x = winX + xPos,
			y = winY,
			width = effectiveWidth,
			height = cellHeight,
			text = "",
			backgroundTransparency = 1,
			onClick = function()
				toggleStates[key] = not toggleStates[key]
				if element.callback then
					element.callback(
						element,
						aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY, effectiveWidth, cellHeight),
						toggleStates[key]
					)
				end
			end,
		})
		componentCache[key] = aereonElement
	end

	local currentRect = aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY, effectiveWidth, cellHeight)
	aereonElement.set("obj_rect", currentRect)

	if isOn then
		aereonElement.set("backgroundColor", element.activeColor or Color3.new(0.2, 0.5, 0.9))
		aereonElement.set("hoverColor", element.activeColor or Color3.new(0.2, 0.5, 0.9))
	else
		aereonElement.set("backgroundColor", element.backgroundColor or Color3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.18))
		aereonElement.set("hoverColor", element.hoverColor or Color3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35))
	end

	aereonElement.render(dt)

	if element.texture then
		local scale = element.scale or 2.0
		local texW = element.texture.x * scale
		local texH = element.texture.y * scale

		local iconX = currentRect.x + effectiveWidth / 2 - texW / 2
		local iconY = currentRect.y + (name and (cellHeight / 2 - texH / 2 - 8) or (cellHeight / 2 - texH / 2))

		local iconRect = aRect.new(iconX, iconY, texW, texH)

		rl.DrawTexturePro(
			element.texture.texture,
			structs.Rectangle:new({
				x = 0,
				y = 0,
				width = element.texture.x,
				height = element.texture.y,
			}),
			aRect:translate(iconRect),
			vector.create(0, 0),
			element.rotation or 0,
			ImageColor
		)
	end

	if name then
		local textX = currentRect.x + effectiveWidth / 2 - labelWidth / 2
		local textY = currentRect.y + cellHeight - 18
		rl.DrawTextEx(vend, name, vector.create(textX, textY), 16, 1, TextColor)
	end

	if isOn then
		local dotR = 3
		local dotX = math.floor(currentRect.x + effectiveWidth / 2)
		local dotY = math.floor(currentRect.y + cellHeight - dotR - 3)
		rl.DrawCircle(dotX, dotY, dotR, (element.activeColor or Color3.new(0.2, 0.5, 0.9)):ToRaylib(0))
	end

	if aRect.MouseIsInRect(currentRect) and element.tooltip then
		local mx = rl.GetMouseX and rl.GetMouseX() or currentRect.x
		local my = rl.GetMouseY and rl.GetMouseY() or currentRect.y
		updateTooltip(dt, tostring(element) .. "_toggle", element.tooltip, mx, my)
	end

	return effectiveWidth + (element.padding or 5)
end

local function renderDropdownButton(xPos, name, element, windowData, dt)
	local winX, winY = windowData.x, windowData.y + 80
	local maxItemWidth = 0
	if element.options then
		for _, opt in ipairs(element.options) do
			local itemWidth = measureTextWidth(opt.label or "")
			maxItemWidth = math.max(maxItemWidth, itemWidth)
		end
	end
	local labelWidth = name and measureTextWidth(name) or 0
	local cellWidth = element.width or math.max(maxItemWidth, labelWidth) + 20
	local cellHeight = element.height or 30

	local key = element
	local aereonElement = componentCache[key]
	if not aereonElement then
		local opts = {}
		for _, opt in ipairs(element.options or {}) do
			table.insert(opts, opt.label)
		end

		aereonElement = gui.dropdown({
			x = winX + xPos,
			y = winY,
			width = cellWidth,
			height = cellHeight,
			options = opts,
			selectedIndex = 1,
			backgroundColor = Color3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.18),
			hoverColor = element.hoverColor or Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3),
			textColor = Theme.TextColor,
			onSelect = function(idx, optLabel)
				local opt
				for _, o in ipairs(element.options or {}) do
					if o.label == optLabel then
						opt = o
						break
					end
				end
				if opt then
					element._selected = opt.label
					if opt.onClick then
						opt.onClick(opt)
					end
					if element.onSelect then
						element.onSelect(opt)
					elseif element.callback then
						element.callback(opt)
					end
				end
			end,
		})
		componentCache[key] = aereonElement
	end

	local currentRect = aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY, cellWidth, cellHeight)
	aereonElement.set("obj_rect", currentRect)

	if element._selected then
		local idx = 1
		for i, o in ipairs(element.options or {}) do
			if o.label == element._selected then
				idx = i
				break
			end
		end
		aereonElement.set("selectedIndex", idx)
	end

	aereonElement.render(dt)

	local labelWidth = 0
	if name and name ~= (element._selected or "") then
		labelWidth = measureTextWidth(name)
		local lx = currentRect.x + cellWidth / 2 - labelWidth / 2
		rl.DrawTextEx(vend, name, vector.create(lx, currentRect.y + cellHeight + 5), 18, 1, TextColor)
	end

	if aRect.MouseIsInRect(currentRect) and element.tooltip then
		local mx = rl.GetMouseX and rl.GetMouseX() or currentRect.x
		local my = rl.GetMouseY and rl.GetMouseY() or currentRect.y
		updateTooltip(dt, tostring(element) .. "_dropdown", element.tooltip, mx, my)
	end

	local leftOverhang = math.max(0, (labelWidth - cellWidth) / 2)
	return cellWidth + leftOverhang + (element.padding or 10)
end

local function renderSeperator(xPos, windowData, element, dt)
	local winX, winY = windowData.x, windowData.y + 80
	local key = element
	local aereonElement = componentCache[key]
	if not aereonElement then
		aereonElement = gui.divider({
			x = winX + xPos,
			y = winY + 5,
			width = element.width or 2,
			height = element.height or 70,
			color = element.color or Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2),
			vertical = false,
		})
		componentCache[key] = aereonElement
	end

	aereonElement.set("x", winX + xPos)
	aereonElement.set("y", winY + 5)
	aereonElement.render(dt)

	return (element.width or 2) + (element.padding or 20)
end

local NewToolbarElement = Signal.new()
ishared.NewToolbarElement = NewToolbarElement

NewToolbarElement:Connect(function(categoryName, elementName, element)
	if not categoryRegistry[categoryName] then
		categoryRegistry[categoryName] = {
			title = categoryName,
			elements = {},
		}
	end

	categoryRegistry[categoryName].elements[elementName] = element
end)

game.EngineSignal:Connect(function(route, name, data)
	if route == "NewToolbarCategory" then
		categoryRegistry[name] = data
	end
end)

local function drawCategories(windowData, dt)
	local buttonWidth = 100
	local buttonHeight = 30
	local padding = 5

	local categoryCount = 0
	for _ in pairs(categoryRegistry) do
		categoryCount += 1
	end

	local extraPadding = 5
	local totalWidth = categoryCount * buttonWidth + math.max(0, (categoryCount - 1) * padding)
	local width = totalWidth + extraPadding

	local height = 35
	local x = windowData.x + (windowData.width - width) / 2
	local y = windowData.y + 35

	local Categories = aRect.new(x, y, width, height)
	rl.DrawRectangleRounded(aRect:translate(Categories), 0.5, 18, backgroundColor)

	local startX = x + extraPadding / 2
	local i = 0
	for name, category in pairs(categoryRegistry) do
		local key = "CategoryTab_" .. name
		local aereonElement = componentCache[key]
		if not aereonElement then
			aereonElement = gui.textButton({
				x = startX + i * (buttonWidth + padding),
				y = y + (height - buttonHeight) / 2,
				width = buttonWidth,
				height = buttonHeight,
				text = name,
				backgroundColor = Color3.new(0.12549, 0.12549, 0.12549),
				hoverColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
				pressColor = Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor,
				textColor = Theme.TextColor,
				rounded = { 0.5, 5 },
				onClick = function()
					currentlySelected = name
				end,
			})
			componentCache[key] = aereonElement
		end

		aereonElement.set(
			"obj_rect",
			aRect.new(startX + i * (buttonWidth + padding), y + (height - buttonHeight) / 2, buttonWidth, buttonHeight)
		)
		if currentlySelected == name then
			aereonElement.set("backgroundColor", Theme.SecondaryBackgroundColor)
		else
			aereonElement.set("backgroundColor", Color3.new(0.12549, 0.12549, 0.12549))
		end
		aereonElement.render(dt)

		i += 1
	end
end

fileMenu:hide()

local fileMenuVisible = false
local wasFileMenuShowing = false

window.tabChanged = function(self, index, tab)
	if tab and tab.name == "File" then
		if fileMenuVisible then
			fileMenu:hide()
			fileMenuVisible = false
			propback:SetTab(nil)
		else
			fileMenu:show()
			fileMenuVisible = true
		end
	else
		if fileMenuVisible then
			fileMenu:hide()
			fileMenuVisible = false
		end
	end
end

	end

		return

	ishared.ToolbarMinimized = propback.Minimized

local function renderImageDropdownButton(xPos, name, element, windowData, dt)
	local winX, winY = windowData.x, windowData.y + 80
	local cellWidth = element.width or 60
	local cellHeight = element.height or 60
	local dropHeight = element.dropHeight or 22
	local totalHeight = cellHeight + dropHeight
	local labelWidth = name and measureTextWidth(name) or 0
	local effectiveWidth = math.max(cellWidth, labelWidth + 10)

	local btnKey = element
	local aereonElement = componentCache[btnKey]
	if not aereonElement then
		aereonElement = gui.button({
			x = winX + xPos,
			y = winY,
			width = effectiveWidth,
			height = cellHeight,
			text = "",
			backgroundTransparency = 1,
			backgroundColor = element.backgroundColor or Color3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.18),
			hoverColor = element.hoverColor or Color3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35),
			onClick = function()
				if element.callback then
					element.callback(element, aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY, effectiveWidth, cellHeight))
				end
			end,
		})
		componentCache[btnKey] = aereonElement
	end

	local btnRect = aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY, effectiveWidth, cellHeight)
	aereonElement.set("obj_rect", btnRect)
	aereonElement.render(dt)

	if element.texture then
		local scale = element.scale or 2.0
		local texW = element.texture.x * scale
		local texH = element.texture.y * scale
		local iconX = btnRect.x + effectiveWidth / 2 - texW / 2
		local iconY = btnRect.y + cellHeight / 2 - texH / 2
		rl.DrawTexturePro(
			element.texture.texture,
			structs.Rectangle:new({ x = 0, y = 0, width = element.texture.x, height = element.texture.y }),
			aRect:translate(aRect.new(iconX, iconY, texW, texH)),
			vector.create(0, 0),
			element.rotation or 0,
			ImageColor
		)
	end

	local dropKey = tostring(element) .. "_idd_drop"
	local dropElement = componentCache[dropKey]
	if not dropElement then
		local opts = {}
		local maxItemWidth = 0
		for _, opt in ipairs(element.options or {}) do
			table.insert(opts, opt.label)
			local itemWidth = measureTextWidth(opt.label or "")
			maxItemWidth = math.max(maxItemWidth, itemWidth)
		end
		effectiveWidth = math.max(effectiveWidth, maxItemWidth + 20)

		dropElement = gui.dropdown({
			x = winX + xPos,
			y = winY + cellHeight,
			width = effectiveWidth,
			height = dropHeight,
			options = opts,
			selectedIndex = element.defaultIndex or 1,
			backgroundColor = element.dropBackgroundColor or Color3.new(0.13, 0.13, 0.13),
			hoverColor = element.hoverColor or Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3),
			textColor = Theme.TextColor,
			backgroundTransparency = 1,
			borderTransparency = 1,
			onSelect = function(idx, optLabel)
				local opt
				for _, o in ipairs(element.options or {}) do
					if o.label == optLabel then
						opt = o
						break
					end
				end
				if opt then
					element._selected = opt.label
					if opt.onClick then
						opt.onClick(opt)
					end
					if element.onSelect then
						element.onSelect(opt)
					elseif element.callback then
						element.callback(opt)
					end
				end
			end,
		})
		componentCache[dropKey] = dropElement
	end

	local dropRect = aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY + cellHeight, effectiveWidth + 100, dropHeight)
	dropElement.set("obj_rect", dropRect)

	if element._selected then
		local idx = 1
		for i, o in ipairs(element.options or {}) do
			if o.label == element._selected then
				idx = i
				break
			end
		end
		dropElement.set("selectedIndex", idx)
	end

	dropElement.render(dt)

	local fullRect = aRect.new(winX + xPos, winY, effectiveWidth, totalHeight)
	if aRect.MouseIsInRect(fullRect) and element.tooltip then
		local mx = rl.GetMouseX and rl.GetMouseX() or winX + xPos
		local my = rl.GetMouseY and rl.GetMouseY() or winY
		updateTooltip(dt, tostring(element) .. "_idd", element.tooltip, mx, my)
	end

	return effectiveWidth + (element.padding or 5)
end

propback.stepped = function(propback)
	if propback.title == "Toolbar" then
		Theme = game:GetService("StudioThemeService").SelectedTheme
		backgroundColor = Theme.BackgroundColor:ToRaylib(Theme.BackgroundTransparency)
		TextColor = Theme.TextColor:ToRaylib(Theme.TextTransparency)
		ImageColor = Theme.ImageColor:ToRaylib(Theme.ImageTransparency)
		vend = KinemiumFontService.GetDefaultFont()

		local dt = KinemiumRaylib.GetLib().GetFrameTime()
		tooltipState.hoveredKey = nil
		local totalElementsWidth = 0
		local category = categoryRegistry[currentlySelected]
		if category then
			for _, element in pairs(category.elements) do
				if element.type == "Separator" then
					totalElementsWidth = totalElementsWidth + 20
				elseif element.type == "Custom" then
					totalElementsWidth = totalElementsWidth + (element.width or 50) + (element.padding or 20)
				else
					totalElementsWidth = totalElementsWidth + (element.width or 100) + (element.padding or 5)
				end
			end
		end

		drawCategories(propback, dt)

		local toolbarContent
		toolbarContent = {
			get_rect = function()
				return aRect.new(0, 0, totalElementsWidth + 30, 50)
			end,
			set = function(prop, value)
				if prop == "obj_rect" then
					toolbarContent.rect = value
				end
			end,
			render = function(dt)
				local r = toolbarContent.rect
				local renderX = r.x
				local winY = propback.y + 80

				if category then
					local elements = category.elements
					for _, element in pairs(elements) do
						if element.type == "ImageButton" then
							local width = renderButton(renderX - propback.x, element.text, element, propback, dt)
							renderX = renderX + width
						elseif element.type == "ToggleButton" then
							local width = renderToggleButton(renderX - propback.x, element.text, element, propback, dt)
							renderX = renderX + width
						elseif element.type == "DropdownButton" then
							local width =
								renderDropdownButton(renderX - propback.x, element.text, element, propback, dt)
							renderX = renderX + width
						elseif element.type == "ImageDropdownButton" then
							local width =
								renderImageDropdownButton(renderX - propback.x, element.text, element, propback, dt)
							renderX = renderX + width
						elseif element.type == "Separator" then
							local width = renderSeperator(renderX - propback.x, propback, element, dt)
							renderX = renderX + width
						elseif element.type == "Custom" then
							if element.render then
								local cellWidth = element.width or 50
								local cellHeight = element.height or 50
								local padding = element.padding or 20
								element.render(aRect, {
									x = renderX,
									y = winY,
									width = cellWidth,
									height = cellHeight,
									window = propback,
								})
								renderX = renderX + cellWidth + padding
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end,
		}

		if not scrollableToolbar then
			scrollableToolbar = gui.scrollable({
				child = toolbarContent,
				direction = "horizontal",
				scrollbarWidth = 4,
				scrollbarColor = Theme.Accent,
				scrollbarHoverColor = Theme.Accent,
				scrollbarBackgroundTransparency = 1,
			})
		end

		scrollableToolbar.set("child", toolbarContent)
		local toolbarWidth = propback.width - 30
		scrollableToolbar.set("obj_rect", aRect.new(propback.x + 15, propback.y + 80, toolbarWidth, 100))
		scrollableToolbar.set("contentWidth", totalElementsWidth + 30)
		scrollableToolbar.render(dt)

		if tooltipState.hoveredKey == nil then
			tooltipState.hoverTimer = 0
			tooltipState.visible = false
		end

		if tooltipState.visible then
			drawTooltip(tooltipState.text, tooltipState.x, tooltipState.y)
		end

		if renderFileMenu then
			if rl.IsKeyPressed(256) == 1 then
				fileMenu:hide()
				fileMenuVisible = false
				renderFileMenu = false
				-- Deselect the File tab
				propback:SetTab(nil)
			end

			-- Block input for buttons under the file menu
			local menuObjRect = fileMenu.get("obj_rect")
			if menuObjRect and arectlib.MouseIsInRect(menuObjRect) then
				_G.__aereon_blockInput = true
			end

			fileMenu.render(dt)

			_G.__aereon_blockInput = false
			renderFileMenu = false
		end
	end
end

local function findCharacterModelForPlayer(player)
	if not player then
		return nil
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if child.ClassName == "Model" and child.FindFirstChildOfClass then
			local humanoid = child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				local uid = child.GetAttribute and child:GetAttribute("__characterUserId")
				if type(uid) == "number" and uid == player.UserId then
					return child
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local byName = workspace:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
	if byName and byName.ClassName == "Model" and byName.FindFirstChildOfClass then
		if byName:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			return byName
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function resolveCharacter(player)
	local character = player.Character or findCharacterModelForPlayer(player)
	if not character then
		return nil
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or not humanoid.RootPart then
		return nil
	end

	return character, humanoid
end

local zoomDist = 12
local character
local humanoid
local rootPart
local yaw
local pitch
local smoothCamPos
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()

local function bindCharacter(nextCharacter, nextHumanoid)
	character = nextCharacter
	humanoid = nextHumanoid
	rootPart = humanoid.RootPart

	local rootLook = rootPart.CFrame:GetLookVector()
	yaw = math.atan2(-rootLook.X, -rootLook.Z)
	pitch = math.rad(15)
	smoothCamPos = rootPart.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 8, zoomDist)
	rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
end

local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
while not localPlayer do
	task.wait()
	localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
end

character, humanoid = resolveCharacter(localPlayer)
while not character do
	task.wait()
	character, humanoid = resolveCharacter(localPlayer)
end
game.StopCameraInput = true

bindCharacter(character, humanoid)

local cursorDisabled = false

local function setCursorDisabled(disabled)
	if disabled == cursorDisabled then
		return
	end
	cursorDisabled = disabled
	if disabled then
		UserInputService:DisableCursor()
	else
		UserInputService:EnableCursor()
	end
end

UserInputService.MouseWheel:Connect(function(input)
	local delta = input and input.Delta or 0
	if delta > 0 then
		zoomDist = math.max(CAM_ZOOM_MIN, zoomDist / CAM_ZOOM_MUL)
	elseif delta < 0 then
		zoomDist = math.min(CAM_ZOOM_MAX, zoomDist * CAM_ZOOM_MUL)
	end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()

	CAM_ZOOM_MIN = localPlayer.CameraMinZoomDistance
	CAM_ZOOM_MAX = localPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance

	if
		not character
		or not humanoid
		or character.Parent == nil
		or humanoid.Parent == nil
		or humanoid.RootPart == nil
	then
		local nextCharacter, nextHumanoid = resolveCharacter(localPlayer)
		if not nextCharacter then
			return
		end

		bindCharacter(nextCharacter, nextHumanoid)
	end

	rootPart = humanoid.RootPart or rootPart
	if not rootPart or rootPart.Parent == nil then
		return
	end

	local camera = workspace.Camera
	if not camera then
		return
	end

	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head then
		return
	end

	local isFirstPerson = zoomDist <= 0.5
	local rmb = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonDown(Enum.MouseButton.Right)

	local sens = isFirstPerson and CAM_SENS_FP or CAM_SENS

	if isFirstPerson or rmb then
		setCursorDisabled(true)
		yaw = yaw - math.rad(delta.X * sens)
		pitch = math.clamp(pitch - math.rad(delta.Y * sens), math.rad(CAM_MIN_Y), math.rad(CAM_MAX_Y))
	else
		setCursorDisabled(false)
		flushDelta()
	end

	local camRot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(yaw, pitch, 0)

	if isFirstPerson then
		local firstPersonPos = head.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		smoothCamPos = firstPersonPos

		camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(firstPersonPos) * camRot
		rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position) * CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(yaw, 0, 0)

		character.Head.Transparency = 1

		humanoid.TurnSpeed = 999
		humanoid:Face(Vector3.new(-math.sin(yaw), 0, -math.cos(yaw)))

		localPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
	else
		localPlayer.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic

		local focusPos = head.CFrame.Position
		local camOffset = camRot * Vector3.new(0, 0, zoomDist)
		local targetCamPos = focusPos + camOffset

		local rayVector = targetCamPos - focusPos
		local finalCamPos = targetCamPos
		if rayVector:Magnitude() > 1e-4 then
			local camHit = workspace:Raycast(focusPos, rayVector, rayParams)
			if camHit then
				finalCamPos = focusPos + rayVector:Unit() * math.max(camHit.Distance - 0.3, 0.1)
			end
		end

		for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
					continue
				end
				part.Transparency = 0
			end
		end

		camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(finalCamPos, focusPos)

		humanoid.TurnSpeed = 18
		humanoid:ClearFacingDirection()
	end

	local moveInput = ZERO
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
		moveInput += Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
		moveInput += Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
		moveInput += Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)
	end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
		moveInput += Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
	end

	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then

Created thread src/sandboxed/editablemesh_demo.luau: 
  Success: true
